title: Bully Ray Suggests Alternate Finish To Raw Bloodline Brawl
raw_title: Bully Ray Would Have Changed One Thing About WWE Raw Angle With 946 & The Bloodline
summary_src: WWE Hall of Famer Bully Ray explains how would have kept everything about the latest Bloodline-946 segment the same, except for its finish.
body: On "Busted Open Radio," Ray explained that he would have kept everything about the latest Bloodline-946 segment the same, except for its finish. "946 beats down The Bloodline. Roman's entrance, the John Wayne walk, the four-on-four in the middle, the big schmoz, everything," Ray said, "and just when you think The Bloodline are going to get the upper hand, everybody has spilled out of the ring, Roman Reigns just hit a big Superman Punch on whoever, Carmelo Hayes in the back door with that tire iron he was carrying to the ring. Crack Roman right in the back of the head ... and he goes down." Carmelo Hayes, a former WWE United States Champion, is the newest addition to 946, having just debuted among the terrorizing group last week. In that case, Hayes struck down Jimmy Uso, Jey Uso, and Solo Sikoa with a crowbar. This week, he found himself on the receiving end of a Samoan Spike from Sikoa before rolling out of the ring. In Ray's preferred scenario, Hayes would have nailed "The OTC" Roman Reigns with a crowbar instead this week, with his new allies then helping him continue the attack until they felt satisfied with themselves. "When the rest of The Bloodline run in to check on him, because it's freaking Roman, that's when 946 pours it on again," Ray added. "And you don't have to have 946 standing over The Bloodline like we saw last week, but they give them their shots, and then they get out of dodge."
summary: Bully Ray praised the latest segment pitting 946 against The Bloodline on Raw but would have altered only the conclusion. In his vision, after the brawl spilled outside the ring and Roman Reigns delivered a Superman Punch, Carmelo Hayes would have struck Reigns in the back of the head with a tire iron instead of taking a Samoan Spike from Solo Sikoa. Hayes had previously used a crowbar on Jimmy Uso, Jey Uso and Sikoa in his debut with the group the previous week.

body: Edge More Share Options More Share Options Share close facebook x threads email superstar stats Superstar Stats Edge Buy the Song Career Highlights WWE Champion; World Heavyweight Champion; World Tag Team Champion; WWE Tag Team Champion; Intercontinental Champion; WCW U.S. Champion; 2001 King of the Ring; Money in the Bank Ladder Match winner; Royal Rumble Match winner (2010, 2021); 2012 WWE Hall of Fame Inductee In another life, Edge could have been a rock star. From his voluminous hair to his long leather jackets and double-horns signature pose, every detail of his WWE image screamed it. As the pyro blasted into the air behind him on the entranceway before he stepped into the ring, he injected arenas with the energy of a packed concert – without the dangers of crowd-surfing and mosh pits. There was even a legion of groupies – Edgeheads – who tracked his every move. It's no surprise, then, that Edge is a guitar collector and grew up listening to KISS, a band famous for their flamboyant outfits and outrageous stage antics. What is a surprise is how a shy high schooler from the little town of Orangeville, Ontario, evolved into The Rated-R Superstar. Edge had some fine company as he worked his way up the independent scene in the '90s: his childhood friend and partner for countless five-second poses, Christian. When Edge was signed to a WWE contract in 1997, it was only a matter of time before Christian would also climb the ladder, following his best bud into uncharted territory. "E&C" made sweet music as a tag team, using a lot more than just Con-Chair-Tos to claim seven championships together. A Triple Threat Ladder Match victory at WrestleMania 2000 over The Hardy Boyz and The Dudley Boyz laid the foundation for a series of landmark Tables, Ladders & Chairs (TLC) contests, and some of the greatest tag team action of all time. Of course, tag teaming wasn't Edge's only specialty, as he masterfully crafted a singles career and captured a whopping 31 total titles – many of them the WWE Universe didn't even see coming. Beyond his ability to capitalize on opportunities, Edge became known as The Master Manipulator because he wasn't afraid to cross the line in order to rattle the competition. After he made history in 2006 as the first man to ever cash in the Money in the Bank contract, he rubbed his WWE Championship triumph in the face of all challengers with an R-rated celebration on Raw; more explicitly, a frolicking good time with Lita on a bed placed right in the middle of the squared circle. Mind games were taken to a whole new level by the self-proclaimed "most-watched champion." A debilitating injury forced Edge to retire in 2011 but, in the 2020 Royal Rumble Match, The Ultimate Opportunist made an incredible return to the squared circle and immediately set out to add numerous epic matches to hs already storied career. 24:16 Karl Anderson More Share Options More Share Options Share close facebook x threads email Faction reveals that shook WWE: WWE

title: On the Record: Dave Meltzer Breaks Down Past Health Issues Faced By Late AEW Star PAC
raw_title: Dave Meltzer Discusses Past Health Issues Faced By Late AEW Star PAC
body: Dave Meltzer has discussed the health issues previously experienced by late AEW star PAC, whose real name was Benjamin Satterley, following the official determination of his cause of death. The Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office ruled that Satterley died from bronchial asthma and classified his death as natural. He was 40. Speaking on Wrestling Observer Radio, Meltzer said the wrestler had experienced health problems before his death, including blood-clot issues in 2023 and problems affecting his lungs. Meltzer said a friend had informed him about PAC’s medical history. Meltzer also discussed the uncertainty surrounding whether Satterley had access to an inhaler during the fatal episode. (via WrestlingInc) “We don’t know if he had an inhaler in his car. He did have lung issues. This isn’t something that came out of nowhere that nobody knew. I don’t know how well it was known, but one of his friends had told me that … he had the blood clot issues in 2023, and said that he had some lung issues. And so the lung issues are consistent with what happened unfortunately. Usually, you’d have the inhaler with you and I don’t know, it may have happened so quick. There was stuff in his rental car, but it may have happened so quick that he wasn’t able to get it. It’s a horrible situation the more you learn about it. It doesn’t get better, it gets worse,” he said. Satterley competed as PAC in AEW and Neville in WWE. He was found unresponsive behind the wheel of a rental car in a parking lot in Des Plaines, Illinois, on September 27, hours after he competed at All Out. AEW dedicated its September 30 episode of Dynamite to Satterley’s life and career.

title: Ilja Dragunov explains WWE exit and AEW arrival
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov talks his AEW fairy tale & WWE regrets, Gunther’s booking
body: Link Ricky Havlik for All Elite Wrestling Fresh off a Saturday night debut at AEW’s WrestleDream PPV, and with his first AEW match tomorrow night on Dynamite to promote, Ilja Dragunov stopped by The Ariel Helwani Show this afternoon (Oct. 20). Dragunov left WWE when his last contract expired, and spoke a little bit about that decision and the one to join AEW at the post-PPV media scrum, but he went a little more in depth with Helwani. The lack of creative for his character after dropping the United States title last December was a red flag for the Mad Dragon: ”After I dropped the belt, things kind of went in directions where I felt like, ok, it could have been better. There could have been more time to go into a story, into something that is outside of just holding a championship, captivating for the people… It never changed anything about my work mentality, because I love what I do, and I make every minute count for myself. But we all have feelings, and… especially if we’re in a business like this, we want to devote ourselves to this…” “There was no intention of the company to let me go… It was an accumulation of a lot of things. Of course, the offering, because we all know at the end of the day, it’s a business. But also, it’s definitely based on my feeling of how I want to work creatively. I spent most of my twenties in WWE. That’s a very, very long time, and the landscape in this beautiful business changed… the expiration of my contract came and the negotiations didn’t lead anywhere. There was nothing that I felt satisfying. Nothing that gave me the perspective of, ‘Oo, I must stick with what I have here.’ I had a gut feeling. I think things will work out for me, that I can bet on myself… Change always requires guts. It requires courage. It requires dealing with the possibility that things could not work out your way. It all came down to betting on myself and believing it’s going to be all right.” That also sets up a great line from Ilja about the polarizing reaction he gets from wrestling fandom: “I don’t see it as a defeat. I’m glad that people are upset for me, and maybe it could have worked out a different way… “I have two categories of people watching my work. Either people who are extremely behind me, really get me, really get emotionally invested in me, or it’s the polar opposite, the people who think I’m the cringiest person in the world. But I love it that way because people care.” This clip also includes Helwani asked if Dragunov leaves with any regrets, which he dismisses with, “No, why should I?” before talking about what he got out of his seven years there, and expressing gratitude for the opportunities he got during that time. Asking about his old friend and epic rival Gunther’s booking this year got Dragunov to be slightly critical of his old company: “I guess my feelings the same feeling as a lot of other people share — if you are the person to retire John Cena, it’s kind of like a standard that you should keep a certain level
summary: Ilja Dragunov discussed his decision to depart WWE after his contract expired, citing a lack of creative direction for his character following the loss of the United States title last December. The performer expressed that he desired more storytelling opportunities beyond championship reigns to better connect with audiences while maintaining his strong work ethic. He made his AEW debut at WrestleDream on Saturday and is set for his first match on Dynamite this week.

title: Prime Video Adds More Wrestling as MLW Expands Streaming Reach
raw_title: Prime Video Adds More Wrestling as MLW Expands Streaming Reach
body: Wrestling fans have another place to watch Major League Wrestling (MLW), but the latest streaming deal comes with a catch. MLW has announced that its flagship weekly series, MLW Fusion , is now available to purchase on Amazon Prime Video, giving fans another way to watch matches, follow rivalries, and revisit past episodes. This is not a new show included at no extra cost with a Prime membership, as the latest deal lets viewers purchase full seasons for $26.99 or individual episodes for $1.99. “MLW belongs on the biggest platforms, and Amazon Prime Video is another significant step in that direction,” said MLW Founder and CEO Court Bauer in a statement. For fans who prefer buying individual episodes or seasons rather than relying on a rotating streaming catalog, the new option provides another way to access the show. Still, viewers looking to avoid another expense have other choices. “We’re making it easier for fans to discover and experience Fusion, follow the rivalries and revisit the fights that get everyone talking. This gives our fans another way to watch and opens the door for a new audience to experience MLW,” Bauer said The Prime Video announcement doesn’t replace MLW’s existing free streaming options. Instead, the deal is the latest in a series of moves by MLW to get its programming in front of more viewers. Then, in September, MLW added Tubi as a home for new weekly episodes . The promotion’s flagship series airs on Tubi every Thursday at 8:00 PM ET, giving fans a way to follow without paying for an additional subscription. Now, Prime Video joins YouTube, VEEPS, Tubi, and NJPW WORLD as streaming destinations for MLW programming; however, with Amazon, the promotion is taking a different approach. Rather than relying exclusively on a free, ad-supported service, the promotion can also sell individual episodes and full seasons to viewers who prefer to purchase their content.

llm_long: Speedball Mike Bailey has spoken about the approach of Will Ospreay in the ring. Bailey noted that Ospreay shows no hesitation in any movement or decision and commits fully to everything he does.
Ospreay currently holds the AEW World Championship and leads the United Empire's US branch. The faction also includes Speedball Mike Bailey, Andrade El Idolo, the Brawling Birds, and Francisco Akira.

Bailey pointed out that Ospreay's complete commitment can sometimes lead to overcommitting or making overly quick decisions. He described this as a potential flaw but emphasized that watching Ospreay perform remains impressive.
Bailey first experienced Ospreay's style during their match at PWG in 2015. He observed that the same level of force and forward momentum has stayed consistent throughout Ospreay's career.
This consistent full commitment is what Bailey believes has elevated Ospreay to his current position as AEW World Champion.

title: In Memoriam: Pac’s (Ben Satterley) cause of death determined
raw_title: Pac’s (Ben Satterley) cause of death determined
body: Pac’s cause of death has been determined to have been from bronchial asthma by the Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office in Illinois. His death was ruled as being the result of natural causes. Pac died on Sept. 27 one day after wrestling on AEW’s All Out PPV. Satterley’s body was spotted by a witness in a rental car about on a street about a mile from O’Hare International Airport in Chicago and that person called 911, according to information made available by the Cook County medical examiner’s office. “Benjamin Satterley, who performed under the name ‘Pac,’ was found dead about 4 p.m. Sunday in Des Plaines, according to the Cook County medical examiner’s office.” There were no signs of foul play or trauma when Pac’s body was discovered according to the report. The Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office report on Pac’s cause of death was first reported by The New York Post.
summary: The latest: pac’s cause of death has been determined to have been from bronchial asthma by the Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office in Illinois. His death was ruled as being the result of natural causes.

title: Cappuccino Jones confirms exit from WWE ID program

body: Cappuccino Jones is the latest talent to confirm that his WWE ID contract has come to an end. PWinsider.com reported on Tuesday that Jones and Santi Rivera were no longer part of the ID program, and later in the day, Jones confirmed the report . After 2 years, my time in WWE ID has come to an end, as I’ve decided to part ways. I’m grateful for all of the knowledge, experience, & wisdom that I’ve attained and will take with me for the rest of my career. Thank you WWE. i’m ready for my next cup. Do ya dig it? Jones, 24, was signed to a WWE ID deal in 2024 and began performing on EVOLVE. Jones was the men’s ID champion for seven months, beginning in August 2025 when he beat Jack Cartwheel in a tournament to crown the inaugural champion. He dropped the title this past March to Starboy Charlie, a.k.a. Chazz Hall. Jones joins Laynie Luck, Marcus Mathers, and Sam Holloway among the ID talents whose deals have ended over the past week.

title: Comeback Watch: Jordynne Grace Reportedly Absent From WWE Creative Despite Previously Planned Return
raw_title: Jordynne Grace Reportedly Absent From WWE Creative Despite Previously Planned Return
body: 0 Jordynne Grace has been absent from WWE TV for several months, and the latest backstage reports suggest the company has no current plans for her return. The former TNA Knockouts World Champion is reportedly healthy and has been around the WWE roster despite her absence from TV. WWE had previously considered pairing her with Ivy Nile in a new tag team, but those plans appear to have stalled. The team could have given both wrestlers a fresh direction. Reports also suggested that the pairing might have been linked to the trademarked name “Iron Built.” However, WWE has yet to officially announce the team or reveal when Grace might return. It’s also unclear whether the previously filmed segments will eventually air or if WWE has decided to take things in a different direction. For now, no confirmed return date for Grace has come to light. The latest WrestleVotes report also suggests that fans shouldn’t expect her to return to television anytime soon. During a recent WrestleVotes Q&A, JoeyVotes and TC were asked about Grace’s status and when fans might see her return to WWE TV. “The thing that I’ve heard recently is she’s not in the creative plans. That doesn’t mean they don’t want plans for her,” JoeyVotes said (H/T: Ringside News ). He also pointed to the crowded women’s division on SmackDown as a possible reason for her absence. Many superstars are already involved in ongoing storylines, leaving less time for others to appear on TV. “They’ve got full-blown stories. They’ve got Fatal Influence, Charlotte’s group, Jade Cargill’s group. That’s one story. They’ve got Tiffany with the briefcase. They’ve got Nikki and Paige and Chelsea Green. That’s another story,” he explained. As a result, Grace may have to wait for the right opportunity to make her reentry into television. body: Jimmy House is the latest talent to exit the WWE ID system, confirming the news on Tuesday. House confirmed with Fightful Select that he was released by WWE from the program. House added that Gabe Sapolsky’s guidance and advice was a major part of his getting signed. House is the latest talent to leave the WWE ID system in recent weeks, joining the likes of Laynie Luck , Marcus Mathers , Cappucino Jones , and more.

Whether it’s an absurd spot that brings time to a standstill, a sequence where communication breaks down, a cartoonish storyline that crosses the line into self-parody, or simply talent on screen you don't enjoy, these frustrations are inherent to the business. Yet, there are concrete steps that promoters and talent can take today to improve the presentation of professional wrestling and restore its physical credibility and narrative integrity, especially as it appears everyone is trapped under the weight and responsibility of producing a ludicrious amount of content per week. Think about this the next time you watch weekly pro wrestling TV: "Does Anybody Really Try to Win a Match Anymore?" There are too many matches today that exist purely to be performative, where a rush of things happening in the ring happen and then we move on to the next match. That isn't to say the athleticism isn't impressive, but the performers are not attempting to actually defeat each other within the context of the show, so the audience waits and reacts to the big spots or the run-in, treating what should be perceived as the meat and potatoes of the show as the parsley on the plate. This isn't news to anyone, but ninety-nine percent of the adult audience knows pro wrestling is a scripted work, but they do not want to be reminded of it. Just like going to a movie where you accept the internal logic of superheroes against supervillains once the lights dim in the theater and the Marvel logo appears, wrestling fans want to immerse themselves in the internal logic of the show once the first bell rings and that's something that needs to be worked on, because everything seems so haphazard in presentation up and down the board. Something as simple as punches need to mean something again. The punch was literally the hallmark for Hulk Hogan and Jerry Lawler in the height of their fame. Instead today, so many matches have that back-and-forth "yay/boo" strike exchange that exists solely to elicit a canned audience response rather than reflecting the logic of a real fight. If punching someone back-and-forth isn't working, a believable fighter would try something else, right? One of the reasons current day WWE's version of AAA works is that when punches are thrown, in most instances, they are meaningful and they are presented like they are weapons being used in battle. It takes time to get those little things back over and I understand in the crunch of production, time is a commodity that isn't offered when your back is against the wall, but at some point, the scales needs to be adjusted or else pro wrestling will one day evolve into looking like

title: Ospreay and Copeland team on Dynamite
raw_title: AEW Dynamite: Will Ospreay teams with Adam Copeland, Dragunov’s opponent revealed, Maya World returns
summary_src: Will Ospreay will team with Adam Copeland, and an opponent has been revealed for Ilja Dragunov’s AEW in-ring debut.
body: Will Ospreay will team with Adam Copeland, and an opponent has been revealed for Ilja Dragunov’s AEW in-ring debut. The post-WrestleDream edition of Dynamite on Wednesday is set to feature a first-time team-up involving Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland against Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. The match was teased at the post-show press conference this past Saturday and comes after Ospreay and Copeland were featured in the Clockwork Carnage match. In the final seconds, Ospreay hit Copeland with the Hidden Blade and pinned him to win the match with his third fall. Last week, Copeland announced he would be retiring in 2027, and it was made clear that Ospreay and Copeland are expected to have a match for the title eventually. Ilja Dragunov will be taking on Speedball Mike Bailey in his first match with AEW. Dragunov debuted at WrestleDream, and it was announced he would wrestle on Dynamite. It will be Dragunov’s first match since April, after allowing his WWE contract to expire this past April and awaiting a visa to be processed before his arrival in the new company. Finally, Maya World will return to the ring on Wednesday and is scheduled for a #1 contender’s match against Queen Aminata for a shot at the TBS Championship. Maya World was injured last month after wrestling on the Rebel Heart edition of Dynamite on September 9. Dynamite is scheduled for the Watsco Center in Coral Gables, Florida, with WrestleTix reporting that approximately 3,000 tickets have been distributed .

Ilja Dragunov makes his in-ring debut for the promotion against Speedball Mike Bailey, his first match since leaving WWE in April. Maya World also returns on the show.

title: Top Takeaways From Lucha Underground Binge
raw_title: TOP FIVE LIST: Takeaways from bingeing four seasons of Lucha Underground including Penta, Rey Fenix, Ricochet, Inter-gender wrestling
body: Working in my own store that carries a lot of pro wrestling merchandise, I spend all day on Mondays with wrestling on the TV in-store. I will watch something until the start of Raw, then pick it back up the next week. In doing so, I was finally able to complete the entire series, and what a wild series it was. On the first episode, you saw Pentagon Jr. and Rey Fénix. They were never announced as brothers on this show, but there was a unique focus on these two characters. They were both incredible in the ring. The first time I watched years ago, I felt a little bit like I did when first watch Rey Mysterio Jr. arrive in WCW. The way Fénix worked the ropes was so unique. Pentagon had this unique charisma that you could not ignore. They were set up to be key characters, and the people running this show, including Konnan’s eye for talent, knew they had something special in these two. Mil Muertes was a reskinned Judas Masias, who came in as a possessed killer, paired with Catrina who controlled him to do her will. Santos Escobar was under a mask as King Cuerno. A hunter who came in to stalk his prey. I could not believe how mishandled this talent was in WWE after watching him perform in “The Temple.” Ricochet, again under a mask, was Puma, Konnan’s new protege, who was trying his talent against top tier opponents for the first time. My favorite character was Sexy Star. It was very unfortunate that she made the decisions she made to blackball her from a career she was very good at. A woman in an abusive relationship finally decided to stand up for herself, and become a fighter. She was able to fight off her abuser, and in doing so, realized she had everything it took to defeat men in a competitive fight. She even worked her way to being the promotion’s champion for a brief moment. Well-defined background, very good in the ring, and beautiful to attract viewers and look great on posters. Perhaps one of wrestling’s biggest losses, but that was a decision of the performer to deserve her fate of no longer being accepted. I was hesitant to accept this when I first viewed Lucha Underground, but came to not only accept it, but enjoy it. I have previously stated my appreciation for the character of Sexy Star, but I also liked seeing competent women mix it up with men, who were confident in selling offense and even taking clean losses to the women on the roster. In a world where we go to theaters and accept Wonder Woman, Harley Quinn, or Atomic Blonde as viable cinema, why can’t this extend to wrestling? I have often said that Asuka would make me more nervous to fight than many of the men on the roster. That said, I completely understand that corporate WWE will not be entertaining this again any time soon. We had Chyna as the Intercontinental Champion, but that was the exception that won’t be happening again any time soon. summary: A wrestling merchandise store owner completed all four seasons of Lucha Underground while watching in-store on Mondays ahead of Raw. title: Backstage Buzz: WWE’s Backstage Reaction to Bron Breakker’s Scary Neck Landing Revealed — Report
raw_title: WWE’s Backstage Reaction to Bron Breakker’s Scary Neck Landing Revealed — Report
body: 0 Bron Breakker suffered a scary neck landing during a live event on October 17 in Honolulu, Hawaii. Despite how dangerous the moment looked, the company reportedly wants to move on rather than extend the spotlight on the moment. The incident happened during a six-man tag team match. Breakker teamed up with Bronson Reed and Austin Theory to face Oba Femi, LA Knight, and Penta. During the match, Breakker attempted his usual top-rope Frankensteiner on Knight. However, Knight managed to escape the move, causing Breakker to land awkwardly on his neck . The landing immediately raised concerns, and the referee checked on Breakker. But despite the fall, the former NXT Champion continued wrestling and finished the match. While that was encouraging, the incident still raised questions about his condition. WWE has yet to confirm whether Breakker suffered an injury during the match. During a recent Q&A session, JoeyVotes and TC of WrestleVotes were asked about WWE’s reaction to Breakker’s frightening fall. According to WrestleVotes, officials don’t seem interested in making the incident a major talking point. “People backstage are like, ‘Let’s no-sell this a little bit and hope he’s done,’” WrestleVotes said (H/T: Ringside News ). “I’m sure there were medical personnel checking on him. But at the same time, they want to get over this quickly,” WrestleVotes added. One of the biggest takeaways from the WrestleVotes report is that nobody backstage is reportedly being blamed for what happened. Rather than treating the incident as a major mistake, WrestleVotes described it as an unfortunate accident during a non-televised event. “It was a house show — it was probably a simple sort of mistake. There’s no heat on anybody,” WrestleVotes explained. However, that doesn’t mean the company is ignoring how serious the landing could have been. Breakker’s health remains the main concern. The lack of a public injury announcement also doesn’t confirm he escaped the incident unscathed. For now, there is no clear update on his condition beyond the fact that he finished the match. As noted earlier this month, the former WWE star will be part of Chris Jericho’s Rock N Wrestling Rager At Sea from November 7th to 11th. title: Billy Gunn Calls Triple H's 2019 AEW Jab A Bad Move
raw_title: ‘A D— Move’: Billy Gunn Says Triple H’s 2019 AEW Jab Backfired
body: Skip to content Wrestling News Home » ‘A D— Move’: Billy Gunn Says Triple H’s 2019 AEW Jab Backfired Triple H’s response became one of the most memorable moments of the ceremony. However, Gunn is now offering his perspective on the exchange several years later. Speaking with Kenny McIntosh of Inside The Ropes , Gunn recalled anticipating a remark about AEW during the ceremony. He explained that the promotion was generating considerable interest at the time and that he expected Triple H to address his decision to join the company. “I knew it was coming. I kind of knew they were going to do something AEW because it was hot at the time and I was there and they were all wondering how I got to go there, and that’s because Tony Khan was super cool,” Gunn said. He also explained that AEW owner Tony Khan had supported his decision to attend the Hall of Fame ceremony despite working for a rival promotion. “I went, asked, and he said ‘100%. Of course you can. I would never hold you back from that,’” Gunn recalled. “I didn’t know what they were gonna do, but I knew they were going to do something. I also knew that if they were, Hunter was going to have something to say. Once I set myself up for that, I just let it go,” he explained. Gunn then offered his blunt assessment of the incident, arguing that Triple H was the one who suffered from the exchange. “The only one that got hurt out of that whole deal was him. I don’t want to say it, but it was a d*ck move,” Gunn said. He added that he believed the remark was an attempt to save face, despite there being little need for such a response. “It was kind of trying to save face, and you didn’t need to because it’s going to happen. It’s the wrestling business. It’s what we do. They like to stir up sh*t,” Gunn continued. [H/T Fightful ] During the 2019 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony, fans began chanting “AEW” while D-Generation X delivered its induction speech. Gunn had joked that Vince McMahon could not fire him because he worked for AEW. Triple H responded by saying McMahon would buy the company just to fire Gunn again, referring to AEW as a “pissant company.” The remark drew widespread attention as AEW prepared to launch its weekly television programme, Dynamite, later that year. The promotion subsequently established itself as WWE’s most prominent rival in the North American wrestling market. Gunn joined AEW in 2019, initially working as a coach before becoming a regular on-screen personality. He later teamed with his sons, Austin and Colten Gunn, before joining forces with The Acclaimed. Triple H, meanwhile, eventually took charge of WWE’s creative direction and became the company’s Chief Content Officer in 2022. body: October 20, 2026 By Corey Michaels AEW , North America , Pro Wrestling School is in session, and the leaves have lost their green. September has come and gone, with the autumnal breeze in full force. For All Elite Wrestling, the month has had many changes. Some amazing, some heartbreaking. AEW had a few special episodes and an incredible AEW All Out 2026 in Chicago, Illinois. September certainly was heavy for the company. That is why I’ve moved the Honorable Mentions from before the list to right after for this month. Grab a slice of Chicago-style deep dish pizza and join me as I recap which wrestlers stood out this month. Over half a month late, here’s who made my list! It’s still Swerve’s House, and his new roommates have made AEW their home remarkably quickly. Perhaps moreso with Kofi, as he acclimates to the AEW territory. Since New Level joined Strickland at AEW All In 2026 at the tail end of August, they’ve showcased an entirely different side to their wrestling style. Their moveset is quicker, and their agility more acrobatic; they’ve adjusted so well that you’d be forgiven for thinking they’d been in AEW for years. Leaving WWE may have been a heavy choice, but Austin and Kofi are making the most of their fresh digs. The triumvirate put their titles on the line at All Out 2026 against the previous holders, Hangman Adam Page and BroDido, in a near-25-minute clash that rivaled the other high-caliber matches at the pay-per-view. Fans were left in complete awe, both in the NOW Arena in Chicago and behind screens. Returning to Kofi, he hasn’t slouched one bit. No resting on laurels here. Having spent most of his life wrestling for WWE, he’s gotten cozy with a different way of performing. For Dragon Ball Z fans, Kofi wrestling under fewer limitations is the equivalent of Goku taking off his weighted clothing. This man stayed getting his reps in, facing Lee Moriarty and Bandido in early October. But that’s a story for another time, perhaps when I review October. Nevertheless, it’s safe to say New Level has found the grass was greener on the other side of the fence. Previously, wrestlers who’ve left WWE either used it as a stepping stone to return or leverage their star power. Thankfully, New Level appears to be in the league of those who believe in the company and want to see it grow. Their chemistry with Swerve is also notable. They’re hilarious together, with Strickland the straight man to New Level’s hilarity. In the same vein, they play the same role juxtaposed to Swerve’s sadistic, vitriolic side. body: The situation is also interesting because Blanchard recently spoke about MLW as if she were preparing for a bigger run with the promotion instead of a one-night appearance. During an interview with TMZ's Inside the Ring , Blanchard stated that she had big plans for the MLW Women's World Championship. MLW initially published an article announcing that Blanchard was joining the promotion and also added her to the company's official roster page. Both listings have since disappeared, leaving her status for this weekend's event unclear. The sudden changes have led to speculation that her MLW debut may no longer be happening. The timing is interesting because CMLL had already caused some confusion about Blanchard's MLW plans. Shortly after MLW announced her debut, the promotion said that September 12 was expected to be her only appearance for the company. According to PWInsider , Blanchard's name has now been removed from the MLW roster page . The announcement saying she was joining the promotion is also no longer available. Mike Johnson of PWInsider wrote that "all signs are that won't be happening." However, MLW has not officially confirmed that the booking is canceled. title: NXT Builds to Cruz vs Lennox Main Event
raw_title: WWE NXT Coverage: Dame Vs Diggs, Dusty Road Tag Classic Continues, Grayson Waller And Tony D’Angelo Face Off Ahead Of Halloween Havoc
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin WWE NXT COVERAGE: DAME VS DIGGS, DUSTY ROAD TAG CLASSIC CONTINUES, GRAYSON WALLER AND TONY D’ANGELO FACE OFF AHEAD OF HALLOWEEN HAVOC By Eric Lewis on 2026-10-20 20:27:00 Welcome to PWInsider’s coverage of WWE NXT on The CW Network in the U.S. and on Netflix here in Canada and around the globe. Thanks to Mike Johnson for filling in for me last week! The show opens right away with a serious narrated promo for tonight’s main event, Cruz Montana versus DarkState leader Dion Lennox. The match was put over as a clash of personalities and upbringings. They cut briefly to Cruz and Dion each arriving at the WWE Performance Center in Orlando, FL, then we’re inside the arena, and Tony D’Angelo is on his way to the ring with something to say. Vic Joseph and Booker T are on the call. Grayson reminds the NXT audience that he and Tony entered WWE right around the same time. They’ve teamed together and had similar career arcs, but they’ve never really faced off. Grayson said he looks forward to taking out Tony. Tony says Waller always resented him. Waller said he’s right. Tony was chosen, but it took Grayson longer to get the spotlight he deserves. Tony says Waller still hides behind one-liners and memes because he’s desperate for attention. “You’re just a troll!” Waller said it’s called having a personality, but Tony left his personality in the fedora he used to wear. We cut to the women’s locker room earlier in the day, where Izzi Dame is upset because apparently Zaria packed up decorations Dame had set up at Zaria’s locker space. Skylar Rae and Layla Diggs ask Dame why she won’t simply leave Zaria alone. They assume it’s about the North American title. Dame says it’s not that simple. Diggs and Dame go back and forth, and we learn that they’ll have a match later that night. Vic Joseph begins to tell us what is in store for NXT tonight when suddenly BirthRight cuts in with a promo from outside the building. They say they’re going to win tonight in the Dusty Tag Team Classic. Match #1: Dusty Rhodes Tag Classic: Birthright’s Charlie Dempsey and Lexis King vs. AAA Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. & Galeno Joseph notes that Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo was injured on a Canadian tour over the weekend and is not cleared to compete, which is why he’s been replaced by his BirthRight stablemate Lexis King. Dempsey and Wagner start the match. It’s a technical fight at first. They’re trying to take each other down. This seems like Dempsey’s specialty, but they’re evenly matched. They each make tags. We see Hank and Tank backstage getting ready for their match later tonight. The other members of BirthRight get involved outside the ring. Ariana Grace distracts the referee, so Wagner leaps over the ref and nails a senton on King, Dempsey, and Uriah Connors on the outside. After a break, Dempsey has Wagner in an arm bar. He’s methodically wearing him down. The crowd is split between the two.

body: "I remember the guys there were telling me how impressed they were with Claudio, because Claudio would fly in there, and they would do these singles matches, and he would not get tired," Meltzer said. "And you know, the Mexicans don't get tired because they wrestle in that altitude. But a lot of the Americans have trouble." Castagnoli has not only shown no difficulty adapting to the elements in Arena Mexico, but has thrived there, winning the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship last fall and holding it for several months. Perhaps more impressively, Castagnoli was recently part of the CMLL International Gran Prix, and alongside fellow AEW/CMLL star Hechicero wrestled the entire match, which lasted a little less than seventy four minutes. CMLL's respect for Castagnoli is only matched by his own respect for the promotion, as Castagnoli became the first AEW star to sign a dual AEW/CMLL deal in March. In a recent interview, Castagnoli also referred to CMLL's homebase of Arena Mexico as his favorite wrestling venue to work in.

Mexican wrestlers typically do not fatigue easily due to competing in the high altitude of Arena Mexico. Many American wrestlers struggle to adapt to those conditions.
Castagnoli adapted well to the environment in Arena Mexico and achieved success there. He won the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship last fall and held the title for several months.
Castagnoli also participated in the CMLL International Gran Prix alongside Hechicero. The two wrestled the full match, which lasted just under 74 minutes.

title: Syko Stu Recalls Raja Jackson Shoot Incident
raw_title: Syko Stu Details Incident With Raja Jackson
summary_src: At KnokX Pro on August 23, 2025, Raja Jackson, the son of Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, beat independent wrestler Syko Stu unconscious in a planned spot that went too far. Raja entered the ring and slammed Stu down, knocking him unconscious.
body: At KnokX Pro on August 23, 2025, Raja Jackson, the son of Quinton “Rampage” Jackson, beat independent wrestler Syko Stu unconscious in a planned spot that went too far. Raja entered the ring and slammed Stu down, knocking him unconscious. Raja then landed over 20 legitimate unanswered strikes to Stu’s head before independent wrestler Doug Malo pulled him off. “I don’t remember a lot of it. I do remember Raja coming backstage and he was filming. Usually you don’t film backstage like that. I know there was the can spot and I don’t remember too much after that. I do remember that we did call a finish and he was supposed to come in. I think he was going to give me one punch because of the can spot. It’s supposed to be a wrestling punch, but if he would’ve connected with it a little more, I could’ve sold it better. I don’t think anyone expected what was going to happen to happen,” he said. He stated that he doesn’t know why Raja took the beer can spot so personally, and that once he realized Raja wasn’t a worker, he admitted he was wrong and they came up with the angle. “I was out on the slam. I don’t remember anything. The match went really good until that. I don’t remember anything until, I believe it was Tuesday. I woke up in the hospital. I was in and out of consciousness the whole time. I woke up on Tuesday and saw some of the wrestlers. Rikishi was there and we were talking. I was just trying to recover,” he said. Stu noted that they wouldn’t show him the video or talk about it in the hospital. He said that his family was mad about what happened, but they remain a strong support group for him. He was discharged on Thursday after entering on Saturday. Stu said that he does a lot of word exercises as part of the rehab process, but it still affects his everyday life, as he’ll forget things five minutes later, will do things multiple times, and has forgotten names and faces. When asked about the statement where he said he forgave Raja, Stu replied, “That was a little bit out of context. What I actually said was, ‘I’m not holding a grudge.’ I never said anything about forgiveness. Everybody can learn something from this. I just didn’t want to hold a grudge because that brings the negative energy into it. When you have to let something go, it kind of helps you heal from it. As far as forgiveness, when we’re in the courtroom and I was reading that statement, I don’t think the LA Times heard the same statement that I read.” He said he doesn’t know what he would say to Rampage if he saw him today. Stu stated that he can physically wrestle, but he mentally can’t do it because he’s unable to remember matches and spots. He hasn’t wrestled since the incident and has been advised not to, but he would like to wrestle again. If you use any of the quotes above, please credit and link to the original source with a h/t and link back to Fightful for the transcription.

Jackson delivered more than 20 unanswered legitimate strikes to Stu's head until Doug Malo intervened and pulled him away. Stu later explained that the two had agreed on a finish involving one wrestling punch after a beer can spot, but the sequence went too far and he does not recall much of what happened afterward.

Raja slammed Stu and then delivered more than 20 unanswered legitimate strikes to his head until independent wrestler Doug Malo intervened and pulled him away.
Syko Stu has limited memory of the incident itself. He recalled Raja filming backstage, which is unusual, and remembered calling a finish that involved one wrestling punch after a beer can spot.

Stu stated he was unconscious from the initial slam and has no recollection of the following events. He woke up in the hospital on Tuesday after being admitted on Saturday and remained in and out of consciousness until then.
During his hospital stay, medical staff would not show him video of the incident or discuss it. Wrestler Rikishi visited him there as he began to recover.

Stu was discharged from the hospital on Thursday. He now participates in word exercises during rehabilitation but continues to experience short-term memory issues such as forgetting things within minutes, repeating actions, and failing to recall names and faces.

body: 0 WWE star Erik and his wife, former WWE wrestler Sarah Logan, have welcomed a new addition to their family. The War Raiders member shared the happy news on social media, marking another special milestone for the couple outside the wrestling ring. Erik, whose real name is Raymond Rowe, announced the arrival of their third child on Instagram on Tuesday, October 20. The couple also shared an update on how the mother and newborn are doing following the birth. Erik and Sarah, who previously performed in WWE under the names Sarah Logan and Valhalla, welcomed a baby girl named Dena Elizabeth Rowe. She was born at 2:13 p.m. local time, weighing nine pounds and measuring 21 inches long. The War Raiders star reassured fans that both his wife and their newborn were doing well. In his announcement, Erik wrote on Instagram , “Both mama and baby are healthy and safe.” He concluded the message with a heartfelt expression of gratitude, adding, “God’s gifts are truly endless.” Dena joins the couple’s two other children. Erik and Sarah welcomed their first child in February 2021 and their second in November 2024. The pair married in 2018 in a traditional Viking-themed ceremony, reflecting their shared connection to wrestling’s Viking-inspired presentation. Erik remains signed to WWE, where he teams with Ivar as part of The War Raiders. The duo have continued appearing on WWE programming, including SmackDown, and have also competed in AAA in recent months. Sarah, meanwhile, departed WWE in June 2025 after the company did not renew her contract. She later confirmed in February 2026 that she was stepping away from professional wrestling. body: Ilja Dragunov recently revealed that suffering panic attacks during his wrestling matches has become a consistent occurrence in his career. Recently, speaking to Ariel Helwani on The Ariel Helwani Show , Dragunov opened up about his experience with panic attacks. “ I still have that. Sometimes I have this very bad, sometimes I have it less, but it’s a consistent thing that is kind of a part of my life. “ But I came to the conclusion, and especially when you’re younger, you try to fix everything. You try to find the simple answer to complex questions, which the phrase itself explains that it’s not possible ,” he shared. “ Because it’s not only something negative. This kind of panic or this kind of feeling that I carry with myself is also letting me perform harder. It lets me put more effort and more devotion to what I’m doing. And it lets me love more,” he added. When asked by Helwani about his baddest panic attack, Dragunov answered, “ Well, that’s a good question. Well, I guess at least multiple times every week. I don’t even pay attention to it that much because, again, that’s what I said. I don’t try to be a polished person. “ As soon as I kind of accepted myself and saw the good sides of these things, because nothing is just black and white; there are a lot of gray areas, it gave me the option to deal with that way easier ,” he said. While Dragunov suffers panic attacks during matches, Helwani asked if he had faced something similar in the gorilla position before his matches. “ You accept. You try to go. I mean, the thing is, it gives me a lot of pride because I had this in the middle of a fight. I had this on my entrance. I had this seconds before where I felt like I was forgetting my whole match. “It’s the reason also I’m very proud of myself on certain days. It’s exactly that I never give in. I accepted it. I dealt with that. It made my performances for myself even more real ,” he finished. Done with WWE, Dragunov recently joined AEW and made his debut at WrestleDream 2026. body: The Hardys (Matt Hardy and Jeff Hardy) will have full creative control of the 10/13 TNA iMPACT taping. TNA Wrestling announced a very special night at the Dothan Civic Center on Tuesday, October 13, to mark the start of the 35 th year of Jeff and Matt Hardy as professional wrestlers. The wrestling legends, aka, The GOATs, have been given full creative control of that night’s show, which will air October 15, as Thursday Night iMPACT! on AMC, per TNA Director of Authority Santino Marella. Every element of the October 13 th show in Dothan will be orchestrated from the minds of Jeff & Matt. They are the matchmakers, will set the surprises and match stipulations, and of course play a huge role themselves in-ring during the evening. The October 13 th TNA show in Dothan will air Thursday, October 15 on AMC. To celebrate this special anniversary night, every fan in attendance is encouraged to dress like Jeff or Matt from any era of their historic careers. The two best-dressed fans – one as Matt, one as Jeff – will be crowned the winners and be the first in line for the post-show meet and greet with the real Hardys. A special commemorative photo – of The Hardys and The Hardy Look-Alikes – will be taken and featured on TNA’s social media outlets and the TNA website. Special Hardy merchandise will be available exclusively at the Dothan shows to honor the Hardys’ 35 th year. The Hardys have held countless championships during their illustrious careers, which began on October 15, 1992, in North Carolina. They are recognised by fans, peers and media as the greatest tag team in professional wrestling history and are the only duo to have held the WWE/World, WCW, TNA, ROH, Raw and SmackDown Tag Team Championships. This is TNA’s first live events in Dothan, Alabama in more than a decade and the first-ever TNA television tapings there. title: In Memoriam: AEW Star PAC’s Wife Called His Phone as Police Investigated His Death
raw_title: AEW Star PAC’s Wife Called His Phone as Police Investigated His Death
body: 0 Newly released medical examiner records have revealed further details about the final hours of AEW star PAC . This includes a heartbreaking moment when his wife, Natalie Taylor, tried calling him while authorities were investigating his death. The call came less than three hours after the couple had last spoken on September 27. According to a Cook County Medical Examiner report obtained by the New York Post , PAC, whose real name was Benjamin Satterley, was found unresponsive inside a rental car near a CAVA restaurant in Des Plaines, Illinois. Taylor called her husband’s cellphone after authorities arrived at the scene, but police answered instead. She told investigators that she had spoken with Satterley earlier that day. Moreover, he had explained his plans before heading out. “Satterley told his wife that he was stopping at the restaurant CAVA before heading to O’Hare Airport,” the report stated. Taylor also informed investigators that her husband had a previously diagnosed medical condition for which he had received medication. The specific condition was redacted from the documents. However, she told authorities that he had “no history of illicit drug or alcohol abuse.” The report noted that Satterley was discovered shortly before 4 p.m., slumped over in the driver’s seat of his running rental car. During the emergency call, the person who found him told dispatchers, “I don’t see his chest moving at all.” Toxicology testing did not reveal anything extraordinary. The medical examiner ultimately determined that PAC died from bronchial asthma and classified his death as natural. Inhalers were also found at the scene. Nevertheless, the report did not establish whether he utilized them during the medical emergency. PAC had wrestled Andrade at AEW All Out on September 26, the night before his death. He was 40 years old. Taylor later shared an emotional tribute on Instagram . She recalled the plans they had made for his return, including setting up his new home gym and spending time together. The report provides more detail about PAC’s final hours, but it does not establish whether he had time to use an inhaler before the emergency. title: Mickie James set to appear at TNA's Bound for Glory as incredible matches lined up on card
raw_title: Mickie James set to appear at TNA's Bound for Glory as incredible matches lined up on card
body: Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) legend Mickie James will appear at Bound for Glory next weekend as the company prepares for its biggest show of the year. During "Impact" on Thursday, TNA aired a vignette that showed an older logo on a crate. When the crate opened, a strong beam of light appeared. When the light went dark, a white cowgirl hat and a denim jacket appeared. A woman took the hat and placed it on her head. Wrestler Mickie James attends the 2013 Spike TV Guys Choice at Sony Pictures Studios on June 8, 2013, in Culver City, Calif. (WireImage) James’ "Hardcore Country" entrance theme played and fans knew exactly who was in the video. The legendary women’s wrestler had multiple stints in TNA. She joined the company initially in 2002 while TNA was under the National Wrestling Alliance banner. She worked there for about a year before moving to WWE . James returned to TNA in 2010, immediately getting into a feud with Madison Rayne. She defeated Rayne to win the TNA Knockouts Championship in April 2011, becoming the first woman in pro wrestling history to hold the TNA Knockouts Championship, WWE Women’s Championship and WWE Divas Championship. She’s a five-time Knockouts champion. She was also with the company from 2021 to 2023. Earlier this year, she battled the Elegance Brand at No Surrender and the "Impact" episodes afterward. Her appearance is just one of the many highlights set for Bound for Glory next week. The event takes place Sunday, Oct. 11, at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida. There are four championships on the line, including a six-way scramble for the vacant TNA X Division Championship which will feature Fabian Aichner, KC Navarro, Cedric Alexander , Rich Swann, Ryan Nemeth and BDE; a Knockouts Championship match between Xia Brookside and Indi Hartwell; a four-way match for the TNA International Championship among Mustafa Ali, Jason Hotch, John Skyler and Special Agent Zero; and Nic Nemeth defending the TNA World Championship against Leon Slater. Elsewhere, Ricky Sosa will take on Eddie Edwards, Joseph Sawyer and Samuel Shaw go up against The Hardys in a Falls Count Anywhere match and a Call Your Shot Gauntlet will be held with the winner getting a future championship match. Mustafa Ali pins Jason Hotch to win the TNA International Championship at TNA Wrestling's Lockdown on Aug. 23, 2026. (TNA Wrestling) It will be a great weekend of professional wrestling, that’s for sure.

title: Injury Update: WWE NXT Star’s Return Timeline Revealed After Serious Injury
raw_title: WWE NXT Star’s Return Timeline Revealed After Serious Injury
body: 0 WWE NXT star Dorian Van Dux has received an update on his recovery from a serious injury. His tag team partner Sean Legacy revealed when doctors expect him to be cleared for in-ring action. The latest news offers a clearer picture of Van Dux’s road back after an extended absence from competition. Legacy shared the update during a backstage segment on the October 20 episode of NXT , where he was speaking with several members of the roster. During the segment, Legacy spoke with Romero Moreno, E.K. Prosper, Chazz “Starboy” Hall, Noam Dar, and Saquon Shugars. He revealed that doctors told him Van Dux should be cleared to compete in approximately two months. This timeline enables a potential return around December 2026. Van Dux was initially sidelined after suffering a punctured lung in September. The injury followed an attack by BirthRight, the faction consisting of Lexis King, Uriah Connors, and Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo, which had targeted Van Dux and Legacy during their ongoing rivalry. There was some positive news on September 27, when Van Dux was announced as medically cleared to compete. However, another backstage attack involving BirthRight on the October 6 episode of NXT created a further setback, and the team was subsequently removed from the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. Van Dux last competed on September 15 , leaving Legacy without his regular partner as their issues with BirthRight continued. The latest medical update suggests that the wait for their reunion in the ring could last several more weeks. The two-month timeline is based on what Legacy said doctors had relayed to him. WWE has not provided further medical details in the supplied information. Moreover, the update does not confirm a specific return date. For now, Van Dux’s recovery remains the key factor in his return to NXT competition. If the expected timeline holds, December could bring him another opportunity to get back in the ring and resume his partnership with Legacy — a comeback worth keeping on the radar. title: Legal Watch: WWE NXT Ends in Chaos as Cruz Montana Gets Arrested After Dion Lennox Match
raw_title: WWE NXT Ends in Chaos as Cruz Montana Gets Arrested After Dion Lennox Match
body: This week, Montana and Lennox wasted no time getting physical after the bell rang. Lennox landed a big right hand and a spinebuster, while Montana responded with a sit-out powerbomb and many hard-hitting moves. Neither man could take full control. Lennox landed several heavy strikes and used a headlock to wear Montana down. However, Montana eventually broke free and hit a superkick, followed by a clothesline, an enzuigiri, and a stunner that nearly ended the match. The bell did nothing to calm Montana down. He continued attacking Lennox, forcing security to step in. Lennox kept taunting Montana even while lying at ringside. Montana responded by slamming him onto the exposed concrete and hit a curb stomp that left him down. Montana then picked up the steel ring steps and prepared to smash Lennox with them. However, Cutler James stepped in and threw himself over Lennox, taking the impact to protect his fellow DarkState member. The situation eventually led to what appeared to be police officers stepping in. Two officers confronted Montana, restrained him, and handcuffed him before escorting him away. title: The 50 coolest maneuvers of all time
raw_title: The 50 coolest maneuvers of all time
body: Which Superstars with shared finishing maneuvers did it better? And what exactly do we mean by coolest? If you were cool you wouldn’t be asking that question. Pure intensity, pure mayhem, pure Warrior. Whenever Ultimate Warrior’s music hit, all hell would inevitably break loose. But nothing demonstrated the sheer electricity and powerful essence of such a wild Superstar like his Gorilla Press Slam. Putting her own spin on the Gory Neckbreaker — a move innovated by Mexican ring legend Gory Guerrero — Victoria felled many a female in WWE with the chiropractic nightmare she called the Widow’s Peak. In executing the maneuver, the raven-haired aggressor would hoist her opponents back-to-back over her shoulder then drop them savagely to the canvas, twisting their necks backward in a sickening show of force. Incapacitating such iconic Divas as Torrie Wilson, Stacy Keibler and WWE Hall of Famer Trish Stratus, the Widow’s Peak earned Victoria her second Women’s Championship in a Fatal 4-Way Match on the Feb. 23, 2004, edition of Raw, when she used the dreaded maneuver to take out Lita. — JAMES WORTMAN Some wrestling moves are precision holds, designed to stretch opponents’ limbs past their breaking points. Others are about hitting a dude so hard his head might pop off. JBL’s Clothesline from Hell clearly falls into the latter category. The big Texan took a cue from fellow Lone Star State native Stan Hansen, as both men enjoyed recklessly throwing their beefy arms at foes like big league sluggers swinging for the fences. JBL almost always connected, knocking the poor sap across the ring from him into next week. Hell probably sounded like a vacation after getting clobbered by The Wrestling God’s signature clothesline. — BOBBY MELOK If finding a four leaf clover is considered good luck, then finding yourself in Dean Malenko’s Texas Cloverleaf must be just the opposite. Watch Malenko execute the Texas Cloverleaf in an underrated classic It’s a hold that looks awesome as it inflicts pain and certainly spells bad luck for anyone finding themselves locked in it. — TOM LIODICE A close-fisted punch in a WWE match usually garners an admonishment — almost always unheeded — from the referee. However the rule book goes out the window when Roman Reigns lands his breathtaking Superman Punch. A jumping, cross-body right hand delivered with phenomenal impact, the blow is made all the more devastating by the incredible torque generated by The Shield member’s 250-pound frame. John Cena, Sheamus and Big E have all been flattened by a hit so impactful it would rival the power of George Foreman in his prime. What makes this move even more frightening? Even if an opponent is somehow able to avoid the strike, they still have to worry about a Roman Reigns spear that can rearrange the organs of any Superstar today. — ANDY SEIFE No one threw a Spinebuster quite like Arn Anderson. llm_long: At a KnokX Pro event on August 23 2025, Raja Jackson knocked independent wrestler Syko Stu unconscious during a planned spot that escalated beyond the script.
Raja slammed Stu and then delivered more than 20 unanswered legitimate strikes to his head until independent wrestler Doug Malo intervened and pulled him away.
Syko Stu has limited memory of the incident itself. He recalled Raja filming backstage, which is unusual, and remembered calling a finish that involved one wrestling punch after a beer can spot.

Stu stated he was unconscious from the initial slam and has no recollection of the following events. He woke up in the hospital on Tuesday after being admitted on Saturday and remained in and out of consciousness until then.
During his hospital stay, medical staff would not show him video of the incident or discuss it. Wrestler Rikishi visited him there as he began to recover.

Stu was discharged from the hospital on Thursday. He now participates in word exercises during rehabilitation but continues to experience short-term memory issues such as forgetting things within minutes, repeating actions, and failing to recall names and faces.

title: Ilja Dragunov explains AEW signing over WWE
raw_title: Ilja Dragonuv says he signed with AEW because it is a better fit for him than WWE
body: Ilja Dragunov said he decideioid to leave WWE and sign with AEW because he saw AEW as a better fit for him. “It was an accumulation of a lot of things,” said Dragunov during an interview on The Ariel Helwani Show. “An accumulation of, of course, the offering, because we all know, at the end of the day, it’s the business. But it’s also definitely based on my feeling of, like, how do I want to work creatively? Do I need a scenery change? Is the scenery change something where I can see myself staying forever? Because you’ve got to consider a lot of factors. Like, I spent the most of my 20s in WWE. That’s a very, very long time.” Dragunov mentioned that since he signed with WWE, the wrestling landscape has changed with AEW launching as a new alternate. “And the landscape in this beautiful business changed. So, the beautiful thing is nowadays we have other opportunities. And for me personally, after such a long time being with a company, to not seek out new opportunities, maybe a place where I see myself more fitting — who wouldn’t do that?” Dragonuv made his AEW debut on Oct. 17 at the WrestleDream PPV. He is scheduled to make his in-ring debut on Dynamite this week.

body: Link wwe.com Josh Jagler got hooked on wrestling in ’96-’97 when the nWo invaded WCW, and has been addicted ever since! If you’ve paid NXT any attention in 2026, or followed it here on Cageside, you know the developmental brand’s crown jewel (pun intended) has been the women’s division. Maybe the ladies down in Orlando are just more talented than their male counterparts, or maybe Raw and SmackDown haven’t raided their division as much. Either way, the men’s division has had a hard time keeping up this year. With so many of NXT’s top male stars getting promoted this year, there’s been an influx of new talent (including the return of an old talent) trying to stand out in a crowded field of meh. If we can make one complaint about NXT, it’s not that they’re not trying. Between the leader of a nepo-baby faction dropping diss tracks and a toothless LFG winner hallucinating talking raccoons , they are certainly throwing anything they can against the wall to see what sticks. Without further ado, let’s talk about what went down tonight! As NXT went on the air tonight, we saw a stellar video package detailing the recent rivalry between Dion Lennox and Cruz Montana and hyping us up for tonight’s main event. After an in-ring promo battle a few weeks ago and an exchange of pre-packaged promos the week after, the tension between them ratcheted up last week when Dion attacked Cruz as Montana was getting off the phone with his mother. After laying Cruz out, Dion hit redial and had his own conversation with Momma Montana. About an hour before meeting Cruz in the ring, Dion paced backstage as Osiris Griffin and Cutler James watched a cell phone video Montana made last week, vowing to beat Lennox’s ass tonight. Dion made a few cryptic threats about taking Cruz back to that dark place, and the DarkState trio walked off to plan how. As the dust cleared and Cruz surveyed the damage, two supposed police officers came out and tackled him to the ground. The show closed with Montana pinned to the ground being restrained, while Dion looked on, seemingly satisfied that he had pushed his rival to return to “that dark place”. A few weeks after making a surprise return to NXT and winning a #1 Contender’s Battle Royal, Wren Sinclair met NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan in the ring to sign their contract for Halloween Havoc. On her way, Wren got last-minute motivation from Kendal Grey after the WrenQCC crossed paths with an irate Birth Right (find out why they were mad by scrolling down a bit!) and Chantel Monroe (more on her below!). NXT put a different (and refreshing) spin on the contract-signing gimmick by sending the challenger out with the contract and calling the champion out to sign it. No authority figure or table in the ring. Wren called Kelani out, and Jordan’s music cut her off mid-sentence. Kelani came out wielding a chair and claimed she had a gift for Wren. title: Billy Gunn required sons to graduate college before AEW
raw_title: Billy Gunn says he refused to get his sons hired by AEW
summary_src: A part of AEW since 2020, Billy Gunn was never in favor of his sons getting hired by Tony Khan’s promotion before they graduated from college.
body: A part of AEW since 2020, Billy Gunn was never in favor of his sons getting hired by Tony Khan’s promotion before they graduated from college. Speaking to Kenny McIntosh of Inside The Ropes , Gunn recently opened up and shared that he refused to get his sons hired by AEW, and instead wanted them to finish college first. “ I’m not that guy anyway. Like if you suck, I’m telling you, you suck. I wanted my kids to actually suck so they didn’t do this job. But unfortunately, their dad was in DX. But that doesn’t matter. Just because I’m good at something doesn’t mean they’re going to be good at something ,” Gunn said. “First of all, they had to graduate from college. That was number one. Don’t even come to me. Don’t even attempt to do this job if I don’t get that. “ Austin [Gunn], the day he graduated, walked from the stage up the balcony where I was sitting, handed me this and goes, ‘When do we start?'” He further discussed that while his other son, Colten, had everything planned out for him till he was 60. However, when even Colten Gunn wanted to wrestle, it shocked his wife and him. “ They’ve known that because they’ve lived it their entire life, is me never being around. Like never being home. It’s a little easier now, but when I first started, I was on the road 300 days out of the year, ” Gunn said when asked why he didn’t want his sons in wrestling. “ That’s insane. That’s zero life at home. That’s zero seeing your kids do [anything]. That’s zero seeing anybody do anything because when you go home, you sleep the entire time because you don’t do that on the road. So I don’t want that for my kids. I want better things for my kids like we all do.” Despite training his sons, Gunn wanted them to earn an AEW tryout first. Saying he handed his sons nothing, Gunn added, “ I did teach them. I trained them up until a certain point to where they were kind of getting the feel of it. “ And then I would send them away to people that I trusted to kind of just get a different perspective. But they had to go to Tony. They had to ask to get a tryout. They had tryouts. They did all that. I didn’t go, ‘Hey, would you hire my kids because they’re my kids?’ No, that ain’t me ,” he shared. The veteran added that he did not visit AEW asking them to hire his kids. Gunn claimed that he always had the belief that one had to earn their opportunity and work for it. “ Too many people just get it handed to them and they don’t understand the struggle it takes to do this job.” The Gunns have been a part of AEW since 2020 and have won the AEW tag team and trios titles. Austin approached him with his diploma the day he graduated asking when they could start, while Colten's decision to wrestle also came as a surprise to Gunn and his wife.
llm.speaker: Billy Gunn
llm.quote: I’m not that guy anyway. Like if you suck, I’m telling you, you suck. I wanted my kids to actually suck so they didn’t do this job.

llm_long: Billy Gunn has been part of All Elite Wrestling since 2020. He insisted that his sons Austin and Colten complete their college education before pursuing careers in the promotion.
Gunn stated that he refused to help get his sons hired by AEW until they graduated. He emphasized that his own success in wrestling did not guarantee they would succeed in the same field.

On the day Austin Gunn graduated, he handed his diploma to his father and immediately asked when they could start in wrestling. Gunn had required college graduation as the first condition before any discussion of entering the business.
Colten Gunn also decided to pursue wrestling after having a different career path mapped out until age 60. The choice surprised both Gunn and his wife, given the demanding nature of the profession.

Gunn explained that his frequent absences from home, including 300 days on the road each year early in his career, made him hesitant for his sons to follow the same path. He wanted them to have more stable family lives than he experienced.
Although Gunn trained his sons to a certain point, he required them to seek and complete AEW tryouts on their own. He did not ask for them to be hired simply because they were his children.

body: 0 WWE’s Independent Development (ID) program has seen another departure. This exit adds to a growing list of talents who have recently moved on from the system. The latest exit involves a wrestler who joined the program earlier this year and gained experience on WWE EVOLVE under a different ring name. The departure was confirmed directly to Fightful Select, bringing his brief run with WWE’s developmental initiative to an end. Jimmy House, who performed as CJ Valor during his time on WWE EVOLVE, confirmed to Fightful Select that WWE released him from its ID program. He signed an ID contract in March 2026, around two months after participating in the company’s tryouts in Orlando. House had already indicated a change in direction last month when he announced that he would return to using his independent wrestling name. His latest confirmation clarifies his status with WWE following that announcement. Despite the departure, House reportedly spoke positively about his experience in the program. He highlighted the opportunity to learn from WWE Hall of Famer Sean “X-Pac” Waltman. Moreover, House credited Gabe Sapolsky’s advice and guidance as important factors in helping him secure the contract. Jimmy House’s exit comes amid wider turnover within WWE ID. Laynie Luck, Marcus Mathers, Cappuccino Jones, Santi Rivera, Sam Holloway, and Veronica Haven are among the other names mentioned in reports of recent departures from the system. His tenure was relatively short, running from his March signing to his recently confirmed release. During that period, competing on EVOLVE as CJ Valor gave him an opportunity to gain experience within WWE’s developmental structure. WWE ID continues to serve as part of the company’s broader talent-development pipeline. However, the latest departures show that its roster is changing. For House, the WWE chapter has closed, and he has already signaled a return to his independent wrestling identity. His next career move has not been announced in the provided reports. For now, his departure adds another name to the list of talents moving beyond WWE ID as the program’s lineup continues to evolve. body: Link wwe.com Josh Jagler got hooked on wrestling in ’96-’97 when the nWo invaded WCW, and has been addicted ever since! If you’ve paid NXT any attention in 2026, or followed it here on Cageside, you know the developmental brand’s crown jewel (pun intended) has been the women’s division. Maybe the ladies down in Orlando are just more talented than their male counterparts, or maybe Raw and SmackDown haven’t raided their division as much. Either way, the men’s division has had a hard time keeping up this year. With so many of NXT’s top male stars getting promoted this year, there’s been an influx of new talent (including the return of an old talent) trying to stand out in a crowded field of meh. If we can make one complaint about NXT, it’s not that they’re not trying. Between the leader of a nepo-baby faction dropping diss tracks and a toothless LFG winner hallucinating talking raccoons , they are certainly throwing anything they can against the wall to see what sticks. Without further ado, let’s talk about what went down tonight! As NXT went on the air tonight, we saw a stellar video package detailing the recent rivalry between Dion Lennox and Cruz Montana and hyping us up for tonight’s main event. After an in-ring promo battle a few weeks ago and an exchange of pre-packaged promos the week after, the tension between them ratcheted up last week when Dion attacked Cruz as Montana was getting off the phone with his mother. After laying Cruz out, Dion hit redial and had his own conversation with Momma Montana. About an hour before meeting Cruz in the ring, Dion paced backstage as Osiris Griffin and Cutler James watched a cell phone video Montana made last week, vowing to beat Lennox’s ass tonight. Dion made a few cryptic threats about taking Cruz back to that dark place, and the DarkState trio walked off to plan how. As the dust cleared and Cruz surveyed the damage, two supposed police officers came out and tackled him to the ground. The show closed with Montana pinned to the ground being restrained, while Dion looked on, seemingly satisfied that he had pushed his rival to return to “that dark place”. A few weeks after making a surprise return to NXT and winning a #1 Contender’s Battle Royal, Wren Sinclair met NXT Women’s Champion Kelani Jordan in the ring to sign their contract for Halloween Havoc. On her way, Wren got last-minute motivation from Kendal Grey after the WrenQCC crossed paths with an irate Birth Right (find out why they were mad by scrolling down a bit!) and Chantel Monroe (more on her below!). NXT put a different (and refreshing) spin on the contract-signing gimmick by sending the challenger out with the contract and calling the champion out to sign it. No authority figure or table in the ring. Wren called Kelani out, and Jordan’s music cut her off mid-sentence. Kelani came out wielding a chair and claimed she had a gift for Wren. title: TNA Wrestling Partners With LaMelo Ball’s Fashion Brand
raw_title: TNA Wrestling Partners With LaMelo Ball’s Fashion Brand
body: "TNA Wrestling is so proud to welcome LaFrance, the premium lifestyle brand of NBA superstar LaMelo Ball, as our new official apparel partner," Hannifan said. Hannifan announced that TNA referees will wear LaFrance apparel instead of the generic black-and-white striped shirt. Plus, TNA stars and fans can soon purchase TNA-themed LaFrance apparel. TNA fans got a first look at the new referee LaFrance uniform at Bound For Glory. The blue shirt features a white collar and the TNA and LaFrance logos displayed on the front. LaMelo Ball , the No. 3 pick in the 2020 NBA Draft, is one of the NBA's most exciting players. The skilled point guard frequently dishes out highlight-worthy passes and shows off his impressive range with one-legged jumpers and half-court three-pointers. Off the court, the California-born guard is equally as flashy. Ball often showcases his insane car collection , featuring a Rolls-Royce Cullinan, McLaren 750S Spider, Lamborghini Urus and Tesla Cybertruck, among others. In 2020, the NBA star launched his lifestyle fashion brand LaFrance . In addition to becoming an official TNA Wrestling partner, LaFrance will soon release a Stranger Things-themed collaboration with PUMA . The upcoming collection includes the Stranger Things x PUMA MB.06 , LaFrancé , and LaFrance RNR , with each pair featuring different elements from the Netflix series' supernatural world. TNA Wrestling's LaFrance partnership announcement was not the only exciting news at Bound For Glory. Leon Slater cemented himself as the youngest World Champion in TNA history by defeating Nic Nemeth in the main event of Bound For Glory. The 22-year-old high-flyer is the youngest wrestler to hold World Championship gold in TNA, WWE or AEW. After the historic win, Slater said he was "grateful" for the support he's received along the way to achieving his dream of becoming a World Champion. "I'm a big believer in manifestation and self-confidence and all of that jazz . I always saw myself with something like this," Slater said while holding the TNA World Championship. "People have asked me if I'm nervous or if I'm worried. I say no. I feel like everything is happening how it's supposed to. "I'm just so grateful. I'm grateful for the people God put me around," he continued. "Grateful for the environment God put me in." The TNA star concluded, "I could not be prouder to represent Total Nonstop Action!" Slater is now the youngest X-Division Champion and World Champion in TNA history. Slater is expected to appear on the next episode of TNA iMPACT! on Tuesday, Oct. 13, following his historic performance. The episode will also mark the first time TNA referees don the LaFrance threads on TNA iMPACT! The post TNA Wrestling Partners With LaMelo Ball's Fashion Brand appeared first on HEAVY .
