summary_src: Penta’s first match against Roman Reigns looked huge on WWE television, but backstage it was apparently complete chaos.
body: “This is a good question, brother, because, oh man, now I’m relaxed. I cannot tell you what happened all day. But that day, bro, was too much stress for me because, you know, I had a lot of things in my brain.” The match itself was already a massive deal for Penta, but WWE had plenty more planned around it. His elaborate arrival involved a horse, and that quickly became another thing he had to worry about before even getting near the ring. “You know, the first thing is against Roman Reigns, first time ever, Mexico City, my family is there. So, hours before that, you saw my arrival shot in the arena with the horse. You saw that?” As cool as the entrance looked when everything came together, getting there apparently wasn’t easy. Penta revealed there were problems with the horse only a few hours before the match while he was simultaneously being pulled in several other directions. “Okay, two hours before my match, maybe three, so problems with the horse. It’s not here, maybe it’s delayed, maybe something. You need makeup, I need to go to the ring, you know, I practice. Oh, you have an interview. Oh, you have meet-and-greet.” Penta barely had a chance to think about the fact that he was about to wrestle Roman Reigns. Every time he finished one responsibility, somebody was apparently waiting to send him somewhere else. “In that moment, everything was on my brain. ‘Hey, Penta, you need an interview. Oh, Roman is here. Oh, the horse has come.’ You know, I became crazy, bro.” Then suddenly it was time to wrestle. Penta said everything moved so quickly that he essentially went from dealing with the backstage madness to being told he was next. “In that moment, when I opened my eyes, like, ‘You are next.’ Oh, okay. You know, everything was too fast.” It wasn’t until two days later that the magnitude of the night finally hit him. Penta found himself sitting alone in his garden when he was finally able to slow down and realize what he’d just experienced. “Bro, to be honest, two days later than my match, I started sitting in my garden, like, ‘Wow.’ Now, bro, I promise you, two days, two days later.” Despite all that chaos, Penta tried to enjoy whatever he could while it was happening. Even the people helping put together his presentation were rushing to make sure everything was ready in time. “But in the same moment, I tried to enjoy every moment, you know, every interview. title: 5 Greatest WWE Golden Era Championship Reigns
raw_title: 5 Greatest WWE Golden Era Championship Reigns
body: October 21, 2026 By Daniel Sinasac WWE , History , Pro Wrestling , WWE Universe The WWE Golden Era was the start of something special for World Wrestling Entertainment. Before that era, WWE was in its territorial phase, happy to sell out arenas across the Northeastern United States . Then the boom happened, and WWE morphed into a national conglomerate and began its path into mainstream media. This path to greatness was started during the WWE Golden Era, not just for the company, but for the men and women who captured championship gold. This era produced the most impressive reigns the wrestling world has ever seen. These individual reigns have become legendary, establishing Hall of Fame careers that will live on forever. Each WWE Golden Era championship saw a great run, and below are the wrestlers with the single greatest championship reigns. WWE’s Women’s Championship was not a strong title during the WWE Golden Era. The Women’s division was not taken very seriously, and the list of credible contenders was short. Most fans can’t even remember any specific reigns with the championship, outside of one iconic stint that started at WrestleMania. Wendi Richter was a huge ally of the Rock N’ Wrestling Connection. She and Cyndi Lauper developed a strong partnership as MTV and WWE joined forces. It was this relationship that had a lot to do with WWE becoming a national sensation, and it was capped off with Richter capturing the WWE Women’s Championship at WrestleMania. It was a law of diminishing returns after WrestleMania, with Richter holding onto the championship for 238 days, but it was by far the most impressive reign of the WWE Golden Era. title: How WWE Can Correct Their Big Mistakes — Joe Hendry
raw_title: Joe Hendry: How WWE Can Correct Their Big Mistakes
body: October 21, 2026 By Josh Prost WWE , Pro Wrestling , Raw , WWE Universe Joe Hendry signed a contract with WWE in November 2025 after spending the previous year making appearances in the company, including a spot in both the 2025 Royal Rumble and on night two of WrestleMania 41 against Randy Orton. There are some wrestlers in WWE that benefit from being silly. Danhausen’s antics have made other wrestlers extremely mad, which has excited the fans. Otis has been a funny man for years, and his popularity has increased in recent years. Hendry has always had silly songs as part of his career, but his songs in WWE haven’t been popular with fans. Everyone disliked his concert with Danhausen , as their combined lyrics were strange and no one really knew what was going on with the dancers or Minihausens around the ring. His feud with McDonagh was also weird, as calling him a Funko Pop and having an actual person wear a Funko Pop on his head seemed very childish. He also lost the feud, which didn’t help him. Wrestlers can be silly, but being silly with a child’s sense of humor isn’t going to get him fans. He doesn’t have to be serious, but he needs to dial back the silliness to get everyone back on his side. Everyone knows that Hendry is great with a guitar and has a catchy singing voice. But since his main roster debut six months ago, that’s all he’s done. He’s just sung songs about McDonagh and Paul while not making much of an impact in the ring. Going back to championship pursuits will show fans that he can actually wrestle. He’s won several titles on the English independent circuit before being signed to a major company. When he was with TNA Wrestling, he was the Impact Digital Media Champion for 266 days and the TNA World Champion for 126 days. His NXT Championship run was for 60 days, as he defended it against Jackson Drake on the February 10 NXT and Ricky Saints at NXT Vengeance Day. There’s no question that he is capable of being a champion on the main roster. Having him just sing and lose matches is a waste of talent for a man who can actually have good matches in the ring. After Monday night’s loss, WWE has a choice to make with Hendry. He is very popular with his songs, but the results in the ring haven’t been what fans have wanted. The Danhausen concert didn’t turn out well; he lost in embarrassing fashion to Bron Breakker , and his feud with McDonagh was childish. This isn’t the same man that was entertaining in Ring of Honor and TNA Wrestling over the past few years. Things need to change for him to be successful on the main roster. He needs to be less silly to appeal to everyone watching WWE programming. Kids may like him, but adults have a problem with his presentation. He also needs to start challenging for titles. Six months in without a title opportunity for him isn’t a good look. He’s been a champion several times, and WWE needs to start treating him like one. title: Drew McIntyre Says He's In Best Shape Of His Life
raw_title: Drew McIntyre Talks Staying In Shape While Away From WWE: “I’m In The Best Shape Of My Life”
body: Drew McIntyre has not appeared on WWE programming since he lost an Unsanctioned Match to Jacob Fatu at Night 1 of WrestleMania 42 . During his time away from WWE, McIntyre has been filming several major acting projects, including the reboot of Highlander – where he plays the role of Angus, and the movie The Last Druid – which filmed in Barcelona, Spain. He also is starring in the digital series Agent of Shadows, which is produced by WWE and ReelShort. McIntyre was recently a guest on Insight with Chris Van Vliet , where he discussed staying in shape while being away from WWE, being even bigger now than the last time we saw him, and says that he is in the best shape of his life. CVV: I feel like you’ve gotten bigger since the last time I saw you! DM: “I have gotten bigger since the last time you saw me. I believe I was around 275 prior to Mania.” CVV: So, are you doing all this because you’re getting ready to return to WWE? DM: “No, I just like to look good. Obviously, I’m in the best shape of my life. I feel physically great. I’m sure you saw the clip that was out there when I was running the ropes. I was just rolling around the ring at Miro’s school, Rusev; you’re very welcome. It’s here in Nashville, and my buddy was like, I’ve never seen anybody hit the ropes so fast because he’s not seen Bron Breaker, the only other man that’s faster than me. He got a little clip, a 15-second clip, and it blew up online. I think over 8 million views, so people seem to be excited about the idea that I’m coming back to wrestling, but I’m just seeing what happens right now. I’m enjoying myself. Hollywood Drew is jumping from project to project, and when the time is right, WWE is home.” You can see the clip of Drew McIntyre talking about being in the best shape of his life on Insight with Chris Van Vliet below. You can check out the full episode of Insight with Chris Van Vliet featuring WWE Superstar Drew McIntyre below. We will keep you updated here at Bodyslam.net on any news or information regarding Drew McIntyre and his potential WWE return when it becomes known. title: “if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling” — Christopher Daniels
raw_title: Christopher Daniels: “if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling”
body: While speaking to Going Ringside , former AEW tag team champion Christopher Daniels was asked about tribalism in wrestling. Here is what Daniels had to say… “Listen, if you’re a professional wrestling fan, I think you should support all professional wrestling. WWE is the oldest game in the game. They’re the oldest group in the game, but AEW is coming along strong. AEW is great, and hopefully, if you like professional wrestling, AEW presents tremendous professional wrestling week in and week out. So, if you’re against that, I don’t know what to tell you. Go watch something else. That’s fine. But we’ve got plenty of fans, and we’re bringing more fans along the way. I look forward to showing them professional wrestling each and every week.”

title: Swerve Strickland explains WWE avoiding AEW crossover
raw_title: Swerve Strickland is right on the money about why WWE will never do a joint show with AEW
body: Link AEW Cain A. Knight is a hardcore number-cruncher who has analyzed and covered pro wrestling for Cageside Seats since 2014, and followed the sport as a fan going back to the 1980’s. In a new interview with Billboard , AEW star Swerve Strickland was asked if there will ever be a cross-promotional event between WWE and AEW in his lifetime. After answering “no,” Swerve said it’s because WWE will never allow any AEW stars to look better than theirs. It’s control. It’s all about marketing. It’s like the NFL, WWE has to protect their shield. There’s no way they’d allow any of our wrestlers to look better and be better [than them]. Obi Femi is a world beater. You gotta protect that and make sure he keeps looking good. Gunther, have to protect that. Roman [Reigns], have to protect that. Cody [Rhodes], have to protect, even more so because of AEW. There’s a lot of that happening. Swerve is correct, but one key point he fails to address is whether or not AEW would allow WWE stars to look better than theirs. Regardless, the decision-makers in suits may have a problem with putting over stars from another company, but the wrestlers want to wrestle each other, and Swerve doesn’t care who wins and loses. “Us in the locker room, we just wanna have these matches. I’m good friends with Carmelo [Hayes], Jevon [Evans] and Oba. Those are my boys. I love those guys. I don’t care who wins. Double DQs. I don’t care.” The fact that Strickland tweeted his support for Oba Femi during WWE’s Money in the Bank PLE earlier this month seems to back up his implication that the war between WWE and AEW is a front office thing much more than a locker room thing. body: AEW Dynamite is live tonight from the Watsco Center in Coral Gables, Florida, and will air on TBS and HBO Max. This week’s episode will feature the fallout from Saturday’s AEW WrestleDream in Orlando. Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland will team together on the show after Saturday’s Clockwork Carnage match came down to the wire between the two of them. Ospreay and Copeland will take on Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight on Dynamite, with Fletcher and Knight coming off a well-reviewed tag team match against the Young Bucks at WrestleDream. Also scheduled for Wednesday’s show, new AEW signee Ilja Dragunov will make his promotional in-ring debut. He’ll face Speedball Mike Bailey in singles competition. There will also be an AEW World Tag Team Championship eliminator match on the show as Matt and Nick Jackson, the Young Bucks (c), face Mark Davis and Jake Doyle of the Don Callis Family. A number one contender’s match for the TBS Championship is also scheduled as Maya World goes up against Queen Aminata. Dragunov did not compete at WrestleDream. He is scheduled to have his first match in the promotion on the upcoming episode of Dynamite.

In a recent interview, Dragunov addressed his contract negotiations with WWE. He chose not to criticize the company and instead provided measured comments about the discussions and his decision not to renew his deal.
WWE reduces its roster following WrestleMania each year. This year the company requested that multiple talents accept a 50 percent pay reduction to remain under contract.
Several performers who declined the pay cut were released from WWE. Among them, the group formerly known as New Day in WWE rejected the offer and were subsequently let go.
That group debuted in AEW at the All In event held in Wembley Stadium. They captured the AEW World Trios Championships on the same day in partnership with Swerve Strickland.

title: Triple H Narrates Tyrese Haliburton NBA Return Video
raw_title: WWE's Triple H Narrates Video On Return Of Tyrese Haliburton As New NBA Season Begins
summary_src: Paul "Triple H" Levesque narrated a hype video for the return of Indiana Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton ahead of the beginning of the new NBA season.
body: Now that he's healthy, Haliburton is marking his return in a big way. Ahead of his first game back, he took to X (formerly Twitter) to release a hype video , narrated by Paul "Triple H" Levesque. "The brighter the lights. The higher the stakes. The more he shined," Levesque is heard saying in the video, which begins with Haliburton highlights. "He gave an entire city something to believe in. The world saw what he lost. Now, they get to see what he's found." The video then cuts to a few shots of Haliburton immediately after suffering the injury. It then shows his rehabilitation, in a doctor's office, as well as working out in the gym and back on the court. "The injury changed him," Levesque goes on. "Just not the way they hoped. Doubters are back. Unfortunately for him, so is he. Zero. Doubt." In addition to the return hype video, Fightful shared photos on X of Haliburton's arrival to the Pacer's home opener. The star dressed in Triple H's iconic leather-denim jacket combination from his 2002 return to "WWE Raw" in Madison Square Garden after being sidelined for nearly a year with a severe quad injury. Haliburton's most recent WWE appearance came during the July edition of Saturday Night's Main Event . He and Seth Rollins went face-to-face with World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns and New York Knicks star, and 2026 NBA Champion, Jalen Brunson.
summary: With the new NBA season underway, Indiana Pacers guard Tyrese Haliburton released a hype video for his return from injury. WWE's Paul "Triple H" Levesque provides the narration, emphasizing Haliburton's resilience after his setback, rehabilitation and comeback. Per Fightful, Haliburton arrived at the Pacers' home opener wearing Triple H's iconic leather and denim jacket from his 2002 WWE return.

llm_long: Indiana Pacers star Tyrese Haliburton released a hype video ahead of his NBA return after rupturing his Achilles in Game Seven of the 2025 NBA Finals. Paul "Triple H" Levesque narrated the video, which began with highlights of Haliburton and included the quote "The brighter the lights. The higher the stakes. The more he shined."

Levesque continued in the video with the lines "He gave an entire city something to believe in. The world saw what he lost. Now, they get to see what he's found." The footage then showed shots of Haliburton immediately after suffering the injury, his rehabilitation in a doctor's office, working out in the gym and returning to the court.

Levesque added in the narration that "The injury changed him. Just not the way they hoped. Doubters are back. Unfortunately for him, so is he. Zero. Doubt." Haliburton got off to a slow start in the game but came alive in the fourth quarter to help secure Indiana's victory.
Haliburton's most recent WWE appearance was during the July edition of Saturday Night's Main Event where he and Seth Rollins went face-to-face with Roman Reigns and Jalen Brunson.

title: Amazing Red Signs New TNA Deal
raw_title: Report: Amazing Red Signs With TNA Wrestling
body: Mike Johnson at PWInsider reports that Red has signed a new deal with TNA Wrestling. Amazing Red was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame at TNA Bound For Glory. An hour later, he won the vacant TNA X-Division Championship in a scramble match. Red competed in TNA from 2001 to 2005 and then again from 2009 to 2011. He is a four-time X-Division Champion. Prior to Bound For Glory, his last X-Division Title reign came in 2010. TNA has not officially announced Red signing with the company. They announced the signing of Shotzi Blackheart and the re-signing of Santino Marella this week.

title: If You Complained About How WWE Didn't Use Ilja Dragonuv, This Is Your Moment To Show Up And Support Him
raw_title: IF YOU COMPLAINED ABOUT HOW WWE DIDN'T USE ILJA DRAGONUV, THIS IS YOUR MOMENT TO SHOW UP AND SUPPORT HIM - PWInsider
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin IF YOU COMPLAINED ABOUT HOW WWE DIDN'T USE ILJA DRAGONUV, THIS IS YOUR MOMENT TO SHOW UP AND SUPPORT HIM By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-21 08:59:00 For months, the complaints were endless, loud and relentless. Every time Ilja Dragonuv wasn't utilized by World Wrestling Entertainment, the online discourse was the same - where is he? Why isn't he being utilized? Why isn't be on TV? Why isn't he getting pushed? The Russian-born German star, 33, has been beloved for his unhinged intensity, stiff striking, and emotionally charged physical storytelling for as long as he's been performing. The "Unbesiegbar" (Unbeatable) Mad Dragon, Dragunov gained international acclaim before signing with WWE, where captured the WWE NXT UK Championship by ending GUNTHER's insane 870-day reign with an instant classic. He moved to the United States, where he held the WWE NXT title and eventually, the main roster, where he won the WWE United States Championship. Recognized for his intense in-ring style, marked by his signature Torpedo Moskva flying headbutt and H-Bomb forearm strike, Dragonuv excels at believable, hard-hitting encounters and dramatic, resilient selling that position him as one of the most physical performers in modern professional wrestling. He was the exact style of performer that Paul Levesque's NXT popularized themselves utilizing, so it was was unthinkable that under Levesque's creative direction that Dragonuv wouldn't be a massive part of WWE, yet it didn't truly happen. An ACL tear hobbed his momentum for sure, but his return was well received, as was his U.S. title run. However, once 2026 began, other than being unceremoniously tossed from The Royal Rumble by Brock Lesnar, there was nothing truly memorable for Ilja creatively and then, he chose to exit the company. The outpouring of shock and anger over the exit was palpable, to the point I even received emailed accusing me of lying when PWInsider.com broke the news of his exit. No matter how you feel about Dragonuv's run in WWE, the one constant was that die-hard wrestling fans loved his work and loudly complained online when he wasn't utilized in a stronger manner. If they truly believe WWE whiffed the ball on Dragonuv, those same fans will get the chance to see him step up to bat tonight for All Elite Wrestling on Dynamite. As famously stated in Field of Dreams, "If you build it, they will come." Well, Tony Khan built his ballfield and now Dragonuv has been invited to join the team...but will the fans who championed him and blamed WWE for Dragonuv's main roster run falling flat actually take that negative feedback, flip the hourglass and go cheer on Ilja in his new environment? If they don't, every single person who lamented that the main roster machine was sanding down Dragonuv's violent edges should be ashamed of themselves. title: Saudi Airport Attack Kills One Ahead of WWE Crown Jewel
raw_title: Saudi government reports 1 dead, 8 injured following attack on Dammam airport
summary_src: An airport in Dammam was attacked on Wednesday night, Saudi Arabia's aviation authority confirmed in a statement.
body: King Fahd International Airport in Dammam was struck on Wednesday night, per an announcement by the country’s General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA). GACA confirmed that one death and eight injuries occurred due to the attack. Damage to airport property was mentioned as well. No further details are known at the moment. Dammam is an eastern city in Saudi Arabia, sitting on the coast of the Persian Gulf. It is the fifth-most populous region in the country. Saudi Arabia has suffered numerous attacks in recent weeks, many claimed by the Iran-backed Houthis. Riyadh International Airport has been heavily restricted recently after suffering a series of attacks, including one which left 13 dead and over 300 injured. Saudi Arabia remains under attack just days before the country is expected to host prominent combat sports and professional wrestling events. Canelo Alvarez is scheduled to box Christian Mbilli as part of a show in Riyadh on October 31. Just a week later, WWE will visit the city for its Crown Jewel Premium Live Event (PLE). Numerous outlets confirmed earlier today that “non-emergency” staff at the U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia were ordered to leave the country.

summary_src: Erik, one-half of WWE's War Raiders, welcomed his third child alongside wife Sarah Rowe, the former Sarah Logan in the company.

Their second son, named Ezekiel, arrived in November 2024. She revealed in an interview that after her WWE contract expired, she chose not to renew it , and instead wanted to start a homestead and be a farmer and mother. Erik underwent neck fusion surgery in 2023 , but returned stronger than ever to capture not only AAA's tag titles, which he and Ivar won in May, but also the WWE World Tag Team Championships. The pair won the WWE gold in December 2024, and went on to have a 124 reign.

title: Drew McIntyre pitched sword arm chop at WrestleMania
raw_title: Drew McIntyre pitched chopping off someone’s arm with his sword at WrestleMania
summary_src: Drew McIntyre used to carry around a giant sword named Angela back when he was the WWE champion circa 2020 / 2021. He would occasionally threaten his rivals with it, but never go through with actually using it on them. You know, sort of like how Dean Ambrose pulled out a chainsaw in his match […]
body: “You know how I had that sword for years, and everyone was like, ‘Is Drew ever gonna use the sword?’ And I didn’t? …I stuck it in the ring, and I stuck it in [Adam] Pearce’s table. But finally, I pitched to the big man himself. I [said] hey, you know Saving Private Ryan? And Vince had never seen Saving Private Ryan. He didn’t know what I was talking about, but also I speak fast when I’m excited. Half the time he’s like, ‘Uh, yeah. Yeah, sure Drew.’ I was like [in] Saving Private Ryan, they use actors, like amputees, etc. They lop off the limbs they’re actually missing. Very realistic. I think at ‘Mania or something, we should have a fight sequence. We end up backstage, then we hit the pre-tape where I swing the sword at somebody. Whoosh! Arm comes off. Finally, I use the sword. Pay it off, it’s bothering me. Vince was probably much more familiar with Shaving Ryan’s Privates starring Val Venis. title: Davis And Doyle Pin Young Bucks For Future AEW Tag Title Shot

summary_src: Mark Davis and Jake Doyle dominated AEW World Tag Team Champions The Young Bucks to open "AEW Dynamite" and earn themselves a future title shot.
body: Davis and Doyle took the match outside of the ring almost immediately and the Young Bucks never got their feet underneath them. The pair sent the Bucks crashing into the ring barricade and steps, and Nick was bounced off a table with a powerbomb in the timekeeper's area. Back in the ring, Davis landed back-to-back piledrivers on Matt while Doyle cinched in a bear hug on Nick. The pair pinned the champions for the quick victory, to earn themselves a shot at the gold in the future.

They dominated outside the ring with barricade spots, a table powerbomb on Nick Jackson, back-to-back piledrivers on Matt Jackson and a bear hug on Nick before scoring a decisive pinfall victory to earn a future title opportunity.

title: Tyrese Haliburton Pays Homage to WWE Legend at Pacers Season Opener
raw_title: Tyrese Haliburton Pays Homage to WWE Legend at Pacers Season Opener
body: Haliburton, who tore his ACL in Game 7 of the 2025 NBA Finals, will make his long-awaited return to the Pacers lineup on Oct. 21 after 486 days on the mend. To mark his return, the Olympic Gold medalist wore a custom recreation of the denim jacket Triple H wore in his WWE return in 2002. The Pacers shared a photo of the vintage jacket on Instagram, as shown below. As wrestling fans may recall, Triple H wore the same denim jacket when he returned from a quad injury at Madison Square Garden in 2002 after a year-long absence. The crowd pop during his dynamic return is widely regarded as one of the biggest pops in WWE history. Haliburton, a lifelong WWE fan who has appeared at SmackDown, SummerSlam and WrestleMania, honored one of his childhood icons, Triple H, with his pregame fit on Wednesday. The All-Star guard arrived at Smoothie King Center, which recently hosted Money in the Bank, wearing a near replica of Triple H’s famed 2002 gear. When pictures of the Triple H-inspired get-up went viral, the WWE Universe applauded the Pacers star’s fashion sense. A Pacers fan wrote: “I’ve been waiting 16 months for this moment.” The NBA on ESPN Instagram page also shared side-by-side clips of Haliburton and Triple H donning the denim attire. “Tyrese Haliburton arrives in Triple H style ahead of his first game in 486,” ESPN wrote. Tyrese Haliburton’s awesome pregame outfit was not the only WWE-inspired apparel he wore this week. During the Pacers’ final preseason game on Oct. 16, Haliburton rocked a pair of PUMA sneakers with a lime green colorway inspired by the legendary WWE faction DX. Haliburton’s new sneaker is the latest chapter of a growing list of shared moments between WWE and the NBA star. After several ringside appearances and a near in-ring clash with New York Knicks star Jalen Brunson, Haliburton became a playable character in WWE 2K25. Months later, the Pacers star teamed up with Seth Rollins at Saturday Night’s Main Event at Madison Square Garden. Now that he is healthy and moving well again, perhaps Haliburton will one day compete in the squared circle. For now, his focus remains on helping the Pacers return to the NBA playoffs. title: Comeback Watch: Hall Of Fame Legend Signs To Make Full Return In TNA Wrestling
raw_title: Hall Of Fame Legend Signs To Make Full Return In TNA Wrestling
body: TNA Wrestling Backstage News | Image Source: WrestlingHeadlines.com Share on Twitter --> Amazing Red is reportedly sticking around in TNA Wrestling. Following his TNA Hall of Fame induction and X-Division Championship victory at Bound For Glory 2026, a new report indicates that the veteran high-flyer has signed a contract with the promotion. Red enjoyed a memorable night at Bound For Glory, where he was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame during the pre-show before going on to capture the vacant X-Division Championship later in the evening. The championship became vacant after Leon Slater exercised “Option C,” relinquishing the title in exchange for an opportunity at the TNA World Championship, which he ultimately captured. A pioneer of TNA’s original X-Division, Red is now enjoying his fourth reign with the championship and his first since 2010. His return also marks his first run with TNA since 2011, bringing him back to the promotion where he established himself as one of the division’s most influential performers. The reported signing comes amid a series of roster moves for TNA. Earlier this week, the company confirmed that Shotzi Blackheart had signed a contract, while Director of Authority Santino Marella also agreed to a new deal. title: WWE Women’s Championship Match Made Official for October 23 SmackDown
raw_title: WWE Women’s Championship Match Made Official for October 23 SmackDown
body: 0 WWE has added a major championship match to the October 23 episode of SmackDown. Chelsea Green will defend her WWE Women’s Championship against Roxanne Perez after Perez defeated her earlier this month. The road to this title match began on the October 12 episode of WWE RAW, where Perez defeated Green in a non-title match. The Judgment Day member picked up the win after Liv Morgan distracted Green at ringside. The finish gave Green a reason to question the loss, but Perez still walked away with a big victory over the reigning champion. She wasted little time in demanding a shot at the WWE Women’s Championship after the match. However, RAW General Manager Adam Pearce initially told Perez he needed approval from the SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis before he could arrange a championship match. That issue has now been settled, with Pearce and Aldis agreeing to the contest. Green and Perez will face each other one-on-one, with the championship officially on the line. Aldis announced the match on social media . He confirmed that he had received approval from Pearce and WWE management. Both Green and Perez have also agreed to the match, making it official for Friday night. Green has already been announced to face the Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan in a Champion vs. Champion match at Crown Jewel on November 7. However, a defeat at this week’s SmackDown might change the picture, as Morgan might have to face her own Judgment Day member at the PLE. Moreover, Green could face even more competition in the coming weeks, as Nikki Bella has also been eyeing the title and has had some backstage confrontations with Green in the past few weeks. The incident raised further questions about the safety of international travel and major events in the country. title: AEW announces ‘Clockwork Carnage’ match for World Championship at WrestleDream
raw_title: AEW announces ‘Clockwork Carnage’ match for World Championship at WrestleDream
body: The AEW World Championship will be defended in an eight-man ‘Clockwork Carnage’ match at WrestleDream on October 17. Tony Schiavone announced the stipulation during Saturday’s Collision, with AEW subsequently posting the match rules on social media. Two of the eight wrestlers are selected at random to begin the match. Another randomly selected competitor then enters every three minutes until the entire field has entered. During this first stage, a wrestler is eliminated if they are pinned or submitted. That means it is possible for fewer than eight competitors to remain by the time the final entrant arrives. Once the eighth wrestler has entered, the elimination portion ends and a 15-minute scoring period begins. From that point, competitors are no longer eliminated by pinfall or submission. Instead, every pinfall or submission earns one fall, with wrestlers able to score multiple times during the 15 minutes. When time expires, the wrestler with the most falls will win the match and the AEW World Championship. No participants beyond current champion Will Ospreay have been announced. The concept originated with Pro Wrestling EVE, which credited Ospreay with devising the format. EVE staged the first Clockwork Carnage match on Friday at its Global Thunder Queens Attack event in London. Kay Lee Ray won the match to earn a future EVE Championship opportunity, subsequently choosing EVE Champion Kris Statlander as her opponent. Ospreay’s participation as champion is subject to him retaining the title next week. He is scheduled to defend against Kazuchika Okada at Grand Slam France on Tuesday in Paris. Ospreay issued that challenge following his successful defense against Jon Moxley at All Out, with Tony Khan making the match official during the post-show press conference. WrestleDream takes place Saturday, October 17 at Addition Financial Arena in Orlando, Florida.

title: US State Dept Orders Diplomats Out Of Saudi Arabia Before Crown Jewel

summary_src: The US State Department has ordered diplomats to withdraw from Saudi Arabia just over two weeks away from WWE Crown Jewel in Riyadh.
body: Reuters has reported from US officials that the order came as at least one person was killed and eight were injured at King Fahd International Airport in Dammam. Two people have been killed in a drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Shaybah oil field. Per the report, diplomatic personnel have been pulled out of the region in recent months as Iran launched attacks on US facilities following the joint US-Israeli attack on Tehran in February. State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott said in a post on X that the department ordered the departure of non-emergency US government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia, following sustained attacks by the Yemeni Houthis on civilian targets in the Kingdom. This is inaccurate. The U.S. Department of State issued an ordered departure for non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only. Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on... https://t.co/yNrCwDcfIg Four US officials reportedly stated that US missions in other Gulf states would be ordering family members to leave. Pigott's post did not address changes to other missions outside Saudi Arabia. WWE's decision to move ahead with Crown Jewel on November 7 has come under increased scrutiny as the attacks continue. Programming has continued to build towards the event and its planned host, with Crown Jewel Championship matches scheduled pitting Roman Reigns against Sami Zayn and Liv Morgan against Chelsea Green for the title belts kept in Riyadh year-round. Dave Meltzer has reported that WWE is due to receive a payment of approximately $50-55 million for the November event, while WrestleMania 43 next year is also set to take place in Riyadh for approximately $150 million. The Saudi minister and Chairman of General Entertainment Authority, Turki Alalshikh, posted earlier this month that Canelo Alvarez still planned to fight Christian Mbilli in Riyadh on October 31, adding that "Hard times reveal true friends."
summary: The US State Department has ordered the departure of non-emergency government employees and their family members from Saudi Arabia. The move comes ahead of WWE's Crown Jewel event in the country.

body: 0 Aalyah Mysterio has made an appearance on WWE NXT following her recent signing as a recruit at the WWE Performance Center. Aalyah appeared during a backstage segment involving members of the NXT women’s locker room. While she didn’t speak or compete, her presence attracted attention after WWE confirmed her entry into the developmental system. The segment aired ahead of the singles match between Layla Diggs and Izzi Dame. The two women exchanged words backstage, with Aalyah among the other talent present as the confrontation unfolded. The segment eventually led to Dame facing Diggs in the ring. Izzi Dame picked up the victory. Aalyah, however, remained a presence in the background and did not become directly involved in the confrontation or the match. Aalyah’s latest appearance marks a small step as she begins learning the business from the inside. Her family name is already familiar to WWE fans, but developing her own identity in the ring will take time and training. For now, WWE has not announced a match or a larger on-screen role for Aalyah. Her NXT appearance puts her in the mix, but fans will have to wait to see when she takes the next step from the locker room to the squared circle.

title: AEW’s MJF Set for Surprise Referee Role at Independent Wrestling Event
raw_title: AEW’s MJF Set for Surprise Referee Role at Independent Wrestling Event
body: 0 AEW star MJF is preparing to step into an unfamiliar role at an upcoming independent wrestling event, trading his usual position in the ring for a job that requires him to keep others in line. The announcement comes as Create-A-Pro Wrestling prepares for its annual BaseBrawl event on October 24 in Long Island, New York. The promotion has added the former Create-A-Pro student to the show, where he’ll oversee a 10-man tag team match featuring a WWE Hall of Famer and one of the independent scene’s well-known managers. Create-A-Pro Wrestling announced that MJF will serve as the special guest referee when Team Road Dogg faces Team Sidney Bakabella at Saturday’s event. Road Dogg’s lineup includes Create-A-Pro co-owner Brian Myers, Anthony Greene, Aaron Rourke, Bobby Orlando, and Nick Robles. MJF has a history with Create-A-Pro, which served as his training ground before he established himself in professional wrestling. He originally trained under the promotion’s founders, Brian Myers and Pat Buck, and made his professional in-ring debut there in 2015. His appearance also follows the withdrawal of Billy Gunn, who had to cancel his scheduled bookings because of contractual obligations. Create-A-Pro announced MJF as a replacement attraction for the meet-and-greet portion of the event, while also adding AEW announcer Alicia Atout for fans. The promotion confirmed that attendees must purchase an event ticket to take part in the meet-and-greet sessions. The show will take place at Brookside Educational Center and serve as a fundraiser for Merrick Bellmore Little League. For MJF, the event offers a return to the promotion where his wrestling journey began, but this time he’ll be responsible for enforcing the rules rather than bending them. Whether the referee stripes bring out his fair side remains to be seen when BaseBrawl gets underway on Saturday. title: Comeback Watch: Steven Borden Returns to AEW Dynamite, Declares He’s Back for Blood & Guts
raw_title: Steven Borden Returns to AEW Dynamite, Declares He’s Back for Blood & Guts
body: 0 Steven Borden made his return to AEW on the October 21 episode of Dynamite and immediately announced his presence for Blood and Guts. The son of WWE Hall of Famer Sting had been out of action since suffering a concussion at All Out. Borden appeared alongside Darby Allin and The Young Bucks to help Adam Copeland and Will Ospreay fight off the Don Callis Family after their tag team match. Once the group cleared the ring, Borden grabbed a microphone and made his announcement, setting up a potential multi-man showdown at AEW’s upcoming special event. This week’s Dynamite featured a tag team match between Copeland and Ospreay and the Don Callis Family duo of Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. Copeland and Ospreay came close to winning a few times. However, interference from the outside eventually cost them the match. Kazuchika Okada appeared at ringside and distracted Copeland with his AEW International Championship. When Will Ospreay tried to deal with Okada, Fletcher took advantage of the opening. He drove Adam Copeland face-first into the championship belt and hit a brainbuster to secure the victory. The Don Callis Family members continued attacking Copeland and Ospreay after the match, with Okada, Fletcher, and Knight eventually joined by Mark Davis, Jake Doyle, and Wardlow. The numbers became too much for Copeland and Ospreay. Ospreay tried to fight back, but the group continued to overwhelm him. Fletcher even hit Ospreay with the AEW World Championship belt and raised it in the air to celebrate. That’s when Darby Allin’s music hit. However, Allin didn’t come out alone. He introduced the returning Borden, who joined him and The Young Bucks in the fight. They managed to turn things around, clear the ring, and force the Don Callis Family to retreat. After that, Borden took the microphone and made it clear he wanted to take the fight to the Don Callis Family. AEW Blood and Guts is scheduled for Wednesday, November 4, 2026, in Jacksonville, Florida. title: The Young Bucks Suffer Shocking Squash Loss on AEW Dynamite
raw_title: The Young Bucks Suffer Shocking Squash Loss on AEW Dynamite
body: 0 The Young Bucks suffered one of the most shocking losses of their AEW careers on the October 21 episode of Dynamite . The Don Callis Family members Mark Davis and Jake Doyle completely dominated the reigning AEW World Tag Team Champions in a one-sided match. Matt and Nick Jackson entered the opening match fresh off a successful title defense at WrestleDream. However, the champions struggled to keep up with their opponents. The match lasted only a few minutes before Davis and Doyle secured a decisive victory. The contest was an AEW World Tag Team Championship Eliminator Match. This meant Davis and Doyle would earn a future title shot if they defeated the champions. Doyle sent Matt crashing into the barricade at ringside, while Davis targeted Nick and knocked him off the ring steps. The challengers gave the champions very few chances to fight back. The table spot left Nick in trouble, while Matt was left to deal with both challengers inside the ring. The Young Bucks struggled to turn things around as Davis and Doyle continued their attack. Davis tagged in Doyle, and the two men hit Matt with a double splash. Doyle also locked Nick in a bear hug. The final moments were just as one-sided. Davis hit Matt with multiple piledrivers before delivering his finishing move, Close Your Eyes and Count, to secure the pinfall victory. Davis and Doyle squashing the reigning champions in just a few minutes is not what many fans would have expected. Since it was an eliminator match, the Don Callis Family members earned a future opportunity to challenge for the AEW World Tag Team Championship. The 44-year old Amazing Red is currently in his third stint with TNA where he was integral part of ushering in the modern high-flying, modern-era cruiserweight wrestling. body: AEW didn’t waste any time in making several title matches for next month’s AEW Full Gear from Phoenix, Arizona, during Wednesday’s Dynamite . While celebrating her successful title defense over Thekla at WrestleDream, AEW Women’s World Champion Mercedes Mone wondered who was next for her, leading to Marina Shafir coming out and issuing her own challenge for the title. As of this writing, the match has not been made official. Both sets of tag titles will be on the line as World Tag Team Champions Young Bucks will defend against Mark Davis & Jake Doyle after the challengers defeated the champions in a title eliminator Wednesday that turned into a squash. On the other side, Women’s World Tag Team Champions The Brawling Birds will defend against number one contenders Wrathlander. The news comes as a bit of a surprise as AEW head Tony Khan said this past Saturday that Jamie Hayter suffered a “major” injury at last month’s All Out while also saying he hopes to see her in a few weeks. Also on the show, Swerve Strickland challenged new AEW World Trios Champions Hangman Page and Brodido to not just a rematch with himself and the New Level at the pay-per-view but a Texas Death Match in honor of the Strickland-Page match two years ago at Full Gear. title: Steven Borden Returns On AEW Dynamite

body: Steven Borden is back, making his return with Darby Allin on AEW Dynamite to save Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland from a Don Callis Family beatdown. Borden made his return on Wednesday’s show after Ospreay and Copeland teamed to battle the DCF’s Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. Fletcher and Knight picked up the win after Kazuchika Okada got involved, but was pulled to the floor by Ospreay. Copeland took out both Fletcher and Knight with a Killswitch and Spear respectively, but a second spear attempt to Fletcher was missed and Okada was able to clock Copeland with the AEW International Championship. Fletcher then hit a brainbuster for the pin. After the match, the DCF attacked Copeland and Ospreay. Allin then showed up with Borden and they cleared out the ring. Borden said he was back for Blood and Guts, setting up the teams for the stipulation match. You can see clips from the AEW Dynamite match and post-match below. Borden has been out of action since taking a nasty bump at AEW All Out. AEW Blood and Guts will take place on November 4th at Veterans Memorial Arena in Jacksonville, Florida. body: Ruby Soho and Serena Deeb haven’t been seen on AEW/ROH TV in a while, but the two are still reportedly under contract. The latest Fightful Select featured questions asking about the status of both women. Soho hasn’t been seen since April 2024 when she announecd that she and Angelo Parker were expecting. Sean Ross Sapp said that she is still under contract. As As noted in August, Soho was backstage at AEW’s Cincinnati tapings in June getting cleared for a potential in-ring return. Sapp notes that there were creative pitches for her but they didn’t end up happening. It was also noted that Angelo Parker’s deal was previously said to be close to coming up, but there’s no word on the status of that. As for Deeb, she hasn’t competed in AEW or ROH since a loss in the ROH Women’s Pure Title Tournament Quarterfinals back in November of last year. Deeb is also still under contract and has only wrestled one match at all in 2026, a singles bout at HAW Rise From The Ashes IV in March. No word as of now on when Ruby Soho or Serena Deeb may end up returning to AEW or ROH TV.
summary: Ruby Soho has been absent from AEW and ROH television since announcing her pregnancy with Angelo Parker in April 2024. Per Fightful Select, she remains signed to the company, was cleared medically in June, and received creative pitches that did not materialize. title: On the Record: Ilja Dragunov Explains Why He Turned Down WWE’s Offer

body: 0 AEW star Ilja Dragunov has explained why he rejected WWE’s offer. He also confirmed that WWE wanted to keep him. The Russian wrestler recently made his AEW debut at WrestleDream. Dragunov’s arrival followed weeks of mysterious AEW teaser videos. Following his debut, AEW has now booked him against Speedball Mike Bailey. Their match is scheduled for this week’s Dynamite. Speaking on The Ariel Helwani Show , Dragunov discussed his WWE departure. He revealed that his decision came after careful consideration. WWE wanted him to stay, but he wanted change. When asked whether he knew his April match was his last, Dragunov said, “No, absolutely not. And everything I’ve got to tell about that is also not very hot or very exciting. I didn’t know at that time that I was leaving. I was just waiting.” “Again, I’m a person — I love what I do. I want to compete; I want to work. I want to do this and this and that. And it just got a got a little stuck as it was, but it’s nothing new to anybody. It was pretty obvious. And the time just passed by, and then I reached the expiration of my contract.” He also discussed wanting to explore different creative opportunities. “And like I already said after the show at the press conference at WrestleDream, I felt over time that, ‘Okay with how everything is working out and how I’m feeling.’ Because I do, I make a lot of things depending on how I feel about it. I always had the courage to do so. I feel it is time to breathe some new fresh air.” Dragunov confirmed WWE had no intention of releasing him. He said, “Yeah, there that was definitely — there was no intention of the company to let me go.” However, Dragunov explained that several factors influenced his decision. He explained, “It was accumulation of a lot of things. It was an accumulation of — of course the offering, because we all at the end of the day it’s a business. But also, it’s definitely based also on my feeling of like, ‘How do I want to work creatively? Do I need a scenery change? Is the scenery change something where I can see myself stay for like forever?'” Dragunov believes wrestling has changed significantly over time. He now sees more opportunities outside the company. He continued, “Because you’ve got to consider all the factors. Like, I spent the most of my twenties in WWE. That’s a very, very long time. And the landscape in this beautiful business changed. title: On the Record: Swerve Strickland Speaks On Possibility of WWE-AEW Crossover Event
raw_title: Swerve Strickland Addresses Possibility of WWE-AEW Crossover Event
body: 0 Swerve Strickland has explained why he believes a WWE-AEW crossover event is unlikely to happen during his lifetime. In an interview with Billboard , the AEW star discussed the dream matches such a show could deliver but pointed to a major obstacle that goes beyond what wrestlers want inside the ring. Strickland was direct when asked whether the two rival promotions could ever work together on a joint event. According to Strickland, the biggest issue would be protecting each promotion’s top stars and deciding who comes out looking stronger. He compared WWE’s approach to the NFL protecting its identity, arguing that control and marketing would make a crossover difficult to arrange. “It’s control. It’s all about marketing. It’s like the NFL, WWE has to protect their shield,” Strickland explained. He added that WWE would be unlikely to let AEW wrestlers “look better and be better” than its own talent. Strickland named Oba Femi, Gunther, Roman Reigns, and Cody Rhodes as examples of WWE stars whose presentations would need protecting. He also believes a joint event involving the women would create similar complications, mentioning Rhea Ripley, Liv Morgan, and Chelsea Green. One potential matchup he highlighted was Seth Rollins against Will Ospreay. Strickland called it a generational contest, but questioned how the companies could agree on a winner without worrying about who would benefit more. “You wanna see Seth [Rollins] and Ospreay. That’s the generational thing, but who do you protect? Who has the leverage?” he asked. The situation looks different from the wrestlers’ perspective, according to Strickland. He said he is friends with WWE stars Carmelo Hayes, Je’Von Evans, and Oba Femi, and would welcome the chance to compete against them without being concerned about the result. “Us in the locker room, we just wanna have these matches,” he said. “I don’t care who wins. Double DQs. I don’t care.” The post Swerve Strickland Addresses Possibility of WWE-AEW Crossover Event appeared first on Wrestlezone .

body: The first Blood and Guts match of 2026 has been made official. After scoring a tag win over Copeland and Ospreay, Knight and Fletcher looked to inflict more damage alongside their Callis Family teammates. In for the save were the Bucks, Allin, and, appearing for the first time since suffering an injury at All Out, Borden. After clearing the Family from the ring, Borden got on the mic and called out the faction for Blood and Guts. Last year’s Blood and Guts event featured the first-ever women’s match, taking place alongside the annual men’s bout. It’s unclear at the moment if the women’s match will return next month.

title: Pro wrestlers mourn the passing of AEW star PAC
raw_title: Pro wrestlers mourn the passing of AEW star PAC
body: Professional wrestler Benjamin Satterley, who went by the ring name PAC, passed away at the age of 40 over the weekend, according to All Elite Wrestling . News of Satterley's death was quite sudden, as he had previously wrestled the opening match of AEW's All Out pay-per-view on Sept. 26, and AEW announced his passing the following day. Satterley's passing also coincided with the celebration of life ceremony for fellow AEW wrestler "The Butcher" Andy Williams, who tragically passed on Sept. 5, 2026 . Satterley, born in Newcastle upon Tyne, England, started his wrestling career in 2004, traveling across the world and making his name in promotions such as Ring of Honor, CHIKARA, and Dragongate. Known for his high-flying style, raw athleticism, and technical in-ring ability, Satterley was often called "the man that gravity forgot." He was one of the best to ever do it. Before signing with AEW in 2019, Satterley joined WWE's developmental program NXT in 2012 under the ring name Adrian Neville, where he would become one-half of the company's inaugural NXT Tag Team Champions and a one-time NXT Champion. In 2015, he was called up to WWE's main roster, shortening his name to Neville and becoming a two-time Cruiserweight Champion. After leaving WWE, Satterley would join AEW under his original ring name, PAC. Nicknamed "The Bastard," Satterley became the company's inaugural International Champion (originally called the All-Atlantic Championship), a two-time World Trios Champion, and at one point held both titles to become AEW's first double champion. Outside of his achievements in WWE, AEW, and beyond, Satterley was a beloved figure in pro wrestling, both by fans and his fellow wrestlers. His Death Riders stablemate Marina Shafir shared an emotional, heartbreaking tribute to Satterley at an indie event. "Listen. He was our bastard. I was just holding this man yesterday," she said. "He was the best. He was the fucking best. You know why? Because he knew himself. He was just so modest about how fascinating he was." title: A History-Making One-Off? — AEW Grand Slam France
raw_title: AEW Grand Slam France: A History-Making One-Off? | Column
body: For over fifteen years, no non-European pro-wrestling promotions other than WWE had ever staged a show in France. Until now. On Tuesday, October 6, 2026, All Elite Wrestling held AEW Grand Slam France, a double TV taping of Dynamite and Collision, at the Adidas Arena in Paris. It marked AEW’s first venture in continental Europe – excluding its presence at Gamescom 2022 in Germany. France in particular has always been underserved by American promotions. Now, almost twenty years later, after two RAWs, two Smackdowns and two PLEs held by WWE in the country with great success in only two years, AEW seems willing to get in the market. But will Grand Slam France end up just being a one-night-only affair? Shown on Warner TV Next, a small cable TV channel airing reruns of anime and comic-book superheroes, and now on the MyAEW platform, AEW doesn’t have much of a presence or reach in the French market compared to WWE. Available on Netflix since January 1, 2026, the TKO company surely has the advantage, built on a monopoly dating back to the late 1980s on the paid-network TV channel Canal+ and then on the major cable TV channel, AB1. But AEW Grand Slam France was about testing the waters. AEW went a notch above what WWE typically does to promote its first entry in the market. The previous Saturday, several AEW stars – including Jeff Jarrett returning to France – were booked by the upstart KHAO promotion just outside Paris, with flyers given to spectators to promote AEW Grand Slam France. And on Tuesday, ‘Speedball’ Mike Bailey was given a spot to teach a show-host the Boston Crab on the morning-show Télématin, an institution of public network TV – which came back to the Québécois’ ears during its match taped for Collision against Lee Moriarty. WWE never did that, especially on a news day marked by a massive strike by high-school students. Closing the generous 15-match double-taping (including the first-ever showings in France by international stars like Kazuchika Okada, Darby Allin, and Hangman Page), Jon Moxley and Claudio Castagnioli tried to rally up the crowd one last time in an effort to keep the enthusiasm going and convince AEW’s boss, Tony Khan, seated backstage to try and bring its roster back someday (maybe as a stopover for future All In London weeks or European tours). The crowd seemed hopeful. Some even rejoiced with the Death Riders in their usual huddle at ringside while others in the bleachers flashed their smartphone lights in tribute to their fallen comrade, the late PAC. But even with Tony Khan’s generosity and excitement, business remains business. And with only the next AEW Dynasty and its following Dynamite scheduled in Liverpool in February 2027, there’s no indication for the AEW Grand Slam international brand to grace France – or even continental Europe – once again. title: Swerve Strickland Compares In-Ring Work to WWE Legends

body: Swerve Strickland has opened up in detail and compared his in-ring ability to WWE legends. In a recent interview with Billboard’s Carl Lamarre , Strickland reflected on his career and compared himself to several WWE legends. “ Not me being a caricature of hip-hop, and not me being a caricature of a Black wrestler. I’m being me. My success in pro-wrestling is genuinely because of my ability in the ring ,” Strickland said when asked what he would like to be remembered as. “ It’s not because they’re trying to push an agenda, it’s because I perform at a really, really high level — probably the highest level you could see of a Black wrestler in the history of the game. “ You have a lot of guys that truly became household names, like the Mark Henrys, Booker Ts, Ron Simmons, and Dwayne [Johnsons] — but you can rarely ever say they were the best wrestler on that show. They had to compete with Eddie Guerrero, Owen Hart, Bret [Hart], Shawn [Michaels]. Great in-ring technical wrestlers ,” Strickland further added. The former World Champion further continued and claimed that, similar to them, he competes at the highest level with everybody. “ Me and Okada. Me and Kenny [Omega]. Me and [Will] Ospreay. Me and Hangman [Adam Page]. The very, very best I hang with every last one of them. That’s why I’ve always approached hip-hop the same way. I have to be pure and genuinely me as possible and get there because of actual ability rather than just co-signs. ” Strickland, a former AEW Trios Champion with The New Level, recently lost his title at AEW WrestleDream 2026. title: On the Record: AEW's Jeff Jarrett Explains How RevPro Match Came Together At The Last Minute
raw_title: AEW's Jeff Jarrett Explains How RevPro Match Came Together At The Last Minute
body: "When I got off the elevator up where we were doing it, Will Ospreay was walking out of an office with a box of something, and I said, 'Hey, Will, you got a second?' He said, 'Yeah.' And I said, 'I've got this show and this show, blah, blah, blah.' And I said, but tonight, RevPro, it's right there because our hotel literally next door is Wembley Arena, and right around the corner is Wembley Stadium. RevPro's there. I said, 'Do you think you can kind of give them a heads up or ask them? I'd like to walk in the back door and I want to kind of check this out.'" "Will texts me. I didn't respond back because I'm doing the [event]. Then he calls in the middle of it. I'm like, 'Oh man, something must be going on.' He said, 'I got a question for you. Do you have your gear?' And I said, 'Well, you know the old-timer saying, 'Does a carpenter leave work without his hammer and nails and tools?' And he said, 'Well, I just talked to Andy [Quildan] and he wants to know, would you be interested?' It literally all came down around the two or three or four o'clock hour on Saturday." Jarrett was added to the Undisputed British Heavyweight title #1 Contendership Gauntlet match and said that he had a lot of fun doing it.

title: Masatora Yasuda Replaces Injured El Desperado in NJPW Super Jr. Tag League
raw_title: El Desperado out of NJPW Jr. Tag League due to injury, Masatora Yasuda to replace him and team with Mistico
summary_src: El Desperado has withdrawn from this year's NJPW Super Jr. Tag League, which is scheduled to begin this Saturday.
body: Just days before NJPW is scheduled to begin their 2026 Super Jr. Tag League, a change has been made to the lineup. El Desperado has withdrawn from the tour, NJPW confirmed on Thursday morning. The promotional vet was recently diagnosed with spinal canal stenosis and a hernia. In a statement to NJPW, Desperado described beginning to feel a “pins and needles” tingling sensation around his left glute around March. The discomfort turned into pain by June, causing him to wake up in the middle of the night. While he planned to finish up his 2026 schedule before taking time away, Desperado says he struggles to “stand, walk or even sit upright for long periods of time,” and thus has decided to step away from action. Desperado was scheduled to kick off tournament action this weekend alongside CMLL’s Mistico. Taking his place will be Young Lion Masatora Yasuda. The short-notice spot is a huge opportunity for the 27-year-old NJPW trainee. Appearing in his first-ever NJPW tournament (excluding the Young Lion Cup), Yasuda will spend weeks working alongside Mexico’s biggest star currently. Assuming the matchup schedule doesn’t change due to the substitution, Yasuda and Mistico are expected to face Kuukai and Master Wato as part of Saturday’s card in Saitama.
summary: El Desperado has withdrawn from the 2026 NJPW Super Jr. Tag League after being diagnosed with spinal canal stenosis and a hernia. The veteran began experiencing tingling and pain in his left glute in March that worsened by June, ultimately forcing him to step away as he struggles with basic movements. Masatora Yasuda will now team with Mistico in the tournament, marking the 27-year-old Young Lion's first NJPW tournament appearance outside of the Young Lion Cup.

Once the ring cleared, Borden took the microphone and announced he was not only back but specifically calling for a spot in next month's Blood & Guts match.

The annual double cage match is scheduled for Wednesday, November 4 in Jacksonville, Florida. It is shaping up to feature Ospreay, Copeland, the Bucks, Allin and Borden on one side against Davis, Doyle, Okada, Fletcher, Knight and Wardlow on the other.

title: First Matches Set For AEW Full Gear
raw_title: First Matches Official For AEW Full Gear
body: AEW has announced the first few matches for AEW Full Gear, making them official on this week’s AEW Dynamite. It was announced on Wednesday night’s show that Wrathlander will get their AEW Women’s World Tag Team Championship match against The Brawling Birds at Full Gear. Harley Cameron and Willow Nightingale beat the Sisters of Sin and Divine Dominion to secure the title shot that they were originally supposed to get at AEW WrestleDream before Jamie Hayter was pulled due to not being cleared. In addition, it was announced that Mark Davis and Jake Doyle will get their shot at The Young Bucks at Full Gear. The two crushed the Bucks in a title eliminator on Dynamite. Among the not-yet-confirmed matches, Swerve Strickland asked for a rematch for him and The New Level against Hangman Page and Brodido for the AEW World Trios Championships they lost at WrestleDream. Page agreed, but turned down Strickland’s proposal to make it a Texas Deathmatch. The Trios Title match has yet to be officially announced as set. And finally, Mercedes Mone cut a promo in the ring asking who was next for her. Marina Shafir came out to the ring and stepped up, challenging Mone to a title match. That match has not been made official, and it was not specifically noted to be for Full Gear as of yet. AEW Full Gear takes place on November 14th from the Mortgage Matchup Center in Phoenix, Arizona and airs live on PPV. The official card thus far is: * AEW Women’s World Tag Team Championship Match: The Brawling Birds vs. Wrathlander. * AEW World Tag Team Championship Match: The Young Bucks vs. Jake Doyle & Mark Davis. * AEW World Trios Championship Match: Hangman Page & Brodido vs. Swerve Strickland & The New Level. * AEW Women’s World Championship Match: Mercedes Mone vs. Marina Shafir.

Mark Davis and Jake Doyle also secured a title shot against The Young Bucks after dominating them in a title eliminator match.

title: Ric Flair Praises Tony Khan's Generosity at AEW
raw_title: Ric Flair Talks Tony Khan And Working For AEW: “He’s Generous.. I Work For Him And I Don’t Do Anything”
body: The “Nature Boy” Ric Flair signed a multi-year deal with All Elite Wrestling in late 2023. Flair has appeared numerous times on AEW programming, most notably was his inclusion in Sting’s Retirement Match at AEW Revolution 2024. His last official appearance on AEW Television came on the May 17th, 2025 episode of AEW Collision when he participated in the company’s tribute to Steve “Mongo” McMichael, who had recently passed away after a long battle with ALS. Ric Flair was recently interviewed by Biff Poggi for News Nation , and discussed AEW President/Owner Tony Khan and working for All Elite Wrestling. Flair says that Tony Khan may be the greatest promoter of all time and generous to a fault. He added that Tony is a nice guy, has a learjet and a beautiful girlfriend. He then reminds us again that Tony is generous, while pointing out that he works for him and doesn’t do anything. “ He’s got that Learjet. He’s got a beautiful girlfriend. He’s a nice guy. He’s generous. I work for him. I work for him and I don’t do anything. I think he takes care of me out of respect for me. He grew up on me. He’s just a wonderful guy.” You can check out the full interview from Biff Poggi and News Nation with WWE Hall of Famer Ric Flair below. title: Ilja Dragunov Wins AEW In-Ring Debut in Dynamite Main Event
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov Wins AEW In-Ring Debut in Dynamite Main Event
body: 0 Ilja Dragunov made an immediate impact in AEW by defeating Mike Bailey in his in-ring debut on the October 21 episode of AEW Dynamite . Both men started the match by testing each other with grappling moves. Dragunov took Bailey down with a waistlock, but Bailey countered with a wristlock before locking in a waistlock of his own. Dragunov backed Bailey into the corner but broke clean. He then tried to hit a powerful chop, but Bailey dodged and hit back with several kicks. Bailey then hit a Frankensteiner after avoiding Dragunov’s attempt to stop his handspring. The action then moved to the outside, where Mike Bailey hit an Orihara moonsault. Dragunov avoided another kick and sent Bailey’s foot crashing into the steel steps. He followed up with a German suplex on the floor. Bailey tried to regain control on the apron, but his next moonsault attempt ended badly. His knees crashed into the hard surface, leaving both men in pain. Bailey was struggling to put weight on his injured leg. Dragunov then started focusing more on his injured knee. He hit a superplex to Bailey from the top of the turnbuckle. Bailey nearly stole the win with an inside cradle as Dragunov prepared to hit the D-Bomb. He continued fighting back, but his injured knee made it difficult to follow up. Dragunov took advantage and went after the leg again. He knocked Bailey off the second turnbuckle with a chop to the knee before hitting a powerbomb. The Mad Dragon then delivered the D-Bomb. He followed up with another D-Bomb to finish the match. The post Ilja Dragunov Wins AEW In-Ring Debut in Dynamite Main Event appeared first on Wrestlezone .

title: WWE Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia unchanged amid embassy evacuation
raw_title: U.S. Saudi Embassy partially evacuated, no changes to Crown Jewel PLE announced by WWE at this time
body: The U.S. State Department has ordered nonessential diplomatic personnel and their family members to leave Saudi Arabia. The order comes after a string of escalating attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi rebel group. Several scheduled events in Riyadh have either been canceled or postponed. WWE is currently scheduled to run the Crown Jewel PLE in Riyadh on Nov. 7. The company has not announced any plans publicly to postpone, relocate or reschedule Crown Jewel as of this writing. The U.S. Embassy in Riyadh issued a new security alert today stating that more attacks were expected. The alert mentioned that the operations at the King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh are still suspended. Iranian-supported Houthis have engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions. The hostilities have the potential to escalate rapidly beyond that immediate area. U.S. citizens are reminded to follow the guidance of natioonal alerts released by Saudi Arabia’s Civil Defense via cellular broadcast. U.S. government employees working in Saudi Arabia require special authorization from Chief of Mission to use any airport in Saudi Arabia following recent missile and UAV attacks on airports in the Kingdom. Operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh remain suspended. King Abdulaziz International Airport in Jeddah and King Fahd International Airport in Dammam are operational with some delays and cancellations. U.S. citizens should be aware of potential attacks on airports, airspace closures, flight cancellations, and travel disruptions. Please take extreme caution if you choose to use airports in Saudi Arabia. We recommend checking your flight departure status directly with the airline and with the airport. The initial alert led to reports circulating that the Embassy had been ordered to be evacuated, but State Department spokesperson Tommy Pigott issued a correction on Twitter/X stating that it was only meant for nonessential personel and their families. The U.S. Department of State issued an ordered departure for non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members in Saudi Arabia only. Iranian-supported Houthis have increasingly engaged in hostilities against Saudi Arabia, including attacks on civilian airports and other critical infrastructure resulting in civilian casualties and severe travel disruptions. The safety and security of Department personnel and their families remain our highest priority, and we will continue to take all necessary steps to protect and support them.
summary: The U.S. State Department ordered nonessential diplomatic personnel and families to depart Saudi Arabia following attacks by Iran-backed Houthi rebels. Multiple events in Riyadh have been canceled or postponed while the U.S. Embassy issued a new security alert noting expected further attacks and suspended operations at King Khalid International Airport. WWE has made no announcement to alter, postpone or relocate its scheduled Crown Jewel premium live event set for November 7 in Riyadh.

The alert follows an attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport on October 10, after which the airport reopened on Sunday.
Americans in the region are advised to exercise heightened vigilance due to the complex security environment.
Travelers should remain aware of possible flight cancellations, airspace closures, and other travel disruptions.
Iranian-supported Houthis have carried out hostilities against Saudi Arabia.

title: El Desperado Out Of NJPW Super Jr. Tag League
raw_title: El Desperado Withdraws From NJPW Super Jr. Tag League Due To Spinal Stenosis & Hernia
summary_src: El Desperado is out of action. New Japan Pro-Wrestling made the announcement that El Desperado is going to be out of action due to spinal stenosis and a hernia in his leg. He will miss the Super Jr.
body: New Japan Pro-Wrestling made the announcement t hat El Desperado is going to be out of action due to spinal stenosis and a hernia in his leg. He will miss the Super Jr. Tag League tournament and CMLL x NJPW Lucha Kingdom. Below is NJPW’s full write-up along with Desperado’s statement: We apologise to fans who were looking forward to seeing Desperado compete, and appreciate your understanding. In a video released on YouTube, Desperado stated: “My sincerest apologies, but I will not be appearing at Super Jr. Tag League. I’m currently dealing with spinal canal stenosis and a hernia. My left leg has no strength, and with the pain and pins and needles I’m currently unable to stand, walk or even sit upright for long periods of time. From the start of this year I’d noticed some strange sensations in my left glute, and there was some tingling in my legs from around March. At that point I expressed to the company that I was having some symptoms, but that I had no issues with strength or anything like that, and asked to continue wrestling, while staying in contact with the medical and training staff. For this Super Jr. Tag League, Mistico was scheduled to wrestle with me, and we can’t just send him back with nothing to say for it, so I have chosen (Masatora) Yasuda to replace me. Some of you might think ‘with your connections you can come up with a bigger name than a Young Lion,’ but I’d like for you to think of this as a key step to the future of NJPW. And don’t worry about Mistico. Even with his partner like this, he’ll show up for the fans like Mistico always does. I have complete trust in him. So that’s it. I’m off Super Jr. Tag League, and Yasuda is in. Ah, and as for (November 9 Shin Kiba 1st Ring produce event) ‘Gaspe’ Invitational. I can’t move, but my desire to see something truly horrific trumps all that, so we’ll be going ahead as planned. Show up.” New Japan Pro-Wrestling joins fans in wishing Desperado a speedy, full recovery.” As more information about Desperado’s recovery becomes available, we’ll update you here on Fightful.
summary: New Japan Pro-Wrestling announced that El Desperado will miss the Super Jr. Tag League and CMLL x NJPW Lucha Kingdom due to spinal stenosis and a hernia in his leg. The wrestler has been experiencing no strength in his left leg along with pain, pins and needles, preventing him from standing, walking or sitting for extended periods. El Desperado first noticed symptoms in his left glute at the beginning of the year and tingling in his legs from March but continued wrestling after informing the company.

title: Booker T Details Business-Only Bond With Triple H
raw_title: Booker T explains why he and Triple H have never been close friends
summary_src: Booker T has explained his relationship and friendship with Triple H. Always suspected by fans to have a tense relationship with Triple H, Booker T has now cleared the air regarding it.
body: Booker T has explained his relationship and friendship with Triple H. “ When you’re talent, when you know you’re selling tickets, you’re equal. When you’re selling tickets, you might be looked at a little bit different ,” he shared before adding that he never got any heat because he made the boss know that he was selling tickets, and not make friends . “ I don’t have a lot of friends in the wrestling business. I got a few, but I don’t have a lot of friends because I wasn’t there to make friends. I had a lot of cool associates. Even now, people talk about Hunter [Triple H] and I, and our relationship. Hunter and I, we’ve always had a strong relationship, but it’s always been business ,” Booker T said. However, he also made it clear that while they share a strong professional relationship and haven’t gone out eating or hung out together. Despite not sharing a close relationship, he has nothing but respect for him. “ I’ve never looked at this like it was, ‘Hey, we’re buddies. We’re friends,’ or anything like that. Because this thing comes and goes. It’s here, and it’s gone tomorrow. And if you don’t understand that and treat it that way, you can really be upset at the end of the day. body: By Jason Powell , ProWrestling.net Editor ( @prowrestlingnet ) MLW issued the following press release on Tuesday to announce that its Fusion show is available for purchase via Amazon Prime. CHARLESTON, S.C. – Oct. 13, 2026 — Major League Wrestling (MLW) today announced that MLW Fusion is now available on Amazon Prime Video , expanding the league’s reach and giving fans another way to experience and collect its championship fights, epic rivalries and hard-hitting action. Fans can purchase full seasons for $26.99 or individual episodes for $1.99 . Explore MLW Fusion on Prime Video here. The launch of MLW Fusion on Amazon Prime Video further expands MLW’s distribution across leading streaming platforms, bringing the league’s flagship series to a broader audience and strengthening its global media footprint. “MLW belongs on the biggest platforms, and Amazon Prime Video is another significant step in that direction,” said MLW Founder and CEO Court Bauer. “We’re making it easier for fans to discover and experience Fusion, follow the rivalries and revisit the fights that get everyone talking. This gives our fans another way to watch and opens the door for a new audience to experience MLW.” MLW Fusion premieres Thursdays at 8 PM ET, streaming free on Tubi , with replays available on YouTube, VEEPS and NJPW WORLD. title: AEW's Claudio Castagnoli Names Favorite Wrestling Venue: 'As Perfect As It Comes'

body: "I think Arena Mexico," Castagnoli said. "The cathedral. That's pretty much as perfect as it comes." Having received lucha libre training from the luchador Skayde in the early days of his wrestling career, Castagnoli had long desired to wrestle in Arena Mexico before finally debuting there in March 2024. Since then, Castagnoli has become a regular at major CMLL events, including winning the 2024 CMLL International Gran Prix and the CMLL World Heavyweight Championship in late 2025 . The title reign led to Castagnoli signing a dual contract with AEW and CMLL in March , and he defended it successfully six times before dropping it to fellow AEW/CMLL star Hechicero. Castagnoli most recently competed in Arena Mexico for the 2026 International Gran Prix, making it all the way to the final two before once again being defeated by Hechicero. Since his last Arena Mexico appearance, Castagnoli has kept busy by making his third appearance in London's Wembley Stadium, as part of AEW All In this past weekend. Alongside Death Riders stablemates PAC and Wheeler Yuta, Castagnoli was part of the Trios Roulette Royale for the AEW World Trios Championships, once again making it to the end before he and PAC were eliminated by the debuting Austin Creed and Kofi, who captured the Trios Titles with partner Swerve Strickland .
