title: Skadi Wins CMLL International Women’s Grand Prix For Team Mexico
raw_title: Skadi Wins CMLL International Women’s Grand Prix For Team Mexico
body: Skadi pinned Megan Bayne at the 1:04:09 mark to win this year’s International Women’s Grand Prix for Team Mexico. The second generation luchadora lifted the Megasus up and destroyed her with a devastating Spinning Samoan Drop. This latest International Women’s Grand Prix was a start studded affair with wrestlers coming from AEW, STARDOM, Maple Leaf Pro, MLW, and RevPro coming to Arena Mexico to take on the brightest stars from CMLL. The ensuing match was an 11 vs. 11 clash, and ended up being the second International Women’s GP to eclipse a full hour. The biggest contributors for both teams were Persephone for Team Mexico, who eliminated both Mei Seira and Queen Aminata, and also gave the assist to help Olympia eliminate Marina Shafir after she was taken out by the Death Rider. The biggest contributor for Team World was split three ways between Bayne, Shafir, and Momo Watanabe, who all took out two a piece. Obviously Bayne will come down as the most dominant in the record books because she was the last to be eliminated, but the other two should be noted. Ever since the International Women’s GP was first introduced in 2021, Team Mexico has been able to beat Team World each time except in 2023 when future Team World member Tessa Blanchard won. The other women who’ve won are Dark Silueta in 2021, Dalys in 2022, Reyna Isis in 2024, and Persephone last year. Now, Skadi, the daughter of fellow CMLL luchadora Marcela, can add her name to the list. As always, we’ll aim to provide any further updates on CMLL as soon as we hear more.

summary_src: MVP is refuting the rumors that the Hurt Syndicate have refused to put people over in AEW. In a series of social media posts on Saturday, MVP stated that he had seen lies being reported about him, Shelton Benjamin and Bobby Lashley.
body: MVP is refuting the rumors that the Hurt Syndicate have refused to put people over in AEW. In a series of social media posts on Saturday, MVP stated that he had seen lies being reported about him, Shelton Benjamin and Bobby Lashley. “So I open up Twitter to see lies being reported about The Hurt Syndicate. BLATANT LIES!!! Who is the source of these lies? To the contrary, we wanted to work with younger talent! We wanted to drop the tag titles BACK to Private Party!!! STOP BELIEVING THE BS!” He had earlier responded to an article referencing comments made about Hurt Syndicate not wanting to put people over, and the group’s AEW run essentially being over by writing: “This is a blatant lie! ABSOLUTELY UNTRUE!!!!! Who is your source????” MVP then responded to a user on X who claimed a Swerve Strickland vs. Bobby Lashley rematch wasn’t happening due to “creative differences.” The user’s post also included a screenshot of an earlier rumor alleging that MVP had backstage heat and the Hurt Syndicate refused to put other wrestlers over. “Rumor? Nah man. You are absolutely Wrong!!!! None of this is true. But now I know where this whisper campaign is coming from! 😉” “Anyway, I hope most you have a magnificent Saturday! Those of you lying and spreading gossip founded on BS, have the day you deserve!” The last time the Hurt Syndicate wrestled was at the AEW All In Buy-In show at Wembley Stadium in London on August 30. Lashley and Benjamin teamed with Big Boom AJ and QT Marshall in a win over Shane Taylor Promotions’ Carlie Bravo, Lee Moriarty, Shane Taylor, and Shawn Dean. The Hurt Syndicate also teamed with Chris Jericho, Jack Perry, Kenny Omega, and the Young Bucks in a win over the Don Callis Family, The Demand and The Dogs in the Stadium Stampede match at Double or Nothing at Louis Armstrong Stadium in New York on May 24. Ian Carey Ian Carey is the Managing Editor at F4WOnline and is based in Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Ian's work has appeared in award-winning publications including NOW Magazine and The Huffington Post. He joined the F4WOnline team in 2019 and was named Managing Editor in the summer of 2026. Born in Calgary, Alberta, Ian has covered professional wrestling for more than 15 years.
summary: MVP took to social media on Saturday to refute rumors that he, Shelton Benjamin and Bobby Lashley refused to put younger wrestlers over in AEW. He stated the group wanted to work with younger talent and specifically wanted to drop the tag titles back to Private Party. MVP called the claims blatant lies and untrue, demanding to know the source of the reports.

llm_long: MVP has denied rumors claiming that the Hurt Syndicate refused to put other talent over in AEW. In multiple social media posts, he described the reports as blatant lies involving himself, Shelton Benjamin, and Bobby Lashley.
MVP stated that the group actually wanted to work with younger talent. He specifically mentioned their desire to drop the tag titles back to Private Party.

He directly responded to an article that referenced comments about the Hurt Syndicate not wanting to put people over and suggested their AEW run was essentially finished. MVP called the claims absolutely untrue and questioned the source.

MVP also addressed a social media post that linked a potential Swerve Strickland versus Bobby Lashley rematch cancellation to creative differences. He rejected the accompanying rumor about backstage heat and the group refusing to put others over, while indicating he now knew the origin of the whisper campaign.
The Hurt Syndicate last wrestled at the AEW All In Buy-In event on August 30 at Wembley Stadium. Lashley and Benjamin teamed with Big Boom AJ and QT Marshall to defeat Shane Taylor Promotions.

Earlier, the group participated in the Stadium Stampede match at Double or Nothing on May 24. They teamed with Chris Jericho, Jack Perry, Kenny Omega, and the Young Bucks to defeat the Don Callis Family, The Demand, and The Dogs.

title: On the Record: Rob Van Dam Opens Up On Uncomfortable Encounters With Scott Hall and Why Their Relationship Wasn’t Always Positive
raw_title: Rob Van Dam Reveals Uncomfortable Encounters With Scott Hall and Why Their Relationship Wasn’t Always Positive
summary_src: Rob Van Dam isn’t interested in rewriting history just because someone has passed away — and that includes his complicated relationship with WWE Hall of Famer Scott Hall.
body: Speaking on his 1 of a Kind with RVD podcast , Van Dam was discussing why he refuses to pretend every wrestler he encountered throughout his career was a great person. The subject came up while he was defending his continued criticism of Bobby Fulton, explaining that someone’s death doesn’t automatically erase the experiences people had with them. RVD made it clear that he doesn’t believe in changing his stories to make fans feel better about their favorite wrestlers. “After someone passes, unless you made amends with that person, you’re going to have whatever feelings you have about that person based on your experiences with them. And if that don’t change, then it don’t change.” “So, if you want to hear firsthand stories, they’re not always going to be colored the way that you want them to be because that’s not honest and that’s not true. And if you don’t want to hear the stories, then that’s cool, too.” That brought Van Dam back to criticism he received roughly two years earlier after discussing Scott Hall. RVD explained that some fans weren’t happy because his recollections of Hall weren’t particularly flattering. One encounter that stuck with him happened at a For the Love of Wrestling convention in England. Van Dam recalled finding himself at a bar with Hall, who began opening up about personal matters. According to RVD, the conversation quickly became uncomfortable. “It was for the Love of Wrestling, and we were in England, and we ended up at the bar together. And he was just — I was just talking about, you know, like he had this energy reeking off of him, like punishing himself. Like he was, you know, he was in one of those moods.” RVD recalled Hall bringing up the fact that they had never really spent time together drinking despite knowing each other for years. “First he was just like, ‘Robbie, you and I have never sat down together and like had a beer, like in all these years. Like we’ve never.’ And I’m just like, ‘Yeah, how about that, man?'” But Van Dam said there was already some history between them. He remembered an occasion when they were supposed to smoke together, only for Hall to back out after allegedly telling Sean Waltman that RVD was a stooge. “I remember we were gonna go smoking one time, and then he told X-Pac he thought I was a stooge, and so he backed out. And so, you know, I’m thinking about that, you know, like, yeah, stooge. Like if anybody — that’s like Bobby Fulton saying I’m dishonest. You know, like you picked the kind of opposite guy to f*ing label. That’s not even believable.” Things took another turn when Hall started asking RVD whether he knew about his past. Van Dam remembered Hall appearing deeply troubled during the conversation. “Anyway, all I said was, you know, that he was like, ‘Robbie, do you know anything about me? Like, do you know my story? Like what I did?’ And I was just like, ‘Oh God.’ You know, this is just getting really heavy real quick. And I was just like, ‘Yeah, yeah, Scott, I think I do.'”

title: Cody Rhodes Predicts Retirement Sooner Than Later
raw_title: WWE's Cody Rhodes Says Retirement Is Coming 'Sooner Than Later'
summary_src: Cody Rhodes has once again commented on his WWE retirement, stating that it'll come sooner than many might realize.
body: Sting's retirement seemed to open the flood gates for many other wrestlers to follow in his footsteps and leave the ring for the last time. In the last year, fans saw John Cena, Brock Lesnar, and AJ Styles retire, while Adam Copeland recently announced that he's gearing up to end his career by the close of 2027. For the likes of Cody Rhodes, retirement might seem too soon considering he's only been back in WWE for four years, but at 41, even "The American Nightmare" knows he's approaching the end. "I'll say it will probably happen sooner than later, and I'm not giving any type of spoiler. Time goes by, time goes by like this [snaps his fingers]," Rhodes said during an interview with " WrestleTalk ." "When my daughter is 11 years old, I'm not going to be falling down for a living anymore." The question was originally asked in context of Cena's retirement, which Rhodes claims taught him a lot in how it was executed and Cena's attitude towards it. "I think one of the things that I really enjoyed about how John did it is the finality he brought to it," he stated. "'I have given you everything, this is all I have, anything else wouldn't be right.' And when John says he will never wrestle again, he really means it." Rhodes also stated that he hopes to be brave enough to take a risk on a rising star to put over on his way out. Looking at the history of the industry, Rhodes believes one of the most impactful things that can happen is when a younger star takes the final steps to becoming the next "face" of a company, and he'd like to go out making that happen.
summary: Cody Rhodes told WrestleTalk that his in-ring career will likely end sooner than later as time passes quickly. The 41-year-old WWE star referenced his young daughter, saying he will not be taking bumps for a living when she turns 11. Rhodes cited John Cena's recent retirement as an example he admired for its sense of finality.

Rhodes estimated that his time with the company could last around six or seven more years. He expressed a desire not to overstay his welcome in the industry.
When asked about wrestling into his 50s, Rhodes said he does not want to continue that long. He emphasized his gratitude for what wrestling has provided him throughout his career.

Rhodes reflected on his journey from a mid-card talent with limited opportunities to achieving significant milestones. He mentioned portraying the character Guile from Street Fighter as one example of his accomplishments.

He noted that wrestling has given him a great deal while acknowledging the personal sacrifices made over the years. Rhodes believes there will come a point when it is time to stop taking from the industry.

body: During UFC 333, the promotion announced that Carlos Prates will fight Michael Morales for the Interim Welterweight Championship at UFC 336 in Toronto, Ontario, Canada on January 30. Islam Makhachev is the reigning Welterweight Champion, but was unable to fight in January due to Ramadan. Prates is coming off three straight (T)KO victories and three straight Performance of the Night bonuses, finishing Geoff Neal, Leon Edwards, and Jack Della Maddalena in his last three fights. Morales is 19-0 in his career. He’s won his last three fights by first round TKO, finishing Neil Magney, Gilbert Burns, and Sean Brady. In the main event, Joshua Van will defend the Flyweight Title against Manel Kape. Van has won eight straight fights and made two successful title defenses, most recently defeating Alexandre Pantoja. title: Shayna Baszler Targets TNA Knockouts Title
raw_title: Shayna Baszler eyes Knockouts Championship with TNA title pictures running wild
summary_src: Destination X is around the corner on November 15, but that hasn’t stopped the TNA title pictures from running wild before the PPV. One thing we know is that Leon Slater will defend the TNA World Championship against Trey Miguel in the main event of Destination X in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada.
body: Link TNA Manolo Has Pizzazz learned all of life’s lessons from decades of professional wrestling. Manolo has been covering the sport for over ten years on Cageside Seats. Destination X is around the corner on November 15, but that hasn’t stopped the TNA title pictures from running wild before the PPV. One thing we know is that Leon Slater will defend the TNA World Championship against Trey Miguel in the main event of Destination X in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. Trey earned the shot by winning a ladder match against other contenders. In the Knockouts division, Indi Hartwell won the Knockouts Championship and the Apex won the Knockouts Tag Team Championship at Bound For Glory . Those titleholders collided on Impact (Oct. 22, 2026) thanks to the power play from Daria Rae. The SUIT returned from suspension for slapping Hartwell. Indi was still in Daria’s sights, and she booked the champ into an impromptu contractual rematch against Xia Brookside. Despite wrestling in her street clothes, Hartwell overcame the challenge to prevail via Hurts Donut. In the aftermath, Daria distracted Hartwell so Zoey Serrano and Shayna Baszler could ambush the champ. Baszler choked Hartwell out and stood tall holding the Knockouts Championship over her body. Based on basic storytelling logic in professional wrestling, it seems likely that Baszler will get a shot at Hartwell for the gold. The depth in the Knockouts tag team division is increasing. Kiera Hogan dumped Allie to reunite with Tasha Steelz. Fire ‘n Flava are two-time tag champs in TNA. Shotzi Blackheart made a surprise appearance to save Allie, and it seems like that will be a tag team showdown. The Elegance Brand appears to be on the fritz lately. Plus, M is focused on defending the Knockouts Television Championship against Jada Stone on the next episode of Impact. The Nemeth brothers better keep their heads on a swivel. After winning the Call Your Shot Gauntlet, Frankie Kazarian made it clear that he wants to cash in with Avery Styles for the TNA World Tag Team Championship. Avery picked up momentum by beating Joe Alonzo in his Impact debut . At Bound For Glory, Amazing Red was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame, and he won the X-Division Championship . The legend’s first challenger was determined in a four-way contender bout. Cedric Alexander earned the shot after the System interfered to set Fabian Aichner on a platter. Alexander landed a moonsault to win. That title bout takes place on the next episode of Impact. Last not not least, the Order 4 saga is officially closed. Jason Hotch put the nail in the coffin to retain the TNA International Championship over Mustafa Ali in 2 out of 3 falls. Ali got the upper hand trading roll-ups to take Fall 1. Ali overzealously hit Hotch with the title belt to give away Fall 2 via disqualification. Hotch dug deep to win Fall 3 on a GTS variation. title: Billy Gunn Recalls Unexpected AEW In-Ring Run
raw_title: Billy Gunn Says He Wrestled Much More Than Expected In AEW
summary_src: When Billy Gunn started with AEW, he expected to mainly be a coach while wrestling a handful of matches each year, but that quickly expanded.
body: AEW Billy Gunn's AEW run saw him going from a backstage coach to accompanying his sons, Austin and Colten, as The Gunn Club. Eventually, he'd take on his "Daddy A**" gimmick alongside The Acclaimed, even winning the AEW World Trios Championships with Max Caster and Anthony Bowens. Detailing his AEW tenure on "Inside The Ropes," Gunn explained that he wasn't expecting to have a career resurgence in his late 50s and early 60s. "Yeah, so my contract, I had 12 dates a year. Like, I really wasn't gonna wrestle, but I told Tony [Khan], 'If you need me to, I'll do some here and here and there,'" he explained. Gunn added that he had two contracts with AEW, one as a talent and the other in a backstage role. "And then, lo and behold, they crack me out and then I'm working both shows. I'm working all the time, about to fall apart," he laughed. When asked about how it felt to go up against talent considerably younger than him, Gunn credited that ability to the fact that he was never out of shape , and asserted that he could always "hang" with the young guys. "No matter what they do, I can still — it's going to hurt a little while — I can go if I need to." The 62 year-old shared his belief that, at his age, he's not supposed to be in the ring anymore, but he loves to work out for his health and was still in shape to perform. "[Working out] also lets me still hang with my kids, and Anthony, and those guys, and when I need to work, I can work," Gunn said.
summary: Billy Gunn signed with AEW expecting to wrestle only about a dozen times per year while also working backstage. Instead he ended up competing frequently on both shows and capturing the AEW World Trios Championship with The Acclaimed as part of his "Daddy Ass" persona. On Inside The Ropes, Gunn said he was surprised by the career resurgence in his late 50s and early 60s but credited staying in shape for his ability to keep up with much younger opponents.

title: Comeback Watch: Big Change Reportedly Awaiting Drew McIntyre Upon His WWE Return
raw_title: Big Change Reportedly Awaiting Drew McIntyre Upon His WWE Return
body: McIntyre, who has been out of action since WrestleMania 42, is rumored to be back soon, with " Wrestlevotes on Fightful Select " reporting that fans could see him on "WWE Raw" upon his comeback. The report highlighted that sources in WWE believe that the Scotsman could be of better use on the red brand than on the Friday night show. The outlet added that WWE had intended to bring the former world champion back to television since August and had ideas for him, but ultimately decided to change course. During his absence from WWE television, McIntyre has filmed a few movies, including Russell Crowe's "The Last Druid." A recent report confirmed that the McIntyre's movie commitments have ended , which he appeared to hint at in a social media post featuring a video of him training . McIntyre's last match in WWE came at WrestleMania 42, when he lost to Jacob Fatu in an unsanctioned match. He was a constant fixture on the blue brand since the start of 2025, a run which also saw him win the Undisputed WWE Championship from Cody Rhodes at the start of 2026, which he lost back to "The American Nightmare."

body: Knockout Brothers Recapture IWGP Tag Team Titles, Jeff Cobb Revealed as Mystery Partner for NJPW King of Pro-Wrestling 2026 3 weeks ago Image Credit New Japan Pro-Wrestling Image Credit New Japan Pro-Wrestling On October 6th, NJPW’s first night of Road to King of Pro-Wrestling 2026 took place at the legendary Korakuen Hall, with 1,041 fans in attendance to see the Knockout Brothers challenge the United Empire tandem of Great-O-Khan and HENARE for the IWGP Tag Team Titles. The Knockout Brothers, OSKAR and Yuto-Ice, lost the IWGP Tag Team Titles back in June to HENARE and O-Khan, and earned another shot at the championship by defeating Togi Makabe and Toru Yano last month in a very violent No. 1 contenders match. The title match between UE and the Knockout Brothers took place here in the show’s main event, with the champions coming into the bout with a strict game plan: take out the knee of the giant OSKAR and try to keep Yuto-Ice down long enough to continue their reign with the titles. Streaming now on #njpwworld #njkopw pic.twitter.com/nURVnA8NfM The match was exciting, and all was going to plan for O-Khan and HENARE, until the Knockout Brothers once again affirmed the strength of their Pro-Wrestling High and turned the tide in their favor. It would be Yuto-Ice using his body as a shield to protect OSKAR’s knee from chair shots brought on by O-Khan that would be the momentum shifter for challengers. After fighting off a kneebar from O-Khan with another assist from Ice, OSKAR was able to recover, and he and Ice were able to find an opening to hit O-Khan with the K.O.B to secure the victory and start their second reign as champions. Since business between the Knockout Brothers and United Empire is far from finished, Yuto-Ice took time during his post-match comments to reveal that former United Empire member and current Unbound Juggernaut Jeff Cobb would be fighting alongside them in challenging O-Khan, HENARE, and AEW Men’s World Champion Will Ospreay for the NEVER Openweight Six-Man Titles at King of Pro-Wrestling on October 12th. title: Leon Slater Hopes For TNA Six-Sided Ring Return
raw_title: Leon Slater Says He Would Love To Compete In TNA's Six-Sided Ring As TNA World Champion
summary_src: Leon Slater says he’d love to compete in a six-sided ring in TNA. When TNA first made its debut, they didn’t use the traditional four-sided ring but rather a six-sided wrestling ring, which was used until 2010. They later brought it back in 2014 but ultimately retired it again in 2018.
body: Leon Slater says he’d love to compete in a six-sided ring in TNA. When TNA first made its debut, they didn’t use the traditional four-sided ring but rather a six-sided wrestling ring, which was used until 2010. They later brought it back in 2014 but ultimately retired it again in 2018. Speaking on the I Love Wrestling Podcast , Leon Slater was asked about his reaction to the announcement of TNA Destination X returning this year. Slater said that he was praying that the six-sided ring would make a comeback again. “I was just praying that the six-sided ring would come back, to be real. I don’t know if it is, I don’t know if it isn’t, but man, I hope it does. Because I’m sure, growing up a TNA fan, that’s what we loved, right? So to get the chance to compete in a six-sided ring, as much as people said it sucked back in the day, it’s like way harder; it hurts way more than a four-sided ring, and that hurts enough. I would love the chance to be TNA World Champion and wrestle in a TNA six-sided ring. Elsewhere in the interview, Slater talked about his Option C promo at TNA Lockdown. Fans can read his full comments here . If you use any of the quotes above, please credit and link to the original source with a h/t and link back to Fightful for the transcription.
summary: Leon Slater expressed his desire to wrestle in TNA's six-sided ring as the TNA World Champion. The British star, a longtime TNA fan, discussed the unique ring on the I Love Wrestling Podcast while reacting to the return of Destination X. He noted the six-sided ring was originally used from TNA's debut until 2010, revived in 2014 and retired again in 2018.

llm.summary: Leon Slater expressed his desire to wrestle in TNA's six-sided ring as the TNA World Champion. The British star, a longtime TNA fan, discussed the unique ring on the I Love Wrestling Podcast while reacting to the return of Destination X. He noted the six-sided ring was originally used from TNA's debut until 2010, revived in 2014 and retired again in 2018.
llm.speaker: Leon Slater
llm.quote: I would love the chance to be TNA World Champion and wrestle in a TNA six-sided ring.

llm_long: Leon Slater expressed his strong desire to compete inside a TNA six-sided ring. The British wrestler shared his excitement while discussing the upcoming return of TNA Destination X during an appearance on the I Love Wrestling Podcast. Slater admitted he had been hoping the six-sided ring would be revived for the event. He noted uncertainty about whether it would actually return but emphasized his wish to experience it firsthand.

The six-sided ring was a signature element when TNA first launched and remained in use until 2010. It was later reintroduced in 2014 before being retired once more in 2018. Reflecting on his fandom, Slater recalled that growing up as a TNA supporter made the unique ring a beloved aspect of the promotion. He acknowledged that while many criticized it in the past, performing in the six-sided ring is significantly more difficult and painful than a traditional four-sided ring.

Slater stated he would love the opportunity to capture the TNA World Championship while competing inside the six-sided ring. He also addressed his Option C promo from TNA Lockdown during the same interview.

title: Injury Update: Stephanie Vaquer Cleared for WWE In-Ring Return After Ankle Injury
raw_title: Stephanie Vaquer Cleared for WWE In-Ring Return After Ankle Injury
summary_src: Stephanie Vaquer is officially done with the crutches and ready to get back in the ring. After suffering an ankle injury at Money in the Bank, Vaquer has now confirmed she’s cleared to compete — and Becky Lynch is apparently first on her list.
body: WWE posted a video of Vaquer on Twitter , where she delivered the good news herself. Vaquer dramatically tossed her crutches aside before revealing that she’s been cleared and sending a very direct message to Lynch. “Becky, you wanted to know when I’m cleared? See you Monday.” That means Vaquer is set to confront Lynch on the October 26 episode of Monday Night RAW. Whatever Becky has been waiting to say or do, she won’t have to wait much longer now that Vaquer is officially cleared. Vaquer had been dealing with the ankle issue since Money in the Bank , where she lost the Women’s World Championship to Liv Morgan. Fans became concerned after the match when Vaquer was visibly limping, needed help from referee Jessika Carr and eventually sat down on the steel steps before heading backstage. Vaquer later confirmed that she had twisted her ankle during the show . At the time, she played down the severity and said she expected the injury to require only a short period of rest. “I twisted my ankle. It’s not a big deal — just a couple of days of rest.” The injury was legitimate rather than part of a WWE storyline, but there was optimism from the beginning that Vaquer wouldn’t be sidelined for long. She also made it clear that losing her championship bothered her considerably more than the ankle itself. “But more than anything, I’m very disappointed about that match. I would have loved to be able to do this interview with you with the championship here on my shoulder, but I wasn’t able to retain it.” Now the injury question is officially out of the way, and Vaquer already has some unfinished business waiting for her. Her message to Becky makes Monday’s RAW the next stop, and fans won’t have to wait long to find out what happens when the two come face-to-face. title: WWE Legend Ric Flair’s Health Update Revealed Following Hospitalization
raw_title: WWE Legend Ric Flair’s Health Update Revealed Following Hospitalization
body: ‘The Nature Boy’s fall came hours after he had shared a health update on social media. Flair, 77, broke his silence and shared a promising health update after being hospitalized yesterday. The WWE Hall of Famer issued a statement on his X account, saying that he will be okay after the fall. Flair posted a photo alongside the statement, which showed his right eye bandaged. He expressed his gratitude to the hospital staff and doctors for taking care of him well into the early morning hours. “Thank you all for the messages and prayers! I will get back to you each individually as I get stronger. Thank you to all the Tampa General Hospital staff and doctors that put up with me until 4:30 a.m. I appreciate you all and thank you for everything you did for me. I am focused on my healing and recovery right now,” Flair wrote on X . “I will be okay! And just so you know, for those who were asking and wondering, I don’t own my own Facebook page anymore. I apologize for the reckless posting behavior on my Facebook when I was in the hospital. It was completely inappropriate!” Flair wrote. Although Flair’s fall was a scary situation, particularly because of his age, it is nice to see that he received a promising health update. Ric Flair was forced to cancel an appearance in Seattle, Washington, because of a blood clot in his leg. The WWE Hall of Famer was told that he had to limit his travel, so he regrettably canceled his appearance. Flair revealed that he will be undergoing a procedure soon to address the issue. He then apologized to fans for the inconvenience, but said that he will be prioritizing his health. “I am truly sorry of the inconvenience and disappointment. I’m incredibly grateful for you patience, understanding, and continued support. I look forward to getting healthy and seeing you all down the road,” Flair wrote on X . Flair’s hospitalization led to fans extending their best wishes to the pro wrestling legend on social media. His daughter, WWE superstar Charlotte Flair took to social media to update fans on her father’s health. While Flair did sustain some injuries from the fall, most noticeably on his eye, Charlotte reassured fans that he will be okay. Charlotte even shared that her father did not lost his sense of humor, saying that late WWE legend Ultimate Warrior was to blame. “Not my dad telling the doctor he fell because of Warrior dropping him on his head. (Ps: He’s going to be ok),” Charlotte Flair wrote on X . Giancarlo Aulino Giancarlo Aulino is sports writer who covers UFC for Heavy.com. He began writing for Heavy in 2025 after providing MMA coverage for Sportskeeda. Giancarlo is an experienced journalist and interviewer, having covered soccer clubs Toronto FC and Inter Toronto FC as a full-season reporter, and also producing sports coverage for Toronto radio station VIBE 105.5FM. title: End of an Era: Rey Mysterio's Final 4 Opponents Before He Retires
raw_title: Rey Mysterio's Final 4 Opponents Before He Retires
body: By Shawn Van Horn Published Oct 24, 2026, 5:00 PM EDT Shawn Van Horn is a Features Writer & Editor for The Sportster. He is also a Senior Author for Collider. Shawn has followed pro wrestling for most of his life is well-versed in current events of WWE and AEW. He lives in small town Ohio, where he likes to watch rasslin' and movies. Sign in to your TheSportster account Rey Mysterio is such an influential wrestling legend that WWE inducted him into the Hall of Fame even before he retired. Still, there comes a time when all professional wresters must hang up their boots for the last time. For Mysterio, the time could be coming very soon, as Wrestlevotes on Fightful Select reported that 2027 may be his goodbye from the sport. With all he has accomplished in putting luchadors on the mainstream map, from WCW to WWE and everywhere in between , Mysterio deserves a memorable sendoff . These four wrestlers should be his final opponents. Mysterio can face a whole host of newer superstars in his last matches, but like John Cena did, it's the legends and former rivals we want to see him tangle up with. Along with Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes is the face of WWE. It only makes sense that the American Nightmare should show the ultimate respect to Rey Mysterio by having a match with him. There is more there, however, than a simple dream match between two greats. Mysterio and Rhodes have a history which helped shape who Cody is today. With Mysterio having always been a babyface, what he did for Rhodes during a great heel run back in 2011 can't be understated. The son of Dusty Rhodes struggled in his early days until he became a cocky, self-absorbed bad guy under the "Dashing" gimmick . After Rey broke Cody's nose during a match , Rhodes transformed from a narcissist to a man breaking down who had to hide his face behind a mask. The brilliant SmackDown feud led to a match at WrestleMania 27 and beyond . Having the two of them face off again must happen, especially if we get the Cody Rhodes heel turn we've all been clamoring for. Today, CM Punk is cheered by everyone, no matter what he does. It's easy to forget just how good of a heel he once was, especially during his Straight Edge Society days , when Punk led his own faction and had angry fans eating out of the palm of his hand. If you're a bad guy in WWE, there's no easier way to get over than to make Rey Mysterio a target. That's exactly what Punk did. Punk and Mysterio had a long rivalry in 2010, with a match at WrestleMania 26 that the latter won leading to Punk snapping . This resulted in several PLE matches, with Punk so desperate to win that he began stalking Rey's family. Their feud ended with a stipulation match. If Punk won, Mysterio would have to join the SES. If Rey won, Punk shaved his head. The good guy, as usually happens in sports entertainment, got the win, forcing Punk to go bald . In 2027, no one needs to play the heel. These two greats can tell a phenomenal story with their personalities alone.

See you Monday 😘” So much for a welcome-back message. Vaquer spent months recovering from an ankle injury, and Lynch is already counting down the days until she expects her to get hurt again. Vaquer’s injury happened at Money in the Bank, where she lost the Women’s World Championship to Liv Morgan. Unfortunately for her, Lynch has absolutely no intention of making that return a pleasant experience. The timing also makes Becky’s comment even more personal. Vaquer hasn’t wrestled since getting hurt, and rather than question whether she can beat Lynch, Becky is questioning whether she can even stay healthy long enough to stick around. Both women are now headed for the October 26 episode of WWE RAW, and Lynch has already made sure their confrontation won’t be friendly. Vaquer wanted Becky to know she was cleared. Becky responded by putting an expiration date on her comeback. title: Ric Flair Rushed to Hospital After Falling Outside Restaurant in Florida

body: Getty/TMZ Sports Ric Flair was taken to the hospital after he fell outside a restaurant in Florida on Friday ... hours after telling fans he couldn't fly due to a blood clot. Sources with direct knowledge tell TMZ Sports ... Ric was hanging at Wagamama in Tampa this morning when he got up from the bar, leaving his phone and drink behind and walking across the street. While outside, our sources say Ric suddenly fell and injured his face. A photo TMZ Sports has obtained shows emergency medical personnel gathered around Ric. Launch Gallery TMZSports.com We're told Ric cut his head and eye open during the fall ... and his eye was bleeding extensively. He may also have a concussion. He was ultimately loaded into an ambulance and taken to the hospital. The timing of Ric's fall is interesting ... because he released a statement a few hours ago saying he couldn't make it to a fan convention in Seattle because doctors told him not to fly too far with the clot. Our sources tell us the clot issue isn't new ... but instead something the legendary wrestler has been dealing with for months. He noted blood clots can be serious -- even life-threatening -- in his post ... and also mentioned Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts' own recent diagnosis with clots. Ric apologized to fans and his agent for having to miss the event. He also said he will soon undergo a procedure to have the affected vein stripped. It's unclear how this fall may impact that procedure. Friday's trip to the hospital isn't the first for Flair ... who nearly died back in 2017 after an intestinal rupture. Ric spent weeks in the ICU, part of the time in a medically induced coma, before making a miraculous recovery.

summary_src: Zoey Serrano thought she was legitimately going to pass out during one of her WWE matches with Shayna Baszler, and Triple H apparently wasn’t ready for the match to end just yet.
body: During an episode of Zoey’s 10,001 Internet Questions , Serrano and Baszler looked back at their experiences wrestling each other in WWE. Serrano specifically remembered one match where Baszler was wearing a cast and was supposed to finish her off with the Kirifuda Clutch. Serrano said Baszler was putting the submission on tight enough that things quickly became uncomfortable. She recalled needing to tap out as part of the finish but feeling like Baszler was legitimately putting the clutch on her. “There was, just because I haven’t told the internet this, we had a match together. You had that damn cast on. You had the cast on, and Hunter wanted you to, like—I needed to tap out, so you had to put your clutch on me. And you were, like, legit putting it on me, and I’m thinking—” Baszler immediately cut in and pushed back on that part of the story. She made it clear that she wasn’t intentionally applying the submission for real: “Okay, okay, okay. That’s not true.” Serrano clarified that the bigger problem was how exhausted she already was by that point. While stuck in the clutch and struggling to breathe, she kept hearing the referee relay the same message from Triple H. “But when you’re already, like, tired, it’s different. And I felt like I couldn’t breathe, and it felt like forever. And all I keep hearing the ref say, ‘Hunter says keep going. Hunter says keep going.’ And at this point, I’m cursing the ref. I’m like, ‘What is happening?’” Baszler then explained what Triple H actually meant by telling them to keep going. According to her, he wasn’t telling Serrano to simply lie there in the submission but wanted her to continue fighting. “Let me explain something, too. When Hunter is on the headset saying, ‘Keep going,’ he’s not saying just lay there in it. He wants you to be fighting.” Serrano agreed, explaining that she had to keep scrambling, getting back up and going down again while Baszler remained attached to her. That made an already exhausting situation even tougher. Baszler admitted Serrano wasn’t exaggerating about how rough the Kirifuda Clutch could feel in that situation. She then got into why someone’s submission experience can make such a big difference. “And I’m sorry, Z, but you’re not lying, especially in that clutch.” Baszler asked Serrano how much legitimate submission training she had at the time. Serrano revealed she had around two years of experience and was still a white belt. “All right, so for anyone that trains submission, how much submission training do you have? Shoot, shoot.” Serrano didn’t try to oversell her experience. She gave Baszler a pretty straightforward answer about where she was at with her training: “Like two years. I Appreciate You All And Thank You For Everything You Did For Me!” Flair had fallen outside a Wagamama restaurant in Tampa on Friday, cutting his head and eye, TMZ reported . “I Am Focused On My Healing And Recovery Right Now,” he said, adding, “I Will Be Okay!” He shared a photo of himself smiling with a patch covering one of his eyes. Just hours before his fall, Flair had told his fans he had to cancel an appearance at the Washington State Horror Con in Seattle due to a blood clot in his leg.
summary: - WWE legend Ric Flair was hospitalized after falling outside of a Florida restaurant, per multiple reports. Just hours before his fall, Flair had told his the audience he had to cancel an appearance at the Washington State Horror Con in Seattle due to a blood clot.

title: Legal Watch: Former WWE NXT and AEW Wrestler Amber Flora Arrested for DUI in Florida
raw_title: Former WWE NXT and AEW Wrestler Amber Flora Arrested for DUI in Florida
summary_src: Former WWE NXT and AEW wrestler Amber Flora is dealing with some serious legal trouble after getting arrested in Florida. The 34-year-old wrestler, also known as Amber Nova, was busted on DUI-related charges in Orlando, and she was already back out of jail just hours later.
body: According to court documents obtained by Ringside News, Flora was arrested on Friday, October 23, on charges of driving under the influence and refusing to submit to DUI testing. She was booked by Orlando police and released at 10:07 AM after posting $2,000 in total bail. Ringside News has also obtained nine pages of law enforcement documents filed in Orange County on October 24, confirming that Flora was arrested in connection with a DUI investigation. The paperwork identifies her as Amber Judith Flora and lists Orlando Police Department Officer Alvin Silverio as the arresting officer. The records place her arrest at 1:48 AM on October 23 near South Orange Blossom Trail and McLeod Road in Orlando. The documents also indicate that no crash was involved in the incident. Flora was taken to the Orange County Sheriff’s Office DUI Testing Center following her arrest, where officers attempted to obtain breath samples. However, the testing documents show that no valid samples were collected, leaving investigators without a recorded blood alcohol concentration from those attempts. The arrest comes as Flora has continued making appearances throughout the professional wrestling industry. She made a name for herself on the independent scene, capturing the SHINE Nova Championship in 2023, and has appeared for WWE NXT, AEW and Impact Wrestling. Ringside News can also confirm that that Flora attended a mandatory court appearance on Saturday, October 24, with another compliance date scheduled for November 2. The situation now leaves Flora facing two DUI-related allegations, although an arrest doesn’t establish guilt and the case has not been resolved. The court process will determine what happens next. For now, the wrestler is out of custody, but the legal trouble is far from over. With another court date approaching, Flora will have to deal with the allegations while questions remain about exactly what happened during her encounter with Orlando police. title: WWE Announces Major Women’s Match for October 26 RAW
raw_title: WWE Announces Major Women’s Match for October 26 RAW
summary_src: Becky Lynch and Stephanie Vaquer have been going at each other on social media, and now Adam Pearce has stepped in with an announcement that puts a championship opportunity on the line.
body: On October 24, Pearce took to Instagram to announce that Lynch will face Vaquer on Monday Night RAW, with the winner earning a future shot at the Women’s Championship. The decision comes just hours after Lynch mocked Vaquer’s recent injury, predicting that she’d be back on the sidelines within three weeks of returning. The trouble started when WWE shared footage of Vaquer announcing she’d been medically cleared . After spending months recovering from an ankle injury suffered at Money in the Bank, Vaquer tossed her crutches aside and sent a direct message to Lynch, telling her she’d see her on Monday. Becky didn’t exactly roll out the welcome mat. Instead, she fired back on Twitter by predicting Vaquer would be injured again within three weeks. The jab made it clear that Lynch wasn’t interested in celebrating Vaquer’s recovery, and now she’ll have to back up those words inside the ring. Vaquer hasn’t competed since Money in the Bank, where she lost the Women’s World Championship to Liv Morgan and suffered a legitimate ankle injury. She initially believed she’d only need a few days of rest, but her absence stretched much longer than expected. Now that she’s finally cleared, WWE isn’t wasting any time putting her into a major match. The stakes couldn’t be much higher for either woman. Vaquer has an opportunity to get right back into the championship picture after losing her title, while Lynch can secure another title opportunity by defeating someone she just publicly mocked for getting injured. What started as a heated exchange online has now turned into one of the biggest matches announced for Monday’s show. Pearce has made sure that neither woman can simply walk away from the situation, and the winner will have a championship opportunity waiting on the other side. With Vaquer making her return to competition and Lynch already taking shots at her health, Monday’s RAW has all the ingredients for an ugly showdown. The trash talk is over, the match is official, and one of them is leaving with a shot at the Women’s Championship. summary: Pearce took to Instagram to announce that Lynch is slated to meet Vaquer on Monday Night RAW, with the winner earning a future shot at the Women’s Championship. Now that she’s finally cleared, WWE isn’t wasting any time putting her into a major match.

title: On the Record: Drew McIntyre Says Vince McMahon Put Undertaker in Charge of Him
raw_title: Drew McIntyre Says Vince McMahon Put Undertaker in Charge of Him
body: During a recent interview with The Joe Vulpis Podcast , WWE Superstar and former WWE Champion Drew McIntyre spoke about who gave him advice when he first joined WWE in 2007. McIntyre revealed that after Vince McMahon anointed him as “The Chosen One,” McMahon assigned The Undertaker to be in charge of him. Below are some highlights: “There was a few people looking after me. They had to. I was so helpless. So, I got to America in 2007, I want to say November, and I was on TV 3 weeks later. The writers happened to be there the first week that I was in America at OVW, Ohio Valley Wrestling, where [John] Cena came from, Batista, Brock [Lesnar] — The training ground, like Wade Barrett and I were going there. I got there three weeks before him. The writers happened to be there. They needed a body to get in the ring so they could see the guy who was a heel. ‘Like, kid, do you mind just rolling around with him?’ And then I caught a little promo afterwards. And I guess they like what they saw. And I got a call from Howard Finkel telling me that you’re going to be on TV the following week. And I was like, ‘Okay, Howard Finkel, I’ll be on TV next week.’ “And sure enough, I was on Smackdown the following week. And I remember I was wrestling Zack Ryder. About the same age as well. Been around for a minute. And the referee said to me at one point, ‘Work the hard camera.’ And I was like, ‘What the **** is a hard camera?’ ‘Like, ask the referee.’ I just came from the UK. We didn’t have television over there. Like we had a little TV show. We all turned our back to, like, say, this is the hard camera, the main camera that’s catching the wide shot of the ring. He kept telling me, face that, basically, cuz that’s where the millions of people are. You keep turning your back to them. I had no idea what it was. So I was literally watching WWE five, six weeks prior at university in the dorms, and at my girlfriend’s dorms at the time. And then suddenly I was on SmackDown wrestling, and then I got back to the apartment. “I was living in Louisville, and I remember getting on the internet at the little internet cafe there. My MySpace had blowing up, and I was like, ‘Oh, a lot of friend requests. Wonder why.’ Oh, accept, accept, accept, accept, accept again. Just no time to process anything, understand what’s going on. And my buddy told me, ‘It’s cuz you’re on TV worldwide, you idiot!’ I was like, ‘Oh, everyone just wants to be my friend all of a sudden.’ So trying to process everything. You’re coming over, and things happening so quick was insane.” “Thankfully I had people like Dave Taylor who was a British wrestler was forced to look after me. summary_src: Amber Flora’s DUI arrest is looking a whole lot messier now that police documents are coming to light. The former WWE NXT and AEW wrestler was allegedly slurring her words, swaying while walking and struggling to provide a breath sample after being arrested in Orlando, Florida.
body: Ringside News obtained nine pages of official law enforcement documents filed in Orange County on October 24, detailing what happened after F lora was arrested on October 23. The 34-year-old wrestler, also known as Amber Nova, was taken into custody by Orlando police at approximately 1:48 AM on suspicion of DUI before being brought to the Orange County Sheriff’s Office DUI Testing Center. That’s where officers say things started getting interesting. According to the Alcohol Influence Form, Flora had bloodshot, glassy eyes, a flushed face and an odor of alcohol coming from her breath. Her speech was described as slow and thick-tongued, while officers also documented that she appeared dazed and confused. Despite those observations, the report states that she was cooperative during the initial observation period. The situation apparently didn’t get any better when officers escorted her to the testing room. According to the documents, Flora was walking slowly and swaying from side to side. Police then asked her to submit to a breath alcohol test, but she initially refused. After officers explained the consequences, she was unable to make a decision about whether she would continue refusing, so the testing equipment was started to give her another opportunity. That first round didn’t go anywhere. Between 3:06 AM and 3:17 AM, officers attempted to collect two breath samples, but neither produced a valid result. The official testing records marked both attempts as “NSP,” meaning no sample provided. Flora also asked to speak with her attorney during the process, according to the officer’s account. But here’s where things took another turn. Before officers finalized the refusal, Flora pleaded with them and said she wanted to take the breath test after all. Police restarted the machine and gave her another chance, but the second round ended exactly like the first. Between 3:19 AM and 3:31 AM, two additional attempts failed to produce valid breath samples. According to the officer’s written account, Flora continued talking during the periods when she was supposed to provide a sample. After four unsuccessful attempts across two testing sequences, police officially classified the situation as a refusal at 3:31 AM. The paperwork doesn’t contain a measured blood alcohol concentration, meaning there’s no documented breath alcohol reading establishing how much alcohol, if any, was in Flora’s system. However, officers recorded multiple observations they considered signs of possible impairment, and the refusal became a separate part of her legal troubles. Flora was subsequently released from custody after posting $2,000 in total bail. She appeared in court on October 24, with another compliance date scheduled for November 2. The wrestler previously competed for WWE NXT, AEW and Impact Wrestling, and captured the SHINE Nova Championship in 2023. title: TNA Instantly Fires Former AEW Star For Disrespecting WWE
raw_title: TNA Instantly Fires Former AEW Star For Disrespecting WWE
body: However, Caster referencing Saudi Arabia in a freestyle rap promo led to TNA cutting all ties instantly and sending the following press release: "During Sunday's Bound For Glory pay-per-view, insensitive comments were made by Max Caster referencing attacks in Riyadh that killed and injured many people. Making light of violent attacks is wrong. This should never have made it into the show, and that responsibility is ours. Our thoughts are with the victims, their families, and everyone affected. We sincerely apologize. We have removed the segment from replays and our social channels and are taking steps to ensure something like this never happens again. Max Caster will no longer be wrestling for TNA." TNA cited that the reference to Saudi Arabia attacks was not approved nor is it something they want an association with. Wrestling Observer questioned whether the WWE partnerships with Saudi Arabia and TNA influenced this decision. Caster is known for controversial rap promos, and TNA decided to cut bait after his first one. WWE likely had nothing to do with this directly since they only have a distant partnership with TNA. All that WWE really cares about is having an ally and sometimes using TNA to counter program AEW to hurt their efforts as competition. However, the partnership is more important to TNA as a smaller promotion who gets talent and sometimes financial help from WWE . TNA President Carlos Silva likely did factor in WWE's relationship with Saudi Arabia when growing upset about Caster's line. Silva and TNA do not want to alienate WWE or criticize their business relationship with Saudi Arabia. Caster's promo and all mentions of him were removed from TNA's social media page earlier today. TNA later made the public statement and confirmed Caster would not return again. Caster and his former AEW tag team partner Anthony Bowens have been rumored to have WWE interest once it became apparent that they were hitting free agency. The Acclaimed team could have been an easy act to bring to WWE. Bowens has been the name more linked to WWE , and it makes more sense now with Caster's controversial persona. Any chances of WWE signing Caster are likely done since they make so much money from Saudi Arabia and try to refrain from answering the safety concerns. Caster will now have to move around the independent circuit and hope that AEW eventually wants him back. Bowens getting signed by WWE would create even worse news for him since the potential of a tag reunion is his biggest bargaining chip for AEW . Caster tried to rock the boat with a controversial promo and instead just hurt his own career. The post TNA Instantly Fires Former AEW Star For Disrespecting WWE appeared first on HEAVY .

title: On the Record: Ilja Dragunov Opens Up On personal significance behind AEW debut entrance
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov reveals personal significance behind AEW debut entrance
body: Ilja Dragunov says the entrance music he used for his AEW debut at WrestleDream brought back memories of the earliest years of his professional wrestling career. Dragunov made his AEW debut on October 17 with a new entrance presentation featuring “Soviet March,” the same music he used while wrestling on the German independent circuit. Speaking to Ariel Helwani , the former WWE United States Champion explained why the music was so important to him and how it reflects his wrestling persona. “Because it’s putting together so many layers of my persona. I’m Russian-born but German-raised, and I have a lot of roots through to my German side of culture, but also to my family Russian side. And in the beginning, of course, when you try to find your own persona in professional wrestling, everybody was portraying me, of course, when I started, like, okay, you’re the Russian, so we need Russian music,” he said. “But I love classical music, so it has this classical vibe, but it also has this other vibe, and it’s also very heavy. And it also just fits so perfectly with my over-the-top, artsy, orchestra-composer-like persona. It fits just all the boxes. So if you hear this music, it exactly tells you how I perform,” he added. Dragunov said the entrance presentation was developed collaboratively with AEW, with both sides contributing ideas. “That is the best part about this, that since the work has begun, it has been always a collaboration. It has been always working together. So all the ideas that came from the company side and all the ideas that I had in my mind creatively were just flowing so well into one another,” he said. “That was such a beautiful procedure to work. And even just to get one little detail, that was one that touched my heart the most, is that even the entrance music, that it was possible to get this specific entrance music,” Dragunov added. The song accompanied Dragunov during his early career in Germany and remained an important part of his journey through European wrestling before he joined WWE. “This guided me through the youngest, youngest years to my biggest moments that put me on the platform in Europe, got me to the United Kingdom, got me to the States. So much of my career is based on that music. And when I heard this music and did my entrance on Saturday at WrestleDream, I felt like a child again in the business,” he shared. “And I was craving this feeling for a very, very long time.” Following his appearance at WrestleDream, Dragunov made his AEW in-ring debut on the October 21 episode of Dynamite, where he defeated “Speedball” Mike Bailey in the main event. raw_title: Jay White Reveals New AEW Faction Name After Teasing Bullet Club Return on Collision
summary_src: Jay White just gave his new AEW alliance an official name, but not before teasing a return to something fans know very well.
body: The announcement came after the two factions joined forces on Wednesday’s AEW Dynamite. David Finlay and Clark Connors aligned themselves with Jay White, Juice Robinson, Ace Austin, Austin Gunn and Colten Gunn following an attack on the Death Riders, bringing together seven wrestlers with a shared enemy. During his appearance on Collision, White made it clear that the newly formed alliance needed a fresh identity. He initially teased using the Bullet Club name, referencing the faction’s history and his own connection to the group, before revealing that they would officially be known as The Last Outfit. The Bullet Club tease was especially interesting considering White’s history with the faction in New Japan Pro Wrestling. Both White and Finlay previously led versions of Bullet Club, making their reunion under the same banner a significant development for anyone who followed their careers in Japan. Instead of bringing back the Bullet Club name, however, White and his allies are moving forward with something new. The Last Outfit now combines the Bang Bang Gang and The Dogs into one faction, giving AEW another major group as the company continues its build toward Full Gear. The decision also raises questions about what The Last Outfit has planned for the Death Riders. After their attack on Dynamite and White’s announcement on Collision, the group has already made its presence known, and its next move could make things even more complicated. With seven members, two former Bullet Club leaders and a brand-new identity, The Last Outfit has officially arrived in AEW. Whether this alliance can establish itself as one of the company’s most dangerous factions remains to be seen, but Jay White certainly knows how to get people talking. body: Alexander made his intentions known after picking up a dominant victory over Blade Brown on Collision. The Don Callis Family member wasted little time putting Brown away, finishing him with an ankle lock before grabbing a microphone and delivering a message about his faction’s growing dominance. Alexander praised Don Callis for assembling what he believes is the most dominant faction in professional wrestling. He also pointed to the group’s upcoming involvement in Blood & Guts, Mark Davis and Jake Doyle’s issues with the Young Bucks, and Kazuchika Okada holding the AEW International Championship. But Alexander wasn’t satisfied with watching his teammates collect opportunities. He wanted a championship of his own, and he specifically called out TNT Champion Darby Allin for a match at Fright Night Dynamite. Alexander also made another promise. If he beats Allin for the TNT Championship, he intends to defend the title against Adam Copeland, putting even more pressure on the champion heading into Wednesday. That brought Copeland out to confront Alexander and the Don Callis Family. Alexander and Trent Beretta initially retreated from the ring, leaving Rocky Romero to take a spear. Beretta then returned and suffered the same fate, but things quickly turned against Copeland when Mark Davis and Jake Doyle arrived and attacked him before Alexander could get his own spear. AEW later confirmed that Allin will defend the TNT Championship against Alexander on the October 28 edition of Dynamite: Fright Night, taking place in St. Louis, Missouri. With the Don Callis Family already causing problems for Copeland and Allin, Wednesday’s title match could have consequences beyond the championship itself. Alexander wants to bring another title into the faction, and he has made it clear that Copeland is already on his radar. title: WWE legend pictured after hospital treatment as fans 'shocked he's still alive'

body: Wrestling legend Ric Flair is pictured for the first time since being rushed to hospital following a fall outside a restaurant. The WWE hall of famer, 77, posted a selfie of his bruised face with an eye patch on show. The Nature Boy – who collapsed on Friday , just hours after revealing he had a blood clot – thanked fans for their well-wishes and said: "I am focused on my healing and recovery right now. I will be okay! "And just so you know for those who were asking and wondering, I don’t own my own Facebook page anymore. I apologize for the reckless posting behavior on my Facebook when I was in the hospital. It was completely inappropriate !" Flair is one of the most iconic wrestlers of all time (Image: WireImage) The 16-time former world champion also thanked medics who looked after him, posting on social media: "Thank you all for the messages and prayers! I will get back to you each individually as i get stronger. "Thank you to all the Tampa General Hospital staff and doctors that put up with me until 4:30am. I appreciate you all and thank you for everything you did for me!" Worried fans said they were praying for the WCW legend, who was reportedly at a Wagamama when he got up from the bar, left his phone as well as drink behind and walked across the street before suddenly falling and injuring his face. Flair previously revealed he had been diagnosed with a blood clot One wrote: "The shocking (and welcome) news is that Ric Flair is alive." Another said: "He ain’t got long left surely…?" A third said: "He looks so ill." Another fan said: "Bro’s one salt & vinegar crisp away from being finished off." A fan asked: "Seriously, how is this guy not dead yet?" But one wag joked that he had the Grim Reaper "going Broadway", a wrestling term for a time limit draw. The iconic grappler has suffered from a series of health issues in recent years, including being last year diagnosed with skin cancer. He beat the deadly disease for a second time in July 2025, but a life of excess has left him with issues. He was recently forced to cancel an appearance at a fan convention in Seattle, Washington and revealed doctors ordered him not to board long flights after finding a blood clot. Flair was bleeding extensively and was feared to have suffered a concussion in his fall. His daughter Charlotte, herself a 14-time WWE Women's Champion, revealed on X during his hospital stay that he told the doctor he fell because of the Ultimate Warrior dropping him on his head. title: Ric Flair Hospitalized After Fall Following Blood Clot Diagnosis
raw_title: Ric Flair health update after wrestling legend hospitalized hours after revealing blood clot
body: Per the TMZ report, which included photos and video of the 77-year-old wrestler down on the sidewalk being attended to paramedics, Flair suffered a "nasty" fall while walking across the street after leaving Tampa's Wagamama bar and restaurant. TMZ reported that Flair sustained cuts on his head and around his eye, that his eye was "bleeding extensively," and that it is also believed he may have sustained a concussion. The incident occurred just hours after Flair canceled an appearance at a fan convention in Seattle due to a blood clot in his leg. In a social media post Friday, Flair referenced the ongoing situation with Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts, whose season recently ended due to the discovery of blood clots in his lungs , and said he is scheduled to have a procedure to address the issue soon. Unfortunately, I Am Dealing With A Blood Clot In My Leg, And My Doctors Have Limited My Travel To 3–4 Hours. Seattle Falls Outside That Range, And As Disappointed As I Am, I Have To Put My Health And Recovery First. Blood Clots Are Extremely Serious And Can Be Life-Threatening. We Have Seen This Recently With Jalen Hurts And The Complications Involving Blood Clots In His Lungs. It Is A Reminder That This Is Not Something To Take Lightly, And I Must Follow Medical Advice. I'm Scheduled To Have A Procedure To Strip The Affected Vein, Which My Doctors Expect Will Allow Me To Be Cleared For More Travel Afterward. Please Know This Decision Was Not Made Lightly. I Am Truly Sorry For The Inconvenience And Disappointment, And I Am Incredibly Grateful For Your Patience, Understanding, And Continued Support. I Look Forward To Getting Healthy And Seeing You All Down The Road. Thank You For The Love And Support. Flair is a two-time WWE Hall of Famer and widely considered to be one of the greatest talents in pro-wrestling history. Flair's daughter, WWE star Charlotte Flair, issued an update late Friday on social media saying that her father is "going to be ok." Not my dad telling the doctor he fell bc of [Ultimate] Warrior dropping him on his head… (ps: he's going to be ok)

Flair referenced the seriousness of blood clots in a social media post, noting he is scheduled for a procedure to address the issue.

body: "Ben, he was one of the first guys that I called," Jericho said. "Tony [Khan] was calling him, the [Young] Bucks were calling him. But I called Mox, and I called PAC. And Ben was working in Dragon Gate, and didn't want to quite leave from there late, cause he had loyalty to Dragon Gate. I was like 'Okay, that's cool. But when you're ready, trust me, you're going to love it, because we're here for the right reasons, for the love of wrestling,' you know? And then he came and he was amazing." At the time of AEW's formation, PAC was the top foreign star in Dragon Gate, even making an appearance at AEW's Jacksonville rally with the Open the Dream Gate Championship, Dragon Gate's top title, in tow. title: In Memoriam: Wrestling world mourns the shocking death of AEW star PAC, Benjamin Satterley, at 40 — 'I'm speechless'
raw_title: 'I'm speechless': Wrestling world mourns the shocking death of AEW star PAC, Benjamin Satterley, at 40
body: AEW announced Satterley's shocking death Sunday night. He was 40 years old. No details surrounding his death have been released. The news sent shockwaves throughout the industry, particularly with Satterley competing just one night earlier at AEW All Out in the greater Chicago area. Satterley challenged Andrade for the AEW National Championship in the opening match of Saturday's pay-per-view. Current and former colleagues from AEW and WWE quickly took to social media to remember Satterley, who spent more than two decades in professional wrestling. AEW World Champion Will Ospreay, a fellow Englishman, called Satterley "the greatest export from our country" and "a hero to myself and many others." Fellow AEW star Kyle Fletcher shared an equally emotional tribute, calling Satterley one of his favorite wrestlers of all time and reflecting on the experience of working alongside a childhood hero. A flood of WWE stars and personalities also paid tribute, including Kevin Owens, Rhea Ripley, Jade Cargill, Adam Pearce and Paul Heyman, showing the reach Satterley had across the wrestling industry. Satterley joined AEW in 2019 following a six-year run with WWE that began in 2012. He remained a prominent member of the promotion's roster until his untimely death, wrestling in televised matches three times over the final eight days of his life. More reactions and tributes to Satterley from around the professional wrestling world can be seen below.

body: The 2026 edition of CMLL Torneo de Escuelas was won by the team of Escuela Magia Blanca (Tornado and Rey Pegasus). We just came out of the Torneo de Escuelas with a victory alongside my partner, Tornado. We didn’t expect such a quick response, but thanks to the fans, thanks to the promotion, and thanks to us and the effort and dedication we’ve put into this wonderful sport to keep moving forward. Now we really need to stay focused and keep preparing for more because, obviously, we want to keep climbing even higher on the ranks and in the programs.”

body: Los Perros del Mal continue to reign as the AAA World Trios Champions. Week One of AAA Héroes Inmortales saw Angel, Daga, and Berto defend the Trios Championship against Mr. Iguana, La Parka, and Nino Hamburguesa. The finish saw Karmen Petrovic climb the apron and distract the referee, paving the way for Daga to hit a low blow on La Parka and roll him for the pinfall. The champs attacked Iguana and Nino after the match. Karmen Petrovic also joined in the fun, as she stomped Nino against the steel steps. However, Big Mami returned to a massive pop and wiped out Karmen, launching her across the ring. She set Petrovic up for a running hip attack, but before she could execute the move, Daga pulled his ally out of the ring. Los Perros del Mal’s reign currently stands at 44 days. The trio captured the title from Los Psycho Circus at Triplemanía 34. summary: Los Perros del Mal defended the AAA World Trios Championship against Mr. Iguana, La Parka and Nino Hamburguesa in the opening week of Héroes Inmortales. Daga scored the pinfall on La Parka after a low blow set up by a distraction from Karmen Petrovic. Post-match, Big Mami made a surprise return to attack Petrovic and prevent further harm to the losing team. The champions' reign now stands at 44 days after winning the belts from Los Psycho Circus at Triplemanía 34.

title: Big Mami Returns to AAA at Heroes Inmortales 2026

summary_src: After months of absence from AAA television, Big Mami made her return at Heroes Inmortales 2026. Following the opening match of AAA Heroes Inmortales 2026, Los Perros del Mal began a ruthless attack on their opponents, La Parka, Mr. Iguana, and Niño Hamburguesa.
body: After months of absence from AAA television, Big Mami made her return at Heroes Inmortales 2026. Following the opening match of AAA Heroes Inmortales 2026, Los Perros del Mal began a ruthless attack on their opponents, La Parka, Mr. Iguana, and Niño Hamburguesa. After Los Perros del Mal defended their trios titles, Karmen Petrovic began attacking Hamburguesa. However, Big Mami came out for the rescue . Big Mami marched down the stage and almost performed a hip attack on Petrovic before she was pulled out of the ring and rescued. Big Mami is a former AAA World Mixed Tag Team Champion with Hamburguesa. The duo held the title for 775 days from 2017 to 2019. She last wrestled for AAA in 2025 before making her return at Heroes Inmortales 2026. As of now, AAA has not yet announced her in-ring comeback match, although she is expected to get involved in a feud with Los Perros del Mal. title: Ric Flair Shares Health Update, Photo Of Him Wearing Eye Patch After Fall
raw_title: Ric Flair Shares Health Update, Photo Of Him Wearing Eye Patch After Fall
body: Ric Flair is letting fans know he's OK after a fall landed him in the hospital ... sharing a photo of him wearing a patch taped over his right eye. Ric posted an update on Instagram ... thanking his fans for their support and the hospital staff for taking good care of him. He added .. "I am focused on my healing and recovery right now. I will be okay!" We broke the story ... Ric took a tumble outside a Wagamama in Tampa, Florida, on Friday ... cutting his head and eye open in the process. Ric's daughter Charlotte Flair previously shared with fans that her dad was going to be all right. She wrote on X ... "Not my dad telling the doctor he fell bc of warrior dropping him on his head... (p.s. he's going to be okay)." The scary fall came only a few hours after Ric revealed on social media that he's battling a blood clot in his leg that forced him to cancel upcoming travel ... so here's hoping he rests up!

title: Rey Pegasus Recalls Meeting Indie Peers in CMLL Torneo de Escuelas
raw_title: Rey Pegasus Speaks On Sharing The Ring With Fellow Indie Wrestlers In CMLL Torneo de Escuelas
summary_src: Rey Pegasus talks about meeting fellow wrestlers in CMLL Torneo de Escuelas. Rey Pegasus and Tornado won the 2026 edition of CMLL Torneo de Escuelas. He’s since won the Mexican National Middleweight Championship in the promotion as well.
body: Rey Pegasus talks about meeting fellow wrestlers in CMLL Torneo de Escuelas. Rey Pegasus and Tornado won the 2026 edition of CMLL Torneo de Escuelas. He’s since won the Mexican National Middleweight Championship in the promotion as well. Speaking with Fightful’s Luis Pulido , Pegasus discussed meeting fellow indie wrestlers such as Karma I, Tornado, Cerebro Negro Jr., and many more in the Torneo de Escuelas. “That’s right. I spent many years as an independent wrestler, and, obviously, I met a lot of fellow wrestlers—many from the wrestling scene. When we went to ask for a chance or to train at the wrestling schools, well, obviously, since we had different coaches, sometimes our schedules didn’t align. When the tryouts came around—and they do hold them to determine whether you’ll participate or not—it was a surprise to run into each other there and see familiar faces, specifically people I’d already faced and with whom I’d shared the locker room and the ring on the independent circuit. It was a surprise, more than anything, to realize, ‘Oh, look, here we are now, and we’re going to give it a shot.’ It’s really cool—it’s really cool—that so many of our fellow wrestlers who’ve been grinding it out in the independent circuit have made it here, been given this opportunity, and taken advantage of it. It’s a surprise, and it’s really cool to share the locker room with them right now because we know where we came from; we know what we struggled through before to make it to the best wrestling promotion.” Elsewhere in the interview, Pegasus discussed winning the CMLL Torneo de Escuelas. Fans can read his full comments here .

The veteran independent wrestler shared his thoughts in an interview with Fightful's Luis Pulido.

llm_long: Rey Pegasus and Tornado won the 2026 edition of the CMLL Torneo de Escuelas as representatives of Escuela Magia Blanca. The duo defeated Estudiante Jr. and Feroz along with Pantera Jr. and Psycotic in the finals of the tournament. Pegasus has since captured the Mexican National Middleweight Championship in CMLL.

In an interview with Fightful’s Luis Pulido, Pegasus recalled encountering several fellow independent wrestlers during the Torneo de Escuelas, including Karma I, Tornado, and Cerebro Negro Jr. Pegasus explained that he spent many years on the independent scene and often crossed paths with these wrestlers in matches and locker rooms but their training schedules at different schools rarely aligned.

He described the tryouts for the tournament as a surprise because familiar faces from the indie circuit suddenly appeared together competing for a spot in CMLL. Pegasus stated it was cool to realize that so many independent wrestlers who had been grinding on the circuit had now received this opportunity and were taking advantage of it.

He added that it feels good to share the locker room with them now because everyone knows the struggles they went through to reach the top promotion. Pegasus noted that his time in CMLL has lasted just a few months and has already been filled with surprises and opportunities he has seized to remain on the active roster.

He credited the fans, the promotion, and the effort he and Tornado invested in the sport for their quick success in the Torneo de Escuelas. Pegasus said they did not anticipate such a rapid response but now must stay focused and keep preparing to climb higher in the ranks and on the programs.

summary: Mini Vikingo was pulled from his scheduled AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match against Rey Fenix at Lucha Libre AAA's two-week Héroes Inmortales special after suffering an elbow injury. The 18-year-old was not cleared to compete on the October 20 episode of NXT and was shown in the trainer's room during the first week of the event, where he revealed doctors told him he requires surgery. title: Injury Update: Mini Vikingo Opens Up On He Needs Surgery After Injury on WWE NXT
raw_title: Mini Vikingo Reveals He Needs Surgery After Injury on WWE NXT
summary_src: Mini Vikingo is going to need surgery, and his planned AAA World Cruiserweight Championship match against Rey Fenix is now on hold. During AAA Heroes Inmortales results for October 24, 2026, Vikingo revealed that doctors told him he would need an operation after suffering an injury on WWE NXT.
body: Vikingo was originally scheduled to compete on the October 20 episode of WWE NXT, but it was announced that he wasn’t medically cleared. He was also supposed to challenge Rey Fenix for the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship during the two-week Heroes Inmortales special. During the October 24 show, Vikingo was shown in the trainer’s room when Fenix came to see him. Vikingo explained that he still wanted his championship rematch, but doctors had informed him that his injury would require surgery. There is currently no word on when Vikingo will undergo surgery or how long he will be out of action. His planned match against Fenix will have to wait while he recovers. For now, Vikingo’s focus will be on getting healthy before he can return to the ring. It’s an unfortunate setback for the AAA star, especially with another championship opportunity waiting for him. title: Eric Young Joins WWE as NXT Producer
raw_title: Eric Young Reportedly Back in WWE In New Role
body: Former TNA World Champion Eric Young is reportedly back in WWE in a new role. In the latest PWInsider Q&A session , Mike Johnson was asked about the whereabouts of the two-time TNA World Heavyweight Champion. Johnson said that Eric returned to WWE in July in the role of a backstage producer in NXT. “That was the assumption for a lot of people when Young asked for and received his TNA release, and it was correct. He started working for WWE as a Producer for NXT in July. I don’t know if he will wrestle,” Johnson wrote. As noted , Young departed TNA Wrestling on July 1, 2026, after the promotion accepted his request for a release. Eric had a four-year stint with WWE in the late 2010s. He re-signed with the promotion in 2022, though the 46-year-old never appeared on television and ultimately left, later citing personal, professional, and moral reasons behind his decision. In October 2024, during an appearance on INSIGHT with Chris Van Vliet, he opened up about his second return to the company. Check his comments HERE.
summary: Eric Young returned to WWE in July as a backstage producer for NXT, according to PWInsider's Mike Johnson. Young had requested and received his release from TNA on July 1. He previously had a four-year run with WWE in the late 2010s before re-signing in 2022 without appearing on television.
