title: Ric Flair Allegedly Made Botox Remark to Woman Before Bloody Fall That Sent Him to Hospital
raw_title: Ric Flair Allegedly Made Botox Remark to Woman Before Bloody Fall That Sent Him to Hospital
summary_src: Ric Flair’s bloody fall outside a Florida bar just got another strange detail. A Ringside News reader who says they were at the establishment when the WWE Hall of Famer suffered his injuries claims Flair made a remark about a woman’s Botox shortly before the accident.
body: The reader contacted Ringside News with an eyewitness account of what allegedly happened before Flair fell on October 23, 2026. According to the reader, Flair got up, tapped a woman on the forehead, and made a comment about her appearance. The reader claims the exchange happened before Flair’s fall, which left the 77-year-old with injuries to his head and eye. It’s unclear whether the woman responded or what happened immediately after the remark. Flair’s accident has already drawn plenty of attention. During the October 25 edition of Wrestling Observer Radio , Dave Meltzer explained that Flair had been drinking at a bar near his Florida home before stepping outside and falling. “And he went there, and I’m not sure exactly what happened. Like, he’d left his phone, so he wasn’t leaving, but he went to go across the street and fell down and hit his head, messed up his eye really bad.” Flair was taken to Tampa General Hospital after the fall and remained there overnight. He was released on October 24, but Meltzer claimed Flair returned to the same bar that evening. “You know, was hospitalized. He’s out of the hospital. He’s okay. He’s at the same place that he was yesterday morning, tonight. So there you go. You know, it’s not even keeping him home.” The situation is particularly concerning because Flair is already dealing with a blood clot in his leg , which recently forced him to cancel an autograph appearance in Seattle. Flair addressed his hospitalization on October 24 , sharing a photo of his injured face and thanking the medical staff who treated him. “Thank You All For The Messages And Prayers! I Will Get Back To You Each Individually As I Get Stronger. Thank You To All The Tampa General Hospital Staff And Doctors That Put Up With Me Until 4:30am. I Appreciate You All And Thank You For Everything You Did For Me! I Am Focused On My Healing And Recovery Right Now. I Will Be Okay!” His daughter, Charlotte Flair, also reassured fans that her father would be okay, revealing that he was already joking with doctors about an old wrestling incident involving the Ultimate Warrior. Now, the alleged Botox exchange adds another bizarre moment to the events surrounding Flair’s hospitalization. Steve Carrier Steve Carrier is the founder of Ringside News and has been reporting on pro wrestling since 1997. His stories have been featured on TMZ, Forbes, Bleacher Report, and more.

body: Nemeth is set to face Slater soon in TNA, and has noticed the potential that he has, as he lavished praise on him and his talent in an interview with Adrian Hernandez . Nemeth said that Slater has great ring intelligence and athleticism, which should hold him in good stead in the future. "I can't say anything negative about him, and in the next few weeks, I'm going to because I have to, and I'm a bad guy, and that's pro wrestling. But I'm going on two-and-a-half years of singing his praises. He's smarter than he should be. His ring IQ shouldn't be as high as it is right now, and it's already high. Plus, the athleticism and the things that he can do that no one else can, [and] he's another one of those guys that he's nice and humble too backstage. So it kind of makes me sick," he said. "We get it. You're nice and a good guy. Oh, cool. And you're charismatic, and you're going to be running pro wrestling for the next 20 years. Blah, blah, blah. Nobody cares here [laughs]." While Nemeth has acknowledged the talent that Slater has and sees him as a future world champion, he vowed to not let him beat him to the title. He feels that Slater's niceness could get in the way of him doing everything in his power to become a world champion, while also noting how his experience and ring IQ will let him get the better of Slater. Slater and Nemeth will go one-on-one at Bound for Glory for the latter's world title, an opportunity that the former earned after vacating his X-Division Championship and choosing to exercise Option C, thereby earning his first shot at the TNA World Championship .

title: Bret Hart Accuses Shawn Michaels of Stealing His Ladder Match Idea for WrestleMania X

summary_src: Bret Hart is still pissed about Shawn Michaels and Razor Ramon’s legendary WrestleMania X ladder match, and more than 30 years apparently hasn’t changed a thing.
body: Speaking to Inside The Ropes , Bret Hart admitted this one still gets under his skin. In fact, he says he still loses sleep over how everything went down. “That really pisses me off, that one. It really, really pisses me off. I lose sleep over it even now, you know. It pisses me off because I’ve always been really honest, and I remember, like, my first year that I was in WWF, 1985 or so, I went to Vince and I said, ‘I have this idea for a match. We’ve done it in Calgary for years, but it’s a great idea for a match. It’s called a ladder match.’” According to Bret, Vince McMahon didn’t even know what a ladder match was at the time. Hart explained the whole thing to him, including how they could hang money or a championship above the ring. “And he goes, ‘What’s a ladder match?’ And I explained it to him. You hang a sack of money, like $10,000 or $20,000 or something, for the winner, and you climb up the ladder and try to get the money, or you could do it with a belt. And I explained all this to Vince, and I said, ‘I’d like to do a ladder match.’ I remember that was in ’85, and he goes, ‘I’ll think about it.’ And I never heard another word about it.” Bret didn’t give up either. He pitched it again a few years later, but Chief Jay Strongbow wasn’t exactly rushing to get a ladder into the ring. “Then I went to him again, like about two or three years later, and brought it up again, and it never went anywhere because I think—I remember Chief Jay Strongbow, who was old school, if you remember him at all or know who he was, but he was an old, pretty smart old guy about wrestling. He was one of Vince’s lieutenants or bookers, one of the agents, they call them. And he came up, and I started telling him about the ladder match, and he called it a ‘Tennessee town-killer match.’ And I go, ‘It’s not a town-killer. It’s not a bad match.’ He was like, ‘These stupid gimmick matches, they don’t draw. They’re bad ideas. Just go out there and wrestle,’ kind of thing. And it’s like, this is a really good idea if you just would give it a chance.” Eventually, Hart brought the idea to McMahon again while he was Intercontinental Champion. This time, Bret wanted to actually show Vince what he was talking about, and he asked him to promise that WWE would only use the concept with him. “Nothing ever happened for a few more years, and so when I was—it must have been when I was Intercontinental Champion—and I came to Vince again, and I said, ‘I just want to tell you about this ladder match one more time. It’d be a great idea sometime, somewhere.’ He couldn’t remember me telling him about it. And I said, ‘I’m going to tell you about this idea for a match, but I want you to promise me that you’ll only do it with me. Let me show you how to do the match.’” Hart already had experience working ladder matches, so he knew exactly what he wanted to demonstrate. title: Ex-NXT and AEW wrestler Amber Nova arrested on DUI
raw_title: Former NXT and AEW Wrestler Amber Nova Arrested on DUI Charge in Orlando
body: Flora, 34, was released later that morning after posting $1,000 bail on each charge, totaling $2,000. According to jail records TMZ initially obtained, Flora was arrested at 5:40 a.m. and released at 10:07 a.m. Flora attended a mandatory court hearing on Saturday, with court docket records indicating a compliance date of November 2. Documents filed Saturday in Orange County and obtained by eWrestlingNews.com indicate that police stopped Flora at around 1:48 a.m., suspecting her of driving under the influence and taking her to the county's DUI testing facility. It was unclear why the time differed in the jail records. According to the documents, Flora had two attempts to provide a valid sample between 3:06 a.m. and 3:17 a.m., but failed to do so; the documents also noted that Flora requested to speak with her lawyer during the test. After Flora agreed to take the test, the officers restarted the machine and made two more attempts between 3:19 a.m. and 3:31 a.m. to obtain a valid sample; the documents say they failed to do so. According to the officer, Flora spoke during the periods meant for providing a sample, and the test was marked as a refusal at 3:31 a.m. In the ring, Flora has wrestled in TNA Wrestling, All Elite Wrestling, the National Wrestling Alliance, and NXT, WWE's developmental branch. Born in New Jersey and raised in South Carolina near Hilton Head Island, she worked as an emergency medical technician before starting her wrestling career in 2016 on the Florida independent scene. Flora's ring character is based on her father's profession as a mechanic and the 1973 Chevrolet Nova car she owns. Flora's first appearance for TNA, which at the time was known as Impact Wrestling, was in 2017. She wrestled twice in NXT, losing to Nikki Cross in 2018 and teaming up with Tanea Brooks in a 2019 loss to Io Shirai and Kairi Sane. In April 2021, she wrestled against Kris Statlander on AEW's main show, Dynamite, in Statlander's return from a knee injury. Flora wrestled mostly on AEW's Dark shows throughout 2022. Flora won the Shine Nova Championship in 2023 by defeating Ivelisse. Her latest match took place in September. She lost to Nat Castle in a match for the IWF Women's Championship at the IWF Homecoming event in Brockport, New York, on the 19th. The developmental system has churned out many promising talents in recent years, far outweighing those who have come through the men’s division. However, when looking across the current women’s roster on Monday Night RAW and Friday Night SmackDown, some names are currently being wasted. 2026 has seen Liv Morgan hold the Women’s World Title to ransom, weak WWE Women’s Title reigns from Jade Cargill and Chelsea Green, and many, many names sitting and waiting patiently on the sidelines despite possessing the quality to break out as the next big thing. Triple H needs to seriously reconsider his approach, as he is currently wasting potential stars. Before being signed by WWE, Giulia was billed as one of the best professional wrestlers in the world… only to be stripped back to a generic, bland, and uninteresting version of her former self . Triple H squandered her reigns as United States Champion, failing to make her a cool, unstoppable force who ruled over the roster. Instead, she’s been beatable, the coolness of her presentation has been abandoned, and there has been no effort made into turning things around for her; she has lost more and more edge each and every time she’s seen on screen. She undoubtedly has something special, but she has as of yet not been afforded the opportunity to showcase that on the main roster. In NXT, she felt like a major player, but her world title potential has been missed since coming to Friday Night SmackDown. title: Tatum Paxley Calls Alexa Bliss Huge Inspiration
raw_title: Tatum Paxley Discusses WWE Main Roster Mentor
body: WWE Tatum Paxley is living out a full-circle experience in WWE. Not only was the former powerlifter a recent WWE Women's Tag Team Champion, but her partner is the very woman who inspired her to pursue pro wrestling in the first place. During a recent interview with "No Holds Barred," Paxley spoke glowingly about her time learning under, and now partnering with, that co-champion, Alexa Bliss. "Alexa Bliss has been a huge inspiration for me," Paxley said. "She was the one that got me interested in pro wrestling and the one that kind of opened my eyes to seeing their story to be told here. She was a huge inspiration, so to be working alongside her now, there's no word for it. It's insane." Paxley and Bliss first crossed paths in 2025 as the former challenged the latter and Charlotte Flair for the WWE Women's Tag Team Titles at "WWE NXT Homecoming." Less than a year later, Paxley officially aligned with Bliss and Flair during her WWE main roster debut. Now, she considers both of them major mentors, helping her adjust to the new life and demands as a "WWE SmackDown" roster member. "I have the best people that have kind of taken me under their wing," Paxley said. "Charlotte Flair, Alexa Bliss. So even though two months is a pretty short time, I just feel like I've been there a lot longer, I just feel like that's where I was meant to be. I'm with the right people." Paxley and Bliss captured the Women's Tag Team Championships earlier this month by defeating Fatal Influence's Fallon Henley and Lainey Reid on WWE's blue brand. WWE At the start of her WWE career, Paxley leaned into her powerlifting background as a member of Diamond Mine, a faction filled with multiple strong performers. Once WWE allowed her to bring her own character vision to life, however, she took on a much darker appearance, one that she's now carried forth to the main roster. "They were hearing me like, 'Okay, you want to be this dark stalker character.' It's what I kept asking to present. I always knew it's what I wanted. It's how I visualized myself. But at the time, I didn't really know how to present it ... So we started off with this, I hate to say 'strong' gimmick because I was very strong, but I just knew that wasn't it. That wasn't my personality. That wasn't me to my core," Paxley said. "Something I struggled with my whole life was presenting who I really am. WWE gave me the platform to actually find myself because it's also, hey, if you don't show us who you are times one million, see you [bye]. You got it or you don't, so I knew I had to really find that. I was able to really dig deep and start showing these weird sides of myself." To illustrate her successful character evolution, Paxley pointed out that she initially introduced herself to the WWE Universe with her natural brown hair showing. title: Comeback Watch: MJF Makes Surprise Wrestling Return Amid AEW Television Absence
raw_title: MJF Makes Surprise Wrestling Return Amid AEW Television Absence
summary_src: MJF may still be missing from AEW television, but he just made his return to a wrestling ring in a pretty unexpected place. The former AEW World Champion popped up at the Create A Pro Wrestling Academy on October 25, serving as the special guest referee for a huge 12-man tag team match.
body: MJF received a big reaction when he made his entrance, with fans cheering as he headed toward the ring. Naturally, he soaked up every second of it and played to the crowd in typical MJF fashion. Things also got very MJF before the match even started. At one point during his entrance, he took off his Dynamite Diamond Ring and shoved it down his pants for safekeeping, because apparently being the referee wasn’t going to stop him from making the night about himself. The appearance is notable because MJF hasn’t been seen on AEW television since All In on August 30. While this wasn’t his official AEW comeback, it did put him back inside a wrestling ring while his absence from the company continues. MJF previously addressed his time away during a September 24 interview with Pro Wrestling Illustrated. He made it clear that his AEW absence isn’t happening without a plan and said he’s simply waiting until the timing feels right . “I don’t want to give anything away. I don’t want to give anything away, but just know whenever I come back because I’m waiting for the right time, the right moment.” Whenever that moment arrives, MJF has already made it pretty obvious what he wants. He said the AEW World Championship will be at the top of his list regardless of who is holding it when he finally returns. “What you can expect from me coming back is I’m going to whoever has the fake title, I’m going to beat them and prove that I am the one true champion emphatically. I’m going to become the first ever undisputed world champion in the history of my company. And then I’m going to continue to increase business as that is what I do best. And I’m going to continue to face some of the best names professional wrestling has to offer because the best professional wrestlers professional wrestling has to offer, bell-to-bell, resides in All Elite Wrestling.” For now, there’s still no word on exactly when MJF will walk back onto AEW television. His surprise Create A Pro appearance at least gave fans their first chance in a while to see him back in a wrestling ring, even if he was wearing stripes instead of actually competing. title: WWE legend dies after health issues as tributes paid to 'great wrestler and better friend'
raw_title: WWE legend dies after health issues as tributes paid to 'great wrestler and better friend'
body: Former wrestling favourite Jack Armstrong has passed away age 79 after a lengthy illness. He started as a wrestler in 1963 and fought in a career that lasted more than 30 years. He wrestled in the World Wide Wrestling Federation – which later became the WWE – and also wrestled in Japan, the AWA and UWF during his time in the ring, and even had a stint as an actor and starred in the original version of hit film The Wrestler. Armstrong went by a number of different stage names during his career, including Lenny Solomon, Super Scorpion, Black Jack and Sailor Jack. It was known that he recently had fallen unwell and had been fighting health issues for a long time. His friend paid tribute to him and shared a snap of them together (Image: Laura Creavalle/Facebook) He had a leg amputated after an infection took hold and was also on dialysis, but it was announced that he passed away after a heartbreaking message from his former pal. Close friend and former bodybuilder Laura Creavalle made the announcement after she moved into his home to help care for him in his final weeks. She travelled to Los Angeles and posted a heartwarming message saying that despite his bad health, he still had his sense of humour. Writing on Facebook, she said: "I’m in LA after 19 yrs to be with my best friend Jack Armstrong, used to be a professional wrestler. The wrestling legend performed for more than 30 years (Image: WWWF) “His best friend was Rocky, the Rock’s father, they used to share rooms together when they were on the road. He has known the Rock since he was a baby. “His health is failing so I have decided to come out here to help. They had to remove one of his legs as he is on dialysis, but his sense of humour still stays. He is 79. I’m hoping he makes it to 80. I’m glad just to be here by his side.” But his health took a turn for the worse and she ended up posting again along with the sad announcement. She wrote: “As to my post a few days ago. I’m sorry to announce that I lost my best friend Wild Man Jack Armstrong today. “He was a great wrestler and an even better friend. The stories are 2 many to share but he bought my first posing suit in LA and I lived with him for many years when I was a beginner struggling bodybuilder. Broke and homeless.” Choose Daily Star as a '' on Google News for quick access to the news you value.

title: Intercontinental Title From WrestleMania 3 Sells For Record Price
raw_title: Intercontinental title from classic WrestleMania 3 match sells for record amount
summary_src: How much would you pay for the same title held by legends of days gone by?
body: Link Geno Mrosko is a lifelong pro wrestling fan who has been covering it since becoming a Manager at Cageside Seats in 2011. How much would you pay for the same title held by legends of days gone by? Conrad Thompson acquired the Intercontinental championship title Ricky Steamboat won from Macho Man Randy Savage in one of the most highly acclaimed matches in WWE history at WrestleMania 3 back in 2020, having traded Pat Patterson’s original Intercontinental title for it. Today, he’s a happy man because the belt sold at auction for an unheard of amount. The red letter WWF Intercontinental title, famously held by Tito Santana, Savage, Steamboat, and finally by Honky Tonk Man, sold for $716,750 at Heritage Auctions’ Fall Sports Catalog auction just this weekend. According to the Observer, it becomes the most anyone has ever paid for a championship title, easily beating out Hulk Hogan’s WWF world championship from WrestleMania 2 . It’s not, however, the record for most expensive piece of pro wrestling memorabilia. Either way, it’s a lot of money for a title that hasn’t been used on television dating back to the 1980s. title: Backstage Buzz: Ethan Page Walks Away After Heated Confrontation With Wrestling Fan
raw_title: Ethan Page Walks Away After Heated Confrontation With Wrestling Fan
summary_src: Ethan Page just found himself face-to-face with the exact kind of wrestling influencer drama he doesn’t seem to have much patience for.
body: The awkward exchange started when Heel Girlfriend questioned why Page was even there. She didn’t exactly give him the warmest welcome either. “I don’t care about Ethan Page. What are you even doing here?” Page immediately pushed back and explained that he’d been asked to make content with them. Apparently, he thought the interaction was going to be a whole lot friendlier than what he actually got. “I’ll be honest with you. You asked me to do content. I thought you were gonna compliment me and not have your girlfriend scream at my face in front of a bunch of people trying to enjoy the pay-per-view.” Page clearly wasn’t interested in sticking around and arguing about it. Instead, he said the whole situation had embarrassed him before deciding to walk away. “I am thoroughly embarrassed right now. I’m outta here, pal.” The timing makes the exchange pretty funny considering Page had plenty to say about wrestlers getting caught up in drama with fans just last month. During a September appearance on Inside the Ring, he argued that wrestlers today are “a lot softer” because of how easily some of them get dragged into arguments with people online . “I think trusting people now is probably safer than back in the day, but more people are a lot softer now.” Page specifically couldn’t understand why wrestlers spend their time responding to fans who criticize them. He questioned why they don’t put that same energy toward the people actually showing them support. “What are you responding to fans for? What the hell? Why don’t you respond to the ones that compliment you? Only the ones that hurt your feelings, that tell you the truth, are you the one you’re giving them attention?” This time, Page didn’t have the luxury of simply ignoring a post on his phone because the confrontation was happening right in front of him. He still didn’t stick around for a prolonged argument, though, choosing to call the whole thing embarrassing and make his exit instead. title: On the Record: New Report Details Pac’s Health Issues Before His Death
raw_title: New Report Details Pac’s Health Issues Before His Death
body: A new report has shed light on the health issues Pac reportedly faced before his death, with a critical care physician describing the circumstances as “very sad and rare.” AEW announced on September 27, 2026, that Pac, formerly known as Neville in WWE, had died aged 40. He was found inside a rental car in a Chicago-area parking lot less than 24 hours after All Out. According to Dave Meltzer of F4WOnline .com, Pac had a history of lung problems and blood clots that affected how he managed his travel schedule. While Will Ospreay regularly flies between England and the United States, Pac reportedly limited his flights by spending longer periods in America before returning to the United Kingdom for several weeks. Meltzer also highlighted Pac’s demanding fitness routine, which included weightlifting and cardio, as he reflected on the shock of his reported death from bronchial asthma. Dr. Alex Patel, a Toronto-based critical care physician, offered Meltzer some medical context. He explained that fatal asthma attacks typically involve people with previous asthma-related hospital admissions, although the report did not establish whether Pac had that history. Discussing Pac’s blood clot issues in 2023, Patel said long-haul air travel is a recognised risk factor for pulmonary embolisms. He outlined precautions that can reduce that risk, including movement during flights, compression stockings and, in certain cases, prescribed blood thinners. Patel also raised the possibility that previous blood clots could have affected Pac’s heart and increased the risk of complications during a severe asthma attack. However, he stressed that this could not be determined without information about Pac’s heart function. “If you do have underlying blood clots, they can affect the right side of your heart. There is some link between severe asthma attacks, and death, occurring more in people who have underlying heart issues so certainly if the right side of his heart was affected, it could lead them at higher risk for asthmatic complications. Difficult to know, though without a heart or echo report on what his underlying heart function was, and if it was affected by the pulmonary embolism.” Patel described the circumstances as extremely rare. He suggested that the speed of the attack may have left little opportunity for medical intervention and that immediate access to doctors, such as those present at a wrestling event, might have made a difference. Those comments represent possible explanations rather than confirmed findings about Pac’s case.
summary: A new report has shed light on the health issues Pac by most accounts faced before his death. Per Dave Meltzer of F4WOnline .com, Pac had a history of lung problems and blood clots that affected how he managed his travel schedule.

title: Crown Jewel Still Set for Riyadh as US Warns of Airport Threats
raw_title: U.S. Embassy urges “extreme caution” at Saudi airports in fresh alert ahead of WWE Crown Jewel
summary_src: The U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia issued a new security advisory on Sunday, warning Americans to exercise “extreme caution” when using any airports in the country.
body: The U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia issued a new security advisory on Sunday, warning Americans to exercise “extreme caution” when using any airports in the country. The October 25 alert comes less than two weeks before WWE is scheduled to hold Crown Jewel in Riyadh on November 7. The State Department warned of potential attacks on airports, airspace closures, flight cancellations and other travel disruption amid continued missile and drone attacks by the Iran-backed Houthis. U.S. government employees who remain in Saudi Arabia now require special authorization from the Chief of Mission to use any airport in the country following recent attacks. Please take extreme caution if you choose to use airports in Saudi Arabia. The alert also provides an update on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, which partially reopened on Sunday. Domestic flights and some international services operated by Saudi carriers have resumed, while a limited number of flights normally based in Riyadh are operating from Prince Naif bin Abdulaziz International Airport in Qassim. Airports in Jeddah and Dammam are operating with some delays and cancellations. The new notice also restates the State Department’s ordered departure of non-emergency U.S. government employees and their family members. Sunday’s alert says the order became effective on October 23. It therefore does not appear to represent a second or expanded evacuation order, but reiterates the earlier measure while adding more detailed restrictions and warnings concerning airport use. The security situation has continued to develop since then. As reported on Saturday , U.S. intelligence officials have warned Secretary of State Marco Rubio that Iranian plans to target Americans have reached “advanced stages.” In a separate development, travel issues have now placed a world championship fight on another major Riyadh event in doubt. Sports Illustrated reports that Lindolfo Delgado, trainer Robert Garcia and their team remain in the United States without travel booked for Delgado’s scheduled fight against Arthur Biyarslanov for the vacant IBF super lightweight championship. The match is scheduled for the October 31 Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli card in Riyadh, one week before Crown Jewel. Boxing reporter Dan Rafael reported that Biyarslanov is already in Saudi Arabia, while a source told him the Delgado fight would “probably not” take place. The match has not officially been canceled. Saudi Arabia remains at “Level 3: Reconsider Travel” under the State Department’s travel advisory system. WWE has announced no change to Crown Jewel, which remains scheduled for November 7 at Riyadh Season Stadium. TKO executive chair Ari Emanuel said on Friday that “everything’s still set,” adding that the company has a team monitoring developments daily and could relocate an event if necessary.
summary: WWE Crown Jewel remains scheduled for Saturday, November 7 at Riyadh Season Stadium, and WWE has not announced any change since the U.S. Embassy in Saudi Arabia issued its latest security alert on October 25. The alert urges Americans to use extreme caution at Saudi airports because of possible attacks, airspace closures, flight cancellations and travel disruptions linked to missile and drone strikes by Iran-backed Houthis. It also notes that the State Department ordered non-emergency U.S. government staff and their families out of the country on October 23, and that Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport has only partly reopened. The U.S. travel advisory for Saudi Arabia remains at 'reconsider travel'. On Wrestling Observer Radio, Dave Meltzer said WWE plans to run the show unless something catastrophic happens before then. On October 22, TKO's Ari Emanuel told Fox News that everything was still set, with a team monitoring the situation daily and looking at where the event could move if needed.

He wrote on his X account, “Incredibly gutted to announce that I won’t be able to make it on tomorrow’s show I split my head open wrestling in Boston tonight and am physically unable to compete (that’s saying something if I’m saying that haha fml) Huge apologies to Shire, the people in the match, RevPro team, and all the fans. Talk about a unfortunate birthday week and travel, but that’s how it goes sometimes.” 1 Called Manders continued, “Don’t feel bad; it is what it is. Gotta love wrestling even when it seems to be a “low” point. It’s not. Logging off. Love you guys 🤘🏻.” Additionally, Manders wrote in another announcement today that he won’t make his advertised dates for RevPro in the UK due to the same injury. He wrote the following: “Unfortunately, due to an injury I suffered last night, I will no longer be making my scheduled RevPro appearances in England and everything I’m gutted, disappointed, and upset about this. I was looking forward to getting back over there, seeing everyone, and doing what I love. Wrestling is everything to me, and having to pull out of these dates is not something I take lightly Right now, I need to focus on getting healthy and doing what I can to get back in the ring I’m also gonna be getting off social media for a while. I’m sorry to everyone who’s supported me, reached out, or was looking forward to seeing me. I just need some time to myself to deal with everything and get my head right. Thank you to everyone who has supported me. I don’t take any of it for granted. Incredibly gutted to announce that I won't be able to make it on tomorrow's show I split my head open wrestling in Boston tonight and am physically unable to compete (that’s saying something if i’m saying that haha fml) Huge apologies to Shire, the people in the match,… https://t.co/ZFeDhN4qku — 1 Called Manders ワン・コールド・マンダース (@1called_manders) October 25, 2026 Unfortunately, due to an injury I suffered last night, I will no longer be making my scheduled RevPro appearances in England and everything I’m gutted, disappointed, and upset about this. I was looking forward to getting back over there, seeing everyone, and doing what I love.… — 1 Called Manders ワン・コールド・マンダース (@1called_manders) October 25, 2026 1 Called Manders , Revolution Pro Wrestling , RevPro , Jeffrey Harris

llm_long: Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton will face each other in a Last Man Standing match at WWE Crown Jewel. The premium live event is scheduled for November 7 in Saudi Arabia.
Rhodes proposed the stipulation during a confrontation on SmackDown. Orton responded by cautioning Rhodes to be careful what he wished for.
The two wrestlers have a long history that dates back to Rhodes' first stint in WWE. They have been feuding for much of 2026.
Rhodes defeated Orton in one of the main events of WrestleMania 42. Orton then picked up the victory when they met at Sunday Night’s Main Event in September.
Orton has repeatedly questioned Rhodes’ killer instinct during their rivalry. Rhodes showed a more aggressive side in recent segments, including taking out Baron Corbin with a punt.
On SmackDown, Rhodes wanted to fight Orton immediately, but Orton declined. SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis then booked their Last Man Standing match for Crown Jewel.

title: On the Record: Former WCW Champion Says Trick Williams is a Future World Champion
raw_title: Former WCW Champion Says Trick Williams is a Future World Champion
body: When surveying the landscape of the WWE main roster, Page believes one competitor has superstar written all over him: Trick Williams. In an exclusive interview shared with Heavy, Diamond Dallas Page said that he has been high on Trick Williams’ potential since his NXT tenure and believes the SmackDown star is a future World Champion in the making. “I knew Trick was going to be [a trick],” Page told Gambling.com . “He just kept doing what he was doing. He has the potential to be the guy there. He’s got it. It’s not going to happen for a couple of years, if it does, but he has the potential to be the guy. Page continued, “He’s got the body and he’s got the charisma. He’s super lovable. Guys want to hang out with him. Chicks want to be with him. He’s got the IT factor.” Trick Williams seems to believe the same thing, as he went toe-to-toe Friday on SmackDown with WWE Champion Sami Zayn, and declared that he is a better representation of a champion than the reigning World Champion . “You’re a bum! You’re a joke! I’m the superstar,” Williams shouted at Sami Zayn. “When it comes to being a champion, only one of us knows how to look like a champion, talk like a champion, walk like a champion and smell like a champion. “When it comes to being a champion, Sami Zayn, I am the veteran and you are the rookie,” Williams exclaimed. Trick Williams has been on the WWE main roster for less than a year, but it’s evident that he is one of the most charismatic superstars to enter the squared circle. The two-time United States Champion is dynamite on the mic and isn’t afraid to give anyone in the locker room a verbal lashing. As Page pointed out, Williams has a championship demeanor. As the kids say, he has an aura about him. He oozes confidence and backs it up in the ring, where his former NFL pedigree stands out. Even though the two have become rivals, Sami Zayn admitted that Trick Williams is having “one of the best rookie years” in WWE history. Following their viral promo on SmackDown, the WWE Universe couldn’t help but notice similarities between Trick Williams and The Rock. “I swear Trick is like if Rock and Booker T had had a kid,” an Instagram user wrote. Earlier this year, WWE broadcaster Wade Barrett also compared the former NXT Champion to The Rock. Williams responded to Barrett’s comparison in an interview with The Sun, and said that although he appreciates the love, his goal to be the first Trick, not the “next Rock.” “As far as when it comes to The Rock, you know, The Rock was one of those guys who made me wanna actually be in the business in the first place. “I used to watch his promos and how he could control the crowd with his voice. I thought it was the most amazing thing ever.” In terms of flare, showmanship and, frankly, swagger, Trick Williams is already closer to The Final Boss than most WWE stars have ever been. With a bit more time and a little bit of elbow grease, Trick Williams could become a World Champion like him, too. Jalyn Smoot Jalyn S

title: Stone Cold Steve Austin's 1999 Knee Brace Sells for $225,700
raw_title: ‘Stone Cold’ Steve Austin’s Circa 1999 Match-Worn, Signed Knee Brace Sells For $225,700
summary_src: “Stone Cold” Steve Austin’s match-worn and signed knee brace from circa 1999 sold at auction. A knee brace from the 1990s, used by The Texas Rattlesnake, went up for auction on Heritage. This DonJoy knee brace is signed by Steve Austin and comes with a WWE letter signed by Linda McMahon.
body: “Stone Cold” Steve Austin’s match-worn and signed knee brace from circa 1999 sold at auction. A knee brace from the 1990s, used by The Texas Rattlesnake, went up for auction on Heritage. This DonJoy knee brace is signed by Steve Austin and comes with a WWE letter signed by Linda McMahon. Circa 1999 Stone Cold Steve Austin Match Worn & Signed Knee Brace with WWE Letter Signed by Linda McMahon. Stone Cold Steve Austin was the driving force behind wrestling’s boom in the late 1990s, helping transform WWE during the Attitude Era. With his anti-authority attitude, Austin connected deeply with fans who embraced his rebellious defiance, especially in his rivalry with Mr. McMahon. His persona-a tough, no-nonsense, beer-drinking brawler who rejected rules-felt authentic and relatable, breaking away from the cartoonish characters of earlier eras. Austin’s intense promos, unpredictable actions, and physical in-ring style made him must-see television and boosted ratings during the Monday Night Wars. He redefined what a top star could be, proving that charisma and attitude could outweigh traditional hero archetypes. His influence is still seen today in edgier storytelling and more realistic characters. Stone Cold didn’t just succeed-he helped save WWE financially and reshaped the industry’s direction for years to come. Very few Stone Cold match worn items have reached the open market. His match worn vests have never surfaced which has left collectors scurrying for anything worn by the Rattlesnake. The knee brace which Austin wore in WrestleMania 38 recently realized $58,045 on an auction site. Heritage Auctions realized the top price ever paid for a knee brace when it sold one from $115,900 in May of 2026. This knee brace is from the early 2000’s when Austin was keeping WWE alive in its fight with WCW for the top wrestling spot. The offered Don Joy knee brace (16″) has a very similar wear pattern like the previous one we offered in May. Various scratches and some paint loss are found on the brace. Three of the four Velcro fasteners are still fully functional. The top button which has broken off which probably ended its in-ring run. Austin signed the top in gold paint pen and dated “5-8-99” nearby. A WWF authentication sticker is placed near the date reference. LOA from WWE. LOA from Heritage Auctions. Full LOA from PSA/DNA. Full LOA from Beckett Authentication Services. 1999 Stone Cold Steve Austin Event-Used & signed Knee Brace sold for $225,700 at Heritage! This moves to rank 1 for Steve Austin! Making it Austin's top auctioned item ever! See Stone Cold's Top 20 Historical Auctions here: https://t.co/gL85tEFiVX pic.twitter.com/Mwu1eNi2Zv — ProWrestling-Collectibles (@ProMemorabilia) October 25, 2026 Earlier in May, a different knee brace used by Austin was sold for $115,900.
summary: A match-worn and signed knee brace from circa 1999 used by Stone Cold Steve Austin sold at auction for $225,700. The DonJoy brace, which includes a WWE letter signed by Linda McMahon, was listed through Heritage Auctions. Austin was a key figure in the late 1990s wrestling boom as the central character of WWE's Attitude Era.

llm_long: Max Caster made his TNA debut at Bound For Glory by answering Moose's open challenge. TNA cut ties with Caster the following day. The company had originally planned for Caster to work only Bound For Glory. He was later added to the Dothan, Alabama tapings that followed the pay-per-view.

After Caster was removed from those tapings, the shows had to be rewritten. Caster issued an apology to TNA and Carlos Silva. He has since announced that he is stepping away from wrestling to take a hiatus. Caster said he will be going to therapy.
He added, "I’m gonna get it right so that the next time I’m in the ring it feels like I’m at home."

llm_long: World Series of Wrestling announced on Sunday that Buddy Matthews will miss the upcoming WSW Megamania tour due to scheduling conflicts. The tour was set to run from October 29 through November 2. In a statement, the promotion said it had just learned that Matthews would no longer be appearing on the WSW Megamania Tour.

The promotion added it was really disappointed that Buddy won’t be joining them this time around but completely understands that schedules can change. World Series of Wrestling expressed hope to welcome Buddy back on a future tour. Matthews had been cleared to return to the ring in early August after suffering an ankle injury.

He had been sidelined since early 2025 when the injury occurred during his entrance for a match with Kazuchika Okada at AEW Grand Slam Australia, after which he underwent surgery. Matthews remains signed to AEW and has not yet made his return to in-ring competition.

title: Tessa Blanchard’s MLW Debut Finally Has a New Date After Delay
raw_title: Tessa Blanchard’s MLW Debut Finally Has a New Date After Delay
body: Blanchard was previously announced for MLW and was expected to make her debut at Fightland in September, 2026. However, the appearance was pulled after a miscommunication and reported friction between MLW and her home promotion, CMLL. She was instead booked for a CMLL event on the same day. CMLL later clarified that her agreement with MLW was only for the planned appearance, and she was subsequently removed from the MLW roster page. However, the former TNA World Champion now has a new date for her MLW debut. Tessa Blanchard appeared on the October 7 episode of CMLL Informa, where it was revealed that she will compete for MLW at Saturday Night SuperFight on November 7. title: Eric Young Returns To WWE As NXT Producer
raw_title: More On Eric Young Returning to WWE As Producer
body: A new report has some additional details on Eric Young making his return to WWE as a producer in NXT. It was reported on Saturday that Young returned to WWE in July as a producer on the developmental brand. According to Fightful Select , Young and Triple H have maintained a good relationship for a long time and that the WWE CCO made it clear to Young that he could return to WWE whenever he wanted to come back. Young exited TNA on the first of July after the promotion granted his request to be released from his contract. He was with WWE from 2016 to 2020, leading the stable SAnitY, and was let go as part of the April 2020 pandemic-related budget cuts. He returned in 2023 but never appeared on TV, and requested his release. He later cited his not wanting to work for Vince McMahon, who had returned to the company after his “retirement” due to the sexual misconduct allegations against him, as his reason for asking for his release.
summary: Eric Young joined WWE as a producer for NXT in July. Per Fightful Select, Triple H has long maintained a strong relationship with Young and made it known he could return to the company at any time. Young had previously worked for WWE from 2016 to 2020 as leader of the SAnitY stable before being released in April 2020, then returned briefly in 2023 without appearing on television.

title: Street Fighter Drops 72 Percent in Second Weekend
raw_title: Cody Rhodes & Roman Reigns’ Street Fighter suffers steep second-weekend box office drop
summary_src: ‘Street Fighter’ fell sharply in its second weekend at the box office. The movie, which features Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns in key roles, fell to number four at the box office this weekend drawing around $8.6 million, according to Deadline.
body: ‘Street Fighter’ fell sharply in its second weekend at the box office. The movie, which features Cody Rhodes and Roman Reigns in key roles, fell to number four at the box office this weekend drawing around $8.6 million, according to Deadline . That is a steep 72% drop from last weekend, as it opened drawing $31 million domestically. WB’s Clayface topped the charts this week, opening to $24 million. You Can See Everything followed at $19.5 million, while Wildwood drew $11.6 million. Deadline noted that with Clayface’s success, the now-combined WB/Paramount company Skydance has crossed the billion dollar mark at the box office this year, joining Universal, Disney, and Sony. The film features Cody Rhodes as Guile and Roman Reigns as Akuma. New Japan Pro Wrestling’s Hirooki Goto is also in the film, playing E. Honda. Critics praised Rhodes in the film, with Hollywood News describing his performance as “a show-stealing stunner.” Street Fighter currently holds a 41% approval rating from critics on Rotten Tomatoes, though has a 78% approval rating from audiences. Bryan Rose Bryan Rose is an editor from California that has been covering professional wrestling for well over a decade. He officially joined F4WOnline as an editor in 2017.
summary: The Street Fighter movie starring Cody Rhodes as Guile and Roman Reigns as Akuma fell to fourth place at the domestic box office this weekend with $8.6 million. That represents a steep 72 percent decline from its $31 million opening frame. WB's Clayface led the weekend with $24 million, followed by You Can See Everything at $19.5 million and Wildwood at $11.6 million, per the Wrestling Observer.

One publication described Rhodes as a scene-stealing stunner and praised his comedic ability. An entertainment journalist wrote that Rhodes steals every scene he is in.

title: Rey Pegasus Still Processing CMLL Middleweight Title Win
raw_title: Rey Pegasus Says He Still Hasn't Fully Processed Winning CMLL Mexican National Middleweight Title
summary_src: Rey Pegasus comments on winning the Mexican National Middleweight Title. Rey Pegasus became the challenger for the Mexican National Middleweight Title via online fan voting. He faced then-champion Guerrero Maya Jr.
body: Rey Pegasus comments on winning the Mexican National Middleweight Title. Rey Pegasus became the challenger for the Mexican National Middleweight Title via online fan voting. He faced then-champion Guerrero Maya Jr. at CMLL Noche de Campeones, ultimately defeating him for the belt. Speaking with Fightful’s Luis Pulido , Pegasus commented on winning the fan vote and later the title as well. “Come to think of it, several weeks have already gone by, and I still can’t wrap my head around it. I’ll be completely honest: sometimes I still can’t believe how it all went down, especially at the beginning with the voting. It was also quite a surprise because it featured one of wrestling’s greatest legends, Señor Blue Panther, and a wrestler who’s really making a name for himself, with a strong track record and tremendous family support, Brillante Jr., and me, the new guy. To see that, in such a short time, the audience supported me so much in the voting already made me very happy. Competing for that championship was already a historic moment for me, and I also knew who I was going to face: Guerrero Maya Jr., a wrestler with so much experience, so many years in the ranks of CMLL, and, above all, so many title defenses under his belt. He was one of the wrestlers with the most title defenses and the longest career, especially with that historic championship—a title held by wrestling legends, more than you can imagine. It’s so important that even I, at times, didn’t fully grasp the magnitude of that championship. I went out there with all my heart that day—I went out with all the determination in the world to win that championship. I was very happy because, as I also mentioned in the interview, I’m not from Mexico City and I don’t have my family nearby, but that day I was fortunate enough that they made the trip to be present at Arena México and witness the championship match. Imagine how excited I was to have my family there. To have the chance to win that championship is something I still haven’t fully processed to this day. I haven’t fully processed that moment. I’m still savoring it, enjoying it, and it really was something very, very, very beautiful that I got to experience.” Elsewhere in the interview, Pegasus commented on being in Los Amos del Aire. Fans can read his full comments by clicking here .
summary: Rey Pegasus earned a shot at the CMLL Mexican National Middleweight Title through fan voting and defeated Guerrero Maya Jr. at Noche de Campeones to capture the championship. In an interview with Fightful, he admitted that weeks later he still cannot fully process the victory, especially given the strong competition in the vote that included Blue Panther and Brillante Jr. Pegasus described the fan support and the title match itself as historic moments in his young career.

llm_long: Rey Pegasus and Tornado won the 2026 edition of the CMLL Torneo de Escuelas as representatives of Escuela Magia Blanca. The duo defeated Estudiante Jr. and Feroz along with Pantera Jr. and Psycotic in the finals of the tournament. Pegasus has since captured the Mexican National Middleweight Championship in CMLL.

In an interview with Fightful’s Luis Pulido, Pegasus recalled encountering several fellow independent wrestlers during the Torneo de Escuelas, including Karma I, Tornado, and Cerebro Negro Jr. Pegasus explained that he spent many years on the independent scene and often crossed paths with these wrestlers in matches and locker rooms but their training schedules at different schools rarely aligned.

He described the tryouts for the tournament as a surprise because familiar faces from the indie circuit suddenly appeared together competing for a spot in CMLL. Pegasus stated it was cool to realize that so many independent wrestlers who had been grinding on the circuit had now received this opportunity and were taking advantage of it.

He added that it feels good to share the locker room with them now because everyone knows the struggles they went through to reach the top promotion. Pegasus noted that his time in CMLL has lasted just a few months and has already been filled with surprises and opportunities he has seized to remain on the active roster.

He credited the fans, the promotion, and the effort he and Tornado invested in the sport for their quick success in the Torneo de Escuelas. Pegasus said they did not anticipate such a rapid response but now must stay focused and keep preparing to climb higher in the ranks and on the programs.

title: TNA Rewrote Tapings After Cutting Ties With Max Caster
raw_title: TNA Reportedly Had To Shift Creative Plans After Cutting Ties With Max Caster
body: The fallout from the Max Caster rap at TNA Bound For Glory reportedly extended a bit beyond the PPV itself. As you likely know , Caster made his TNA debut at Bound For Glory in a loss to Moose, but it proved to be a one-and-done due to his entrance rap. Caster referenced the airport bombing in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia that happened less than 24 hours earlier, which caused controversy and led to TNA cutting ties with him. It had previously been reported that the company was planning to use Caster in their post-Bound For Glory tapings, which obviously didn’t happen. According to Fightful Select , the original plan was to have Caster work just Bound For Glory, but he was added to the Dothan, Alabama tapings ahead of Bound For Glory. Once he was removed from the taping, the company had to rewrite the shows to account for the matter. Max Caster issued an apology to TNA and Carlos Silva. He has since said that he is taking a hiatus from pro wrestling and will be going to therapy, adding that “I’m gonna get it right so that the next time I’m in the ring it feels like I’m at home.”
summary: Max Caster made his one-off TNA debut at Bound For Glory in a loss to Moose. His entrance rap referencing a recent airport bombing in Saudi Arabia led to immediate controversy and TNA severing ties with him. Per Fightful Select, the company had added Caster to post-Bound For Glory tapings in Dothan, Alabama and was forced to rewrite those shows after removing him from the plans.

Speaking with Fightful’s Sean Ross Sapp , Maclin commented on wrestling Copeland and rehabbing his leg. “I’m feeling great. I’m still buzzing from Northern Rising. It’s like a dream come true of a matchup and a day that I will cherish and now probably chase the rest of my career, just for that feeling of comfort and being an adult in this business, but then also still having that inner child in me enjoy every moment and then looking across at one of my heroes. Dude, it’s so cool. Leg is feeling good. Like I was telling you off camera before this, just got done with doing a leg workout and it’s been a road to recovery and rehabbing. I’m still going to rehab probably for a long time, regardless, but at the same time I’m back to full strength. I’ve been fully cleared since before Northern Rising and I’m ready to just take on the world wherever I’m needed.” Fans can check out the two-part documentary highlighting Maclin’s journey to MLP’s Northern Rising on the Boots To Boots YouTube channel .

BEST MIC MOMENT (Roman Reigns talking to Sami Zayn) : There were so many layers to the opening interaction between Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn that it took us on a roller coaster ride to kick off Raw, reminded everybody of the storied past between them, while setting the wheels in motion for the matchup at WWE Crown Jewel. What stood out most was the manner in which Reigns showed condescension toward a Superstar he clearly views as beneath him. From the look The OTC gave Zayn in the parking garage as he walked past him on the phone, to the smug acknowledgments that they were equals. Reigns’ message was clear: He is still The Big Dog of the company, no matter what title is on his shoulder. “The man makes the title, not the title makes the man,” said it all. It took all of five minutes for Reigns to take Zayn from being on top of the world to being a guy who is lucky to even be Undisputed WWE Champion. title: On the Record: WWE's Chelsea Green Says Most Pro Wrestling Promos Give Her 'The Ick'
raw_title: WWE's Chelsea Green Says Most Pro Wrestling Promos Give Her 'The Ick'
body: "If I have to hear another promo where the cadence is so wrestling-y...it gives me the ick," Green said. "I cringe all the time. Like, it's getting better and better because we're leveling up. We're taking acting classes, we're realizing that it needs to be real, it needs to be authentic, and if its not, you have to dive deep like you would in acting. Like, come up with a backstory, create something that's real so that you can do an emotional recall, you know what I mean? And that's what I was doing...Yes, the words were real, the promo was real, but at the end of the day, I still wrote it, memorized it, and then acted it out for you." Green won't have to worry about promos this Friday on "SmackDown," however, as she'll instead look to make her first defense of the WWE Women's Championship since winning it. She will be challenged by Nia Jax, who alongside partner Lash Legend defeated Green and WWE United States Women's Champion Tiffany Stratton two weeks ago, and laid out Green just days after she won the Women's Title.

title: On the Record: Kevin Nash Says He Shut Down The Idea Of WWE Recreating Scott Hall As A Hologram
raw_title: Kevin Nash Says He Shut Down The Idea Of WWE Recreating Scott Hall As A Hologram
body: "I spent 30 years of my life with Scott, and Scott wouldn't let that... I know Scott wouldn't let them do that to me," he expressed. Apparently, the rest of the Kliq members all looked to Nash to make the final call on this, and he claims he was the deciding vote. "The Scott thing was so fresh, too. Like, Scott hadn't been gone very long..." he added, noting that it had only been about a year since his passing when the offer was made. "I'm just saying like... You know... I just believe in letting people f***ing... that have passed... leave them the f*** alone." He further argued that a dead person has no say in being used for something like AI, and more often than not, it's only done for the person's family or estate to financially profit from it. However, Nash expressed that it's fine if someone signs off on it before dying, but he takes issue with it being done on behalf of someone. Former WWE talent and licensed attorney David Otunga addressed the possibility of WWE using AI to recreate or create matches between long-deceased wrestlers . Otunga pointed out how broad WWE contracts are and noted how many rights they have to wrestlers, arguing that WWE could legally someday have a "Bray Wyatt vs. Macho man Randy Savage" match if they wanted to.
summary: The latest: the latest: I spent 30 years of my life with Scott, and Scott wouldn't let that. I know Scott wouldn't let them do that to me, he expressed.

title: Kalisto Praises Ryback As A Sweetheart During 2016 Feud
raw_title: Kalisto Says Ryback Was A 'Sweetheart' During WWE Feud
summary_src: Although former WWE star Ryback has developed a rough reputation to some, Kalisto has stated that he was one of his favorite people to work with.
body: WWE Former WWE talent Ryback has picked up somewhat of a controversial reputation following his exit from the promotion, at least in part due to his aggressive social media rants. Back in 2016, Ryback and Kalisto feuded for the WWE United States Championship , showcasing a "David and Goliath" dynamic. Looking back, Kalisto claims Ryback was great to work with. "Oh, my God, man, he was nothing but a sweetheart," Kalisto stated during an interview with " TMZ Sports ." "I do get asked that a lot, too, and I always say, 'Man, he was like the best human being on earth with me.' He was awesome, he took care of me, I took care of him." "At the time he went on his way, he was frustrated with his own career, I believe, and how things were going," Kalisto added. He then claimed that Ryback was the one who wanted to work with him and assured him that he'd take all the heat to put him over in their feud. "Man, we just clicked. When we got in the ring? We just clicked! ... When we started working with each other, man, just things started flowing." Kalisto went as far as to say that Ryback was one of his favorites to work with in WWE, harkening back to their big vs. small dynamic, and pointing out that they hit each other hard in a satisfying way that wrestlers want the contact to be in wrestling. "I loved working with him," Kalisto said. "I wish I can work him again.
summary: Kalisto recalled his 2016 WWE United States Championship program against Ryback and described him as nothing but a sweetheart who took care of him in the ring. Kalisto said the two immediately clicked during their matches and that Ryback had specifically asked to work with him while taking the heat to help put him over. He added that Ryback was frustrated with his own career at the time but was the best human being on earth with him.

title: Voice Actor Eric Bauza Dies at 46
raw_title: Voice Actor Eric Bauza Passes Away, Voice Of Bugs Bunny And More Performed In Multiple WWE Animated Projects
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin VOICE ACTOR ERIC BAUZA PASSES AWAY, VOICE OF BUGS BUNNY AND MORE PERFORMED IN MULTIPLE WWE ANIMATED PROJECTS By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-26 00:21:00 Emmy Award winning Voice actor Eric Bauza, best known for being the modern day voice for a number of Looney Toons characters, including Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck passed away yesterday, his family announced via social media. Bauza was only 46 years old. His family's statement: "Eric Bauza, Emmy Award-winning voice actor and the modern voice of iconic Looney Tunes characters Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck, along with dozens of other beloved cartoon characters, has passed away suddenly. More details to come." Bauza's talents were heard across the board in the John Cena film Coyote vs. Acme , where he voiced a ton of animated characters, including Tweety Bird during a great scene with Cena. Bauza also lent his talents to a number of the WWE-Hanna Barbera crossover animated films, voicing Dino and Bam Bam in The Flintstones & WWE: Stone Age SmackDown!, Rolf Rodriquez in The Jetsons & WWE: Robo-WrestleMania! a nd Big Earl in Scooby-Doo! and WWE: Curse of the Speed Demon. Bauza was supremely talented and his loss will be a massive one especially for the world of animation. PWInsider.com sends our deepest condolences to Bauza's family, friends and fans. llm_long: Voice actor Eric Bauza has passed away at the age of 46. His family announced the news via social media, stating that the Emmy Award-winning performer died suddenly.

Bauza was known as the modern voice of iconic Looney Tunes characters including Bugs Bunny and Daffy Duck. He also provided voices for dozens of other beloved cartoon characters throughout his career.

His work appeared in the John Cena film Coyote vs. Acme, where he voiced multiple animated characters including Tweety Bird. Bauza contributed to several WWE-Hanna Barbera crossover animated films as well.

In The Flintstones & WWE: Stone Age SmackDown! he voiced Dino and Bam Bam. He portrayed Rolf Rodriguez in The Jetsons & WWE: Robo-WrestleMania! and Big Earl in Scooby-Doo! and WWE: Curse of the Speed Demon.

title: Buddy Matthews Pulled From WSW Megamania Tour
raw_title: Buddy Matthews Pulled From WSW Tour Due To Scheduling Conflicts
body: Buddy Matthews will miss the WSW Megamania tour that kicks off this week due to scheduling conflicts. World Series of Wrestling announced on Sunday that Matthews will be unable to be part of the tour, which runs frmo October 29th through November 2nd. “We have just learnt, that due to scheduling conflicts, Buddy Matthews will no longer be appearing on the WSW MEGAMANIA Tour. We’re really disappointed that Buddy won’t be joining us this time around, but we completely understand that schedules can change. We hope to welcome Buddy back to World Series Wrestling on a future tour! Buddy Matthews announced in early August that he had been cleared to return to the ring. He had been on the shelf since early 2025 when he suffered an ankle injury during the entrance for his match with Kazuchika Okada at AEW Grand Slam Australia and underwent surgery. A post shared by World Series Wrestling (@worldserieswrestling)
summary: World Series of Wrestling announced that Buddy Matthews will miss their Megamania tour running from October 29 through November 2 due to scheduling conflicts. The promotion expressed disappointment but hopes to bring him back in the future. Matthews had been cleared to return to the ring in early August after undergoing ankle surgery for an injury suffered at AEW Grand Slam Australia.

title: Comeback Watch: Stephanie Vaquer Returns And The Final Pieces Ahead Of Crown Jewel Come Together
raw_title: Stephanie Vaquer Returns And The Final Pieces Ahead Of Crown Jewel Come Together
body: We know Stephanie Vaquer is returning to take on Becky Lynch in a No. 1 contender's match for Liv Morgan 's WWE Women's World Championship and we've also learned about a few others. From the looks of things, it seems like the ladies will play major roles in this week's episode of Raw. Let's talk WWE. Vaquer has been sidelined since Money in the Bank, where she suffered an ankle injury in her loss to Morgan. She announced Saturday night that she had been cleared and that her ankle is 100 percent. Aside from the Vaquer-Lynch matchup, fans will also see Bayley vs. Lyra Valkyria in a No DQ match, Raquel Rodriguez will defend the Women's Intercontinental Championship against Iyo Sky , while Chad Gable and Dragon Lee face Big Cass and Ethan Page in a tag-team match. I'd also expect to see some developments in the Bloodline-946 drama — even if it is subtle. Champion vs. Champion for the women's Crown Jewel Championship Perhaps we see one or two matches added from this week's Raw and/or SmackDown. I wouldn't be surprised to see a cash-in at Crown Jewel. title: Moxley’s push in AEW should be the blueprint for unlocking Ospreay’s potential as a centerpiece act — RADICAN’S TAKE
raw_title: RADICAN’S TAKE: Moxley’s push in AEW should be the blueprint for unlocking Ospreay’s potential as a centerpiece act
body: AEW seemed primed to push Will Ospreay as a centerpiece championship act after All in London in August. Virtually every top wrestler in the promotion passed the torch to Ospreay both ceremonially during his entrance and in the ring with Kenny Omega putting him over as much as a big name incumbent top champion possibly could in the main event of All In London, which was the biggest show AEW held in 2026. Has AEW pushed Ospreay as a centerpiece money-drawing champion since he captured the title at All In London? It has been a mixed bag. We’ve seen Will involved in some segments with his version of the United Empire that can only be described as goofy Dynamite. None of the people in the group dressed as a top stable should. Ospreay hardly ever looks the part of champion unless he’s in his entrance or ring gear. The wrestlers in Ospreay’s version of United Empire don’t have matching gear. It’s hardly a championship presentation. The group looks like a collection of strangers when they’re shown together in backstage segments on TV. Ospreay followed up his landmark win over Omega at All in London for the AEW World Hvt. Championship with an excellent match with Jon Moxley at All Out with Moxley symbolically passing the torch to him in the ring. AEW has to endure a lot of heartache and tragedy since Ospreay won the title. The Butcher Andy Williams and Pac both died unexpected deaths. AEW had a tribute show in support of Rebel, who is battling ALS, a tribute show to honor Williams on Collision, and a tribute show on Dynamite to to honor Pac. It certainly hasn’t been business as usual for AEW since Ospreay’s big moment in the U.K. at the end of August. The week after the Pac tribute show, Ospreay successfully defended the AEW World Championship against Kazuchika Okada on Oct. 6 at Grand Slam Paris with no build after the tribute show to Pac. It was the right decision by Tony Khan not to push future programming on Dynamite during Pac’s tribute show. Okada vs. was an excellent match and although the match didn’t have much of a build, it was a notch in Ospreay’s belt to have an AEW World Hvt. Championship defense of that caliber on a big edition of Dynamite against a motivated Okada. Now is the time for Tony Khan to really take a look at Ospreay and decide how they put him in the best position to be a money drawing act. There’s one problem though and it’s that despite doing his best to pot over Ospreay in recent months, Jon Moxley is still the heartbeat of AEW. Moxley has been the center of AEW’s universe and the entire promotion revolves around him and has for quite some time regardless of who has held the top title. Who’s promos do you remember most from the last two months? Who’s match did you think about the most coming out of WrestleDream? For months, Moxley has been trying to not only put Will Ospreay in prime position to be the one person the promotion revolves around, but he’s just been too good on the mic and in the ring to not overshadow him at time
summary: AEW seemed primed to push Will Ospreay as a centerpiece championship act after All in London in August. Has AEW pushed Ospreay as a centerpiece money-drawing champion since he captured the title at All In London?.

title: Backstage Buzz: Word On AEW’s Plans for WrestleMania 43 Weekend
raw_title: Backstage Note on AEW’s Plans for WrestleMania 43 Weekend
body: As previously reported , there’s been talk about AEW holding a major event the same weekend as WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia next year. However, AEW has yet to announce any concrete details. In the latest Fightful Select Answers Q&A , Sean Ross Sapp was asked about the timeframe for when AEW announced their WrestleMania weekend plans. Sapp predicted that it will be announced once WWE announces their own plans for WrestleMania 43. WWE has only announced that WrestleMania 43 will be held in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia in April 2027. No final dates, nor a venue, have been announced for the show. This is the latest WWE has ever waited to announce its WrestleMania plans. Sapp also predicted that WWE will finally announce the dates and venue during Crown Jewel Week. He also noted that AEW has an idea of what they want to do, where they will do it, and what their plans are, adding that AEW has been in discussions for the show since WrestleMani 43 was announced. As noted , during the AEW All Out 2025 media call, Tony Khan said that AEW is planning on holding a “huge show” show in Spring 2027. However, he didn’t provide any other specific details and if the AEW show would run against WrestleMania 43. WrestleMania 43 will be the first-ever WrestleMania held outside North America.
summary: Per 411Mania.: as previously reported , there’s been talk about AEW holding a major event the same weekend as WrestleMania 43 in Saudi Arabia next year. Sean Ross Sapp was asked about the timeframe for when AEW revealed their WrestleMania weekend the plan.
llm_long: WrestleMania 43 is scheduled for April 10-11, 2027 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Roman Reigns versus Oba Femi has consistently been viewed as a likely main event for the two-night show.
Reigns currently holds the World Heavyweight Championship on Raw. The report does not identify which match is planned as the opposing main event.
Cody Rhodes versus CM Punk is not the current plan for the other headliner. Plans for WrestleMania 42 in 2026 underwent multiple changes in the lead-up, largely due to injuries.
The final two main events for WrestleMania 42 featured Rhodes against Randy Orton and Punk against Reigns. Sami Zayn is the current Undisputed WWE Champion on SmackDown.

Liv Morgan holds the Women's Championship on Raw, while Chelsea Green serves as interim Women's Champion on SmackDown during Rhea Ripley's absence. WWE is scheduled to return to Riyadh for Crown Jewel on November 7, 2026.

title: Wrestling Shifts Focus to Recovery and Injury Prevention
raw_title: The Changing Approach to Physical Recovery in Professional Wrestling
body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin The Changing Approach to Physical Recovery in Professional Wrestling By Kendall Jenkins on 2026-10-25 10:55:00 Professional wrestling is one of the most physically demanding forms of sports entertainment. Although audiences primarily see dramatic matches, impressive athletic movements, and carefully developed storylines, the work behind these performances requires considerable physical preparation. Wrestlers frequently manage demanding travel schedules, regular training sessions, and repeated physical impacts while maintaining the conditioning needed to perform consistently. In previous decades, wrestling culture often emphasized toughness and the ability to continue performing despite discomfort. Today, greater attention is being given to recovery, injury prevention, and long-term physical well-being. Modern performers increasingly recognize that maintaining a successful career involves understanding when to train, when to rest, and how to manage the demands of professional competition. From improved training facilities to more individualized recovery programs, the industry is adopting practices commonly associated with other professional sports. These changes are helping wrestlers approach physical preparation more systematically while highlighting the importance of protecting their bodies throughout demanding careers. Recovery facilities have become an increasingly important consideration for professional athletes, including wrestlers who regularly experience demanding physical workloads. Training centers and private fitness facilities may incorporate relaxation areas, massage services, hydrotherapy equipment, and other amenities intended to support structured recovery routines. Saunas have also become a familiar feature in many wellness environments. Their popularity reflects an interest in combining physical relaxation with dedicated time away from strenuous activity. For wrestlers who spend considerable time traveling between events, access to a comfortable wellness facility can provide a welcome opportunity to unwind. When evaluating sauna installations, understanding the difference between a full spectrum sauna or far infrared sauna can help facility owners and individual users explore different infrared heating technologies. Comparing these approaches provides useful information when selecting equipment for a dedicated relaxation space. The overall design of a recovery area also matters. Comfortable surroundings, convenient access, and appropriate facilities can encourage athletes to maintain consistent routines rather than treating relaxation as an occasional activity. For professional wrestlers, these environments can complement broader recovery programs that include adequate sleep, suitable nutrition, physical therapy, and carefully managed training schedules. title: Nikki Bella Got Rejected After Shooting Her Shot With a Married Man on a Flight
raw_title: Nikki Bella Got Rejected After Shooting Her Shot With a Married Man on a Flight
summary_src: Nikki Bella once tried shooting her shot with a good-looking stranger on an airplane, only to find out pretty quickly that he was very much unavailable.
body: The story came up during The Nikki & Brie Show while Nikki and Brie Bella were chatting with Victoria Arlen about books. When Arlen picked The Shack as a book she could read over and over again, Nikki immediately remembered a pretty awkward moment from years ago. Nikki said The Shack was everywhere at the time, and she happened to notice an attractive man sitting a few rows behind her reading it. Apparently, that was enough for her to decide to make the first move. “You wanna hear a funny story? So, I’m on a flight when it came out, and, you know, everyone’s reading it. I’m on a plane, and this good-looking man is sitting a few rows behind me, and I noticed he’s reading The Shack. And so the flight attendant, she comes over, and I was like, ‘Can you send that man a drink?’” Unfortunately for Nikki, the drink didn’t exactly work its magic. The flight attendant returned shortly afterwards and informed her that the mystery man had turned down the offer because he was married. “And then she came back, and she was like, ‘Sorry, he said no, he’s married,’ and blah, blah. And I’m like, ‘Okay.’ And I gave a thumbs up, and I’m like, ‘Oh my God, I’m never doing that again.’” At least things didn’t get too uncomfortable after that. Nikki said the man seemed to appreciate the gesture and laughed about it, with the two exchanging thumbs-ups from their seats. “But he appreciated it, and he laughed and gave me the thumbs up. But I was just like, seeing this good-looking man, he’s reading The Shack.” So Nikki’s attempt at some mid-flight flirting didn’t exactly produce the result she wanted, but at least the rejection couldn’t have been much friendlier. All it took was somebody mentioning The Shack for the whole embarrassing memory to come flying right back. title: Injury Update: Anna Jay Undergoes Shoulder Surgery After Years of Bone Deterioration
raw_title: Anna Jay Undergoes Shoulder Surgery After Years of Bone Deterioration
summary_src: Anna Jay has finally undergone the shoulder surgery she was hoping to avoid, and now she’s revealed just how much damage doctors actually had to repair.
body: Speaking during her October 26 Twitch stream , Jay confirmed that the surgery took place nearly three weeks ago. She even joked about whether fans wanted to see the full incision before explaining exactly what doctors did. “I don’t know if everyone wants to see my full incision. I was only under anesthesia for the surgery, which was almost three weeks ago. In two days, it will be two weeks. So almost three weeks ago, I had shoulder surgery, obviously. Basically, they did what’s called a Latarjet surgery. Basically, that surgery is to fix the missing shoulder bone.” Jay then explained why her shoulder had become such a recurring problem. Between repeatedly dislocating it and undergoing previous surgeries, she says the bone had gradually deteriorated to the point where a significant portion was missing. “What was happening to my shoulder over all these years — you know, dislocating it, having other surgeries — my bone was just deteriorating, and more of it was missing. Every time I dislocated it, more bone would chip off. So they described it to be like a golf ball on a tee, and the shoulder sits on a tee, and when it falls off, it’s dislocating.” The numbers made things even clearer. According to Jay, doctors told her she was missing 20% of the bone, which finally explained why her shoulder had become so easy to dislocate. “And basically, the tee of my shoulder was missing 20% of the bone. So no wonder it would just keep coming out, because 20% of a tee is a big deal.” Fixing that meant doing more than simply repairing the existing damage. Jay explained that doctors took bone from another area of her shoulder and attached it to the damaged section, leaving her with two screws holding everything in place. “So they basically take part of another bone in your shoulder, and they get that off, take that, and attach it to the tee of the shoulder and give me more bone. So it’s like a bone on the shoulder that you’re not using, and they screw it in. So now I have two screws in my shoulder.” Thankfully, the actual procedure went well. Jay dealt with a decent amount of pain during the first couple of weeks, but she’s now moving into the next stage of recovery with physical therapy set to begin. “The surgery went well, and I start physical therapy tomorrow, so that will be exciting. For the first week or two, I was in a good amount of pain. She had spent months hoping there might be another way to handle the injury, especially since it was the same shoulder that had already caused her problems in the past. There still isn’t a timetable for Jay’s return to the ring, and she’s only just beginning physical therapy after the procedure.
