body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin CALIFORNIA'S PRO WRESTLING REVOLUTION TO TOUR WITH DRAGON GATE By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-26 15:20:00 The following was announced today: Two members of the Revolution family are headed to Japan as a champion returns for his third tour and one of our top students prepares for his international debut. Pro Wrestling Revolution is proud to announce that “El Rey de las Pesadillas” El Cucuy and “El Terror de la Paja” El Espantapajaro will be heading to Japan to work with our partners at Dragon Gate Pro-Wrestling for the remainder of 2026! Based in Japan, Dragon Gate is recognized for its fast-paced, high-impact wrestling, spectacular athleticism, and exciting blend of international wrestling styles. Pro Wrestling Revolution, founded in 2008, has spent years showcasing the art of lucha libre while developing talent and creating opportunities for wrestlers to compete on the international stage. Our relationship with Dragon Gate represents exactly what we work toward: building connections, developing talent, and creating opportunities for our wrestlers to prove themselves around the world. For El Cucuy, this marks his third trip to Japan to compete for Dragon Gate Pro-Wrestling, another important milestone in an already impressive international journey. A graduate of the Pro Wrestling Revolution Training Academy, Cucuy has represented our organization in Costa Rica, Dubai, and Japan, gaining valuable experience and showcasing his talent on an international stage. He currently stands as the Pro Wrestling Revolution World OpenWeight Champion and is also one-third of the Pro Wrestling Revolution Trios Champions. We could not be prouder of how far Cucuy has come. Watching a graduate of our academy continue to grow, represent our company around the world, and reach new heights in his career is exactly why we do what we do. We look forward to seeing what this next chapter brings for El Rey de las Pesadillas. Joining Cucuy on this journey is one of our top students, El Espantapajaro, who will be making his first-ever trip to Japan! When El Espantapajaro first came to Pro Wrestling Revolution, he was eager to try his hand at lucha libre. Coming from a solid background in JUCO football, he brought a competitive mindset, physical intensity, and a willingness to work to everything he did inside the ring. But talent alone does not get you to this level. It takes discipline, consistency, sacrifice, and a commitment to improving every single day. At times, El Espantapajaro has trained five days a week, putting in the work and dedicating himself to becoming the best wrestler he can be. We are incredibly proud of both El Cucuy and El Espantapajaro as they take this next step in their careers and represent Pro Wrestling Revolution in Japan. title: On the Record: MVP Says Diddy’s Prison Perks Are Nothing Compared to What He’s Seen Behind Bars
raw_title: MVP Says Diddy’s Prison Perks Are Nothing Compared to What He’s Seen Behind Bars
summary_src: Diddy’s prison privileges might sound crazy to some people, but MVP isn’t impressed. The former WWE Superstar spent nine and a half years behind bars, and he says having money in prison can get you just about anything.
body: During the October 26, 2026 episode of Marking Out with MVP and Dwayne Swayze , MVP got into the dirty side of prison life while discussing his time in Florida’s correctional system. He claimed some guards were so desperate for money that they were running drug operations inside the very prisons they were supposed to be policing. MVP recalled one correctional officer at DeSoto Correctional Institution who allegedly had two inmates selling drugs for him. The guard supplied the drugs, the prisoners handled the sales, and everybody got a piece of the money until the whole operation came crashing down. “If you got money them correctional officers don’t make any money. Them correctional officers get paid a pittance. You know, they make less than regular cops. The correctional officers when I was in the system of Florida, they were the man who was bringing the drugs in.” “There’s one guard, he finally got caught. And he ended up doing prison time. He had two guys that were selling dope for him. So, he’d bring, he’d smuggle in the drugs, give it to these dudes. They’d sell it on the compound; they bring him money, they’d keep their share, he’d go out and he’d smuggle dope.” The conversation then turned to Rick Ross, who previously worked as a correctional officer. MVP joked that Ross should have leaned into his prison guard past instead of trying to distance himself from it, considering what MVP says some officers were doing on the job. “But he should have said instead of saying, ‘No, I didn’t do it. Yeah, yeah, man, yeah, I was, you know, I was bringing in that work. You know, yeah, I was a CO, but I was bringing in work, you know.’ That would have been like, ‘Oh, okay, yeah, believable.'” And that’s where Diddy entered the conversation. MVP said hearing about the music mogul’s access to special privileges behind bars didn’t surprise him because wealthy inmates have been pulling strings inside federal prisons for years. He pointed to organized crime figures who, according to him, have long enjoyed a very different prison experience from everybody else. “So, when I found out about Diddy, what he was getting access to, like, ‘Yeah, the mob been doing that for years in federal penitentiaries.'” “That’s not new. They They don’t eat what we eat. You know, they they Yeah, you You got connections, you got money, you make things You can make things happen.” MVP also revealed just how broke some correctional officers were during his time at Glades Correctional Institution. He recalled guards borrowing food from inmates, including one officer named Bostick who would occasionally ask him for soup and chips. “Some of those guards, they had a what they call a BOQ, bachelor’s only quarter. And only like single officers could live there. It was like just like like trailers.” “So, I remember this one officer, Bostick. He was cool. I liked As far as COs go, he was cool, you know, but he used to come to me every now and again and be like ‘Hey man, get a soup and chips f

title: Ric Flair Urged to Consider What He’s Putting Charlotte Through After Recent Hospitalization
raw_title: Ric Flair Urged to Consider What He’s Putting Charlotte Through After Recent Hospitalization
summary_src: Vince Russo thinks Ric Flair needs to start thinking a lot more about how his behavior affects Charlotte Flair.
body: Speaking on the Coach and Bro Show , Russo addressed Flair’s recent antics and argued that the bigger issue isn’t simply what Flair chooses to do with his own life. He believes Flair should be considering what those decisions put his daughter through. “What he’s gotta do is put his family first. I mean, it’s that simple. He has to take into consideration what he is putting her through. And again, I don’t know if Ric takes that into consideration when he says the things he says and when he does the things he does. It just seems like Charlotte is the one having to put out fires.” Russo then pointed to Flair’s family situation, noting that David Flair has stayed away from the spotlight for years while Reid Flair passed away in 2013. In Russo’s view, that leaves Charlotte as the family member who continually has to face questions whenever something involving her father becomes public. “Again, he should be conscious of that and be aware of that — he’s got a daughter. Because David’s out of the limelight for years, Reid passed away, so there’s just one daughter that is going to constantly be answering for him, and he should take that into consideration. Because she’s probably worrying about him 24/7, Coach. It’s a full-time job, and I’m sure it is for her as well.” Russo’s comments come after an eventful few days for Flair in Tampa. On October 23, Flair suffered a nasty fall outside an establishment near his Florida home that left him bleeding from his head with an injured eye and resulted in an overnight stay at Tampa General Hospital. That accident was already concerning because Flair had recently revealed that he was dealing with a blood clot in his leg . The issue forced him to cancel an autograph appearance in Seattle, and Flair had said he was set to undergo a procedure for the clot. There have also been claims about Flair’s behavior during his nights out around Tampa. Ringside News readers have alleged that Flair regularly makes comments toward women at The Pearl , with one reader claiming men have occasionally stepped in before Flair’s security calmed things down. Another reader who said they were present before Flair’s October 23 fall claimed Flair approached a woman, tapped her on the forehead and made a remark about Botox. There is no indication that the alleged interaction had anything to do with Flair’s later fall. Flair was released from the hospital on October 24, but he didn’t stay away from his usual hangout for long. He returned to the establishment that same evening , just one day after the fall sent him to the hospital. That’s the part of the situation Russo clearly believes Flair needs to look at differently. His concern is that whatever Flair chooses to say or do publicly doesn’t necessarily end with him, because Charlotte may be left worrying about her father and answering questions about him afterwards. title: Grayson Waller Fat-Shames Tony D’Angelo Ahead of WWE NXT Halloween Havoc
raw_title: Grayson Waller Fat-Shames Tony D’Angelo Ahead of WWE NXT Halloween Havoc
summary_src: Grayson Waller is already making things personal ahead of his next NXT Championship defense. With Halloween Havoc coming up on October 31, the champion decided to take a pretty brutal shot at Tony D’Angelo before they even get in the ring.
body: Speaking with Tyler Walsh , Waller talked up his run as NXT Champion and made it clear he doesn’t see D’Angelo as the guy who’s going to end it. Then, in typical Waller fashion, he turned his attention to D’Angelo’s weight and Italian heritage while talking about their upcoming title match. “I’m the king of NXT, and I’m gonna be the champion for a long time coming, lads. As everyone knows, October 31st — unfortunately, I don’t get to celebrate Halloween properly, but that’s probably a good thing — I’m taking on Tony D’Angelo. He would actually fit in well here in New York. He’s a fat Italian who’s about to get drowned when Grayson Waller defends the NXT Championship against him.” Waller wasn’t finished there either. He kept going with the food jokes, telling D’Angelo to enjoy himself while he still can because Waller plans on being the one celebrating once Halloween Havoc is over. “Keep enjoying the cannolis, keep enjoying the pastrami, the salami, the pasta — all those things, because I’m gonna be enjoying the victory October 31st at Halloween Havoc.” The trash talk comes after a busy few weeks around the NXT Championship picture. Mason Rook previously earned a future shot at Waller’s title by defeating Tony D’Angelo and Saquon Shugars in a Triple Threat Match on the September 15 episode of NXT. That means Waller already has another challenger waiting in the wings, but first he has to make it through D’Angelo at Halloween Havoc. Waller certainly doesn’t sound worried about that happening. He’s already talking like his championship reign is going to last for a long time, and now D’Angelo has a few extra reasons to want to shut him up on October 31. title: Zoey Serrano Recalls Learning of Shayna Baszler's TNA Signing
raw_title: Zoey Serrano Recounts Learning Shayna Baszler Signed With TNA, Expressed To Creative That She Still Wants Singles Run
summary_src: Zoey Serrano is still aiming for that singles run. Shayna Baszler signed with TNA Wrestling and is now reunited with Zoey Serrano. The duo won the TNA Knockouts World Tag Team Titles at the 2026 Bound For Glory pay-per-view.
body: Shayna Baszler signed with TNA Wrestling and is now reunited with Zoey Serrano. The duo won the TNA Knockouts World Tag Team Titles at the 2026 Bound For Glory pay-per-view. While appearing on Busted Open , Serrano recounted learning that Baszler signed with the promotion. “Honestly, I didn’t really know if — I mean, obviously Daria (Rae) was there and everything else but I didn’t know if Shayna (Baszler) was gonna come so when she told me that she finally signed and that we were gonna be a team together, that was really exciting. I found out, I think, like four days ahead of time or something.” Serrano continued speaking about being paired back up with Baszler. She stated that once Baszler signed, TNA Head of Creative Delirious immediately put out the idea of them being a team. Serrano spoke to him about still wanting to do singles work. “I wanted to do my own thing. I was in a tag for the last — my entire career, so I was like, ‘I wanna go out and do a singles and figure myself out before I go back into another team,’ and it wasn’t discussed. I wasn’t told anything. It just was kind of like, ‘Hey, I signed –’ when she told me — and then Delirious kinda just said, ‘Okay, you two are a team. Let’s think of tag names.’ But I did have a talk with Delirious. I was like, ‘I still wanna do singles stuff. I wanna do both, and be a workhorse more than anything else and find myself.’ That’s really the goal at this point in my career is just finding myself again. Have fun with everything.” Serrano went on to state that working with Delirious has been a breeze, as he’s been receptive to all her ideas. He reassured her that she’ll still be doing singles work. “It’s so much easier to actually go up and talk to Delirious. I feel like everything I pitched to him, he was just like, ‘Yeah. We’ll do it on this show.’ We’re also probably taking some stuff off of his plate where he’s like, thank you, you know? Giving him some ideas. But yeah, I’ve definitely made that clear. He sent me a text saying, ‘Don’t worry. We’re gonna still do singles’ and everything so I’m excited to mix both of doing both singles route and tag… I love working with Shayna (Baszler) but, I definitely wanna see where I could go with the singles route.” On the 10/22 Thursday Night iMPACT, Baszler and Serrano jumped Knockouts World Champion Indi Hartwell. Baszler held up the Knockouts Title to close the segment.
summary: Zoey Serrano learned about Shayna Baszler's signing with TNA just four days before they were paired together as a tag team, according to her appearance on Busted Open. Once Baszler signed, TNA Head of Creative Delirious immediately suggested reuniting the duo, who went on to win the TNA Knockouts World Tag Team Titles at the 2026 Bound For Glory. Serrano expressed to creative that she wanted to pursue a singles run first after being in a tag team for her entire career, but the idea was not discussed further.

title: Backstage Buzz: Latest On Rusev Amid Extended Absence From WWE TV
raw_title: Backstage Update on Rusev Amid Extended Absence From WWE TV
body: An update on Rusev amid his extended absence from WWE television. The Bulgarian Brute has been off television since facing Je’Von Evans on the July 27th episode of Monday Night RAW. It was later reported that Rusev suffered an injury during the match. His wife, CJ Perry, later revealed that the former US Champion landed awkwardly on his neck and informed the referee that he couldn’t feel his hands. Though he finished the match, the veteran was subsequently put in concussion protocol for two weeks, per Fightful Select. He subsequently returned to the Performance Center, but an undisclosed illness further derailed his return. According to Fightful Select , there had been discussions regarding bringing Rusev back to television in September. Rusev returned to action at recent WWE live events in Hawaii, working a singles match with Joe Hendry and a tag team match alongside Ethan Page. However, as of this writing, there is no indication of when he’ll return to television.
summary: Per 411Mania.: an update on Rusev amid his extended absence from WWE television. It was later reported that Rusev suffered an injury setback during the match.

title: WWE Star Was Told She’ll Likely Never Turn Heel
raw_title: WWE Star Was Told She’ll Likely Never Turn Heel
body: 0 WWE Superstar Sol Ruca says she was told she might never turn heel. Sol Ruca has become one of the most interesting and highly gifted prospects in the WWE women’s division. After a successful stint in NXT, she was called up to the main roster earlier this year. She won the Women’s Intercontinental Championship within a short span and had a 57-day run with the title before dropping it to Raquel Rodriguez. As she continues to make strides in WWE, Sol Ruca commented on a potential heel turn. She addressed the possibility during a recent interview on The Finish with Kor & Tor . She revealed WWE officials told her in the past that she might never turn heel due to her bubbly personality. Sol Ruca believes it would take a very special person to bring that side out of her. “I have no idea. Think I would love to be able to try that. I have been told in the past that I most likely will not be heel ever because of just how I am naturally. I am quite a bubbly person. So, I don’t know. I feel like it’s going to take a very special person to really get that side out of me. But I guess we’re just going to have to wait and see,” the WWE star said. Despite coming up short, Sol Ruca delivered a great performance in the Women’s Money in the Bank Ladder match earlier this month. She has competed in the Hawaii live tour and on three Main Event episodes since then. It will be interesting to see how WWE will book the 27-year-old on the main shows in the coming days. raw_title: Samantha Irvin reveals she turned down WWE record deal as AEW rumors swirl
body: Link WWE via X/Twitter Samatha Irvin (real name Samantha Johnson-Mann) is believed to be a free agent after her two-year WWE non-compete clause is believed to have recently expired . She walked away from her role in WWE as a ring announcer on October 21, 2024, and since that time she has independently released several songs. But Irvin’s two passions could have once intertwined, as she revealed over the weekend that WWE once wanted to become involved in launching a music career for her. “WWE offered me a record deal, to which I politely declined because I have no interest in the music business!” Samantha posted Saturday (Oct. 24) on X (Twitter). “My interest was in managing wrestlers. And that’s all I’ve ever expressed.” She continued: “I made some songs last year for fun & videos with my colleagues from Cirque du Soleil and released independently for my singing fans from before wrestling but other than that, I made no proclamations about or efforts towards a ‘music’ career 🙏🏽 Singing career wise, I’ve had a fantastic one, though!!! Saw the world multiple times over.” Though she seems intent on not dedicating her full attention to music, Irvin could soon be entertaining wrestling fans again soon. On Friday, Fightful Select reported that AEW, where her husband Ricochet works, has “has internally discussed bringing her in a number of times, but it was made clear that it isn’t going to happen immediately upon her free agency.” Irving offered a humorous reply on X to the report about being “internally discussed,” though she didn’t actually reveal anything with her message. summary_src: Ten days ago, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo was teaming with his teammates in WWE NXT’s Birthright stable in an 8-man tag on a house show in Canada. The match against Tony D’Angelo, Tavion Heights, Shiloh Hill & Shawn Spears was stopped after Lorenzo took a fall to the floor and landed badly.
body: Link Channing Lorenzo’s Instagram Story Ten days ago, Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo was teaming with his teammates in WWE NXT’s Birthright stable in an 8-man tag on a house show in Canada. The match against Tony D’Angelo, Tavion Heights, Shiloh Hill & Shawn Spears was stopped after Lorenzo took a fall to the floor and landed badly. Some accounts claimed he hit his head on the ring post. Whatever led to his bad landing, Stacks left the building wearing a neck brace on a stretcher as Birthright’s Uriah Connors was put through a table and Spears apologized to the crowd for the unplanned ending. Word came later that night (via Wrestling Observer ) that Lorenzo was in the hospital, but that was the last update. Usually that means good news, and that was what we got in-character confirmation of today (Oct. 26) from Stacks’ Instagram Story . A photo, presumably from Fri., Oct. 16 in the hospital, shows Lorenzo on a stretcher giving the camera both middle fingers and captioned: Doc was worried about my ‘attitude’ … Told ’em it’s a preexisting condition. title: Kofi Reveals Main Reason He and Austin Creed Joined AEW
raw_title: Kofi Confirms The 'Main Reason' He & Austin Creed Signed With AEW
summary_src: Kofi confirms the "main reason" he and New Level tag team partner Austin Creed signed with AEW was to take on Kenny Omega and the Young Bucks of The Elite
body: So far during their AEW stay, New Level's Austin Creed and Kofi have found themselves tied to Swerve Strickland , competing for the AEW World Trios Championships against "Hangman" Adam Page and Brodido in a feud that may soon devolve into a Texas Death Match . But no matter how that saga turns out, Kofi and Creed appear to have another potential program they're looking forward to just as much, if not more. Kofi revealed what that feud was during an appearance on "The Mick and Kenny Show," telling Mick Foley this potential rivalry was a huge catalyst for why he and Creed decided AEW was the place to be. "The main reason that we came to AEW was for the Young Bucks and Kenny Omega," Kofi said. "And again, going back to manifestation, we had a, like a video game challenge with the Bucks and Kenny, and we had a big face off when we were still with WWE . And I don't know how that was allowed to happen, because they were very particular about not letting people interact with people from other promotions. "So we talk about it all the time, like our dream opponents being the Young Bucks, being Kenny Omega. And now that we're here, we're on the cusp of it actually being possible to happen. Even at All In, and then the 'Dynamite' after, we had the little ships in the night, and I was like 'Oh my god. It's so close.'" As noted by Kofi, he and Creed came face to face with the Bucks at AEW All In, during a confrontation that featured fellow AEW teams Adam Copeland and Christian Cage, FTR, and the Motor City Machine Guns. A month later, the Bucks would defeat FTR and Copeland and Cage to win the AEW World Tag Team Championships for a fourth time , setting up a potential tag title match between them, Kofi and Creed, should the latter team earn a tag title shot in the future.
summary: Kofi explained on The Mick and Kenny Show that the primary motivation for him and Austin Creed to sign with AEW was the chance to feud with The Young Bucks and Kenny Omega. He recalled a video game challenge and in-person face-off that occurred while they were still with WWE, which helped manifest the desired rivalry. The pair are currently involved in a storyline with Swerve Strickland competing for the AEW World Trios Championships.

title: Paul Walter Hauser Reveals High-Level Star Criticized Him
raw_title: Paul Walter Hauser Says He Heard A 'High Level Wrestling Star' Was Talking Behind His Back
summary_src: Paul Walter Hauser is an Emmy award winning actor, but he has made his own way in wrestling, competing for ROH, MLW, PROGRESS, and various independent promotions. Speaking to Alistair McGeorge of Metro, Hauser recalled the reaction when he first got in the ring.
body: Paul Walter Hauser is an Emmy award winning actor, but he has made his own way in wrestling, competing for ROH, MLW, PROGRESS, and various independent promotions. Speaking to Alistair McGeorge of Metro , Hauser recalled the reaction when he first got in the ring. “I think that when I first started, everyone was just watching me to see if I get injured, if I could survive the matches, and I think I surprised some people,” he said, noting that he heard a ‘certain high-level wrestling star’ has been talking behind his back. “They were basically alluding to the fact that I didn’t really belong in wrestling,” he said. “They took a few shots at me in different ways. It was somebody I actually am a fan of and admire their work, so I was kind of bummed. But, it’s good to find out about that stuff because it puts a healthy chip on your shoulder, and it also lets you know who to help and who not to help when they call.” Hauser lost the PROGRESS Proteus Championship to Donovan Dijak at PROGRESS 199. Fans can find full results from the event by clicking here .
summary: Paul Walter Hauser told Metro that when he began wrestling for promotions including ROH, MLW, PROGRESS and independents, many were simply waiting to see if he would get hurt. He learned a high-level wrestling star he admires had been talking behind his back and suggesting he did not belong in the business. Hauser said the experience gave him motivation and clarity on who to assist in the future; he recently dropped the PROGRESS Proteus Championship to Donovan Dijak at PROGRESS 199.

llm_long: Paul Walter Hauser revealed that a high-level wrestling star criticized him behind his back after he began competing in the ring. The Emmy award winning actor has wrestled for Ring of Honor, Major League Wrestling, PROGRESS and several independent promotions.

Hauser told Alistair McGeorge of Metro that when he first started, observers were mainly watching to see whether he would get injured or survive his matches. He said he surprised some people with his performances but learned that a certain high-level wrestling star had been talking about him.

The star was alluding to the fact that Hauser did not really belong in wrestling and took a few shots at him in different ways. Hauser noted that the critic was somebody he actually is a fan of and admires their work, which left him feeling bummed.
He added that finding out about the criticism has put a healthy chip on his shoulder and helps him decide who to help when they call.

title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Preparations Begin in Riyadh
raw_title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 setup underway despite Middle East tensions
summary_src: Preparations for WWE Crown Jewel 2026 are underway despite ongoing tensions in the Middle East. PWInsider reports that the setup for Crown Jewel has begun in Saudi Arabia ahead of the November 7 PLE.
body: Preparations for WWE Crown Jewel 2026 are underway despite ongoing tensions in the Middle East. PWInsider reports that the setup for Crown Jewel has begun in Saudi Arabia ahead of the November 7 PLE. As of now, Riyadh is still scheduled to host the show amid what’s been a violent period with the Iran-backed Houthi rebel group targeting Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport. Riyadh Season Stadium in the King Abdullah Financial District is where Crown Jewel is set to be held. Ari Emanuel, the leader of TKO Group, confirmed last week that everything is still in place for Crown Jewel to take place from Saudi Arabia, though Emanuel said they are continuing to monitor the situation and will have a plan in place if anything changes. An undisclosed United States location is on the table as a backup if WWE does end up changing course. UFC, also owned by TKO, was in Abu Dhabi for an event this past weekend and has respective trips to Qatar and Saudi Arabia scheduled for November and December. WWE’s Crown Jewel event is set to be part of the annual Riyadh Season festival. While some events have been canceled or postponed, a Canelo Alvarez boxing match against Christian Mbilli is proceeding as scheduled for this Saturday. Alvarez has already arrived in Saudi Arabia ahead of the event. As of now, three matches are official for the Crown Jewel PLE: Joseph Currier Joseph Currier is a graduate of the University of Massachusetts, obtaining a journalism degree in 2016. Joseph joined F4W during his time at UMass and has now been writing about the industry for nearly a decade. In addition to his work with F4W, Joseph has previously contributed to Sports Illustrated's wrestling coverage. He lives in Massachusetts and is a diehard fan of the Boston sports teams and Liverpool Football Club.

title: WWE Staff in “Absolute Disarray” Over Crown Jewel Saudi Arabia Situation
raw_title: WWE Staff in “Absolute Disarray” Over Crown Jewel Saudi Arabia Situation
summary_src: Things behind the scenes in WWE aren’t looking good as Crown Jewel gets closer. With the company still scheduled to head to Saudi Arabia on November 7, people within WWE are said to be dealing with “absolute disarray” as they wait to find out whether the show will actually happen there.
body: During a recent Q&A session, WrestleVotes shared what he was told by a longtime WWE source about the mood backstage. According to him, there’s a lot of uncertainty right now because people involved with Crown Jewel simply don’t know whether they’re going to Saudi Arabia, whether the show could be moved, or whether plans could suddenly change. WrestleVotes said the person he spoke with has been around WWE for a long time and has a strong understanding of what’s happening inside the company. From what that source described, the uncertainty is affecting the people who actually have to prepare for the trip. “This is a guy I was talking to Saturday night — very knowledgeable, been in WWE for a long time, and has a good pulse on what’s going on there. It is absolute disarray within the people who work there. Everything, including going into this PLE, not knowing if it’s happening or if it’s gonna move. Waiting on a moment’s notice to see if things are changed.” The bigger issue, according to WrestleVotes, is that many of the people involved don’t really have control over what happens next. Any decision about whether WWE goes ahead with Crown Jewel in Riyadh would have to come from much higher up, leaving talent and staff waiting for answers while the security situation continues to develop. He added that there is also real concern about potentially putting WWE talent and employees on planes and sending them into the region under the current circumstances. “It’s really from the top down where these decisions are gonna be made. The fact that everything going on with Saudi Arabia is chaotic and dangerous, and the potential of talent being sent over there in planes — God forbid something happens to them — the situation is really scary. It’s a very helpless feeling to not have any safeguards in place.” That paints a much more uneasy picture backstage than the one being presented publicly. Saudi Arabia’s General Entertainment Authority chairman Turki Alalshikh promoted Crown Jewel on October 26 and directly encouraged fans to buy tickets, including pushing Roman Reigns vs. Sami Zayn for the WWE Crown Jewel Championship. At the same time, WWE and TKO clearly know the situation could still change. Ari Emanuel previously confirmed that a team has been monitoring things daily and looking at possible alternatives if Crown Jewel ultimately cannot take place in Saudi Arabia. For now, WWE Crown Jewel remains scheduled for November 7 at Riyadh Season Stadium. There’s been no official announcement about moving or cancelling the show, but if this report is accurate, the people expected to actually make the trip are still waiting to find out exactly what they’ll be doing. title: Reason Behind Michin and B-Fab’s WWE Women’s Tag Team Title Win
raw_title: Reason Behind Michin and B-Fab’s WWE Women’s Tag Team Title Win
summary_src: WWE’s decision to suddenly end Alexa Bliss and Tatum Paxley’s Women’s Tag Team Championship reign left a lot of fans wondering what the point was. Now, it appears there wasn’t some huge storyline reason behind the switch — WWE simply wanted to shake things up.
body: During a recent Q&A session, WrestleVotes was asked why Michin and B-Fab were given the Women’s Tag Team Championships on the October 23 episode of SmackDown . According to him, WWE is essentially willing to “hot potato” the championships right now as a way of creating more movement within the women’s tag team division. The idea is to give different teams opportunities and keep the championships moving when there isn’t necessarily a major storyline driving the division. In this case, putting the belts on Michin and B-Fab was apparently part of WWE’s attempt to generate some additional interest. “They hot potato it a little bit. It’s one of those things where, creatively, they wanna kinda stimulate the tag team division and hot potato the tag team titles like that when there’s not a lot going on. It’s about drumming up a little bit more interest in the women’s tag team division.” That definitely puts Bliss and Paxley’s extremely short reign into a little more perspective. The two had only held the championships for around two weeks and hadn’t even picked up a successful title defense before WWE moved the belts again. Michin and B-Fab’s victory wasn’t exactly clean either. Paxley was preparing to hit Cemetery Drive when Jade Cargill punched her behind the referee’s back, allowing Michin to capitalize with a Styles Clash and capture the championships. Fans immediately questioned the decision , especially considering Bliss and Paxley barely had enough time to establish themselves as champions. Some wondered why WWE bothered putting the titles on them at all if the plan was to move on almost immediately, while others criticized the overall direction of the women’s tag team division. Whether moving the belts around more frequently actually creates that interest is another question entirely, but it appears Michin and B-Fab’s win wasn’t the result of some major change of plans. WWE simply wanted to give another team an opportunity and get people talking about the division again. Do you think it will create more interest in the division, or make the championships feel less important? llm_long: B-Fab and Michin defeated Tatum Paxley and Alexa Bliss to win the WWE Women’s Tag Team Titles on the October 23 edition of WWE SmackDown.
Towards the end of the match, Michin distracted the referee, allowing Jade Cargill to strike Paxley.
Michin then hit a Styles Clash on Paxley and secured the pinfall victory.
Paxley and Bliss had captured the titles two weeks earlier on the October 9 episode of SmackDown by defeating Fatal Influence.

title: Hulk Hogan’s estate cashes out on Florida mansion and guesthouse for $8.7 million
raw_title: Hulk Hogan’s estate cashes out on Florida mansion and guesthouse for $8.7 million
body: Its centerpiece is a sprawling, 1,000-square-foot primary suite equipped with a sitting area The sale comes after the 5,400-square-foot home was initially listed in January for nearly $11 million, meaning the final price was almost half the original asking price. Hogan purchased the property in 2012 for $3.3 million. Located near Clearwater’s sandy beaches and Gulf Coast waters , the mansion features five bedrooms, five full bathrooms and a half-bathroom. Its centerpiece is a sprawling, 1,000-square-foot primary suite equipped with a sitting area, a Gulf-front terrace , a morning bar, a spa-inspired bathroom and an expansive walk-in closet. The property’s amenities and waterfront setting made it one of the most recognizable pieces of real estate associated with the wrestling superstar, whose larger-than-life persona helped make him one of the defining figures in WWE history. The main house was not the only property connected to Hogan to change hands. The estate also sold the guest cottage next door for $2.8 million, bringing the combined sales total to $8.7 million. The cottage measures 2,062 square feet and includes three bedrooms, two full bathrooms and a half-bathroom, along with modern amenities. It remains unclear whether the same buyer purchased both properties. Martha Thorn, Hogan’s longtime friend and an agent with the Thorn Collection at Coldwell Banker Realty, represented the listing. The Clearwater home carries particular significance because it was the site of the medical emergency that preceded Hogan’s death last year. He was transported to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead at age 71. Hogan’s passing marked the end of an era for professional wrestling. Born Terry Bollea, he became one of the sport’s most recognizable stars during the 1980s wrestling boom, helping propel WWE into mainstream entertainment with his charismatic personality, signature look and memorable rivalries. His career included multiple WWE championship reigns and a central role in landmark events such as WrestleMania . He later became a prominent figure in World Championship Wrestling, where his move to the villainous Hollywood Hogan character helped reshape his public image and the wrestling landscape during the 1990s. The sale of the Clearwater properties represents another development in the handling of the late star’s estate. Although the mansion ultimately sold for substantially less than its original asking price, the two transactions together generated $8.7 million.
summary: Its centerpiece is a sprawling, 1,000-square-foot primary suite equipped with a sitting area The sale comes after the 5,400-square-foot home was initially listed in January for nearly $11 million. Hogan purchased the property in 2012 for $3.3 million.

title: Contract News: Where Things Stand With Dralistico Potentially Joining WWE as AEW Contract Nears Expiration
raw_title: Where Things Stand With Dralistico Potentially Joining WWE as AEW Contract Nears Expiration
summary_src: Dralistico might already know exactly where he wants to go once his time with AEW is up. With his contract currently set to expire in December, there are now rumblings that he wants to make the jump to WWE and work alongside his brother Dragon Lee.
body: During a recent Q&A session, WrestleVotes was asked where things currently stand with Dralistico potentially joining WWE once he’s free from AEW. He said the talk is that Dralistico does want to come over, with the chance to travel and perform alongside Dragon Lee being a big part of the appeal. WrestleVotes also feels WWE wouldn’t have much trouble finding something for Dralistico to do. With WWE’s involvement with AAA and everything the company has been doing with lucha talent lately, he would fit pretty naturally into the mix. “Yeah, the rumblings are that he wants to come over, and he would like to travel and perform with his brother. He can be used great. It fits with AAA and everything WWE has been doing with luchas as of late.” That makes all the recent talk about Dralistico’s future a lot more interesting. His original AEW contract should actually be finished by now, but Bryan Alvarez previously revealed that AEW added injury time to his deal, which will keep him under contract through December . There was at least some talk about keeping him around. Alvarez said AEW discussed re-signing Dralistico when the injury time was added, but he also believed there was a better than 50% chance Dralistico would try to make the move to WWE. Dralistico hasn’t exactly done much to shut down the exit talk either. Earlier this month, he posted a photo of himself behind bars and handcuffed alongside the message, “Maybe not for long?” Naturally, that got people wondering if he was counting down the remaining time on his AEW contract. He also hasn’t wrestled for AEW in months. His last match for the company came at the June 6 Collision taping, when he teamed with RUSH and Sammy Guevara in an unsuccessful challenge for the AEW World Trios Championship. Nothing is official yet, and Dralistico still has to get through the remaining injury time on his AEW contract. But if the latest rumblings are anything to go by, this might be less about whether WWE would have a place for him and more about what happens once December finally rolls around. Would you like to see Dralistico make the jump to WWE and work with Dragon Lee, or would you rather see him stick around in AEW? Let us know what you think in the comments. title: Ludwig Kaiser’s Battery Case Gets New Evidence Update as Prosecutors Prepare Medical Records
raw_title: Ludwig Kaiser’s Battery Case Gets New Evidence Update as Prosecutors Prepare Medical Records
summary_src: Ludwig Kaiser’s battery case just got another update, and this time prosecutors are preparing to turn over medical records.
body: Ringside News has obtained a new Notice of Supplemental Discovery filed on October 26, 2026, in Orange County, Florida. The document, submitted by Assistant State Attorney Juanda Padgett, confirms that redacted medical records are being made available to Kaiser’s attorney, Thomas D. Sommerville. The filing gets straight to the point: “Please provide a blank DVD for copy of Redacted Medical Records. Upon receipt a copy will be made and sent to your office via US mail.” The notice was emailed to Kaiser’s attorney on October 26, just one week after a judge denied his attempt to get the battery charge thrown out. The filing doesn’t identify whose medical records are involved or what they contain. It also doesn’t confirm that the defense has received them yet. Prosecutors are waiting for the blank DVD before sending a copy. This isn’t the first batch of evidence to surface in the case. On October 22, prosecutors gave Kaiser’s defense access to four photographs of alleged injuries involving Richard Reap, the man accusing him of assault. The pictures were identified as two head injury photos, one right elbow photo, and another showing an injury to Reap’s right side. Those photographs came after Kaiser’s October 19 hearing, where his attempt to have the battery charge dismissed failed . Both Kaiser and Reap testified during that hearing, and prosecutors introduced a CD and four photographs as evidence. The judge ultimately denied Kaiser’s motion to dismiss under Florida’s Stand Your Ground law. The case stems from an April 23 confrontation at an Orlando apartment complex. Reap claims Kaiser, whose real name is Marcel Barthel, punched and pushed him during an argument. Kaiser has denied wrongdoing, and his attorneys maintain that he was acting in self-defense. According to Kaiser’s previously filed self-defense arguments , Reap became aggressive during an elevator encounter involving Kaiser and his girlfriend, Andrea Bazarte. His defense also claims Reap made threats involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement before approaching Kaiser in a threatening manner. Kaiser’s attorneys have maintained that he only pushed Reap because he believed he was about to be attacked. Reap has given a very different account of what happened. The defense has also been fighting to obtain surveillance footage from the apartment building. As Ringside News previously covered , Kaiser’s attorneys sought video from outside the 12th-floor elevator where the confrontation allegedly occurred. Now prosecutors are adding medical records to the discovery process, although the latest document doesn’t reveal whether those records will help the prosecution, the defense, or neither. It simply confirms that another set of materials is being prepared for Kaiser’s legal team. Kaiser has pleaded not guilty and is scheduled to return to court for a pretrial conference on December 17, 2026. A possible trial window running from January 4 through January 22, 2027, is also on the calendar. Kaiser

title: Dustin Rhodes Working On Second Career Book
raw_title: AEW's Dustin Rhodes Writing Second Book, Says 'My Hands Were Tied' In WWE
summary_src: AEW's Dustin Rhodes reveals that he is writing his second book, and seems to criticize his first book by saying "my hands were tied" by WWE while writing it
body: Given he has almost forty years in the wrestling business, it would make sense that Dustin Rhodes would have enough stories to tell that he could write a book. Just a few days ago, a fan learned directly from Rhodes that was not only the case, but that Rhodes had already written one and was in the process of writing another. Rhodes made the revelation on Friday, when he took to X to confirm there would be a second book regarding his career. He also proceeded to take a shot at the first book and WWE. "[I] already have [written a book]," Rhodes tweeted. "I am in the middle of writing my second book. This one will be way more in depth over my whole career, ups and down. Back to glory and doing it my way. My hands were tied with the other company." Already have. I am in the middle of writing my second book. This one will be way more in depth over my whole career, ups and down. Back to glory and doing it my way. My hands were tied with the other company https://t.co/VB0qJY7KW6 Rhodes' first book, "Cross Rhodes: Goldust, Out of the Darkness," was released in 2010 while Rhodes was under contract with WWE , who also co-published the autobiography. At the time, Rhodes' career seemed to be coming towards an end, as he was primarily working as a producer. Instead, the next sixteen years would see Rhodes have a bit of a renaissance, winning the WWE Tag Team Championships twice with brother Cody Rhodes, the Ring of Honor World Tag Team Titles with Sammy Guevara , the ROH Six Man Tag Team Titles with Marshall and Ross Von Erich , and the AEW TNT Championship, which he won his home state of Texas at All In 2025 . Rhodes was last seen performing on AEW TV last summer, when he lost the TNT Championship to Kyle Fletcher in a Chicago Street Fight . He would undergo double knee surgery after the match, and has indicated his hope that he'll be able to return to the ring by the end of 2025 . Rhodes also drew controversy earlier this year for responding to a tweet that many considered Islamaphobic; he later deleted the post, and apologized to fans and wrestlers, including TNA's Mustafa Ali .
summary: Dustin Rhodes confirmed on X that he has already written one book and is currently writing a second one. The upcoming book will cover his full career in much greater detail including the highs and lows as well as his time back on top doing things his own way. Rhodes stated his hands were tied with the other company regarding the first book released in 2010.

title: Stacks Lorenzo Updates Fans After NXT Injury Scare

summary_src: "WWE NXT" star Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo took to Instagram to update fans following an injury scare he experienced at a recent live event.
body: WWE "WWE NXT" star, and member of BirthRight, Channing "Stacks" Lorenzo seemed to suffer an injury scare during a house show in Canada a little over a week ago, but he has now provided an update on his injury on social media. According to a fan on Reddit who was in attendance at the October 16 show, paramedics rushed down to the ring and took out Lorenzo on a stretcher, and his neck was put in a brace. Lorenzo showed off the brace from a hospital bed in one of his Instagram stories posted on Sunday. The star is seen flipping off the camera in the black-and-white photo. "Doc was concerned about my 'attitude,'" he captioned the photo, complete with middle finger emojis. "Told 'em it's a preexisting condition. The show goes on." His next story, also posted on Sunday, was a gym mirror selfie. Lorenzo isn't wearing a neck brace in the image, which he captioned, "Right back to the grind." According to fans on reddit, Lorenzo may have suffered the injury at the live event off a back body drop from the ring to the floor. Others indicated he could have hit his head off the ring barricade during another move. Lorenzo hasn't addressed just what happened on social media. Two days after the live event, BirthRight's Uriah Connors took to social media to indicate Lorenzo was "alive and well" and the faction "can't be stopped." Lorenzo didn't appear on the most recent edition of "NXT. His BirthRight stablemates, Lexis King and Charlie Dempsey, lost to AAA World Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic on the show.

title: Comeback Watch: WWE Scrapped Original Plans for Rusev’s Return
raw_title: WWE Scrapped Original Plans for Rusev’s Return
summary_src: WWE had something waiting for Rusev when he was ready to get back into the mix, but that plan didn’t survive his time on the sidelines. With Rusev still working his way back, the company has already moved ahead with someone else in the spot originally meant for him.
body: During a recent Q&A session, JoeyVotes and TC of WrestleVotes were talking about the tag match featuring Chad Gable and Dragon Lee against Big Cass and Ethan Page on RAW. JoeyVotes brought up the match while discussing what WWE has planned for the show. “The tag match — Chad Gable and Dragon Lee taking on Big Cass and Ethan Page.” That led TC to explain that WWE had actually been looking for someone to pair with Page, saying, “They wanted to find someone for Ethan Page — find a tag team partner for him.” Turns out, Big Cass wasn’t WWE’s first choice. JoeyVotes revealed that the spot was originally supposed to go to Rusev. His injury situation ended up getting in the way, though, and WWE had to change things while he worked his way back. “It was supposed to be Rusev. Rusev’s dealing with a little injury. He’s on his way back.” TC then had a little fun with the situation, joking that if Page and Cass lose their match, everyone will know why Rusev wanted nothing to do with it. “If Ethan Page and Big Cass lose, we know why Rusev didn’t wanna be in this match.” So while Rusev is getting closer to being back in the mix, the direction WWE originally had waiting for him is apparently gone. Page has now been paired with Cass, and the two are moving forward together on RAW. Rusev has at least gotten himself back inside a WWE ring. He wrestled Joe Hendry at the company’s October 16 live event in Honolulu , marking his first match in nearly three months. Hendry picked up the win, but Rusev simply being healthy enough to compete again was the bigger deal. His time away started after the July 27 episode of RAW, when he landed awkwardly on his neck during a match against Je’Von Evans. Rusev experienced numbness in his hands but still managed to finish the match before quickly making his way backstage. That exit caused some confusion at the time because people thought Rusev might have been pissed about losing to Evans. CJ Perry later shut that down , explaining that he was actually in considerable pain and wanted to get backstage so WWE’s medical team could check him out. Things finally started looking better in September. Perry revealed that Rusev had been medically cleared and was heading back to the WWE Performance Center to train. He also planned on getting work in at Natalya’s Dungeon 2.0 because he wanted to be completely ready whenever WWE called him. Now Page has Cass by his side, while Rusev is left waiting for whatever WWE comes up with next. He’s already wrestled his first match back, so the physical comeback has started — it’s the television comeback that still needs a new plan. Do you think WWE will have something big waiting for Rusev when he finally gets back on television? What would you like to see him do next? Let us know what you think in the comments. title: In Memoriam: Possible Consequences for WWE Stars Refusing Saudi Arabia Trip for Crown Jewel
raw_title: Possible Consequences for WWE Stars Refusing Saudi Arabia Trip for Crown Jewel
summary_src: WWE talent apparently can say no to going to Saudi Arabia for Crown Jewel, but that doesn’t mean everything will be fine when they come back to work.
body: During a recent Q&A session, WrestleVotes was asked whether there would be consequences for any WWE talent who decided they weren’t comfortable making the trip. The short answer is that nobody is physically forcing them onto the plane, but there could still be a price to pay. According to WrestleVotes, anyone who stays home wouldn’t get paid for the show. That’s not even the biggest issue, though. He said there could also be a stigma attached to refusing the trip, and a wrestler might come back to find that their position in WWE isn’t quite what it was before. “They could say they’re not going, and they won’t get paid, and the rest of their career will be reflective of that. Not the pay, but the stigma — the position that they might find themselves no longer in. They can say, ‘I’m staying home. I’m watching it on my couch. You can figure it out,’ but things may be different when they go back to work.” WrestleVotes previously said a longtime WWE source described things behind the scenes as “absolute disarray.” People working for the company don’t know whether Crown Jewel will happen in Saudi Arabia as planned, whether WWE could move the show, or whether everything could suddenly change at the last minute. Meanwhile, everything looks like business as usual publicly. Saudi Arabia’s General Entertainment Authority chairman Turki Alalshikh promoted Crown Jewel on October 26 and told fans to buy tickets, while pushing Roman Reigns vs. Sami Zayn for the WWE Crown Jewel Championship. WWE and TKO are at least watching what’s going on. Ari Emanuel previously confirmed that there’s a team monitoring the situation every day and figuring out where the show could potentially go if Saudi Arabia is no longer an option. As of right now, though, Crown Jewel is still set for November 7 at Riyadh Season Stadium. Nobody has announced a move or cancellation, which means talent are still waiting to see exactly what happens. The tricky part is that if this report is right, staying home is technically an option. It just might be an option that follows someone back to work afterwards. Do you think WWE needs to give talent a clear answer about the trip before Crown Jewel gets any closer? Let us know what you think in the comments. H Jenkins H Jenkins has been breaking pro wrestling news on Ringside News for nearly a decade, with his reports featured by TMZ, Forbes, The Sun, and more.

llm_long: King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh reopened on Sunday after being closed since the previous Saturday. Questions continue about whether WWE will proceed with Crown Jewel scheduled for November 7 in the city.

Saudi coalition officials reported the airport had been targeted 20 times during the month, resulting in 17 deaths and 333 injuries. Conflicting reports persist, with some outlets still listing the airport as closed.
Flight data showed 113 arrivals scheduled for Sunday, mostly domestic, and at least one international passenger flight landed. Many international airlines continue to suspend service to Riyadh.

Several major sporting events in Saudi Arabia have been canceled or postponed amid increased attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi rebel group. The Six Kings Slam tennis tournament was delayed from October to December, and the UCI Urban Cycling World Championships set for November were canceled.
The Canelo Alvarez versus Christian Mbilli boxing match planned for October 31 is still expected to take place. WWE has not announced any changes to Crown Jewel as of the latest reports.

title: Wrestling Open Rhode Island Faces Potential End
raw_title: Update On The Future Of Wrestling Open Rhode Island
summary_src: Wrestling Open RI could be coming to an end in December. Beyond Wrestling took to social media on Monday to provide some transparency to fans about the potential end of Wrestling Open Rhode Island brand, which first launched in March 2025.
body: Beyond Wrestling took to social media on Monday to provide some transparency to fans about the potential end of Wrestling Open Rhode Island brand, which first launched in March 2025. Unless attendance improves or sponsor revenue picks up, the brand will be hosting its final weekly event at the Rhodes On The Pawtuxet on Monday, December 28. Fans can check out the Drew Cordeiro’s full statement on the matter below. “Full transparency: Our contract with Rhodes On The Pawtuxet in Cranston runs until the end of 2026 and, as of this writing, unless we see a strong increase in attendance on Monday nights, 12/28/26 will be the final weekly Wrestling Open RI event. The month of November will be treated as an evaluation period. If you like what we do, please tell someone you know, bring your friends, and share our social media posts promoting the events. If you are interested in sponsoring our series, email [email protected] and I can provide you with detailed information. There is a chance that even if attendance doesn’t increase, we will still be able to negotiate a new rental agreement for 2027. Thank you to everyone that supports independent wrestling, and especially our events in Rhode Island. Tonight marks episode 73 of Wrestling Open RI. Rhodes On The Pawtuxet in Cranston is the nicest venue we’ve ever run with the most fan amenities I’ve ever come across. It would be a shame to let it slip away, especially while the state continues to throw millions of dollars to bring new sports to the area. We are the home team.” Interested in more of our independent wrestling coverage? Visit our results section by clicking here.
summary: Beyond Wrestling announced that its Wrestling Open Rhode Island brand, which launched in March 2025, could hold its final weekly event on December 28 unless attendance increases or sponsor revenue improves. The promotion's contract with Rhodes On The Pawtuxet runs through the end of 2026, and November will serve as an evaluation period. Drew Cordeiro urged fans to bring friends, share posts and consider sponsorship opportunities to help sustain the series.

summary_src: WWE revealed on social media that Stephanie Vaquer is potentially unavailable for her number one contender's match against Becky Lynch on "WWE Raw."
body: WWE After it was revealed over the weekend that Stephanie Vaquer was medically cleared to take on Becky Lynch in a number one contender's match to determine who will face Women's World Champion Liv Morgan next, a new post on WWE's X (formerly Twitter) account called Vaquer's status into question once again. The women were set to face off on Monday's edition of "WWE Raw." "Questions have arisen regarding Stephanie Vaquer's medical availability heading into #WWERaw," the post read. "Adam Pearce will address everything on tonight's show." Pearce, general manager of the red brand, revealed on his own X account over the weekend that Lynch and Vaquer would be going one-on-one on Monday night in the number one contender's match. On last week's episode of the show, Lynch challenged Vaquer, who was still wearing a cast backstage. Pearce brushed off the challenge in the segment , before his post confirming the bout on Saturday. Questions have arisen regarding Stephanie Vaquer's medical availability heading into #WWERaw , Adam Pearce will address everything on tonight's show. 📍: Fresno, CA 🎟️: https://t.co/XvOhUdqV8X 📺: 8 ET/5 PT on @netflix "La Primera" reportedly suffered a legitimate ankle injury during her Women's World Championship defense against Morgan and Lynch at Money in the Bank, where Morgan won back the gold. She competed in two matches during WWE's live tour in Hawaii in the days following the event, however. The star had been seemingly playing up the injury backstage, as initial reports indicated she wasn't set to miss a significant amount of time.
summary: WWE posted on X that questions have arisen regarding Stephanie Vaquer's medical availability for her scheduled number one contender's match against Becky Lynch on Monday's Raw. The bout was set to determine the next challenger for Women's World Champion Liv Morgan. General Manager Adam Pearce is expected to address the situation during the show in Fresno, California.

body: WWE Welcome to Wrestling Inc.'s live coverage for "WWE Raw" on October 26, 2026, coming to you live from the Save Mart Center in Fresno, California! Women's World Champion Liv Morgan will be finding out who her next challenger for her title will be, as Becky Lynch squares off against Stephanie Vaquer in a Number One Contenders Match. WWE has noted that "questions have arisen regarding Stephanie Vaquer's medical availability" on their X page and added that "Raw" General Manager Adam Pearce will share more on tonight's broadcast. IYO SKY will be in action as she goes head-to-head with Women's Intercontinental Champion and Judgment Day member Raquel Rodriguez in a non-title match. Tensions between the two women have been on the rise over the past few weeks, with SKY lending a helping hand to WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green ahead of her Women's Crown Jewel Championship match against the aforementioned Morgan at WWE Crown Jewel. Bayley will be colliding with longtime rival Lyra Valkyria in a No Disqualification Match. Bayley has been keeping a close eye on Valkyria and popping up when Valkyria least expects it as Valkyria has become increasingly paranoid, including during last Monday's episode of "Raw" when she snuck out from under the ring to cost Valkyria a match against Lola Vice. Additionally, Big Cass and Ethan Page will be joining forces with one another to take on Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable and Dragon Lee after the former two men attacked the latter two men and Rey Mysterio following a Triple Threat title match between Gable, Lee, and Rey last Monday.

title: Andrade Explains AEW Exit For Personal Reasons
raw_title: Andrade Comments On Moving Between AEW & WWE, Relationship With Tony Khan
summary_src: Former AEW National Champion Andrade looks back on his brief return to WWE.
body: AEW/Speedy Andrade El Idolo holds the distinct record for jumping back and forth between WWE and AEW the most. Originally being introduced to WWE in 2015 as 'Andrade "Cien" Almas,' Andrade eventually established himself on the main roster before leaving WWE in 2021 to jump to AEW, where he competed until 2023. By 2024, Andrade made a high-profile return to WWE at that year's Royal Rumble , before his momentum fizzled out and he shockingly returned to AEW again in 2025. Sitting down for an interview on " Close Up with Renee Paquette ," Andrade commented on his relationship with Tony Khan and the experience of jumping between the two promotions. "Personally, [it] was good, while professionally it was a little sad because 1) my [AEW] contract was expired at this moment, so I need to pick a decision, like I need to go for a personal life – because I was married at this moment – or my professional life, so I picked my personal life," he explained. Andrade maintained that his exit from AEW was done professionally and that he still had a good relationship with AEW following his exit, and that he's grateful for being able to return to the promotion and doesn't plan to take his second chance for granted. "Now is the moment to show who I am! I need to pay to Tony, you know, like I need to pay with my work in the ring?" he proclaimed. Andrade further notes that he wants to uplift AEW while also giving back to the locker room. "This is how I need to pay Tony for this second chance, second opportunity." Since his 2025 return, Andrade has won the AEW National Championship.
summary: Andrade discussed his multiple jumps between WWE and AEW during an interview on Close Up with Renee Paquette. He revealed that when his AEW contract expired he chose to prioritize his personal life, including his marriage at the time, over his professional career. Andrade added that the departure was handled professionally and that he maintains a positive relationship with Tony Khan and AEW.

title: Jeff Jarrett Marks Nine Years Of Sobriety
raw_title: Jeff Jarrett Commemorates Nine Years Of Sobriety
body: Jeff Jarrett celebrated the ninth anniversary of his sobriety on Sunday and commemorated the milestone in a post to social media. Jarrett posted to his Instagram account on Monday to share a photo of his nine-year sobriety coin, as you can see below. Jarrett has been open about his struggles with alcoholism and spoke about the matter on the three-part season seven opener of Dark Side of the Ring in July, which told his story and that of TNA. After he got sober, Jarrett made a return to WWE that ran from 2018 through 2021 and included a Hall of Fame induction. He joined AEW in 2022 after a brief return to WWE and has recently been appearing as a co-host for PPV pre-shows. On behalf of 411, congratulations to Jeff Jarrett on the anniversary.

The TNA co-founder has been candid about his battle with alcoholism, including in a July episode of Dark Side of the Ring. body: AEW/Speedy It's been another wild week in the world of professional wrestling, and as always, that means it's time for the Wrestling Inc. staff to name some winners and losers! We didn't have any major events go down in American wrestling this week, but that doesn't mean the last seven days weren't eventful, especially as both major companies have some big matches to build up. On "WWE Raw," Roman Reigns finally joined his family's fight against the 946 , giving us a sneak peak at a potential WarGames match. Meanwhile, over in AEW, Tony Khan has been building toward both AEW Full Gear and the Blood and Guts "Dynamite" special next week, with multiple matches and segments serving those purposes on Wednesday and Saturday night. Whose stock is trending upward this week, and whose is heading down toward the bottom? Here are your WINC winners and losers for the week of 10/26/2026! WWE There are plenty of examples of "WWE NXT" call-ups to the main roster who have floundered, due entirely to WWE's booking, or lack thereof. Some are called up to "WWE Raw" or "WWE SmackDown," then never used, with Jordynne Grace being a recent example of a disappearing act. Sometimes, even worse, however, a talent is brought up from the WWE Performance Center, then misused in spectacular fashion. There's no better recent example than Joe Hendry, as seen in whatever the heck his Funko Pop-based match with JD McDonagh was on Monday. Hendy was a delightful, viral character during his time in TNA. He was a successful comedy gimmick, at that, as he had a reign with the TNA World Championship before officially making the jump to WWE, where he held the NXT title before making his way to the red brand. Which is where his momentum and entire gimmick went to die. He faced off in a match with McDonagh on "Raw," and Hendry brought backup against Dominik Mysterio, in the form of a little person wearing a giant head fashioned to look like a Funko Pop figure of McDonagh. The joke is that McDonagh has a giant head that makes him look like one of the popular figures, a joke that has been going on via commentary for months, before being picked up, and the Funko part added, by Hendry. The Funko character has followed him around in recent weeks, and became the focal point of their match on Monday. The guy with the costume head took a beating at the hands of Dominik Mysterio, armed with a guitar, and a regular-sized boxed Funko figure from the commentary desk also made its way into the match. The crowd did not seem into this whatsoever, though it was also difficult to hear the crowd on the broadcast thanks to Joe Tessitore's overly-enthusiastic commentary. One would think Hendry, the comedy character, would win the comedy match to put this entire annoying story to rest, but McDonagh scored the victory, with a headbutt of all things, making Hendry look all the more the chump. A win here wasn't going to necessarily propel Hendry forward, but it could have gotten his gimmick back on track ever so

title: Power Slap Staff To Fly Into Bahrain Before Riyadh Event
raw_title: Ariel Helwani Says Power Slap Crew Will Fly To Bahrain And Bus To Riyadh One Night Before WWE Crown Jewel
summary_src: Potential travel plans for WWE Crown Jewel. body: Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport has been closed or running limited flights for much of October after attacks by the Houthis in Yemen on October 10. The US State Department has issued multiple security alerts ordering non-emergency U.S. government employees and their families to leave Saudi Arabia and advising citizens to take extreme caution if they are using the airport. WWE Crown Jewel is scheduled for November 7 in Riyadh and as of now remains on schedule to take place. One day before, Power Slap will be in Riyadh, and Ariel Helwani stated that he was told the Power Slap production staff will fly into Bahrain and take a bus five hours to Riyadh. This is the current plan unless the airport opens up further. Ariel Helwani says unless things change with the airport, he was told the production staff scheduled to work the next Power Slap will fly in to Bahrain and drive to Riyadh. #HelwaniShow pic.twitter.com/M0duUbTDOj It is unclear if that will be the same plan for World Wrestling Entertainment talent and staff ahead of Crown Jewel. TKO CEO Ari Emanuel has said they are monitoring the situation.
summary: Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport has faced closures and limited operations since Houthi attacks on October 10. Per Fightful Select, Ariel Helwani reported that Power Slap production crew will fly into Bahrain and bus five hours to Riyadh one day before their scheduled event, which falls the day prior to WWE Crown Jewel on November 7. It remains unclear if WWE talent and staff will follow the same travel plan.

The US State Department has issued security alerts directing non-emergency US government employees and families to leave Saudi Arabia while urging citizens to exercise extreme caution at the airport.
WWE Crown Jewel remains scheduled for November 7 in Riyadh. Power Slap is set to take place in the city one day prior to the event.
Power Slap production staff are planned to fly into Bahrain and then travel by bus for five hours to reach Riyadh. This arrangement will remain in place unless the airport sees further openings.
It remains unclear whether WWE talent and staff will follow a similar travel plan for Crown Jewel. TKO's CEO has indicated that the situation is being monitored.

summary_src: Former WWE star Kalisto reflected on the "surreal" loss of AEW star Pac, who he worked with in WWE when he was known as Neville.
body: AEW/Ricky Havlik Tributes for AEW star Pac, who also competed in WWE under the ring name Neville, continue to pour in following his death on September 27 . Those across the wrestling world continue to speak fondly of the star , real name Benjamin Satterley, including former WWE star Kalisto, who first worked with him in "WWE NXT." Kalisto spoke with TMZ Sports' "Inside the Ring," where he called the passing of Satterley "surreal." "Awesome to work with. I wish I could have worked him more," he said. "I remember my first match with him, because I always wanted to work with Ben. Just seeing his Dragongate videos. He's one of the wrestlers that inspired me to do the style that I also do. His style was unique. It was awesome. It's just flow, like art. First time I worked with him was, I believe it was the Arnold Classic. It was not televised. It was in front of the people, 8 a.m. Tired. But, man, we were killing it, and I just thought we were having such a great match. The second time I worked with him was on 'SmackDown' for the US title, which, man, we could've done more." Kalisto said while he wishes he could have done more with Satterley in the ring, he's grateful for the time they did have between the ropes, and the fact he got to share a locker room with him. He said everything that stars in both AEW and WWE are saying about Pac is all very true, and he looked up to the "Man that Gravity Forgot" a lot.
summary: Former WWE performer Kalisto paid tribute to PAC, who wrestled in WWE as Neville and passed away on September 27. Kalisto, who first teamed with him in NXT, described their matches as artistic and said he wished they had worked together more often. He recalled their untelevised bout at the Arnold Classic and a later SmackDown United States title match.

title: WWE Signs Former AAA Champion for Backstage Return
raw_title: WWE Signs Former AAA Champion for Backstage Return — Report
body: Skip to content Wrestling News Home » WWE Signs Former AAA Champion for Backstage Return — Report A former champion is reportedly returning to Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide in a backstage role. Ricky Marvin has a long history in professional wrestling, having competed for several promotions throughout his career. His reported agreement with AAA would see him bring decades of in-ring experience to the company’s training and production operations. Marvin previously worked for AAA during multiple stints and remains active on the independent wrestling scene. He is best known for his work in Mexico and Japan, including an extended run with Pro Wrestling NOAH. The Mexican wrestler began his professional career in 1995 and has also competed for CMLL and Ring of Honor. His time in Japan included more than a decade with Pro Wrestling NOAH, where he established himself as a regular competitor. According to False Finish , Ricky Marvin has signed with AAA to take on new responsibilities. Fightful also reported the news on October 26, 2026. “Sources tell False Finish that Ricky Marvin has signed with Lucha Libre AAA as a trainer and occasional producer,” the report noted. Marvin is a former AAA World Trios Champion. He won the championship alongside Averno and Chessman as part of the Los OGTs faction. Marvin also participated in a WWE tryout in Chile in December 2018, although he was not signed by the company at that time. Since 2021, he has been covering WWE, AEW, TNA, and major premium live events and pay-per-views. He specializes in reporting on breaking wrestling news, live event results, and developing storylines. Manik holds a degree in English Literature, which complements his strong background in research and precise reporting.

title: On the Record: New Police Details Surface About Ex-WWE, AEW Star — PAC Cause of Death
raw_title: PAC Cause of Death: New Police Details Surface About Ex-WWE, AEW Star
body: Per California Post's Edward Lewis, who obtained the Des Plaines Police Department incident report, officers made two specific observations — saliva and medication — when they found PAC deceased in a rental car around 4 p.m. on Sept. 27. While the type of medication was redacted, the report confirmed that PAC was headed to Chicago O'Hare International Airport shortly after his meal at CAVA. "I noticed that Google Maps was still open on his cellphone and it was routing him to O'Hare Airport," an officer wrote in the police report "The official added that Satterley's phone had been buzzing, and when it was answered, a woman on the other line said they knew Satterley," wrote Lewis. The report provided additional details on the conversation between the undisclosed woman and the police officer who found Pac dead. "She said "she last spoke to Benjamin on the phone around 1320 hours and he related he was going to CAVA for lunch," according to the police report. "He had been traveling for his occupation as a professional wrestler for the past three weeks around the United States and had been in the Chicago-area since Thursday (09/24/2026) or Friday (09/25/2026). She related his flight had been delayed and Benjamin was scheduled on his flight back to the UK at approximately 1530 hours." PAC had wrestled at Chicago's NOW Arena less than 24 hours before his death at AEW's All Out pay-per-view. He was likely not expected to attend the "AEW Dynamite" taping later in the week in Pittsburgh as he was slated to fly to the UK on Sunday. The police report added that a search of Satterley's pockets and backpack did not result in "any notable findings" and that there were not any "any obviously suspicious marks upon Satterley nor circumstances within the vehicle." A cause of death is pending "additional testing" after the Cook County Medical Examiner concluded an initial autopsy last week. Current and former wrestlers, including luminaries like Dwayne "The Rock" Johnson and John Cena, have shared heartfelt tributes to PAC since his abrupt death. "As global as professional wrestling is, we're still a very tight-knit unit and a tight-knit group because we all share the same DNA," Johnson said of PAC's death. "And that is our love and our passion for the squared circle and to perform for audiences around the world. And we're a little crazy, and that's okay. But when we lose one of our own, it hurts. "And when they're young and so insanely talented, it really, it really f**king hurts." While AEW dedicated an entire episode of "Dynamite" to the life and legacy of PAC, WWE posted a graphic before "RAW" and shared an obituary via social media. Other promotions such as TNA also paid tribute to PAC through their television shows. The post PAC Cause of Death: New Police Details Surface About Ex-WWE, AEW Star appeared first on HEAVY .
summary: Per California Post's Edward Lewis, who obtained the Des Plaines Police Department incident report. The report provided additional details on the conversation between the undisclosed woman and the police officer who found Pac dead.

title: Saudi Arabia’s GEA Chairman Promotes WWE Crown Jewel Amid Security Concerns
raw_title: Saudi Arabia’s GEA Chairman Promotes WWE Crown Jewel Amid Security Concerns
body: 0 Saudi Arabia’s General Entertainment Authority (GEA) Chairman Turki Alalshikh is continuing to promote WWE Crown Jewel ahead of the November 7 event in Riyadh, even as security concerns raise questions about the show’s location. The post comes as WWE continues to advertise Crown Jewel for Saudi Arabia despite reports of concerns among company employees and talent about traveling to the region. WWE has not announced a change to the event’s scheduled location. WWE reportedly has a backup venue available if the security situation forces a relocation. TKO CEO Ari Emanuel previously confirmed that the company is monitoring developments daily and could move the event if necessary. Alalshikh took to X to promote the upcoming Premium Live Event, highlighting the men’s Crown Jewel Championship match between Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn. He also encouraged fans to purchase tickets for the show at Riyadh Season Stadium in the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD). “Roman Reigns takes on Sami Zayn for the WWE Crown Jewel Championship at RiyadhSeason,” Alalshikh wrote, adding the event date and venue before urging fans to book their tickets. According to a recent report , WWE remains in contact with its Saudi hosts as the company monitors the regional security situation. Fightful Select reported that several staff members and talent were unhappy about the prospect of traveling to Saudi Arabia under the current circumstances. The report also noted that WWE is still planning to hold Crown Jewel in Riyadh. However, questions about the event have persisted following reports of attacks near King Khalid International Airport and travel warnings issued by U.S. authorities. The post Saudi Arabia’s GEA Chairman Promotes WWE Crown Jewel Amid Security Concerns appeared first on Wrestlezone .
