title: WWF Red Letter IC Belt Sells For Record $716,350
raw_title: WWF Red Letter IC Championship belt used for Savage vs. Steamboat from WrestleMania III sells for record amount
body: The red letter WWE IC Championship belt that was most famously used for the Macho Man Randy Savage vs. Ricky The Dragon Steamboat match from WrestleMania III sold for a record $716, 350 on auction at Heritage Auctions last weekend. The final price of the auction of the belt, owned by podcaster Conrad Thompson, included a 22% buyer’s premium tacked on the final bid of $587,500. The final price set a record price for a wrestling belt surpassing the previ0us record of $414,800 for Hulk Hogan’s WrestleMania II belt that he wore while wrestling King Kong Bundy in a Steel Cage match. Tony Giese of Heritage Auctions told PWTorch columnsit Sean Radican in an interview last week on Radican Worldwide ahead of the final days of the auction that he felt the red letter WWF IC Championship had a good chance to set a record high for a title belt. “A lot of these belts, you know, they (WWF) would use them for a year, maybe a little longer,” said Giese. “This one, from 1985 through 1988. Because of how long it was used, I think that’s one of the factors that we’re all gonna really point to as to-why this thing could break the record. I think it’s got a very good chance. The style of it, again, you know, we talked about the Hogan belt. We talked about how, you know, it’s just, it’s nostalgia. We remember that belt. We remember seeing it. “This one, I think what sets it apart from the Hogan belts, no offense to the Hogan belt at all, the longevity, and that it was, you know, won by Tito Santana, debuted by Tito Santana in 1985. Then he lost to The Macho Man, then Steamboat had it for a couple months, then The Honky Tonk Man had it. The guys who wore this belt, who owned this belt, it’s not like they had two different belts they used.”
summary: The red letter Intercontinental Championship belt used during the Randy Savage versus Ricky Steamboat match at WrestleMania III sold for a record $716,350 at Heritage Auctions last weekend. The final price, which included a 22% buyer’s premium on a $587,500 bid, was owned by podcaster Conrad Thompson and surpassed the prior record of $414,800 set by Hulk Hogan’s WrestleMania II belt. Tony Giese of Heritage Auctions noted the belt’s extended use from 1985 through 1988 as a key factor in its value.

title: On the Record: Tony Khan on The Hurt Syndicate's status with AEW: "We could see them anyplace, anytime"
raw_title: Tony Khan on The Hurt Syndicate's status with AEW: "We could see them anyplace, anytime"
body: During a media call for the 2026 AEW WrestleDream PPV event, AEW President Tony Khan was asked about The Hurt Syndicate’s status with the company. Here is what Khan had to say… “In the ring, the Hurt Syndicate have said they are for hire, so we could see them anyplace, anytime. I think for the right amount of money. Certainly, one thing they did not want to do was beat up Big Justice and the Rizzler, so they were happy to work with Big Boom AJ, Big Justice, and the Rizzler and turn things around. They had kind of a precarious relationship, as we saw when they brawled at Brawl in the Ballpark. In some of the matches where STP were bested by the Hurt Syndicate at Brawl in the Ballpark, STP then tried to hire the services of the Hurt Syndicate. But, you know, the Hurt Syndicate won’t work with just anybody, but they are for hire under the right circumstances, kind of like The A-Team. I think it’ll be interesting to see how they get involved. I have a lot of respect for Bobby, Shelton, and MVP, and they could come in as hired guns for potentially anybody here.”

title: Backstage Buzz: WWE RAW Plans in Potential Jeopardy After Stephanie Vaquer Update
raw_title: WWE RAW Plans in Potential Jeopardy After Stephanie Vaquer Update
body: 0 WWE’s plans for a major match on the October 26 episode of RAW could be in trouble after the company raised concerns about Stephanie Vaquer ’s medical update. The former Women’s World Champion was scheduled to face Becky Lynch in a number one contender’s match. However, WWE has removed the bout from its official show preview. WWE addressed the situation in a social media post , revealing that Vaquer’s status for the show was uncertain. The company also confirmed that General Manager Adam Pearce would provide an update during the broadcast. “Questions have arisen regarding Stephanie Vaquer’s medical availability heading into #WWERaw, Adam Pearce will address everything on tonight’s show,” WWE wrote. The announcement has raised questions about whether the main event will go ahead as planned. With the match no longer listed on WWE’s official website, the company may have to change its plans for the show. Vaquer’s injury has been a concern for the past few weeks. However, she was expected to return to the ring soon. Despite the injury concerns, the former Women’s Champion competed in two house show matches on October 16 and 17. Positive news surfaced over the weekend when Vaquer said she was fit and ready to face Lynch. Vaquer and Lynch have been building their rivalry since facing Morgan in a triple threat match at Money in the Bank. Morgan won the match and captured the Women’s World Championship by defeating Stephanie Vaquer. Both challengers were frustrated with the result. Moreover, Vaquer and Becky Lynch blamed each other for allowing Morgan to clinch the win. Their planned number one contender’s match was supposed to determine who would challenge Women’s World Champion Liv Morgan next. The episode is scheduled to take place at the Save Mart Center in Fresno, California. The post WWE RAW Plans in Potential Jeopardy After Stephanie Vaquer Update appeared first on Wrestlezone .

title: Comeback Watch: AEW’s Buddy Matthews Pulled From Planned In-Ring Return Due To Scheduling Conflict
raw_title: AEW’s Buddy Matthews Pulled From Planned In-Ring Return Due To Scheduling Conflict
body: 0 Buddy Matthews will no longer compete on World Series Wrestling’s upcoming MegaMania tour, delaying his planned in-ring return after more than a year away from competition. Matthews’ withdrawal comes as fans await his return to the ring following an extended absence from All Elite Wrestling. The former AEW World Trios Champion has not wrestled since February 2025, when he suffered a serious ankle injury at AEW Grand Slam Australia during his match against Kazuchika Okada. Matthews injured his ankle during his entrance before the match but continued to compete. The injury involved ligament damage and required surgery, keeping him out of action for an extended period. He later discussed the difficult recovery process, including having to relearn how to walk. In May 2026, Matthews made a surprise appearance at a WSW event in Adelaide, attacking Donovan Dijak and setting up his planned return for the MegaMania tour. He subsequently indicated that he expected to be cleared to wrestle in October. By August, Matthews had confirmed that he was medically cleared to return . WSW announced on October 25 that Matthews had been pulled from the tour due to scheduling conflicts. The Australian wrestler had been advertised for the five-show run across Australia and New Zealand, which is scheduled to take place from October 29 through November 2. “We have just learnt, that due to scheduling conflicts, Buddy Matthews will no longer be appearing on the WSW MEGAMANIA Tour,” the promotion stated on Instagram . WSW expressed disappointment over the change but said it understood that schedules could change. The promotion also expressed hope that Matthews would return for a future tour. Matthews remains signed to AEW but has yet to make his televised comeback. The promotion has several upcoming events, including Fright Night Dynamite, Blood & Guts, and Full Gear. However, there is no confirmed indication that Matthews’ withdrawal is connected to AEW’s schedule or plans for his return. raw_title: Stephanie Vaquer Not Cleared, Becky Lynch To Challenge For Women's Title On WWE Raw
summary_src: It was revealed on "WWE Raw" that Stephanie Vaquer is not cleared to compete, so Becky Lynch will challenge for the Women's World Championship Monday night.
body: WWE "WWE Raw" General Manager Adam Pearce revealed in the opening of Monday's show that Stephanie Vaquer is not medically cleared to compete in her previously announced match against Becky Lynch. "La Primera" was set to go one-on-one with "The Man" to determine the number one contender for Liv Morgan's Women's World Championship. Pearce announced that Lynch will instead challenge Morgan for her title in the main event of the show. At Money in the Bank, Morgan defeated Vaquer in a triple threat match involving Lynch to win the championship back. Vaquer's status had come into question in recent weeks, as she was reportedly injured in the Money in the Bank bout. She wrestled days later at WWE live events in Hawaii, however. After a backstage segment last Monday, where Pearce told Lynch they'd have to circle back on the number one contender's bout, he revealed on social media on Saturday that Vaquer was cleared, and announced the match for Monday. In the hours ahead of "Raw," WWE revealed on X (formerly Twitter) that Vaquer's status was up in the air once again , and Pearce would be addressing it on the show.
summary: WWE Raw General Manager Adam Pearce announced that Stephanie Vaquer is not medically cleared to face Becky Lynch in their scheduled number one contender's match. As a result, Lynch will instead challenge Liv Morgan for the Women's World Championship in the main event. Morgan had defeated both Vaquer and Lynch in a triple threat match at Money in the Bank to regain the title, after which Vaquer's injury status had been in question despite her wrestling at subsequent live events.

title: On the Record: AEW’s Eddie Kingston Says He Wanted To Quit Wrestling After Deaths of PAC & Andy Williams
raw_title: AEW’s Eddie Kingston Says He Wanted To Quit Wrestling After Deaths of PAC & Andy Williams
body: 0 AEW star Eddie Kingston has revealed that he considered leaving professional wrestling after the deaths of his friends and fellow wrestlers, PAC and Andy “The Butcher” Williams. Williams, known to wrestling fans as The Butcher, died on September 5, 2026, at the age of 48. He was a member of the AEW tag team Butcher and Blade and also gained recognition as a guitarist for the hardcore band Every Time I Die. PAC, whose real name was Benjamin Satterley, died on September 27, 2026, at age 40, one day after competing against Andrade El Idolo at AEW All Out. He was found unresponsive inside a vehicle in Des Plaines, Illinois, while reportedly preparing to travel to the airport. The Cook County Medical Examiner’s Office later determined that he died from bronchial asthma , with his death ruled natural. Kingston opened up about the emotional toll of their deaths following his match against Luke Jacobs at PROGRESS Wrestling’s Chapter 199: Bonestorm event in London on October 25. After the match, Kingston addressed the crowd and thanked fans for helping him through a difficult period. The former AEW Continental Champion admitted that the losses had left him struggling to cope, revealing that he stayed home for five days after learning that both men had died. “You lose real people. Life is a f**ked up place, but I wake up every morning and do this because of the fans,” Kingston said. He continued explaining how much the support he received from fans had affected him during his grief. “After Andy and Ben passed away, I didn’t leave my house for five days. I wanted to leave this business,” Kingston told the crowd. Kingston also thanked fans who had reached out to share their own struggles with mental health and personal hardships. He said their messages helped him when he questioned whether he wanted to continue wrestling. “Every fan who hit me up to tell me your story about mental health and your f**ked up life, and you tell me I helped you, bullsh*t, you helped me,” he added. AEW honored Williams with a special Collision episode on September 12. The show featured a 10-bell salute, tributes from friends and colleagues, and the Butcher Battle Royale, which Daniel Garcia won. The company also dedicated its September 30 Dynamite edition to PAC, with wrestlers and colleagues celebrating his life and career. Saudi coalition officials reported the airport had been targeted 20 times during the month, resulting in 17 deaths and 333 injuries. Conflicting reports persist, with some outlets still listing the airport as closed.
Flight data showed 113 arrivals scheduled for Sunday, mostly domestic, and at least one international passenger flight landed. Many international airlines continue to suspend service to Riyadh.

Several major sporting events in Saudi Arabia have been canceled or postponed amid increased attacks by the Iran-backed Houthi rebel group. The Six Kings Slam tennis tournament was delayed from October to December, and the UCI Urban Cycling World Championships set for November were canceled.
The Canelo Alvarez versus Christian Mbilli boxing match planned for October 31 is still expected to take place. WWE has not announced any changes to Crown Jewel as of the latest reports.

title: WWE Star Drew McIntyre Pays Tribute to Former AEW Wrestler Benjamin Satterley : 선물·상품 : JKN
raw_title: WWE Star Drew McIntyre Pays Tribute to Former AEW Wrestler Benjamin Satterley : 선물·상품 : JKN
body: WWE performer Drew McIntyre offered an emotional tribute to former colleague Benjamin Satterley, who wrestled under the ring names PAC and Neville, following Satterley's recent death at age 40. Speaking in an interview with OutKick Dropkick, McIntyre reflected on a series of recent losses within the professional wrestling community, urging observers to "remember to tell the ones you love, you love them." Satterley, who competed in both WWE and All Elite Wrestling (AEW), died on September 27, 2026. The Cook County Medical Examiner's Office confirmed that Satterley died of bronchial asthma and ruled the manner of death natural. McIntyre recounted first crossing paths with Satterley as teenagers at the 3CW wrestling promotion in Carlisle, England. Noting that Satterley was "fresh out the backyard" at the time, McIntyre described his late peer as "the best of us." The Scottish-born wrestler detailed their early professional journeys, remembering trips they took together across Ireland and to London while reassuring one another that they would achieve international breakthroughs from the United Kingdom. During the interview, McIntyre also honored Rick Achberger, a recognized WWE superfan known as "Rick the Sign Guy." McIntyre noted that Achberger supported him when he first moved to the United States at age 22. McIntyre also acknowledged the passing of Dennis Haskins, the "Saved by the Bell" actor who had previously been involved in WWE programming. Outside the ring, McIntyre is currently featured in the micro-drama series "Agent of Shadows."

title: Ricky Marvin Joins AAA as Producer and Trainer
raw_title: Mexican wrestling legend signs as trainer with AAA/WWE
summary_src: There’s a new mentor working behind the scenes at AAA Lucha Libre, bringing worldwide experience to WWE’s Mexican promotion According to a report at False Finish, international star Ricky Marvin has signed with AAA/WWE as a producer/trainer.
body: There’s a new mentor working behind the scenes at AAA Lucha Libre, bringing worldwide experience to WWE’s Mexican promotion According to a report at False Finish , international star Ricky Marvin has signed with AAA/WWE as a producer/trainer. Marvin, 46, was born in Veracruz, Mexico, broke in with CMLL in the late 1990s, winning the CMLL Japan Super Lightweight Championship twice and the Mexican National Lightweight Championship once. He later worked for AAA, having held the AAA World Trios Championship along with Averno and Chessman. However, he is probably best known for his time in Japan. He spent over a decade in Pro Wrestling Noah, where he and his tag team partner Kotaro Suzuki had rivalries with such teams as the Briscoe Brothers and Bobby Fish & Eddie Edwards. He would win the GHC Junior Heavyweight Championship once and the GHC Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Championship three times—once each with Suzuki, Taiji Ishimori, and Super Crazy. In the United States, his biggest exposure came under a mask as Bengala in Lucha Underground. Marvin has an 11-1 record in Luchas de Apuestas matches. Each of the 11 wins came in Mexico, while his only loss, which cost him his hair, came against Tiger Emperor in Tokyo, Japan, in 2005.

The 46-year-old Mexican veteran began his career in CMLL during the late 1990s, later competed for AAA where he held the World Trios Championship with Averno and Chessman, and gained significant experience over a decade in Pro Wrestling Noah. He also appeared unmasked as Bengala in Lucha Underground and holds an 11-1 record in Luchas de Apuestas.

Marvin previously worked for AAA, where he held the AAA World Trios Championship with Averno and Chessman. He is best known for his lengthy run in Pro Wrestling Noah in Japan, where he formed a notable tag team with Kotaro Suzuki.

In Noah, Marvin and Suzuki feuded with teams including the Briscoe Brothers and Bobby Fish and Eddie Edwards. He won the GHC Junior Heavyweight Championship once and the GHC Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Championship three times, partnering with Suzuki, Taiji Ishimori, and Super Crazy.

Marvin gained exposure in the United States as the masked wrestler Bengala in Lucha Underground. He holds an 11-1 record in Luchas de Apuestas matches, with all wins occurring in Mexico and his sole loss taking place in Tokyo, Japan, in 2005.

title: Sami Zayn Retains WWE Title Against Je'Von Evans On Raw
raw_title: Sami Zayn Defeats Je'Von Evans In Impromptu Undisputed WWE Title Match On Raw
summary_src: Sami Zayn beat Je'Von Evans to retain the WWE Championship during "WWE Raw."
body: WWE Sami Zayn defeated Je'Von Evans to retain the WWE Championship during " WWE Raw ." Zayn came down to the ring for a promo addressing the lack of respect for him as WWE Champion, name-checking the likes of Trick Williams, who will be challenging for his title on Friday's "WWE SmackDown," as well as CM Punk and Je'Von Evans. That prompted Evans to come down to the ring for an exchange of words with Zayn, ending with the champion trying to take his leave until he was informed by Adam Pearce that he was going to defend the title against Evans immediately. Evans started the match off at the advantage, looking to prove a point against the veteran. He dropped Zayn with the Red Dot dropkick, going for the cover for a close two-count. He came almost as close with a roll-up attempt and a subsequent frog splash. But as he sought to finish the match, Zayn rolled out of the ring and looked to be leaving. Penta's music played and Mr. Money in the Bank came out with a referee, backing Zayn into the ring. Evans dropped Zayn as he returned, going for the closest cover of the match. But then Bron Breakker ran down the ramp to take out Penta. Evans took flight to wipe out Breakker, springboarding back into the ring after Zayn but missing. Zayn sent Evans into the corner with an Exploder, following up with the Helluva Kick for the winning pinfall and title retention.
summary: Sami Zayn retained the WWE Championship against Je'Von Evans in an impromptu match on Raw after Evans interrupted his promo. Evans controlled much of the bout with several near-falls including a Red Dot dropkick, roll-up and frog splash. The match ended when Penta and Bron interfered, allowing Zayn to capitalize and win.

llm_long: Sami Zayn retained the WWE Championship by defeating Je'Von Evans on Raw. Zayn had come to the ring to deliver a promo complaining about the lack of respect shown to him as champion.

During the promo Zayn mentioned several names including Trick Williams, who is scheduled to challenge for the title on SmackDown, as well as CM Punk and Je'Von Evans. This brought Evans to the ring for a verbal confrontation that ended with Zayn attempting to leave.
Adam Pearce then informed Zayn that he would defend the championship against Evans right away. Evans gained the early advantage and hit a Red Dot dropkick for a near fall.
Evans followed with a roll-up and a frog splash that also came close to securing the win. Zayn rolled out of the ring and appeared ready to walk away from the match.
Penta then appeared with a referee and forced Zayn back into the ring. Evans nearly pinned Zayn after this sequence but the match was disrupted when Bron Breakker attacked Penta.

Evans dove onto Breakker from the ring but missed a springboard move back inside. Zayn capitalized with an Exploder into the corner followed by a Helluva Kick to score the pinfall and retain the title.

title: The Rock's AEW Comments Still Discussed Backstage in WWE
raw_title: The Rock’s AEW Mention Draws an Internal Reaction Within WWE — Report
body: Skip to content Wrestling News Home » The Rock’s AEW Mention Draws an Internal Reaction Within WWE — Report The Rock ’s public praise of AEW and Tony Khan following PAC’s death reportedly continues to generate discussion within WWE. According to Dave Meltzer, the WWE star and TKO board member’s comments remain a talking point backstage weeks after he paid tribute to the late wrestler. The situation stems from a video The Rock shared earlier this month, in which he remembered PAC and referred to Khan as a friend. He also praised AEW, saying the promotion “is growing into this phenomenal wrestling company.” Meltzer wrote that “evidently with some, that sting still hasn’t gone away.” However, he also noted that people understood why The Rock wanted to address PAC’s passing. According to Meltzer, there may be different interpretations of the situation, but The Rock could simply have wanted to express support for the people who worked with PAC in AEW. Rather than staying silent because of the perceived rivalry between the promotions, he chose to acknowledge the loss. The Rock also addressed the discussion himself in early October, responding to an Instagram post about his tribute. He explained that his decision came from concern for fellow wrestlers rather than loyalty to one promotion over another. “I was born into this business and I’ve seen it all, but when one of our own passes away, I don’t care nor do I see ‘our competition,’” he wrote. “I care about the wrestlers and how it affects them. I’ve been there. To me, humanity matters most.” The report does not indicate that WWE has taken any action against The Rock over his comments. Earlier reports said officials were surprised by his praise for Khan and AEW, rather than upset about the tribute itself. Separately, The Rock did not appear at WWE’s Hawaii tryouts and live events on October 16 and 17, despite initially being advertised. WWE had removed him from promotional materials before those events. For now, the comments remain a topic of backstage conversation. Meanwhile, The Rock has made his reasoning clear: wrestling’s competitive lines mattered less to him than remembering PAC. title: When could the former WWE star arrive if she signs with the company? — Kairi Sane AEW debut date

body: Earlier this year, Kairi Sane was released from WWE during their latest round of mass talent cuts. This immediately led to fans speculating if the former Kabuki Warriors member could sign with All Elite Wrestling when she became a free agent. However, Sane has not joined the company at the time of this writing. With weekly updates on ongoing talks with AEW, it feels like Kairi may show up in the promotion at some point down the line. In September, Chris Jericho announced that the November 7 edition of AEW Collision will take place from his Rock N’ Wrestling Rager at Sea cruise when it docks in Miami, Florida. Then, it was later announced that Kairi Sane will be part of the lineup for this year’s Jeri-Cruise. This has led to speculation that Sane could potentially arrive in All Elite Wrestling on this particular show. Being the first opportunity to have her debut, it feels logical for AEW to bring Kairi in for this special episode of Collision. Following this Wednesday’s Fright Night Dynamite, the next special episode of the show will take place on Wednesday, November 4. All Elite Wrestling will head to Jacksonville, Florida for this year’s AEW Blood and Guts event. While all eyes will be on the two-ring steel cage matches, AEW could make this a very memorable night with a major debut. Kairi Sane debuting at Blood and Guts should make this a night that no AEW fan ever forgets. At AEW WrestleDream 2026, Ilja Dragunov finally made his long awaited debut to the company. After the last pay-per-view featured a notable arrival, the next major show could also do the same. Kairi Sane feels like a significant name that deserves to debut on a huge event like Full Gear 2026. Whether it be an introduction as a new signing or confronting a top star in the company, Kairi could turn a ton of heads by showing up at AEW Full Gear 2026 on November 14. AEW could also wait a little longer to bring Kairi Sane to give the company a massive arrival at the very end of 2026. AEW Worlds End 2026 will feature the semifinals and finals of the Continental Classic tournament, but the company has the chance to give the fans even more on this night. With all eyes on Minneapolis, Kairi Sane could garner the spotlight by debuting on the final pay-per-view of the year. Giving the AEW women’s division a boost heading into 2027, Kairi could be introduced as someone bringing something new to the scene to give it a fresh direction for the new year. title: AEW’s Newest Surprising Faction — The Cut Above the Rest
raw_title: The Cut Above the Rest: AEW’s Newest Surprising Faction
body: October 25, 2026 By Corey Michaels AEW , International , NJPW , North America , Pro Wrestling On October 21, 2026, something unexpected happened on AEW Dynamite . The Dogs assaulted The Death Riders. Not only that, but The Bang Bang Gang betrayed their friends in The Conglomeration! Despite Jay White of The Dogs and Orange Cassidy of The Conglomeration defeating Death Riders’ Wheeler Yuta and Daniel Garcia earlier in the night, their collaboration proved shallow and meaningless. In their wake, The Cut was born. After Roderick Strong lost to AEW Continental Champion Jon Moxley in an Eliminator Match, the shenanigans began. David Finlay and Clark Connors battered Strong like hard-boiled eggs. Multiple times, in fact. Moxley tried to break it up, and they clocked him too. Longtime member of The Dogs, Gabe Kidd, confronted them, and guess what? They laid him flat as well. The Bang Bang Gang, The Conglomeration, and the Death Riders rushed to their aid, but one-third of the cavalry were about as trustworthy as gas station sushi. That’s right—traitors lay in their midst—Jay White snapped Orange Cassidy in a Blade Runner as his colleagues ran roughshod over the mountain of fallen babyfaces before them. I’m still in awe of the segment. The audacity to change some beloved babyfaces into heels. Using The Dogs more meaningfully. Claudio Castagnoli moving like Al Pacino’s Tony Montana in the 1983 film “Scarface” as he made a last stand (he was NOT going down easy). In the middle of the show, AEW executed an angle with potential long-lasting repercussions that will affect the wider roster. If the Don Callis Family was bad enough, wrestlers now have to worry about the lingering cloud of wrestlers who are tired being forgotten or losing too much. All parties involved should benefit from this turn. Amalgamating these two groups may be the refresh AEW needs. The math does itself, then. These teams weren’t used much on programs aside from being fodder or being aligned with bigger players to take a pinfall. Enduring placement in matches and on cards is a disservice to the caliber of talent in this new merger. Jay White was one of the last major Bullet Club leaders in New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW), with intense and unforgettable rivalries with Tetsuya Naito, Kazuchika Okada, Hiroshi Tanahashi, and Kota Ibushi. David Finlay found his footing and proved a reliable leader and ruthless killer, despite having a dry spell early in his leadership. Clark Connors joined other former Young Lions turned War Dogs, mixing American football agility and Japanese Strong Style; he’s an all-rounder. TNA Wrestling fans yearned to see Ace Austin reach greatness back when it was IMPACT Wrestling. Now, he’s wowing audiences with agility and strikes, often lifting wrestlers bigger than him. Juice Robinson outright made Jon Moxley feel at home after he left his Dean Ambrose persona behind in WWE. The Gunn Club also exists. Additionally, The Cut is an opportunity to spotlight other talent.

Copy link Get more Wrestling News in Google Choose us as a and our stories show up more in your Google results. Major League Wrestling’s Chicago weekend is sold out. title: Kaitlyn Has No Desire To Return To The Ring
raw_title: Former WWE Star Kaitlyn Explains Why She Doesn't Think She'll Get Back In The Ring
summary_src: Former WWE Divas Champion Kaitlyn explains why she doesn't intend to return to a professional wrestling ring.
body: Retirement is a rather loose concept in the pro wrestling world as thousands of in-ring performers have failed to resist the itch to return to action at some point in their careers. Kaitlyn, meanwhile, has remained firm in staying away from the ring for several years now. During an interview with "Insight With Chris Van Vliet," the former WWE Divas Champion revealed her intention to keep it that way, largely due to her lack of desire to return. "I hope no one hates me for this, but I don't really want to get back in the ring," Kaitlyn said. "I respect wrestling a lot, and I find it very entertaining. I love the artistry of it. I don't think I could ever have the appreciation that I have now if I had never been a professional wrestler. Because there are so many aspects to the performance. There's so many things to think about. The psychology of the match, connecting with people, telling a story with your face and your body, protecting your face and your body, protecting the person that you're in the ring with, helping them perform to their best. Knowing where the cameras are, knowing how much time you have, being able to change it up if the people in the audience aren't buying it, if they don't care about it, so there's so much to it." Kaitlyn, real name Celeste Bonin, last competed at a special Annual Toy Drive held by Gangrel's Wrestling Asylum in December 2019. Three years later, WWE invited her to potentially compete in the 2022 Women's Royal Rumble . Her in-ring appearance ultimately did not pan out, however, as several other WWE legends, including The Bella Twins and then-Knockouts Champion Mickie James, entered the match instead. Kaitlyn's first run in WWE spanned from 2010 until her departure in early 2014. She later made a brief comeback in the 2018 Mae Young Classic.
summary: Former WWE Divas Champion Kaitlyn told Insight With Chris Van Vliet that she plans to stay retired from in-ring competition. She expressed respect for wrestling and appreciation for its artistry but stated she does not want to get back in the ring. Kaitlyn noted that her experience as a wrestler gave her a deeper understanding of match psychology, storytelling, performer safety and other performance aspects.

She emphasized her deep respect for professional wrestling and its artistry. Kaitlyn noted that her experience as a wrestler has given her greater appreciation for elements such as match psychology, storytelling through facial expressions and body language, and protecting both herself and her opponents.

Additional aspects she highlighted include connecting with the audience, adapting to crowd reactions, managing match timing, and positioning for cameras. These factors contribute to her current perspective on the sport.

Kaitlyn last wrestled in December 2019 at a toy drive event. WWE approached her about participating in the 2022 Women's Royal Rumble match, but she did not appear as other legends took the spots instead.

After his football career ended, he signed with WWE in January of 2020 and came up through their developmental system.

body: October 26, 2026 · 4:40 PM 847 views Veteran wrestler Ricky Marvin has reportedly signed with Lucha Libre AAA to work as a trainer and occasional producer. False Finish reported the agreement , adding that Marvin is returning to a promotion where he already has substantial history as both a wrestler and champion. AAA has not publicly announced the signing at the time of writing, so the move should remain described as a report rather than confirmed company news. The role would give Marvin a regular backstage position while still drawing on more than three decades of in-ring experience. “Sources tell False Finish that Ricky Marvin has signed with Lucha Libre AAA as a trainer and occasional producer. Marvin is a former AAA World Trios Champion alongside Averno and Chessman as part of Los OGTs.” - False Finish Marvin has worked several stretches with AAA and became part of Los OGTs alongside Averno and Chessman during one of his better-known runs with the company. The trio held the AAA World Trios Championship and worked prominently around the promotion’s tag and faction scene. That history means Marvin would be returning to a locker room and wrestling style he already knows well rather than starting from scratch in a new system. A training role would also give younger talent direct access to experience he built across both Mexico and Japan. His career began in 1995 and became especially notable through a lengthy association with Pro Wrestling NOAH, where Marvin built a strong reputation with Japanese audiences. He has also worked for CMLL, Ring of Honor and numerous independent promotions, giving him experience across very different wrestling systems. WWE brought Marvin into a tryout in Chile in 2018, although no contract followed. A backstage AAA role would therefore represent another chapter in a career that has moved repeatedly between Mexico, Japan and the wider international scene.

body: Link WWE Geno Mrosko is a lifelong pro wrestling fan who has been covering it since becoming a Manager at Cageside Seats in 2011. Generally speaking, I wasn’t all that excited when Bayley and Lyra Valkyria set up a No Disqualification match for this week’s episode of Monday Night Raw in Fresno, California. After all, they’ve been going back-and-forth for what feels like forever and while there have been some interesting turns along the way, it sure felt to me like this has taken its course, and I was ready for it to be over. If ever there were a match deserving of the “holy shit” chant it was this one. title: Comeback Watch: WWE Nixed Plans for Rusev’s TV Return on Oct. 26 RAW — Report
raw_title: WWE Nixed Plans for Rusev’s TV Return on Oct. 26 RAW — Report
body: 0 WWE reportedly had plans for Rusev to return to RAW. However, an injury has delayed those plans and forced the company to make a change. The Bulgarian Brute last wrestled on the July 27 episode of RAW, where he faced Je’Von Evans. Rusev finished the match, but reports later revealed that he had suffered an injury during the bout. The setback has kept him out of action since then. His absence has also affected WWE’s plans for Ethan Page, who was expected to get a new tag team partner. However, the company went in a different direction on the October 26 episode of RAW . During a recent Q&A session, WrestleVotes’ JoeyVotes and TC discussed the tag team match between Chad Gable and Dragon Lee against Ethan Page and Big Cass on RAW. JoeyVotes revealed that WWE originally planned to pair Page with Rusev, but the injury forced the company to change its plans. “The tag match, Chad Gable and Dragon Lee taking on Big Cass and Ethan Page. They wanted to find someone for Ethan Page, find a tag team partner for him. It was supposed to be Rusev. Rusev’s dealing with a little injury. He’s on his way back,” JoeyVotes said (H/T: EWRESTLINGNEWS ). It is unclear whether WWE will revisit the proposed partnership once Rusev is ready to return to TV. Rusev’s latest absence began after his match against Je’Von Evans on the July 27 episode of RAW. His wife, CJ Perry, later revealed that Rusev had landed awkwardly on his neck. He also told the referee he couldn’t feel his hands. Despite the scary moment, he finished the match before being sidelined. According to Fightful Select , Rusev spent two weeks in concussion protocol following the incident. He eventually returned to WWE’s Performance Center, but an undisclosed illness reportedly caused further delays in his recovery. There had been some positive news. Rusev returned to the ring at WWE live events in Honolulu, Hawaii, on October 16 and 17. Those appearances were an encouraging sign after several months away from action. However, wrestling at live events does not confirm when he will return to WWE television full-time. title: Johnny Gargano Details Six-Month Wrestling Hiatus
raw_title: Johnny Gargano Explains Why He Laid Around For Six Months
summary_src: Since early in the year, Johnny Gargano was spotted planking backstage instead of wrestling. It wasn't until August when he faced CM Punk in Cleveland that he became Johnny Wrestling again. On his Vlog, Gargano explained why he laid around for six months.
body: Since early in the year, Johnny Gargano was spotted planking backstage instead of wrestling. It wasn’t until August when he faced CM Punk in Cleveland that he became Johnny Wrestling again. On his Vlog , Gargano explained why he laid around for six months. “Everyone wants to know, ‘Why were you laying around and feeling sorry for yourself for six months? What was going on?’ It’s complicated, but the easy answer is right there [shows his title wall]. I feel like everyone expected me to be that guy, and I tried to be that guy, and I couldn’t. I felt like I was letting a lot of people down. I hated that. “You heard Quill ask in the vlog, ‘Did you get the treasure?’ He watches SmackDown, and he loves video games. In his head, when you win, you get the treasure. I don’t know how many times over the past year we’d fly out on Thursday, and before we’d leave, he would ask me, ‘Are you going to get the treasure?’ I would tell him, ‘I’ll try. I’m really going to try.’ I would have a match on SmackDown, I’d lose, and Candice would have the phone in her hand, showing me Quil just crying. ‘Daddy lost. Daddy isn’t getting the treasure.’ That broke me. In my head, it was easier to just not try than to get up, fail, and let people down. I’m not saying that’s right or the way to go about things, but that’s what I did.” Gargano said that Cleveland showed him that if he tries, he can make anything happen. He thanked the fans for continuing to support him and Sami Zayn for showing him the way. title: Bron Breakker Spoils Penta’s Cash-In Attempt With Vicious Ambush
raw_title: Bron Breakker Spoils Penta’s Cash-In Attempt With Vicious Ambush
body: RAW general manager Adam Pearce kicked things off by announcing that Becky Lynch and Liv Morgan would compete later in the evening for the World Women’s Championship. Pearce seemed to have another announcement prepped before he was interrupted by WWE Undisputed Champion Sami Zayn, who demanded Pearce leave the ring so he could address the WWE Universe. During his passionate speech, in which he compared himself to Shawn Michaels, Eddie Guerrero and Kurt Angle , Zayn mentioned that he didn’t appreciate being interrupted by the likes of Je’Von Evans and Trick Williams in recent weeks. Right on cue, the Young OG cut him off once more, and the two engaged in a heated back-and-forth. Before long, Zayn began to head up the ramp, seemingly ending his conversation with Evans. Suddenly, a slightly irked Pearce returned from backstage and told Zayn that, since he wanted so much ring time, he would compete against Je’Von Evans for the WWE Championship. Despite the impromptu origins, the Sami Zayn and Je’Von Evans championship bout was shaping up to be a modern-day classic. For Evans, it was his first championship opportunity since being promoted to the WWE main roster. The Monday night matchup was also his first match since suffering a 20-foot free-fall through an ambulance at Money in the Bank. The talented stars jostled for an advantage, with neither superstar giving an inch. Suddenly, Money in the Bank winner Penta entered the arena, seemingly ready to make it a Triple Threat match for the WWE Championship. Evans and Zayn continued to slug it out as Penta walked toward the ring alongside a referee. Out of nowhere, Bron Breakker stormed down the ramp and ambushed Penta before he could formally cash in. Je’Von Evans leaped outside of the ring to defend Penta from Breakker’s assault. His good-intentioned assist proved costly. Zayn planted him with a Helluva Kick shortly after he re-entered the ring to secure the pinfall victory. Moments later, Breakker and Bronson Reed began brutalizing Evans and Penta. Meanwhile, Zayn headed backstage with his freshly-retained WWE Championship. Breakker flattened both high-flyers with a Spear before Bronson Reed finished the job with a pair of Tsunamis. Bron Breakker’s ambush on Penta was brutal, but it wasn’t a complete shock. During the Oct. 12 episode of RAW, Breakker attempted to spear the Money in the Bank winner, but an injured Je’Von Evans shoved him out of the way and absorbed the blow instead. As medics and referees rushed to assist Evans, Breakker, standing on the ramp, could be heard telling Penta, “Good luck cashing in.” Still peeved from his MITB Ladder Match loss, it appears that Breakker isn’t willing to let the rightful winner prosper. Penta may want to keep his head on a swivel moving forward. The Unpredictable Badass may not be done lurking in the shadows. title: Backstage Buzz: Latest On WWE Crown Jewel, WrestleMania Plans For Saudi Arabia, The Sphere Rumors
raw_title: Latest On WWE Crown Jewel, WrestleMania Plans For Saudi Arabia, The Sphere Rumors
body: WWE Crown Jewel is still on course for Saudi Arabia, and a new report has some details on the company’s current plans for it and WrestleMania. As has been extensively reported, the company is still planning to host the November 7th PLE in the country despite level three security alerts by the US State Department due to the war in Iran. It was noted today that setup is underway for the event. According to Fightful Select , sources working on site in Saudi Arabia say that they’ve been there working for weeks, and expect the event go on as it’s been planned. Ariel Helwani noted on his show that members of the Power Slap production crew will fly into Bahrain and then take a bus to Riyadh for their show, which takes place the night before Crown Jewel. The outlet cites sources onsite as saying that the situation is “nowhere near as bad as the media makes it out to be.” However, WWE talent and staff have expressed that they are “reasonably concerned.” The report goes on to reference WrestleMania, specifically offering context after Eric Bischoff said on a podcast that he would be “shocked” if WWE’s backup plan for WrestleMania was not The Sphere in Las Vegas. As has been noted , there have been rumors that Las Vegas is the backup plan, though those have not been confirmed. It was also reported by POST Wrestling that WrestleMania 43 was internally set for April 10th and 11th, 2027. WWE has not yet announced the dates for WrestleMania 43 publicly, and they have been previously said to be waiting for Crown Jewel week to make the announcement. Fightful Select notes that they’re not sure if that remains the plan considering potential issues in Saudi Arabia. They have had no word that The Sphere is the backup plan. In terms of The Sphere’s availability, John Mayer will be occupying the venue from April 8th through the 18th of 2027 and at the end of the month. Oprah Winfrey is scheduled for The Sphere from April 2nd through the 4th. The Sphere may have an open slot on April 24th to the 25th, but again there’s nothing indicating that it will happen.

title: WWE’s Stephanie Vaquer Pushes Back on Fans Wanting Free Videos
raw_title: WWE’s Stephanie Vaquer Pushes Back on Fans Wanting Free Videos
body: 0 WWE star Stephanie Vaquer has addressed fans who expect wrestlers to record personalized videos for free. She explained that seemingly simple requests can involve considerable time and professional obligations. The former champion shared an example on Instagram that highlighted another issue surrounding these requests: how fans obtain performers’ private contact information. The fan admitted they had never met and replied, “No, buddy, I’m a fan of yours. A producer from here gave me your contact information. Can you help me out with the shoutout?” The exchange also showed the recipient expressing uncertainty about how to handle the unexpected request, writing, “I don’t know whether to tell him to f**k off or laugh… I’d rather just laugh…” Vaquer then explained why wrestlers shouldn’t be expected to provide personalized content simply because someone asks. According to the WWE star, recording videos can take up a significant part of a performer’s schedule. “It’s funny, but people don’t realize that sometimes we spend six or seven hours recording videos. That’s basically an entire day every week, and everyone thinks, ‘Making one video doesn’t cost you anything,’” she explained. Vaquer stressed that personalized content is professional work rather than an automatic favor for anyone who manages to make contact. “Guys, this is part of my job. I’m not trying to be rude, but some people need to understand that, in my case, this is paid work and it’s regulated.” She also pointed out that using her image for a video requires permission. The WWE star admitted, “To make a video, I have to use my image, and for that, I need to ask for permission, which isn’t easy. That’s it.” Stephanie Vaquer’s message highlights the work and permissions involved in producing personalized content. For fans, a quick shoutout might seem like a small ask, but the work behind it isn’t a free-for-all. title: Becky Lynch Gets Title Shot After Vaquer Injury
raw_title: WWE Women's World Heavyweight Championship Booked After Stephanie Vaquer Medical Announcement
body: The show was scheduled to feature three key matches in the women's division. Now, one of those matches has changed. Stephanie Vaquer was scheduled to face Becky Lynch in a number one contendership match, but now Lynch will be getting a world title match against Liv Morgan. On social media, WWE announced that Stephanie Vaquer may not be medically cleared to wrestle on the show. She was set to face Becky Lynch in a singles match with the winner earning a shot at the WWE Women's World Heavyweight Championship. "Questions have arisen regarding Stephanie Vaquer's medical availability heading into WWE Raw," the post said on the WWE X account. "Adam Pearce will address everything on tonight's show." Pearce opened the show and revealed that Vaquer was not medically able to compete. Instead, he outright granted a title shot to Lynch. Vaquer and Lynch have been teasing a major match together for weeks. They recently wrestled one another in a match at the Money in the Bank PLE, but that match also included Liv Morgan. In that match, Morgan won and beat Vaquer to win the WWE Women's World Championship. In other women's division action on the show this week, Iyo Sky will take on Raquel Rodriguez in a singles match. The bout is not currently scheduled to be for Rodriguez's WWE Women's Intercontinental Championship. However, should Sky win, she certainly would likely be at the front of the line for a title shot. Bayley vs. Lyra Valkyria is also taking place this week. The match is a no disqualification match and has been building for months. Valkyria and Bayley are former tag team partners, but Valkyria shockingly turned on her friend and then beat her at Saturday Night's Main Event. Bayley returned with a vengeance and has been a thron in the side of Valkyria. Now, they'll squash their beef on this week's Raw. Other announced matches for the show this week include Chad Gable and Dragon Lee against Big Cass and Ethan Page in a tag team match. Page has been angling for a shot at Gable's WWE Men's Intercontinental Championship and has a chance to put himself in a position to get it this week. Also, 946 were humiliated at the hands of Roman Reigns and The Bloodline last week on the show. They will be looking for some sort of retribution, but Reigns is not currently being advertised this week. llm_long: On the October 26 episode of WWE Raw, Sami Zayn expressed his frustrations after being brought in to promote the show and Crown Jewel only to find himself left off the card. Zayn noted that Roman Reigns could have been brought out since it is his show but stated he would not complain about Reigns' part-time schedule.

He pointed out that Reigns looked at his schedule and decided to skip Fresno, adding that Reigns deserved the time off and that he wished he had done the same. Zayn invoked his time to speak and told Adam Pearce to leave the ring so he could get something off his chest.

He told the crowd he had given them too much credit and thought they could identify greatness when it stood in front of them, but they needed to be spoon fed who is great. Zayn said that is what happened with Trick Williams and that people like CM Punk have to tell fans he is the best in the world for them to accept it, while they acknowledge Roman Reigns because they want to.

He declared that no one in the business has done more with less, walked through miles of crap and came out clean, or been buried so far beneath the dirt and come out like he did. Zayn stated he dug deeper until he struck gold but added that he could brag about that yet he won't.
He concluded by saying he could brag about being the most versatile and that if your name is not Shawn, Eddie, or Kurt, you do not belong in the conversation.

llm_long: Monday Night Raw opened with General Manager Adam Pearce announcing that Stephanie Vaquer remains not medically cleared to compete. This development scrapped the scheduled match between Vaquer and Becky Lynch to determine the number one contender to the Women's World Championship.

Pearce then decided to book Lynch in an immediate title challenge against champion Liv Morgan, placing the bout in the main event slot in Fresno. Lynch delivered a video promo to build the match. During the back-and-forth contest, Lynch trapped Morgan in the Disarmher.

Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez then ran to the ring to interfere. Lynch temporarily neutralized the duo with a flip dive to the floor and a counter to Oblivion inside the ring. Rodriguez and Perez broke up the ensuing pinfall attempt, prompting the referee to call for the bell and disqualify Morgan.

Morgan lost the match but retained the Women's World Championship. Chaos followed as Chelsea Green and Iyo Sky also entered the fray. Morgan ended up laid out in the ring. Rhea Ripley appeared with her Money in the Bank briefcase, announced she was cashing in, and handed the case to a referee.

title: Liv Morgan Retains WWE Women's World Title on Raw
raw_title: Liv Morgan escapes title match against Becky Lynch, potential cash-in attempt from Tiffany Stratton on WWE Raw
summary_src: Through sketchy tactics, Liv Morgan was able to escape two different title threats on WWE Monday Night Raw.
body: Liv Morgan escaped this week’s episode of Monday Night Raw still as the WWE Women’s World Champion, but just barely. Morgan survived a title showdown against Becky Lynch on Monday night (albeit via disqualification), then evaded a possible cash-in attempt from 2026 Women’s Money in the Bank winner Tiffany Stratton as part of this week’s show from the Freshmart Center in Fresno, California. Monday’s show was originally scheduled to have Lynch battle Stephanie Vaquer in a #1 contenders match for a shot at Morgan. But, after Vaquer was scrapped from the card due to not being cleared to compete, Raw General Manager Adam Pearce decided to fast-track Lynch to a title opportunity tonight. Lynch had Morgan in trouble late, reversing an Oblivion attempt from the champ into a second Manhandle Slam. But as she went for a follow-up pin attempt, Judgment Day members Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez crashed the ring, causing the bout to come to a disqualification end. While Morgan technically lost the match, she was able to retain her title due to the way the match had ended. A post-match brawl broke out, with Rodriguez rival IYO SKY and Morgan’s Crown Jewel opponent, Chelsea Green, both hitting the ring for the save. After the babyfaces won the brawl, Morgan found herself laid out in the center of the ring. This caused MITB holder Stratton to try and capitalize on the hurt champ. She scored with a Prettiest Moonsault Ever then looked to cash in her belt, but wasn’t able to get the match started before Dominik Mysterio appeared at ringside and retrieved Morgan, getting her out of harm’s way. While Morgan left California still champ on Monday, danger lurks around the corner for her. Stratton seems focused on cashing in soon, and Lynch is likely in line for a rematch due to how her first encounter with Morgan went down.
summary: Liv Morgan survived a title match against Becky Lynch on Monday Night Raw, retaining her WWE Women's World Championship via disqualification after interference from Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez. The bout was originally set as a number one contender's match between Lynch and Stephanie Vaquer, but Raw GM Adam Pearce inserted Lynch into an immediate title opportunity after Vaquer was pulled due to not being medically cleared. Morgan also avoided a potential Money in the Bank cash-in attempt from Tiffany Stratton following the chaotic main event segment in Fresno.

body: Following the announcement that Stephanie Vaquer was not medically cleared to appear on the October 26 episode of "WWE Raw," Becky Lynch was fast-tracked into the main event match to challenge Liv Morgan for the WWE Women's World Championship. However, The Judgment Day proved to be the deciding factor as the match ended in a disqualification. The match was a back-and-forth affair that saw both women take control of the match for several periods, with Morgan in particular thinking she had won it all with an Oblivion that Lynch was able to kick out of. Lynch locked in a Disarmher that Morgan was also able to escape from, but when she locked it in for a second time, Morgan had nowhere to go. Just then, Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez ran down to support Morgan, providing enough of a distraction to allow Morgan to escape once more. The Judgment Day tried to attack Lynch on the outside but a miscommunication saw Rodriguez boot Perez in the face, before Lynch landed a Senton on both ladies. As she was getting back in the ring, Morgan looked to hit the Oblivion but was cut off by Lynch, who landed the Manhandle Slam for what looked to be the win, until The Judgment Day rushed in to break the count, forcing the disqualification to allow Morgan to keep her title. After the match, The Judgment Day beat down Lynch relentlessly, which prompted a whole host of stars to try and even the odds. Chelsea Green came to rescue to attack her opponent at Crown Jewel on November 7, hitting Morgan with the Unpretti-her. IYO Sky also came our to attack Rodriguez after their bout earlier in the night, but as Morga lay motionless in the ring, Tiffany Stratton hit the ring. She landed the Prettiest Moonsault Ever on Morgan before telling the referee she was going to cash in her Money in the Bank briefcase. Right before the referee could ring the bell, Dominik Mysterio appeared to frantically drag Morgan out of the ring, leaving Stratton in the ring with her briefcase as the show went off the air.

title: Je’Von Evans Makes History in Impromptu WWE Championship Match
raw_title: Je’Von Evans Makes History in Impromptu WWE Championship Match
body: Impressively, following his impromptu WWE Championship bout with Sami Zayn on RAW, Evans is also the youngest World Championship match participant in WWE history. Je’Von Evans , 22, surpassed the previous mark set by Randy Orton, who was 24 when he won the World Heavyweight Championship in 2004 at SummerSlam. Evans latest milestone continues what has been a historic year for the high-flyer. Evans has also staked his claim as the youngest Elimination Chamber and Money in the Bank Ladder match participant. He was the Iron Man of the 2026 Royal Rumble, surviving 41 minutes in the match to earn the honor. Just a few short weeks after suffering a 20-foot free-fall through an ambulance at Money in the Bank, Je’Von Evans was presented with a golden opportunity on RAW. RAW general manager Adam Pearce kicked off the show by announcing that Becky Lynch and Liv Morgan would compete later in the evening for the World Women’s Championship. Just as Pearce was about to make another announcement, he was interrupted by WWE Undisputed Champion Sami Zayn, who demanded Pearce leave the ring so he could address the WWE Universe. Zayn noted that, despite being a two-time WWE Champion, he still feels largely underrated and underappreciated. The Canadian star added that he has also tolerated disrespect from his peers, and that he didn’t take too kindly to being interrupted by Je’Von Evans and Trick Williams in recent weeks. Evans stepped to the WWE Champion and dared him to finish his comments about him face-to-face. Following a heated exchange, Pearce returned from backstage and booked an impromptu WWE Championship match between the two stars. For Evans, it was his first championship opportunity since being promoted to the WWE main roster. The Monday night matchup was also his first match since suffering a 20-foot free-fall through an ambulance at Money in the Bank. Crazily enough, the last-minute championship bout nearly became a Triple Threat match. Penta still has a year to cash in his MITB briefcase, but the luchador nearly pulled the trigger on Monday night. As Evans and Zayn traded blows, Penta entered the arena with his pyro-equipped briefcase. Penta walked toward the ring alongside a referee and seemed primed to cash in to make the match a Triple Threat. Suddenly, Bron Breakker stormed down the ramp and ambushed Penta before he could formally cash in. Je’Von Evans leaped outside of the ring to defend Penta from Breakker’s assault. Assisting Penta proved costly, as Zayn planted him with a Helluva Kick shortly after he re-entered the ring to secure the pinfall victory. Regarding Breakker, it will be interesting to see if he continues to hunt Penta. Still seething from his MITB loss, Breakker appears unwilling to let Penta cash in. He has also ambushed him in two of the last three weeks. Penta and Evans will get a shot at revenge at Crown Jewel, where they will face Bron Breakker and Austin Theory for the World Tag Team Championship. Jalyn Smoot Jalyn Smoot is a s
summary: Impressively, after his impromptu WWE Championship bout with Sami Zayn on RAW, Evans is additionally the youngest World Championship match participant in WWE history. Je’Von Evans , 22, surpassed the previous mark set by Randy Orton, who was 24 when he won the World Heavyweight Championship in 2004 at SummerSlam.

body: A new match for the World Tag Team titles has been added to Crown Jewel. Penta and Je’Von Evans will challenge The Vision on November 7 in Riyadh. The match comes after further confrontation between the two parties on this week’s Raw . Sami Zayn opened this week’s show in Fresno, dismissing Adam Pearce in the ring. He proceeded to complain about Roman Reigns, the crowd, Cody Rhodes, and Trick Williams, among other subjects. Eventually, Je’Von Evans came out and confronted the WWE Champion. Zayn rejected a match and started to leave, but Pearce returned and ordered a WWE Championship match right then and there. The finish of that match had Penta came to the ring, teasing a potential Money in the Bank cash-in. But Bron Breakker soon followed, taking out Penta on the outside. In the ring, Zayn connected with the helluva kick to win the match. Zayn left the ring after the match, allowing Breakker to turn his focus on Evans. Penta recovered and attempted to intervene, but was taken out by Bronson Reed, who made the save for his partner and crushed both with tsunamis. Later, Pearce checked on the two as they were being looked at by trainers and made the match official for next month. title: Vince McMahon’s War Zone Shows Spark Fresh Debate as Crown Jewel Nears
raw_title: Vince McMahon’s War Zone Shows Spark Fresh Debate as Crown Jewel Nears
body: 0 With WWE Crown Jewel 2026 approaching on November 7, the company’s plans to hold the event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, have reignited debate about how WWE handles shows amid geopolitical turmoil. The discussion has also brought Vince McMahon ’s past Saudi events back into the spotlight, with fans sharply divided over whether the former chairman would have handled the situation differently. The event remains scheduled for Riyadh, despite security concerns and an updated U.S. travel advisory. The State Department has ordered non-emergency government employees and their families to leave Saudi Arabia, while WWE has not announced a venue change. According to WrestleVotes (via ewrestlingnews ), a longtime WWE source described the mood among company personnel as “absolute disarray,” with staff and talent waiting to learn whether Crown Jewel will proceed in Riyadh or move elsewhere. The report also highlighted concerns about performers travelling amid potential security risks. Although WWE has reportedly considered contingency plans, the final decision remains with senior leadership. The situation has reignited debate about McMahon’s history of proceeding with major events despite outside turmoil, including Crown Jewel 2018 following the killing of Jamal Khashoggi. Fans have responded with sharply contrasting views: @HBCorb : “Vince McMahon might have been ‘evil’ but Atleast the guy wouldnt have flew his wrestlers into a warzone. F**k TKO.” @twinhypeback : “I mean he literally did though like 10+ times” @PunkshotLariot : “I really hate this revisionist history.” The fan argued that McMahon also put talent at risk and criticised attempts to rewrite his record. @BlueRazz62 : Recalled allegations about a previous Saudi event, claiming a dispute over the broadcast left wrestlers stranded on a plane while Vince McMahon departed separately. The reactions show that nostalgia for McMahon’s leadership is far from universal, particularly when past Saudi events are part of the discussion. Some fans view the current situation as a continuation of WWE’s established approach, while others argue that the company’s leadership and responsibilities have changed under TKO. For now, Crown Jewel remains on the calendar for November 7. With security concerns unresolved and internal uncertainty reportedly continuing, WWE’s eventual decision will matter well beyond the show itself. title: Match Made: Solo Sikoa vs. Royce Keys Added to WWE RAW in Latest Match Announcement
raw_title: Solo Sikoa vs. Royce Keys Added to WWE RAW in Latest Match Announcement
body: 0 WWE has officially added a first-time-ever singles match to next week’s episode of WWE RAW, as Solo Sikoa prepares to go one-on-one with Royce Keys . The announcement comes amid the ongoing war between The Bloodline and 946. Keys announced the match during a vignette on the October 26 episode of RAW , sending a warning to Sikoa. Sikoa later responded, setting the stage for their confrontation ahead of Crown Jewel. This week, Royce Keys appeared in a vignette on RAW, where he addressed the recent reunion of The Bloodline. The Samoan faction had a major reason to celebrate last week after Sikoa rejoined his Bloodline brothers. With Roman Reigns leading the charge, the reunited family came face-to-face against 946 during the main event. The Bloodline ultimately closed the show by destroying Bronco Nima, sending a clear message to 946. However, the reunion has not convinced Keys to back down. He made it clear that the returning family could still find itself in serious trouble when he steps into the ring with Sikoa. “How sweet is that. The Bloodline back together, standing tall, until I call the play. Solo. Brooklyn, New York. Just me and you. I’m going to do exactly to you what I did to the twins. Go ask your big brothers. Ask them what their blood tastes like. Ain’t nobody safe. Nobody,” Keys proclaimed . Sikoa did not take long to respond to the challenge. In backstage footage shown later on RAW, Sikoa appeared alongside his Bloodline brothers and confirmed that he had officially accepted Keys’ invitation to fight. Sikoa stated that he was back with his family and that The Bloodline remained in control of WWE. Echoing the threatening message delivered by Keys, he made it clear that their rivals should be concerned about what comes next. “I accept,” Sikoa declared, ending his message with 946’s catchphrase, “Ain’t nobody safe.” The acceptance sets up a first-time-ever singles match between the two stars. There were small fires in pots, as well as spooky displays, as the wrestlers came to the ring. A very festive atmosphere. * Yes, this was an outdoor show with a 3 p.m. start time. Blizzy (a marijuana gimmick wrestler) and another guy hit coast-to-coast dropkicks. Kanyon nailed a superkick. Even with commentators saying some names, I still have no idea who everyone is. Juni immediately hit the Mike Bailey-style Flamingo Driver for the pin. That topped my expectations. Frightmare got on Hallowicked’s shoulders to even out the height, but Jordan hit a dropkick at 1:30. The LoR began working over Price. Jordan tagged back in and assisted Price in hitting a flip. Oliver nailed a Mafia Kick on Frightmare for a nearfall at 4:00. The LoR hit a German Suplex on Oli

title: Alexa Bliss Negotiates Daughter Travel Clause for WWE Return
raw_title: Alexa Bliss reveals her non-negotiable condition for 2025 WWE return
summary_src: Alexa Bliss recently revealed that she negotiated into her WWE contract the right to bring her daughter on the road before returning to WWE. After an absence of almost two years, Bliss returned to WWE programming at Royal Rumble 2025.
body: Alexa Bliss recently revealed that she negotiated into her WWE contract the right to bring her daughter on the road before returning to WWE. After an absence of almost two years, Bliss returned to WWE programming at Royal Rumble 2025. Recently, speaking on A Shot of Brandi, Bliss opened up about travelling with her daughter and adding that ability into her contract before her return. “ Road life’s a little different. I have my daughter with me now on the road every week ,” Bliss said. “ It’s definitely really hard, but I am in so much of the phase of I don’t wanna miss anything she does. So that was one of the biggest things of coming back. I worked it into my contract that she travels with me. “ I was like, ‘I need to be able to bring my daughter along. That’s non-negotiable,’ because she, at the time, was only barely a year, and I was like, ‘I’m not leaving her on the road multiple days a week ,'” she further added. Further, when speaking about both parents being on tour, Bliss added that her husband has been going on tours for the past 10 years, and thus her daughter needs to be with one of her parents. “ That was just something that it’s a lot of growing pains because now instead of traveling with two cute little bags, you’re traveling with 10 because you have, at first it was a Pack ‘n Play, a travel Pack ‘n Play and a stroller and a car seat, ” she said. She claimed that she’s grateful for the arrangement because now she gets to be there for everything and does not have to miss out on her daughter’s personal milestones. “ I went on the tour, and Ryan sends me a picture, or a video, of her discovering the moon for the first time, and she was so excited. She was like, ‘Moon, moon.’ She was jumping up and down, pointing at the moon, and I was so sad that I had to live that moment through a screen because I was like, ‘Oh, I should have been there for that ,'” she said. “ I don’t ever wanna feel mom guilt, so I just bring her with me.” “ She’s napping at the arena during rehearsals, during pyro tests, during all the things, and it’s finding that, but she loves it, she loves watching ,” Bliss further shared how her daughter is backstage. “ Oh my gosh. She just learned one, two, three, ding, ding, ding. That’s her new favorite thing.” Shounak Chakrabarti Shounak Chakrabarti is an experienced sports journalist with a lifelong passion for athletics and storytelling. She stated that participating helped her achieve closure with Rotunda. Bliss revealed they had been scheduled to reunite on WWE television after WrestleMania. She said the last time she was with him was at WrestleMania when she turned on him against Randy Orton and then they planned to join back together after one WrestleMania.

Bliss explained that she found out she was pregnant and he became sick so they missed each other like ships in the night. She recalled that Rotunda once said in an interview that she and he would always be connected in some way and that gave her comfort.

Bliss described walking through the haunted house the first time as feeling like someone hit her in the gut because it featured all of Windham’s ideas. She noted that Rotunda had always wanted a house at Halloween Horror Nights and seeing it realized was cool yet bittersweet since he would never see it.
Bliss performed in the Firefly Funhouse scene next to a television playing Windham repeatedly and called the experience both cool and heartbreaking.

title: Comeback Watch: John Cena To Return to WWE RAW for the First Time Since Retiring
raw_title: John Cena To Return to WWE RAW for the First Time Since Retiring
body: 0 John Cena is officially heading back to WWE television, with the company announcing his return for next week’s episode of Monday Night RAW in Brooklyn, New York. The appearance will mark his first return to WWE RAW programming since retiring from in-ring competition. The company has yet to reveal exactly what he will do on the show. The announcement came shortly before the main event of this week’s RAW , giving fans an early reason to tune in for the November 2 broadcast. WWE confirmed that John Cena will appear on RAW at the Barclays Center in Brooklyn on Monday, November 2. The episode will stream live on Netflix. However, the company has not disclosed any specific plans for the Cenation Leader’s return. One possibility is that the 17-time World Champion will provide further details about the John Cena Classic, an event he previously announced for December 2026. The concept is expected to focus on established talent facing the next generation. WWE fans would vote online to determine the winner on the night. However, WWE has not confirmed that the tournament will be the focus of Cena’s upcoming appearance. For now, his return is the only officially announced detail, leaving fans waiting to see what he has planned. Cena retired from in-ring competition on December 13, 2025, after facing Gunther at Saturday Night’s Main Event. His final match concluded a year-long farewell tour that began after he announced his retirement plans at Money in the Bank in July 2024. During that farewell run, Cena captured another world championship by defeating Cody Rhodes at WrestleMania 41. That historic victory extended his record to 17 world title reigns. He ultimately stepped away from wrestling because of the physical demands of competing. Moreover, he desired to give younger talent more opportunities. Although Cena’s days as an active wrestler are over, his upcoming RAW appearance shows that his WWE story isn’t finished. Whether he returns to announce the next chapter of the John Cena Classic or address the WWE Universe for another reason remains to be seen. title: ODB Opens Up On Who Will Induct Her Into TNA Hall Of Fame Ahead Of Bound For Glory 2026
raw_title: ODB Reveals Who Will Induct Her Into TNA Hall Of Fame Ahead Of Bound For Glory 2026
body: The veteran star, who returned to the promotion earlier this year, was announced as a TNA Hall of Fame inductee at the Rebellion pay-per-view , with her induction set to take place at Bound For Glory this weekend. Ahead of the show, she spoke to " Busted Open " and named the three who will induct her into the Hall of Fame — TNA Hall of Famers Traci Brooks and Earl Hebner, and veteran star Al Snow. "On Sunday, right before the pay-per-view at 4:00 PM, the pre-show, I will be inducted into the 2026 TNA Hall of Fame with Konnan and Amazing Red," she said. "I have three people involved in my induction there. So first, my BFF, Traci Brooks, Hall of Famer herself. And my mentor since the beginning, since I started wrestling, Mr. Al Snow. That guy needs to go into the Hall of Fame, too. He's trained so many of the greats. And then the legendary Hall of Famer himself, Mr. Earl Hebner will be walking me out." ODB, who was known for her casual attire while wrestling and often ditched glamorous wrestling gear, told the hosts of the show that she's even bought a dress for the big event but is unsure if she will wear it. The former TNA Knockouts Champion will be the fifth female star to be inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame, following in the footsteps of Gail Kim, Awesome Kong, Traci Brooks, and Mickie James .

body: WWE Welcome to Wrestling Inc.'s weekly review of "WWE Raw," a show that this week featured no fewer than three women's matches, including a world championship main event after Stephanie Vaquer was deemed medically unable to compete . The WINC staff actually have thoughts about all three women's matches, not to mention the fact that there were three women's matches in the first place, here in the column this week. We'll also discuss the opening Sami Zayn promo (though we don't have much to say about his WWE title defense ) and the strange absence of content in the red-hot Bloodline vs. 946 feud. If you missed Monday's show, as always, you can catch up by checking out our "WWE Raw" 10/26/26 live blog , which contains all the objective info you could possibly want. If you're more interested in the WINC crew's subjective opinions about the matches and segments we found most interesting (for better or worse) this column is your jam. Here are three things we hated and three things we loved about the 10/26/26 episode of "WWE Raw!" WWE I know that there are going to be those out there who enjoyed this Sami Zayn promo from the opening moments of this episode of "Raw", and I have nothing but respect for that. I've been a long time fan of Zayn myself, but I just can't help but feel like the promo segments he's been cutting over the last few weeks have gotten really old and repetitive at this point. Zayn didn't really say anything he hasn't said in this segment, nor did it really accomplish very much to further the storyline between him and World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns heading into their Men's Crown Jewel Championship match. I will admit that I did like this a little more after Je'Von Evans got involved as it was something a bit different, but it didn't felt like it did enough to totally change my mind about the Zayn portion of this being much of the same thing we've gotten over the course of the past few weeks. When you combine that with the weird lead-in of Pearce announcing the Women's World Championship match between titleholder Liv Morgan and Becky Lynch, this just wasn't something that was for me and I would love to see WWE do something else with Zayn in these segments. WWE While I liked Giulia and Blake Monroe's street fight on "SmackDown" on Friday, I absolutely loved Bayley and Lyra Valkyria's feud-ending no disqualification match tonight. These women beat the hell out of one another, with Valkyria taking the brunt of it, and they put on one of the best women's matches in WWE in recent memory. I'm usually one to complain about feuds going on too long, and while this should be one of those complaints, as they've been fighting since before Saturday Night's Main Event in July, this never really got old to me. title: WWE & AEW Could Be Headed for Another Counter-Programming Battle
raw_title: WWE & AEW Could Be Headed for Another Counter-Programming Battle
body: 0 WWE and AEW could be heading for another counter-programming battle next month. A scheduling change could put NXT up against a major episode of AEW Dynamite. The two promotions have often competed for viewership in recent years. At times, both companies have adjusted their schedules or announced major events on the same night. Their latest clash could record NXT going up against one of AEW’s biggest annual shows. WWE usually airs NXT on Tuesday nights, while Dynamite takes place on Wednesdays. But according to Netflix listings, the November 3 episode of NXT will move to Wednesday, November 4, because The CW Network is scheduled to air election coverage on Tuesday. This enables NXT to go head-to-head with Dynamite, which will feature the annual Blood and Guts special. Earlier this month, Dynamite moved to Tuesday because Major League Baseball playoff coverage took over its regular Wednesday time slot. This put AEW directly against NXT. NXT won in total viewership , but AEW came out ahead in the key Adults 18-49 demographic. AEW will have a major attraction to promote this time, as Blood and Guts has become one of its biggest annual events. Meanwhile, NXT will air its Halloween Havoc fallout episode following the October 31 special. Moreover, this is not the only upcoming scheduling clash between the two companies. AEW has also announced that Dynamite’s New Year’s Smash episode will take place on January 1, 2027, putting it opposite WWE SmackDown. Collision is scheduled to air live on Saturday that week. AEW President Tony Khan discussed the issue last year during an appearance on The Ariel Helwani Show . Khan said he believed WWE deliberately tried counter-programming. However, he also revealed it had not hurt AEW. The post WWE & AEW Could Be Headed for Another Counter-Programming Battle appeared first on Wrestlezone .
