title: TNA Strikes Broadcast Deal With SPORT1 For Germany
raw_title: TNA Announces New Broadcast Deal With SPORT1 In Germany
body: TNA Impact is set to air in Germany starting next week, courtesy of a new broadcast deal announced today. TNA announced on Tuesday that it has signed a new broadcast partnership with SPORT1 that will bring Thursday Night Impact to Germany. The deal will see a German-language broadcast of TNA Impact air on SPORT1 starting November 3rd with “exclusive commentary and localization.” The announcement noted: “This move is a further continuation of the platform’s global expansion initiative, focused on increasing TNA’s television presence across Europe and around the world. Through SPORT1, German wrestling fans will now have regular access to acclaimed TNA programming, ensuring they will be able to enjoy the promotion’s signature brand of hard-hitting action, blockbuster stories, and larger-than-life personas—conveniently located on one of the country’s top sports media.” TNA Wrestling President Carlos said in the announcement, “Germany has always been an important market—both for professional wrestling and TNA, in particular. We are excited to join forces with SPORT1 to bring TNA content back to fans across the country. SPORT1 has firmly established itself as a major platform in sports and sports entertainment, making them an ideal partner as we continue expanding TNA’s international presence. We look forward to giving German fans a consistent destination to experience TNA every week.” TNA Impact airs Thursday nights on AMC in the US, AMC+, and TNA+.
summary: TNA has signed a new broadcast partnership with SPORT1 that will bring a German-language version of Impact to the network. The show will air starting November 3 with exclusive commentary and localization as part of TNA's ongoing global expansion across Europe. TNA President Carlos called Germany an important market for the promotion and expressed excitement about the collaboration.

title: Dustin Rhodes Wants Recently Released WWE Talent in AEW
raw_title: Dustin Rhodes Wants Recently Released WWE Talent in AEW
body: 0 Dustin Rhodes is campaigning for Jimmy House to join AEW following the wrestler’s departure from WWE ID . House, who wrestled as CJ Valor during his time with WWE, confirmed his departure from the ID program earlier this month. He signed with the program in March 2026 after participating in WWE tryouts in Orlando in January. He subsequently competed on WWE EVOLVE. Following his departure, House reflected positively on his time with WWE and thanked the people who helped him during his stint with the promotion. “What a phenomenal time it was wrestling on Evolve and learning from so many amazing coaches in WWE. Incredibly grateful for the friendships built, memories made and lessons learned. Excited to see what the next chapter has in store for me,” House posted . House also expressed appreciation for the support he received from wrestling fans and the opportunity to learn from WWE’s coaches. Responding to a recent interview between House and Fightful’s Sean Ross Sapp, Rhodes praised the wrestler and endorsed a potential move to AEW. “My boy. @coachjimmyhouse would be a great addition to the @aew locker room. One of a kind, genuine person, work ethic and prep, unmatched. Explosive as hell and would absolutely love to see my student in #AEW,” Rhodes wrote on X . It is worth noting that House has trained under Rhodes and competed for his Rhodes Wrestling Association promotion, making the AEW veteran both a mentor and an advocate for his career. Whether House eventually joins AEW remains to be seen. For now, Rhodes has made it clear that he believes his student would be a valuable addition to the roster. title: Sami Zayn Unsure About Retirement and Life After Wrestling
raw_title: Sami Zayn Opens Up About Retirement Plans And Life After Wrestling
body: Sami Zayn has no specific retirement age in mind and remains uncertain about what he wants to do after his wrestling career ends. The Undisputed WWE Champion discussed his future on Chris Van Vliet’s Insight podcast. Zayn admitted that wrestling has been such a massive part of his life that stepping away might prove difficult. When asked whether he had a retirement age in mind, Zayn said he hadn’t figured out either the timing or what would come next. “Not only do I not know the answer to that. The other thing that I think about a lot is I don’t really know what I want to do when I’m done, because there are times I’m like, you know what sounds so nice?” Sami Zayn explained that part of him would enjoy a quieter lifestyle after years in the wrestling business. He mentioned spending more time outdoors, tending to a garden, and disconnecting from his phone. However, he also acknowledged that he might struggle to leave wrestling behind completely. “Just taking care of a garden, just like really slowing down the pace of life and kicking my iPhone into a lake and just really slowing down and living the way humans are meant to live. But also the problem is, it’s in my blood. This has been my life. So after a month, I might start climbing the walls, and it’s like, no, I need to be behind the wheel. I need to be doing three-hour drives. I need to be getting on planes, maybe I need to be performing in some capacity because it’s what I’ve done.” He is currently in his second reign as Undisputed WWE Champion . He is scheduled to defend the championship against Trick Williams on the October 30 episode of SmackDown. The winner would face World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns at Crown Jewel on November 7 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for the Men’s Crown Jewel Championship.

title: Tessa Blanchard and Keyra Set for Double MLW Debut

body: RIO RANCHO, N.M. — Tessa Blanchard has an opponent for her Major League Wrestling debut. MLW has announced that she will face Keyra at Saturday Night SuperFight on Saturday, November 7, 2026, at Cicero Stadium in Chicago. The event begins at 8 p.m. ET and will stream on VEEPS. MLW says the venue is sold out. Keyra will also be making her first appearance for the promotion, giving the matchup two debuting competitors looking to establish themselves in the women’s division. The opponent announcement adds the next detail to Blanchard’s arrival. FightBook MMA previously covered her announced appearance at Saturday Night SuperFight , when her opponent had not yet been revealed. Keyra is now confirmed for that assignment. Known as the “Undeniable Diamond,” Blanchard enters the match with international championship experience. MLW highlighted her CMLL World Women’s Tag Team Championship victory alongside Lluvia and her Women’s International Grand Prix win in its announcement. Those accomplishments provide the background to Blanchard’s first MLW match. Against Keyra, she will have an opportunity to turn the attention surrounding her arrival into an opening victory for the promotion. Keyra’s appearance is more than an opponent assignment for Blanchard. It also introduces the luchadora to MLW, with the promotion emphasizing her striking and explosive offense ahead of the contest. While Blanchard’s arrival has been the focus of the buildup, Keyra will have the same opportunity to leave an impression on the women’s division. A victory would put her own debut at the center of the story. The announcement presents the match as a meeting between two newcomers to MLW. It does not announce a championship at stake or designate the contest as a title eliminator. Saturday Night SuperFight takes place November 7 at Cicero Stadium in Chicago. The announced start time is 8 p.m. ET, with the event available on VEEPS. Blanchard vs. Keyra is one announced matchup, not the complete event lineup. title: Tessa Blanchard Debuts at Saturday Night SuperFight LIVE on VEEPS
raw_title: Tessa Blanchard Debuts at Saturday Night SuperFight LIVE on VEEPS
body: A super debut has been set for MLW Saturday Night SuperFight on November 7 live on Pay-Per-View as Tessa Blanchard is coming to Major League Wrestling. A standout member of the CMLL roster, Blanchard will make her highly anticipated MLW debut at Saturday Night SuperFight on Saturday, November 7, live from the sold-out Cicero Stadium in Chicago, streaming worldwide on pay-per-view exclusively on VEEPS. Fans can pre-order Saturday Night SuperFight now . CMLL INFORMA, Consejo Mundial de Lucha Libre’s official weekly news and interview program, broke the news last night, setting the stage for the Undeniable Diamond’s arrival at MLW’s signature pay-per-view. Fiercely driven and impossible to overlook, Tessa Blanchard is a diamond forged under pressure: brilliant, unbreakable and always ready to cut through the competition in MLW. “Heavy is the crown, but legacy isn’t handed to you… it’s forged under pressure,” said Blanchard. “I’ve earned my place as one of the best in the world at what I do, but I’m not coming to MLW to rest on the Blanchard name. MLW is bringing some of the purest, hardest-hitting action in the sport today, and the Undeniable Diamond belongs right at the top of it.” Tessa’s opponent for MLW Saturday Night SuperFight will be announced in the days ahead. Born and raised in the Carolinas, Blanchard now calls Mexico City home. Known throughout Mexico as La Gringa Más Mexicana, she has become a standout on CMLL’s roster, competing on one of wrestling’s most demanding stages at CMLL’s legendary Arena México. Immersion in lucha libre has sharpened the timing, adaptability and instincts of an already formidable competitor. A third-generation wrestler, Blanchard carries a legacy forged by father Tully Blanchard and grandfather Joe Blanchard. The family name may have created expectations, but Tessa’s accomplishments have established an identity all her own. Now she brings that ambition to MLW on a night built for big fights and bitter grudges… and now super debuts.

body: WWE Viewership for "WWE Raw" on Netflix continues to stay consistent in the leadup to WWE Survivor Series: WarGames at the end of next month. The October 19 edition of the show ended in a big way, with World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns finally coming out to confront the 946 with the rest of the Bloodline, ending the show with a brawl. According to Wrestlenomics , with data from Netflix , the October 19 episode of the red brand drew 2.5 million global views over the course of a week, the same number of views for the October 12 show . A total of 4.3 million hours of the show were viewed across the seven-day period, down slightly from the previous week's 4.5 million hours. The episode ranked ninth for the week globally amongst English TV shows and sixth in the United States. The episode was up from the eighth spot on the domestic chart from the previous week. The top three shows in the states included season one of "From," season three of "Nobody Wants This," and "Love is Blind." Reigns bookended the show in very different ways, starting off by going face-to-face with Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn ahead of their Crown Jewel match set for November 7. When Zayn refused to help Reigns and the Bloodline, as an Honorary Uce, against 946, Reigns ran the fellow champion down. At the end of the night, the "OTC" came out once again to kick off a brawl between his family and the opposing faction. Elsewhere on the show, Chad Gable successfully defended his Intercontinental Championship against Rey Mysterio and Dragon Lee. Penta defeated Bron Breakker, and the team of WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green and IYO SKY defeated Women's Intercontinental Champion Raquel Rodriguez and Roxanne Perez.

title: CJ Perry & Rusev Announce That They’re Expecting Their First Child Together
raw_title: CJ Perry & Rusev Announce That They’re Expecting Their First Child Together
body: In some fitting news on Rusev Day of all days, the WWE Superstar and his real-life wife , former WWE Superstar CJ Perry (formerly Lana), announced that they’re expecting their first child together. Rusev and Perry announced the news in an interview with People . The couple revealed that they started IVF last year, and they recently attempted an embryo transfer in August. Perry explained, “We started IVF in 2025, and on August 10, 2026, we had our embryo transfer. We were so nervous. We had to wait nine days for our first pregnancy test on August 19, followed by another on August 21 to confirm the pregnancy.” Speaking on the IVF process, Perry continued, “You start with so much hope. As you wait to see how many embryos continue developing through day three and then day five, the numbers can get smaller. Then comes the wait for the genetic testing results. Every stage feels like another hurdle.” She added, “Our first embryo to come back with normal genetic testing results was a boy, and he was the one we transferred. When they gave me the option to find out the sex, I wanted to know immediately! There’s so much uncertainty during IVF that I wanted as much information as possible.” Perry and Rusev (real name Miro Barnyashev) are expecting a son, whom they have decided to name Bear Petrov Barnyashev. Rusev said about their son’s name, “Ten years ago, I had a vision of naming our son Bear, and we chose his middle name to honor my father. Bear will be his first grandson.” Perry is due to give birth on April 28, 2027, which will make it a most glorious of Rusev Days. On behalf of 411, we congratulate CJ Perry and Rusev on their child and wish them another happy Rusev Day.

Max Caster , the rapping lightning rod long associated with All Elite Wrestling (AEW), made a hotly anticipated Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) debut at Bound For Glory on Sunday, only to see the occasion eclipsed by a single line in his entrance rap. By Monday, reports of backstage displeasure had begun to circulate, followed by an official statement from TNA apologizing for Caster's remarks and announcing that he would no longer be wrestling for the company. TNA Bound For Glory 2026 took place on Sunday, October 11, 2026, at the Yuengling Center in Tampa, Florida. In the lead-up to the event, Moose issued an Open Challenge, which was accepted by Caster, whose contract with AEW expired earlier in the month. Caster accepted the match in the form of a rap video posted on social media site X, and the wrestling world, or at least the portion of it that pays attention to TNA, waited to see what the self-appointed "best wrestler in the world" would do in his TNA debut. Ultimately, Caster delivered one of his trademark freestyle entrance raps before the bout, but Moose prevailed, securing the victory with a spear in a serviceable but not extraordinary match that would prove to be Caster's first and only in the company. The entrance rap, in which Caster drops a few verses filled with wrestling and pop culture references pulled from recent headlines, was a hallmark of his early AEW tenure as a member of former tag team champions The Acclaimed. Caster continued the performance as part of his more recent heel gimmick, but no doubt the rhymes were expected to be a crowd-pleaser for TNA. Things took a predictable turn, however, when Caster referenced a recent attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, that killed 14 people, part of the ongoing war in the Middle East started by WWE Hall of Famer President Donald Trump . Caster said during his entrance rap : "And it's the firing squad. I drop bombs. You don't even have to fly to Riyadh." Of note, TNA's senior partner in a promotional relationship, WWE, has a show scheduled for Riyadh next month, though under current circumstances, it's unknown whether it will take place as advertised at this time. Fightful's social media summary said that TNA executives were reportedly unhappy with an unscripted, unapproved line referencing Riyadh. raw_title: Major Update On Bruce Prichard's WWE Future
summary_src: A major update on WWE backstage executive Bruce Prichard's future with the company was reported on Tuesday.
body: WWE A major name behind-the-scenes in WWE is set to depart the company next year following WWE WrestleMania 43, according to a new report. PWInsider reported on Tuesday that, as confirmed by multiple sources, Bruce Prichard, executive director of creative writing and talent, is set to retire from his role in WWE following next year's "Showcase of the Immortals." According to PWInsider, Prichard will remain connected to WWE as a consultant after leaving his current role. A source noted that while Prichard's current run with the company is rumored to end with WrestleMania, things could always change, as is the nature of the industry. Prichard began his professional wrestling career at just 10 years old, starting by selling posters for Paul Boesch's Houston Wrestling in 1973. He started working for the then-WWFW in 1987, occasionally as an announcer, before creating his Brother Love gimmick. He was let go from the company after the character was retired in early 1991, but would return in August 1992 as Vince McMahon's "right-hand man" behind-the-scenes , as well as in a writer position, in addition to returning as a new on-screen character. He was released once again in 2008, and worked for TNA and MLW before his final return to the company in 2019, when he joined WWE's creative team. As of June 2020, Prichard holds the position of executive director of both "WWE Raw" and "WWE SmackDown." According to PWI's report, it's believed that writers in "WWE NXT" also fall under Prichard's management. The outlet also reported there is currently no word on who will take up Prichard's current role when he departs the company.
summary: PWInsider reports that multiple sources confirm Bruce Prichard, WWE's executive director of creative writing and talent, is set to retire from his position following WrestleMania 43 next year. He will stay on with the company as a consultant afterward. While the plan is for his current run to conclude after the event, sources note that plans in the industry can always shift.

body: Bruce Prichard is expected to retire as WWE's Executive Director of Creative Writing & Talent after WrestleMania 43 in April 2027 and stay on as a consultant, PWInsider reports. Bruce Prichard is expected to step down from his role as WWE’s Executive Director of Creative Writing & Talent after WrestleMania 43, according to a report from PWInsider’s Mike Johnson . Johnson reported that multiple sources confirmed Prichard, 63, plans to retire from the position after WrestleMania season. Prichard would stay connected to the company as a consultant but would no longer live in Stamford, Connecticut, where WWE is headquartered, or keep his current duties. One source told PWInsider that WrestleMania is the end of the run, while another said there could be some leeway on the timeline. WrestleMania 43 is scheduled for April 10 and 11, 2027, in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. WWE has not announced any change to Prichard’s role, and there is no word yet on who would take over. Per the report, WWE’s three writing teams for Raw, SmackDown and NXT currently fall under Prichard in the company’s creative hierarchy. Prichard broke into the business under Houston promoter Paul Boesch. In WWE in the late 1980s and 1990s, he played Brother Love on television and was the original manager of The Undertaker, but his main work was backstage as one of Vince McMahon’s top producers and lieutenants. He left WWE in 2008 and later worked for Impact Wrestling and MLW. In 2016, he started the Something to Wrestle With podcast with Conrad Thompson, which became one of the most popular wrestling podcasts and was adapted into a series for the WWE Network. JBL now co-hosts the show with Thompson most weeks, with Prichard still appearing. Prichard returned to WWE full-time in 2019 in a top creative position, working under McMahon and later under Paul “Triple H” Levesque, who became Chief Content Officer in 2022. His duties have included running TV tapings when Levesque is not present. Prichard was away from his role for a stretch earlier this year after WrestleMania 42. title: Comeback Watch: John Cena Vows to Make Blockbuster Announcement in WWE Return
raw_title: John Cena Vows to Make Blockbuster Announcement in WWE Return
body: The 17-time World Champion is not only returning to WWE’s flagship show, but he also plans to make a major announcement . The former Royal Rumble winner shared a cryptic message on X (formerly Twitter), declaring that he has blockbuster news to share in his WWE return. “Make sure not to miss #WWERaw next week,” he wrote . “SPECIAL START TIME OF 6PM EST! The wait is over, the speculation ends 11/2 . Let’s build this “Never Seen” CLASSIC! OUR time is NOW!” Cena’s social media post seems to be alluding to the “ John Cena Classic ” that he announced in May at WWE Backlash: Tampa. The WWE icon shared at Backlash that a new WWE tournament, the John Cena Classic , would soon be held annually. The John Cena Classic will be a showcase that includes rising NXT talent and current WWE stars. “I’m so honored to announce to you the John Cena Classic. An entire evening of the best of today competing against the best of tomorrow ,” he announced at Backlash: Tampa . “An entire event where WWE superstars and NXT superstars give you all that they have in hopes to be crowned a champion.” Cena added that a brand-new WWE championship would be introduced for the event. “We are making history. We have a brand-new event and the debut of a brand-new championship in the WWE.” WWE has been relatively mum about the new tournament since Cena’s exciting announcement at Backlash. The promotion has yet to announce when or where the tournament will be held, or how WWE and NXT stars can qualify for the tournament. One thing we do know about the forthcoming tournament is that the WWE Universe will be integral to determining its winner. “I have said time and time again, the biggest superstar in the WWE is the WWE Universe,” Cena said in May . “So, on top of a new championship and on top of a new event. For the first time in history, your voice will be heard louder than ever before. Because you, the audience, will vote to crown the champion of the John Cena Classic .” Fan voting has scarcely been used throughout WWE history. Its last notable use was Cyber Sunday, a Ruthless Aggression-era PLE in which fans voted on match participants and stipulations. For the first time, WWE also recently used fan voting to choose the cover athlete of WWE 2K27 . Voting for the WWE 2K27 cover athlete was open exclusively to Club WWE members and closed earlier this month. The winner has not yet been revealed. Regarding the John Cena Classic, little is known about the design of the new championship belt Cena mentioned. Instead of being a mainstay championship, the John Cena Classic belt could be similar to the Crown Jewel Championship belt, which is awarded at the titular PLE but scarcely worn by the winner after the event. Perhaps, in true John Cena fashion, a new spinner belt will be introduced. For now, we’ll have to wait until Nov. 2 to see what the “Never Seen” superstar has to say about the forthcoming tournament. title: Sami Zayn Names Bloodline Story As Career Peak Before Title Win
raw_title: Sami Zayn Says Bloodline Involvement Was His Career Peak Before Becoming WWE Champion
summary_src: WWE's Sami Zayn explains why his work in The Bloodline saga had been the proudest of his career up until his first world title win.
body: At WWE Night of Champions 2026, Sami Zayn reached a career high when he dethroned "The American Nightmare" Cody Rhodes as the Undisputed WWE Champion. The victory not only brought about Zayn's first world title reign in WWE, but also eclipsed another major peak. During an interview with "Insight With Chris Van Vliet," Zayn explained why his work in The Bloodline saga had been his proudest up until that point. "Probably Bloodline stuff [was the career peak]," Zayn said. "I think that's probably what I'd be best remembered for if my career ended before I won the world title or whatever; it might still be what I'm most remembered for 20 years from now if people remember anything about me 20 years from now. But I was also just very proud of it. But I've had so many things throughout my career. I'm just giving you the answer of what I think would be best remembered, but also simultaneously something I'm extremely proud of, but there's a ton of stuff in my career I'm extremely proud of." Zayn's involvement with The Bloodline stretches back to the spring of 2022, when an on-screen need for approval prompted him to align with the Samoan stable. Despite initial hesitations from The Bloodline members, he then gradually won them and the WWE Universe over, so much so that he was officially hailed the "Honorary Uce." His popularity also convinced WWE officials to extend his Bloodline run, according to reports. "My intent in the beginning was more to be kind of like on the periphery, [but] it evolved," Zayn said, "and that's part of the beauty of it. Part of why I loved it so much is the week-to-week adaptation. I had some ideas and I had an overarching blueprint, which more or less kind of came to fruition, which starts here and ends in a championship match eventually down the road with Roman. That's kind of the blueprint in your head, but some of the week-to-week stuff that you don't account for, those are just gifts that fall into your lap, and then it's playing with those gifts." For months, Zayn had clawed to gain the acceptance of "The Tribal Chief" Roman Reigns and one of his right-hand men, Jey Uso, on WWE programming. Still, he remained captivatingly dedicated in his mission, which eventually led to the former formally embracing him on the September 23, 2022 episode of "WWE SmackDown" in Salt Lake City. Uso did the same two months later when he saw the former NXT Champion prove his allegiance to The Bloodline in a grueling WarGames Match at Survivor Series. Fast forward to the 2023 Royal Rumble, and WWE fans saw a much different scene playing out. Following Reigns' successful Undisputed WWE Championship defense over Kevin Owens, The Bloodline sought to further the damage with a post-match attack. Zayn, however, refused to participate and shockingly struck Reigns in the back with a steel chair . title: Backstage Buzz: WWE’s Crown Jewel Plans May Depend on What Happens on Saturday — Report
raw_title: WWE’s Crown Jewel Plans May Depend on What Happens on Saturday — Report
body: 0 WWE’s plans for Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia could depend on what happens at a major boxing event this Saturday. Despite recent security concerns in the region, the company is reportedly proceeding with its upcoming PLE as planned. How smoothly the boxing event goes could help WWE and its parent company, TKO Group Holdings, understand the security and travel challenges involved in holding a major event in Riyadh. According to Dave Meltzer on Wrestling Observer Radio , WWE is expected to travel to Saudi Arabia unless something serious happens before November 3. The October 31 boxing event headlined by Canelo Alvarez and Christian Mbilli could play an important role in the company’s decision. “Unless something catastrophic happens between now and next Tuesday, they’re going,” Meltzer said. He pointed to Saturday’s boxing event in Riyadh as an important sign of how things are going in the region. Most of the fighters have reportedly traveled to Saudi Arabia, although some have been unwilling to make the trip. “There’s a boxing match on Saturday with Canelo Alvarez. One of the boxers, Lindolfo Delgado, he pulled out. He said he’s not going, but everybody else went. Meltzer also described how the rest of the fighters got to Riyadh,” Meltzer said. Meltzer also discussed how some members of the boxing event changed their travel plans because of security concerns. He added that no incidents had come to light at the time of his comments. “A lot of them flew into Bahrain airport to avoid the Riyadh airport, and then driven five hours to get to Riyadh. There’s been no incidents today. Everyone’s saying it’s great, the security is great, that everything is fine,” Meltzer said However, the lack of reported incidents does not guarantee that the situation will remain the same. Saturday’s boxing event could give WWE a clearer picture of whether a major sporting event can take place safely under the current situation. WWE also has to consider the safety of its wrestlers, staff, production crews, and other personnel traveling to Saudi Arabia. “If something bad happens to the boxing show, yeah, they probably won’t go. But if nothing happens, they’re going,” Meltzer added. WWE’s Crown Jewel 2026 is scheduled for November 7 at Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD. That is just four days after the November 3 cutoff mentioned by Meltzer. The post WWE’s Crown Jewel Plans May Depend on What Happens on Saturday — Report appeared first on Wrestlezone .

title: On the Record: Matt Hardy Opens Up On WWE’s Punishment After Jeff Hardy Rejected Creative Plans
raw_title: Matt Hardy Reveals WWE’s Punishment After Jeff Hardy Rejected Creative Plans
body: 0 Matt Hardy has revealed that WWE took the Hardy Boyz off television after Jeff Hardy refused to participate in certain creative plans in late 2001. During an interview with The Stunner’s Graham Hartmann , Matt discussed the period when WWE began teasing a split between the brothers. Although the storyline suggested that the team could be heading toward a breakup, the situation behind the scenes emerged complicated. Matt explained that WWE had creative plans for the brothers, but Jeff was uncomfortable with some of the proposed material. As a result, the Hardy Boyz disappeared from television for a period while continuing to work live events. Matt believes the team was not ready to separate at the time. Ultimately, WWE eventually reunited the brothers without revisiting the storyline on television. Matt pushed back against the suggestion that WWE had no storyline planned for the Hardy Boyz even though the brothers began fighting on screen. “There was a storyline for our characters, and they wanted us to split up. And there was a couple things that we were asked to do, and Jeff was uncomfortable and didn’t want to do it,” Matt explained. Matt Hardy said the brothers were subsequently removed from television, although they continued to appear at live events. “So, we were off TV for a while, as a ‘punishment,’ I guess, but we still did live events,” he recalled. Hartmann then asked Matt whether he could reveal what WWE had proposed that made Jeff uncomfortable. Matt confirmed that there was a specific idea Jeff had rejected, but he declined to explain it publicly. “Uh, yes, but nothing I can say on here because I would like to stay married,” Matt said. The Hardy Boyz eventually returned to television as a team. Matt explained that they understood they were not yet ready to pursue separate careers. So WWE brought them back together without continuing the breakup angle. The post Matt Hardy Reveals WWE’s Punishment After Jeff Hardy Rejected Creative Plans appeared first on Wrestlezone .

title: Bruce Prichard to retire from full-time WWE role in 2027
raw_title: Bruce Prichard reportedly planning to retire from WWE in 2027
body: By Jason Powell , ProWrestling.net Editor ( @prowrestlingnet ) One of WWE’s top executives is planning to retire from working full-time. Bruce Prichard is expected to give up his position as Executive Director of Creative Writing & Talent after next year’s WrestleMania 43 season. Mike Johnson of PWInsider.com broke the news and added that Prichard plans to continue working for WWE as a consultant. Prichard got his start in pro wrestling in Paul Boesch’s Houston promotion. He joined WWE/WWF in 1987 and debuted the Brother Love character the following year. Prichard left the company in 1991, but he returned a year later and was a member of Vince McMahon’s inner circle until he was fired in 2008. Prichard worked for TNA and MLW before returning to WWE in 2018, and has been with the company ever since. Powell’s POV: Prichard has been one of the most powerful players in WWE over the years. I remember several people in WWE predicting that Prichard would be among the first people fired if Stephanie McMahon and Paul Levesque ever took control of the company. Obviously, that never happened, as Prichard maintained a high-ranking position after Vince McMahon sold the company. It will be interesting to see who takes over Prichard’s job when the time comes. For that matter, it will be interesting to see if Prichard will be more involved in the Something to Wrestle with Bruce Prichard podcast once he retires. Thanks to Kylin from McDonough, Georgia, for passing along the story.
summary: Bruce Prichard plans to step down as Executive Director of Creative Writing & Talent after WrestleMania 43 according to PWInsider.com. He will remain with WWE in a consultant capacity. Prichard first joined the company in 1987, created the Brother Love character, had multiple runs including time in Vince McMahon's inner circle, worked for TNA and MLW in between, and has been back with WWE since 2018.

title: Matt Hardy Reveals Near-Total Control Over Broken Gimmick in TNA
raw_title: Matt Hardy Says WWE Return Cost Him Near-Complete Creative Control in TNA
body: Skip to content Wrestling News Home » Matt Hardy Says WWE Return Cost Him Near-Complete Creative Control in TNA Matt Hardy has revealed that he was close to gaining almost complete creative control over his Broken gimmick in TNA Wrestling before he and Jeff Hardy decided to return to WWE. During an interview with The Stunner’s Graham Hartmann , Hardy explained that he had significant input into the gimmick. Moreover, he was nearing a point where he would have gained almost complete control over its direction. Hardy also recalled disagreements surrounding the brothers’ contracts and creative plans. This ultimately contributed to their decision to leave TNA and return to WWE in 2017. The Broken Universe became one of the most distinctive character presentations in modern professional wrestling, helping Hardy reinvent himself during his time away from WWE. During the interview, Hardy responded to a Wikipedia claim that he had full creative control over the Broken gimmick while working for TNA. He clarified that the arrangement was more collaborative, with input from both sides. “That’s not fully correct. I worked with Jeremy Borash, who was like our guy, and while I was at home, I definitely had very much input,” Hardy explained. Hardy said TNA officials would sometimes suggest a direction for the character. Nevertheless, he remained heavily involved in shaping its presentation and storylines. He added that, had he stayed with the promotion, he would likely have gained almost complete creative control. “You know, they would say, like, we’re hoping to go in this direction,” Hardy said. He then recalled circumstances that contributed to the Hardys’ decision to leave TNA, including a disagreement with Jeff Jarrett and discussions about changing their previously agreed-upon financial terms. “If I would have stayed, though, I would have probably had almost complete creative control. I’d been very close to it,” Hardy added. The Hardy Boyz returned to WWE at WrestleMania 33 in April 2017, making a surprise appearance during the RAW Tag Team Championship match. Their return came on the back of a successful run in TNA, where Matt’s Broken character gained considerable attention and acclaim. As of this writing, Matt and Jeff Hardy remain under contract with TNA. Manik Aftab is a Pro-Wrestling writer at WrestleZone, Evolve Media, covering the latest developments across the sport. Since 2021, he has been covering WWE, AEW, TNA, and major premium live events and pay-per-views. He specializes in reporting on breaking wrestling news, live event results, and developing storylines. Manik holds a degree in English Literature, which complements his strong background in research and precise reporting.
summary: Matt Hardy explained that he had major creative input on his Broken character in TNA and was approaching a deal for nearly full control when he and Jeff Hardy chose to leave for WWE in 2017. He described the process as collaborative rather than granting him complete autonomy as some sources claimed. Hardy also cited contract disagreements and differing creative visions as factors in their departure.

title: Kyle Fletcher Names The Miz As Promo Inspiration
raw_title: AEW's Kyle Fletcher Cites The Miz As An Influence
summary_src: Former TNT Champion Kyle Fletcher explains how WWE star The Miz's verbal mastery has directly influenced his current work in AEW.
body: AEW star Kyle Fletcher has made a name for himself in the ring, but he also recognizes the importance of mastering the microphone. When it comes to promo skills, Fletcher looks to an unlikely source for inspiration: WWE veteran The Miz. During a recent interview with the "Battleground Podcast," Fletcher explained how Miz's verbal expertise has directly influenced his current work in AEW. "I think how much he interacts with the crowd, and not just in a sense of turning to the crowd and yelling at them or whatever," Fletcher said. "A lot of people go into promos and nowadays, I don't want to say people using scripts, but there's a lot of people that have their stuff written for them and they memorize it and they go out there and they say it. That works for some people. It's great. The Miz, it's him, it's Cena, it's all these different guys, they might not know anything that they're going to say when they go out there, and then it's literally all impacted by how the crowd's reacting and what they're doing. I think that's something that I definitely looked at, I was inspired by, and something that I've tried to do in my own stuff." As a performer, Fletcher admitted that overthinking comes quite naturally, especially in relation to promos, which is why some memorize their promos in-depth ahead of time. Seeing The Miz's successful spontaneity has inspired him to do the opposite, however, and furthermore, trust in his speaking abilities. The Miz has cut a number of impassioned promos during his 20-plus year WWE career, including his now infamous firestorm on "Talking Smack" in 2016 . Since turning heel, shaving his head , and joining The Don Callis Family in 2024, Fletcher has delivered speeches of a similar style while also making them his own.
summary: AEW's Kyle Fletcher cited WWE's The Miz as a major influence on his microphone skills. In a recent interview, Fletcher highlighted how Miz interacts with the crowd and adapts his promos in real time based on audience reactions rather than relying on memorized scripts. He noted that this approach, also seen in performers like John Cena, has shaped his current work in AEW.

title: On the Record: Sami Zayn Opens Up On When He Thought His WWE Title Chance Was Gone
raw_title: Sami Zayn Reveals When He Thought His WWE Title Chance Was Gone
body: 0 Sami Zayn has finally reached the top of WWE after years of coming close. However, the two-time WWE Champion recently admitted that he thought his chance to win the company’s biggest title had passed earlier this year. Zayn shocked fans when he defeated Cody Rhodes to win the WWE Championship at Night of Champions in June. He did it again on the September 11 episode of SmackDown after beating CM Punk to become champion for the second time. But before those big wins, Sami Zayn struggled with the thought that he might never become world champion. Speaking on Insight with Chris Van Vliet, Zayn explained how losing to Drew McIntyre at the Royal Rumble earlier this year made him question whether he would ever reach the top. Zayn’s journey toward the WWE title has included several losses. One of the biggest came at Elimination Chamber 2023. There, he challenged Roman Reigns in front of his hometown crowd in Montreal. Fans strongly supported Zayn, but he failed to defeat the OTC. During the conversation, Zayn admitted he could have won that match and that there was a good reason to believe the title could change hands. However, WWE wanted Cody Rhodes to win the championship later. Zayn explained that Rhodes had a lot of momentum at the time. Now, looking back, he believes his own championship wins became even more rewarding because of how things turned out. Things became harder after Zayn lost to McIntyre at Royal Rumble this year. He had another chance to win the WWE Championship but could not get past the Scottish Warrior. “Here’s the thing that’s funny about it because even at the start of this year, which was nine months ago, ten months ago now, whatever, I was wrestling Drew, and I didn’t win. I had kind of just battled with it and went, you know what, maybe the ship sailed,” Zayn said (H/T: Chris Van Vliet ). After coming close to winning the championship several times, the WWE Champion started to wonder whether his opportunity had passed. “But the Cinderella story, underdog who finally wins the big one- we burnt that card; that card was done after losing to Drew because you can only tell that story so many times. You can get them on board once, twice, three times, and it wasn’t the right time. It wasn’t. I didn’t have the momentum that I had a year or two prior to that. But I had to kind of struggle to accept that maybe I just missed the window, slipped through the cracks, and it just won’t happen,” he said. Despite those doubts, his victory over Rhodes and then Punk proved that his first title win wasn’t a one-time fluke. However, Zayn admitted he would have been happy with his career even if he never won a world title. “I’ve had a tremendous career, and winning the world title at that point is just the cherry on top. It would be nice to have, but it’s not like if I never win it, it’s like I never [got it]. You know what I mean? title: WWE Raw Review: The Good, Bad and Ugly
raw_title: WWE Raw Review for Oct. 26: The Good, the Bad, and the Ugly
body: I've said before that Zayn has been one of the best things in wrestling in 2026, and that continued Monday night. Left to promote his upcoming match against Roman Reigns without the benefit of having Reigns on the show, Zayn delivered an excellent promo that led to Je'Von Evans coming out. While I continue to be underwhelmed by Evans on the mic, Zayn elevated the segment that led to an impromptu title match between the two. The match was strong with Evans' near falls getting the crowd into things. I didn't care for the finish where Penta came out (more on that later), but ultimately Zayn walked away with the retention. It's smart to get him some wins heading into his match with Reigns, which he'll almost certainly lose. If you watch nothing else from this show, make time to check out Sami's promo. Bayley and Lyra Valkyria had a really good match with some legitimately innovative spots that proved it's possible to have a hard-hitting grudge match without blood. Seeing Bayley get the win makes me think she's probably staying in WWE. Personally, I would've liked to see her make the jump to AEW, but if she's happy in WWE, more power to her. Lynch and Morgan have good in-ring chemistry, and this singles match was better than the triple threat with Stephanie Vaquer at Money in the Bank . Of course, it had to have the predictable screwy interference finish, but the lead-up to that was well worked. Ethan Page and Big Cass are a fun, old-school heel pairing with the craven smaller guy and the monster to hide behind. I didn't like Penta's booking on this show. He wandered out midmatch, complete with briefcase pyro, to what end? If you're going to cash in, wait until the match is done to maintain the element of surprise. If you're not, why are you there? To distract Zayn? Why? To help Evans? OK, why? So you can take the belt off him instead? Evans came out injured to show Penta respect, and the response is to become a distraction in the biggest match of his career? If you're Evans, you don't want Penta out there because he could take the title from you the second you win it. Then, after Evans lost, in part due to Breakker showing up, which only happened after Penta came out, the two are buddies in the back and looking to challenge for the WWE World Tag Team Championship? Why not have Penta ask Rey Fenix, his brother and the other half of a legendary tag team? I also thought it made Penta and Evans look weak to challenge Breakker and Austin Theory, who wasn't even there, rather than Bronson Reed. If this was the direction, have Zayn win by cheating, then have Penta come out and get laid out by Breakker and Theory. In terms of logic, this was a mess. The Tiffany Stratton almost cash-in was nearly a beat-for-beat recreation of one from her last run with the briefcase, right down to Dominik Mysterio carrying an incapacitated Morgan from the ring to save the belt. Yeesh. I watch college football. I've seen many games with Joe Tessitore on commentary. He does a f
summary: Sami Zayn delivered an excellent promo that built to an impromptu match against Je'Von Evans, which Zayn won to pick up momentum ahead of facing Roman Reigns. title: Major WWE Executive Expected To Exit After Wrestlemania 43 — Exclusive

body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin EXCLUSIVE: MAJOR WWE EXECUTIVE EXPECTED TO EXIT AFTER WRESTLEMANIA 43 By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-27 18:42:00 A major name within World Wrestling Entertainment is expected to exit full-time after Wrestlemania 43 next year, PWInsider.com can confirm. PWInsider.com has confirmed with multiple sources that Bruce Prichard is expected to retire from his position as Executive Director - Creative Writing & Talent (CWT) after Wrestlemania season. We are told Prichard, 63, would remain connected to the company on a consulting basis but would no longer live in Stamford or retain his current duties. One source pegged Wrestlemania as the end of the run, but another cautioned that with pro wrestling being the way it is, there could always be a little leeway on the timeline. In the 1990s, Prichard was best known to fans on camera as Brother Love but primarily worked behind the scenes directly with Vince McMahon as one of his top lieutenants and producers. Prichard left WWE in 2008 and went on to become the host of one of the most popular pro wrestling podcasts Something to Wrestle With , where Prichard and co-host Conrad Thompson did deep dives into events and personalities from WWE’s history. The podcast became so popular that a version of it was brought to the WWE Network for a series of episodes. JBL often co-hosts the show with Thompson currently, but Prichard does still make appearances. As PWInsider.com broke at the time, Prichard was brought back to World Wrestling Entertainment full-time in 2019 to work in a top creative position on the creative team, working directly with Vince McMahon and later, Paul Levesque on creative, including running TV tapings when Levesque was not present. The belief is currently that all three writing teams for Raw, Smackdown and NXT fall under Prichards in the hierarchy of WWE. There is no word yet who might succeed Prichard in his current role, but the company has a lot of time to get there before Wrestlemania this Spring. Prichard originally broke into the business under the legendary Paul Boesch and worked for Impact Wrestling and MLW after exiting WWE in 2008. llm_long: WWE Raw on Netflix drew 2.5 million global viewers for the episode that aired on Monday, October 19. The viewership total matched the previous week's figure and remained consistent with the numbers the show has posted over the past several months.

The episode accumulated 4.5 million global hours viewed, identical to the prior week and also in line with recent months of performance. The show included appearances by Roman Reigns and Sami Zayn along with a match between Penta and Bron Breakker.

The program ranked as a top ten show in nine countries and placed eighth in the United States.

title: Bruce Prichard Expected To Retire After WrestleMania 43
raw_title: Bruce Prichard Reportedly Expected To Retire Next Year
body: Bruce Prichard has been a major part of WWE for decades, and a new report says that may be largely coming to an end next year. PWInsider reports that Prichard is expected to retire from his position as Executive Director – Creative Writing & Talent following WrestleMania 43. The report notes that Prichard would remain in the orbit of WWE on a consulting basis, but that he would no longer live ion Stamford, Connecticut where WWE Headquarters is, nor retain his current position and duties. One source said that WrestleMania 43 would be the end of his run, though another noted that there may be, in the report’s words “a little leeway on the timeline.” Prichard has been part of the company on and off since 1987. He began working there as an announcer before becoming the heel manager Brother Love. When Brother Love’s time on TV came to an end, Prichard remained as a member of the backstage staff and worked with Vince McMahon as one of his top producers and creative team members. He exited the company in 2008 but returned in 2019 to work as part of the creative team. He took time away following WrestleMania 42 for health reasons, returning over the summer. The report notes that the belief backstage as of now that all three writing teams — Raw, Smackdown, and NXT — are under Prichard’s purview. He of course reports to Chief Creative Officer Triple H.
summary: PWInsider reports that Bruce Prichard is expected to retire from his role as Executive Director of Creative Writing and Talent following WrestleMania 43. He would stay connected to WWE in a consulting capacity but would no longer live in Stamford or hold his current position and responsibilities. Prichard has worked on and off with the company since 1987, starting as an announcer before becoming the on-screen character Brother Love and later serving as a key producer and creative team member under Vince McMahon.

title: Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Finals Set For NXT
raw_title: Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic Finals Set For Wednesday Edition Of WWE NXT
summary_src: The finals of the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic are set, and the match will take place on next week's Wednesday edition of "WWE NXT."
body: WWE Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar and Hank Walker and Tank Ledger will face off in the finals of the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic after victories over the NXT Tag Team Champions, the Vanity Project, and AAA World Tag Team Champions the Wagner Brothers, respectively, on "WWE NXT." Moreno and Dar shocked Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes, even after the team tried to injure Dar at an "NXT" live event. The champions looked to keep Dar and Moreno away from one another, downing Dar on the outside against the steps. Dar unleashed a flurry of offense once he was able to tag in, and tried for a quick rollup on Smokes. Baylor dropped Dar on his neck across the back of his knee, but Dar continued to battle on. The match descended into chaos that saw the teams knock down their own partners. Moreno broke up the pin after Vanity Project hit the Hit It and Quit It, and dodged the move at himself. Moreno and Dar hit a pair of spinning backfists to Smokes, and Dar pinned him for the win. El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno put up a good fight against Walker and Ledger, but couldn't get the job done. Galeno overpowered both men to start off, and helped his brother go flying over the top rope to take down the opposing team. Galeno hit both Walker and Ledger with a standing splash, but they rallied to hit a double team move of their own to Wagner Jr., which required Galeno to break up the pin. Wagner Jr. hit a moonsault to Walker, and Galeno followed up with a frog splash, but Ledger broke up the pin. Walker and Ledger hit shoulder tackles to Galeno, then both went to the top rope. They hit double splashes to the champion, and Ledger covered Galeno for the win.
summary: Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar defeated NXT Tag Team Champions Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes in a chaotic match on WWE NXT to advance. Hank Walker and Tank Ledger overcame AAA World Tag Team Champions El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno in the other semifinal. The two winning teams will meet in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic finals on the upcoming Wednesday edition of NXT.

body: WWE The feud between Myles Borne and Tavion Heights is about to get wilder. Ahead of their clash at "WWE NXT" Halloween Havoc, Tavion Heights and Myles Borne went bar-for-bar on the microphone on Tuesday night's "NXT" broadcast. Borne accused Heights of leeching onto him, which in turn caused the former NXT North American Champion to lose everything in 2026. Heights, meanwhile, claimed that he had forgotten who he was along the way. Borne's betrayal at "NXT" Heatwave seemingly woke up the former Olympian, with him now declaring himself as one who thrives under pressure when his back is against the ropes and there's no one else to lean on. Heights further vowed to show Borne that he is not what his former tag team partner once thought, but rather a "weapon in human form" and the "God of suplexes." As security guards desperately tried to keep Borne and Heights from getting physical, Danhausen's laugh echoed throughout the WWE Performance Center. As host of the Halloween Havoc, the face-painted character then instructed his druids to spin the wheel to determine Heights and Borne's upcoming match stipulation. Among the options were Last Man Standing, Trick or Street Fight, Ambulance Match, and a Biker's Chain Match. The wheel ultimately landed on Weapons Wild, which means the former No Quarter Catch Crew members will battle it out with no rules and an array of weapons at Halloween Havoc. Pinfall or submissions in the ring are the only way to win. "NXT" Halloween Havoc will emanate from the WWE PC on Saturday, October 31.

title: WWE Exec Expected To Leave Full-Time Role After WrestleMania 43 — Report
raw_title: WWE Exec Expected To Leave Full-Time Role After WrestleMania 43 — Report
body: 0 WWE could be preparing for a significant change to its creative team following WrestleMania 43, with a veteran executive reportedly approaching the end of his current run. The development could reshape the company’s behind-the-scenes structure, although his connection to WWE may not end entirely. According to PWInsider’s Mike Johnson , multiple sources expect Bruce Prichard to step away from his position as Executive Director of Creative Writing and Talent after WrestleMania 43 in 2027. The report notes that the timeline is not final and could change. Prichard, 63, is expected to remain with WWE in a consulting capacity after leaving his full-time position. However, he would no longer handle his existing creative responsibilities or live in Stamford, Connecticut, according to the report. WWE has yet to identify a potential successor. Prichard’s expected departure would leave a major question mark over the structure overseeing the company’s RAW, SmackDown, and NXT writing teams. Prichard first entered the wrestling business in 1973, selling posters for Houston Wrestling under promoter Paul Boesch. He joined the then-WWF in 1987 and became widely recognized on screen as Brother Love, while also working behind the scenes. After leaving WWE in 2008, Prichard worked with TNA and MLW and became known for the wrestling-history podcast Something to Wrestle With. He returned to WWE full-time in 2019 and took on a senior creative position, later becoming executive director of RAW and SmackDown in June 2020. His work has placed him among the key figures involved in shaping WWE television, making the reported change notable beyond a simple title swap. Still, the report does not specify a reason for his expected exit, and it remains unclear who could step into his role. For now, WrestleMania 43 is the reported marker for Prichard’s move away from full-time duties. Until WWE confirms the plan, the company’s creative future remains a story to watch — with the next chapter potentially taking shape behind the curtain. title: On the Record: Dave Meltzer Speaks On WWE Crown Jewel’s Status Amid Relocation Speculation
raw_title: Dave Meltzer Addresses WWE Crown Jewel’s Status Amid Relocation Speculation
body: Dave Meltzer believes WWE Crown Jewel will take place in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, on November 7 unless a major security incident forces the company to reconsider. Speaking on Wrestling Observer Radio , Meltzer said WWE and TKO appear committed to holding the premium live event at Riyadh Season Stadium. His latest assessment suggests relocation is unlikely unless something disastrous happens in the coming days. Meltzer explained (via Wrestling Inc ), “Unless something happens, catastrophic, between now and next Tuesday, they’re going.” He noted that people involved with the Canelo Álvarez boxing card had reported strong security and no incidents. Many attendees reportedly flew to Bahrain, then drove five hours to Riyadh. When a listener asked if TKO executives might attend Crown Jewel, Meltzer said Nick Khan might travel to Saudi Arabia with WWE. However, he does not expect TKO CEO Ari Emanuel or members of the Board of Directors to attend. Meltzer continued, “Ari is the one making the choice and he’s probably too busy to go, unless he’s got some meetings there. I doubt he would go. I mean, I don’t know if Nick would go or not and it’s immaterial, it’s not his choice.” Emanuel previously addressed the situation, confirming that the company is monitoring conditions daily. He said “nothing’s been canceled” and that WWE has a team assessing where it can move the show if it gets canceled. – ستيج ضخم قادم. – بداية العمل على الساحة الخارجية وقرية WWE.

Mike Johnson at PWInsider reports that “Bruce Prichard is expected to retire from his position as Executive Director – Creative Writing & Talent (CWT) after WrestleMania season.” The report continues, noting that Prichard “would remain connected to the company on a consulting basis but would no longer live in Stamford or retain his current duties,” and there could be leeway with the timeline. Prichard has worked in WWE on and off beginning in 1987, working on TV as Brother Love and in various roles behind the scenes. He has been back with the company as executive director since 2018, working alongside Vince McMahon and now Triple H. He is reportedly set to undergo neck surgery. You can learn more here . Fightful Select will have more details on Prichard’s future when they are known.

title: WWE Books John Cena For NXT Appearance
raw_title: WWE Announces John Cena's NXT Return
summary_src: Following the announcement he'll appear on next Monday's "WWE Raw," it was also revealed the star will be live on "WWE NXT" when it airs on Wednesday next week.
body: WWE After it was revealed on Monday's edition of "WWE Raw" that John Cena will be making an appearance live on the red brand next week, Tuesday's episode of "WWE NXT" also saw the news that the "Never Seen 17" will be appearing on the show next week. The news comes after reports that WWE is trying to load up the show , as it's set to go head-to-head with "AEW Dynamite: Blood & Guts" due to election coverage Tuesday on the CW Network. Commentary revealed on the show that Cena will be live at the WWE Performance Center next week, and the graphic and clip were also posted to WWE's X (formerly Twitter) account . Following the "Raw" announcement, Cena himself took to social media to announce that his appearances are related to the John Cena Classic , a tournament where, according to the star, "NXT" talent will go up against main roster stars, and fans will vote for a standout. "The wait is over, the speculation ends 11/2. Let's build this 'Never Seen' CLASSIC! OUR time is NOW!" Cena posted to X on Tuesday morning. If Cena is clarifying just what the John Cena Classic is on "Raw," it's likely he could announce "NXT" competitors, or how stars can win their way into the tournament, on Tuesday. The former Undisputed WWE Champion first announced the tournament bearing his name , with few details, leaving fans to speculate, at WWE Backlash in May. Since then, Cena has remained mum on specifics, but has touted the tournament and its uniqueness in various interviews.
summary: Following the announcement on Monday's Raw that John Cena will appear on next week's episode, Tuesday's NXT revealed that he will also be live at the WWE Performance Center the same week. The dual appearances come as WWE loads up its programming to compete directly against AEW Dynamite: Blood & Guts, which is shifted due to election coverage on The CW. Cena tied the appearances to his John Cena Classic, a tournament pitting NXT talent against main roster stars with fan voting to determine a standout performer.

summary_src: Tony Khan continues to be excited about the future of AEW. At the beginning of October, Paramount completed the acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, bringing the two media companies together to form Skydance.
body: At the beginning of October, Paramount completed the acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, bringing the two media companies together to form Skydance. AEW is part of the WBD family with programming airing on HBO Max, TNT, and TBS. Speaking on Twitter , Tony Khan said he met with Skydance officials in Los Angeles and he looks forward to the future of AEW under the Skydance banner. “I just got back from Los Angeles, I had a great visit out there with the Skydance team,” he said. AEW will hold its anual Fright Night event on Wednesday in St. Louis, and WBD executives will be in attrndance. “We’re going to be joined by the Warner Bros. executives,” he said. Fans can find Khan’s comments on working with Skydance head David Ellison by clicking here . Fightful will have coverage of AEW Dynamite beginning at 8 PM ET on Wednesday.
summary: Tony Khan met with officials from Skydance in Los Angeles following Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. Warner Bros. executives will attend AEW's Fright Night Dynamite event on October 28 in St. Louis. Khan expressed optimism about AEW's future under the new Skydance banner.

llm.summary: Tony Khan met with officials from Skydance in Los Angeles following Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery. llm_long: AEW President and CEO Tony Khan met with Skydance executives in Los Angeles on Friday. The meetings took place weeks after the Skydance merger with Warner Bros. Discovery was completed earlier this month. David Ellison now serves as chairman and CEO of the combined company known as Skydance.

Khan has previously spoken positively about Ellison as a supporter of AEW who he believes will make the company stronger after the merger. Dave Meltzer reported on Wrestling Observer Radio that Khan emerged from the meetings extremely happy. Meltzer stated that Khan was much happier than he has been about the relationship and came out the happiest he has been since day one.

Meltzer added that two wrestling moves already made by Skydance were not positive. Meltzer clarified that Women of Wrestling will receive another season but it will not be syndicated. Meltzer noted that nothing sounded like it was cut back for AEW following Khan's meetings.

title: NXT Moves to Wednesday for Dusty Tag Finals and Cena
raw_title: Dusty Rhodes Tag Classic finals, John Cena appearance scheduled for special Wednesday night 11/3 WWE NXT
summary_src: A special Wednesday evening edition of WWE NXT will feature an appearance from John Cena, it was revealed tonight.
body: A special Wednesday night edition of NXT is scheduled to be a big one. A grudge match, the finals of this year’s Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic, as well as a special appearance from WWE star John Cena have all been confirmed for NXT’s November 3 episode. While NXT typically airs on Tuesday nights, next week’s show is being moved ahead so the show can avoid going head-to-head with midterm U.S. election coverage. This year’s Dusty Rhodes Classic Finals will see former tag champs Hank & Tank face the up-and-coming duo of Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar. Hank & Tank took down current AAA champs El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. and Galeno on Tuesday night, punching their ticket to the tourney finals. Earlier in the night, Dar and Moreno pulled off an upset when they beat The Vanity Project’s Brad Baylor and Ricky Smokes in the other semi-final. The winning team will have the trophy presented to them by Cody Rhodes. Also on next week’s show, Dion Lennox and Cruz Montana will rematch in an unsanctioned bout. After a heated match between them last week ended in Montana getting escorted out of the building by security, NXT General Manager Robert Stone refused to sanction a second meeting between them. Instead, he offered to let the match go ahead, but unsanctioned by WWE. It was also revealed that Cena will make an appearance next week. Cena is notably also expected to appear on next week’s episode of Monday Night Raw. He has teased that the Raw appearance will be related to the upcoming John Cena Classic tournament, which puts rising names against vets in a tournament format.
summary: WWE NXT will air on Wednesday, November 3 to avoid clashing with U.S. midterm election coverage. The episode will feature the 2024 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic finals between Hank & Tank and the team of Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar, with Cody Rhodes presenting the trophy to the winners. John Cena is scheduled to make a special appearance and Dion Lennox will face Cruz Montana in an unsanctioned rematch.

title: Kam Hendrix Assists Jackson Drake NXT North American Title Retention

body: WWE Jackson Drake is still the NXT North American Champion after unexpected assistance led to a successful defense over EK Prosper on Tuesday night's episode of "WWE NXT." Per usual, Drake arrived to this match with his Vanity Project stablemates: Brad Baylor, Ricky Smokes, and Myka Lockwood. Also per usual, Lockwood sneakily distracted Drake's challenger, in this case by grabbing Prosper's leg as the referee checked on Drake. The defending champion capitalized by launching Prosper into the ring ropes. Drake later hit a springboard Spanish Fly and a cutter for a near fall. Frustrated, Drake then ascended to the top rope, where a headbutt sent Prosper crashing to the mat below. The high-flier didn't stay down long, though, as he sent Drake flying next, courtesy of a hurricanrana. Prosper followed with a leg lariat, and after fighting off Baylor and Smokes, Prosper landed a poisonrana as well. In the title match's closing moments, Prosper went up top for a moonsault, but before he could execute it, Lockwood hopped up to the apron to distract the referee. At the same time, Kam Hemdrix pushed Prosper off the turnbuckle, allowing Drake to deliver a Shining Wizard for the win. Drake captured the NXT North American Championship by defeating Myles Borne at "NXT" Heatwave on August 30. Since then, he's successfully defended it against Tavion Heights, and now Prosper, on "NXT" television. Fellow Vanity Project members Baylor and Smokes reign as the NXT Tag Team Champions, losing to Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic semi-finals earlier on tonight's broadcast.

title: John Cena and Cody Rhodes Will Appear on Special Edition of NXT
raw_title: John Cena and Cody Rhodes Will Appear on Special Edition of NXT
body: During the Oct. 27 episode of NXT, it was announced that John Cena will appear live on the special Wednesday, Nov. 4 edition of the show. Cody Rhodes will also appear to present the trophy to the winners of the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic . The announcement comes hours after Cena revealed that he will return to RAW on Nov. 2 in Brooklyn with blockbuster news to share. “Make sure not to miss #WWERaw next week,” he wrote . “SPECIAL START TIME OF 6PM EST! The wait is over, the speculation ends 11/2 . Let’s build this “Never Seen” CLASSIC! OUR time is NOW!” Cena’s social media post seems to hint at the “ John Cena Classic ” that he announced in May at WWE Backlash: Tampa. The former Royal Rumble winner previously announced that the John Cena Classic , a new annual WWE tournament, would be launched soon. The John Cena Classic will include rising NXT talent and current WWE stars. “I’m so honored to announce to you the John Cena Classic . An entire evening of the best of today competing against the best of tomorrow ,” he announced at Backlash: Tampa . “An entire event where WWE superstars and NXT superstars give you all that they have in hopes to be crowned a champion.” WWE has not confirmed whether his upcoming NXT appearance is related to the John Cena Classic or if participants will be selected on next week’s show. At Backlash , Cena said a new WWE championship belt would be introduced. “We are making history. We have a brand-new event and the debut of a brand-new championship in the WWE.” He also announced that fans will directly influence the winner of the John Cena Classic. “I have said time and time again, the biggest superstar in the WWE is the WWE Universe,” Cena said in May . “So, on top of a new championship and on top of a new event. For the first time in history, your voice will be heard louder than ever before. Because you, the audience, will vote to crown the champion of the John Cena Classic .” Fan voting has scarcely been used throughout WWE history . Its last notable use was Cyber Sunday, a Ruthless Aggression-era PLE in which fans voted on match participants and stipulations. For the first time, WWE also recently used fan voting to choose the cover athlete of WWE 2K27 . Voting for the WWE 2K27 cover athlete was open exclusively to Club WWE members and closed earlier this month. The winner has not yet been revealed. title: Conrad Thompson Recalls Ultimate Warrior Belt Scam Attempt
raw_title: Conrad Thompson Recalls The Ultimate Warrior Attempting To Scam Him Over WWE Memorabilia Purchase
body: During a recent interview with Fightful’s Sean Ross Sapp , wrestling podcast host Conrad Thompson reveals he once attempted to buy some authentic wrestling title belts from late WWE Hall of Famer The Ultimate Warrior. According to Thompson, Warrior tried to scam him over belts, claiming that one of them was the WWE Title belt he wore against Rick Rude at SummerSlam 1990. Thompson received help from legendary title belt maker, Dave Millican, who was able to confirm that Warrior’s items were not the original items worn in-ring. Below are some highlights: “So I was introduced to him through his website. He had a bunch of photos up there, and there was a photo that was no longer linked, but he claimed it was the SummerSlam 1990 belt that he wore against Ravishing Rick Rude. So I took those pictures, and I sent them to belt maker Dave Millican. I said, ‘Hey, is this right?’ and he goes, ‘Absolutely not. That’s not the ring used belt.” “So when I bring that to Warrior’s attention by email, he’s like, ‘Well, it is. Your buddy doesn’t know what he’s talking about.’ He has no idea that it’s the actual belt maker who would have made the belts. Then he said, ‘What are you really after?’ and I said, ‘Well, I’m really after the yellow Intercontinental and the World title from WrestleMania 6,’ because when I was a kid, Sean, that was as good as it got—Hogan versus the Warrior. Those were my guys. I was all about WrestleMania 6.” “So we agreed to make a deal for both of those belts. He wanted me to bring cash and meet him in an airport and the whole thing. So I had used Dave Millican before to authenticate my belt purchase on the big gold belt. So I asked him if he would tag along and authenticate this one for me. He told me that Warrior had sold the Intercontinental years ago and it was on the shelf of a private collector. When I threw the flag on that, he sent me a photo of the guy’s collection, which in that world is a no-no. You’re not supposed to share other guys’ collections. “I don’t know why I broke all the rules on that with my collection, but still it was like a little disappointing to realize that one of your childhood favorites was trying to sell you something that he in fact had already sold—AKA he was lying and conning and bull****ting me. So, the deal never went anywhere. When I presented that to him, he blew a gasket, and it is what it is. But when I was nine, I still had an Ultimate Warrior birthday cake, and he’s still the old—alright. Jim Hellwig may have been a turd, but the Ultimate Warrior ruled.” The Ultimate Warrior passed away in April 2014. llm_long: Conrad Thompson revealed in an interview that he once tried to purchase authentic wrestling title belts from The Ultimate Warrior. Thompson was introduced to Warrior through his website which featured photos of the items. Thompson sent the pictures to legendary title belt maker Dave Millican for verification.

Millican confirmed that the belt in the photo was not the ring-used belt from that event. When Thompson emailed Warrior about the finding, Warrior insisted it was the actual belt and said Thompson's buddy did not know what he was talking about.

Thompson then told Warrior he was interested in the yellow Intercontinental belt and the World title from WrestleMania 6. The two agreed on a deal for both belts that involved Thompson bringing cash to meet Warrior at an airport. Thompson asked Millican to accompany him to authenticate the purchase as he had done previously with the Big Gold Belt.

Millican informed Thompson that Warrior had sold the Intercontinental belt years earlier and it was now on the shelf of a private collector. When Thompson confronted Warrior with that information, Warrior sent him a photo of the collector's items. Thompson noted that sharing another person's collection photo violated unwritten rules in that world.

title: Comeback Watch: Vince Russo Nearly Returned to WWE Creative After 27 Years — Report
raw_title: Vince Russo Nearly Returned to WWE Creative After 27 Years — Report
body: 0 WWE reportedly explored an unexpected reunion with one of the most controversial creative figures in wrestling history this summer. The discussions involved Vince Russo, whose previous work helped shape the Attitude Era, but a potential return would have brought its own set of challenges. According to Conrad Thompson, writing in his debut weekly column for Yahoo Sports’ Uncrowned, Russo held several conversations with WWE President Nick Khan about potentially rejoining the company’s creative team. Thompson revealed that he followed up on the situation a few weeks later and received a clear update: the proposal had “died on the vine.” Russo, 65, therefore isn’t returning to WWE, despite the reported discussions. Russo served as WWE’s head writer beginning in 1997, contributing to the creative direction that helped the company gain ground against WCW during the Monday Night Wars. He left in late 1999 to oversee WCW’s creative operations, where several controversial decisions — including giving the WCW World Championship to actor David Arquette — damaged his reputation. After subsequent stints with TNA and other wrestling projects, Russo most recently worked with Juggalo Championship Wrestling before leaving in September 2026. Thompson believes Russo’s reputation could have proved a bigger obstacle than his ideas. He argued that two generations of WWE wrestlers and staff hold negative opinions of Russo, potentially making it difficult for him to gain support in the current creative structure. Russo has also publicly criticized Triple H’s creative leadership. During an appearance on Talk Is Jericho , he questioned whether the WWE Chief Content Officer would ever engage with him, saying, “Is Triple H ever going to have a conversation with ME? Absolutely not.” Thompson suggested bringing Russo in as a remote creative consultant might have been a more workable option, although he acknowledged that the full-time creative environment could be a poor fit. While the proposed reunion is off the table for now, the reported conversations have renewed discussion about WWE’s creative direction. Russo’s return may not be in the cards, but the idea briefly made it to the table. The post Vince Russo Nearly Returned to WWE Creative After 27 Years — Report appeared first on Wrestlezone .

body: More Share Options More Share Options Share close facebook x threads email October 29, 2024 – WWE today announced the launch of a first-of-its-kind developmental program designed to provide up-and-coming independent wrestlers a pathway to a potential career in WWE. The program will be called WWE ID , short for WWE Independent Development™. “WWE ID is the latest in our efforts to identify and support the journey of up-and-coming wrestlers, in turn raising the profile of and strengthening the independent wrestling ecosystem,” said WWE Chief Content Officer Paul “Triple H” Levesque. Following the 2021 launch of WWE’s NIL program, WWE ID has been constructed to support independent wrestling prospects and wrestling schools with world-class training, development and mentorship. Under the program, WWE will provide prominent independent wrestling schools with the WWE ID official designation, with the goal of providing new trainees and existing talent at these select institutions with enhanced developmental opportunities. Booker T’s Reality of Wrestling (Houston), Cody Rhodes’ Nightmare Factory (Atlanta), Seth Rollins’ Black and Brave Academy (Davenport, Iowa), Elite Pro Wrestling Training Center (Concord, N.H.) and KnokX Pro Academy (Los Angeles) are the first WWE ID independent wrestling schools to earn the official designation. Additionally, WWE ID will identify top independent wrestling prospects with an official WWE ID “prospect” designation and support their developmental journey by providing financial opportunity and assisting with training, mentorship and development, including access to world-class facilities, best-in-class ring training, athletic trainers and more. WWE ID will give fans the opportunity to follow the paths of these standout prospects on the independent wrestling scene through curated, behind-the-scenes content, as well as highlights and matches showcased across WWE’s social platforms. To learn more about WWE ID and WWE’s recruiting process, please visit recruit.wwe.com .

title: WWE Hall of Famer ‘Bullet’ Bob Armstrong passes away
