title: M By Elegance Retains Knockouts TV Title vs Jada Stone
raw_title: M By Elegance Retains Knockouts TV Title Over Jada Stone With Help From Teammate
summary_src: M By Elegance's third test as TNA Knockouts Television Champion proved successful as one of her teammates helped her retain.
body: TNA M By Elegance's third test as TNA Knockouts Television Champion proved successful. On Thursday night's episode of "TNA Impact," M defended her title against Jada Stone, the very woman she faced in the finals of the inaugural championship tournament. Fired up for her rematch, Stone burst out of the gate with a springboard hurricanrana and a hopeful 619. M caught her legs before she could land the latter, however. Stone bounced back with a standing moonsault, and when M accidently booted Mr. Elegance off the apron, she followed with a dropkick and a dive through the ropes. Back in the ring, Stone looked to deliver the Spark Stunner next, only to get caught and dumped to the floor by the defending champion. In the match's closing moments, Stone connected with the 619 on her second attempt. When she sought to land a split-legged moonsault, though, M countered it into a superkick. As M rolled to the outside off Stone's Spark Stunner, Mr. Elegance then found himself wiped out by a moonsault to the floor. A Spanish Fly off the steel stairs followed, with M on the receiving end. While Heather distracted the referee, M asked Mr. Elegance to hand her the KO TV Title belt, to which he refused and seemingly quit The Elegance brand. Nevertheless, M managed to secure the win, in this case by delivering a piledriver to "The Spark." M previously defeated Jada Stone in the finals of the aforementioned tournament to claim the Knockouts Television Championship on August 27. Since then, she's also successfully defended the title against Kiera Hogan and Elayna Black.
summary: On this week's TNA Impact, M By Elegance successfully defended the Knockouts Television Championship against Jada Stone in a rematch from the tournament finals. Stone controlled large portions with high-flying offense including a 619, moonsaults and a Spanish Fly off the stairs, but M countered a split-legged moonsault into a superkick. Mr. Elegance's involvement helped M secure the retention after Stone's late flurry.

title: Amazing Red Retains X-Division Title Against Cedric Alexander
raw_title: Amazing Red Defends X-Division Title Against Cedric Alexander On TNA Impact
summary_src: Amazing Red defeated Cedric Alexander to retain the X-Division Championship during "TNA Impact."
body: TNA Amazing Red defeated Cedric Alexander to retain the X-Division Championship during "TNA Impact." Red captured the title on the same night as his TNA Hall of Fame induction , beating Alexander, BDE, Rich Swann, Fabian Aichner, KC Navarro, and Ryan Nemeth in a seven-way scramble at Slammiversary. Alexander earned the first shot at the new champion by beating Aichner, Swann, and Navarro in a four-way during last week's show, looking to capture the title for the second time this year. Alexander started the match off strong, getting the better of Red after a starting flurry to ensure the champion was grounded and worn down on the mat. He got a near-fall off of a Death Valley Driver, immediately going for the waist control to continue wearing Red down. Red came back all the same, planting Alexander with a tornado DDT. He followed that up with a thrust kick to the gut, looking for the Code Red but getting spiked for a Michinoku Driver, having to kick out before the count of three. Red rolled Alexander up thrice, each getting closer to the final three but ultimately to no avail, before going to the top rope for a leaping flatliner, finishing up with a successful Code Red for the winning pinfall.

Red had won the title in a seven-way scramble at Slammiversary on the same night he was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame. Alexander earned his title shot by winning a four-way match the previous week and controlled much of the bout with a Death Valley Driver and Michinoku Driver before Red scored the victory with a series of pinning combinations.

summary_src: During an interview this week on Skratch N’ Sniff, Chris Jericho revealed that a TV series about the early part of his wrestling career is moving to the pilot phase.
body: Link AEW Cain A. Knight is a hardcore number-cruncher who has analyzed and covered pro wrestling for Cageside Seats since 2014, and followed the sport as a fan going back to the 1980’s. During an interview this week on Skratch N’ Sniff , Chris Jericho revealed that a TV series about the early part of his wrestling career is moving to the pilot phase. The 55-year-old AEW star broke the news while admitting that if a movie was ever made about his life, 62-year-old Brad Pitt would be too old to play him. “It’s one of those things where whoever would play me, we probably don’t even know. You can’t say Brad Pitt ‘cause Brad Pitt’s older than me. But we are actually working on something based on my first book, A Lion’s Tale, that we’ve been working on for a while, of doing a TV series based on that. We’ve kind of moved it up the food chain, and it’s getting pretty close to filming a pilot. And we do have an actor that is very similar to me when he was first starting out, that was from the Letterkenny series, if you ever watched that show. So yeah, there might be something very, very soon, of not just an autobiography, because that’s not enough because I’m Chris Jericho, right? I always have to push the envelope. We might have a whole actual TV series about kind of the early years of my career, which would be a lot of fun. title: Ricky Sosa and Fabian Aichner Enter TNA World X-Cup

summary_src: Ricky Sosa and Fabian Aichner are the first two men to announce their entrance in this year's World X-Cup at TNA Destination X on November 15.
body: TNA After a near decade long hiatus, TNA is bringing back the World X-Cup. And on tonight's episode of "TNA Impact," two men have announced their participation in it at Destination X on Sunday, November 15: Fabian Aichner (who will represent Italy) and Ricky Sosa (who will represent Belgium). The World X-Cup features wrestlers (both on the roster and from other promotions) from around the world to compete in two fatal-four matches. Then, later in the show, the final two stars will compete at their shot to win the overall trophy. title: Does The Cut look like it’s going to be one faction too many or a misuse of the talent or a good fit in the AEW mix? — PARKS’S TAKE
raw_title: PARKS’S TAKE: Does The Cut look like it’s going to be one faction too many or a misuse of the talent or a good fit in the AEW mix?
body: That’s been the story so far of The Cut, the group briefly known as The Last Outfit. By the way, for all the consternation about the name, “The Outfit” would’ve been fine. “The Outfit” evokes the mafia, while “The Last Outfit” is akin to those out-of-style pants and shirt combo you have in the back of your closet. So, it was a rough start for the group. Otherwise, AEW has worked overtime to get heat on the new faction, which makes sense given that they ARE a new faction. Jay White and David Finlay, with their powers combined, seem like the whole is greater than the sum of the parts at this point. Their history coming up together in New Japan adds to the story, as does their on-screen chemistry as partners. The most intriguing aspect about The Cut isn’t the name or the mission – it’s who’s missing. Gabe Kidd made a ton of sense to be a part of this heel squad as they don’t get much more “heel” than Kidd. Anyone who has seen his work in NJPW, especially during the G1 Climax Tournament, can attest to that. Yet, he was turned on along with the Death Riders, keeping him in that now babyface camp for the time being. Could he still betray Jon Moxley and company, playing the long game as a way to further outwit the enemy? Perhaps. But I wouldn’t put money on it. Speaking of Moxley, it’s finally clear he and the rest of his Death Rider cohorts are firmly on the babyface side of the ledger. They’ve been squishy for too long, and really, with Pac’s death and the emotions they poured out celebrating his life on the memorial episode of Dynamite, it would’ve been hard for them to stay heel. They’ve been lacking a mission statement lately so a feud with The Cut gives them something new and fresh to do. With Anarchy in the Arena on the horizon next month for this feud, Tony Khan and company are hitting the accelerator quickly in order to get to that point. Some will decry another large heel faction with The Don Callis Family already chewing up so much TV time. The Cut appears different in both leadership and membership from the Callis Family, a differentiation that will be important moving forward. I don’t expect everyone to love continued gang warfare, but from where I sit, it’s probably the best use of Finlay and White, if not others within The Cut.

summary_src: On "TNA Impact," Shayna Baszler dropped major news: she will soon challenge Indi Hartwell for the Knockouts World Championship.
body: Indi Hartwell's challenger for TNA Destination X has revealed herself. On Thursday night's episode of "TNA Impact," Zoey Serrano suddenly attacked a member of the show's ringside security team. As Serrano laughed, her tag team partner Shayna Baszler then delivered some major news. "I'm letting everybody know Daria hired me to face Indi Hartwell at Destination X, one-on-one for the TNA Knockouts Championship," Baszler announced. "Now, Indi, this feel-good story, this dream of yours, that's all fine and dandy, but you need to understand something. From here on out, it becomes a nightmare, and Shayna Baszler is the thing that haunts it." TNA teased a faceoff between Baszler and Hartwell last week after the latter's successful TNA Knockouts World Championship defense against Xia Brookside. Authority figure Daria Rae stood atop the entrance ramp, looking unimpressed at Hartwell's efforts. This turned out to be a simple distraction, however, as Baszler and Serrano charged in from behind and subsequently beat Hartwell down. Baszler cinched in a chokehold, and when Hartwell passed out, she raised up the KO Title, signaling a future title clash. Hartwell captured the Knockouts World Championship by defeating Brookside at TNA Bound For Glory. The same night, Baszler and Serrano dethroned Allie and Kiera Hogan as the Knockouts Tag Team Champions. Destination X will mark only the second singles encounter between Hartwell and Baszler, the first under the TNA banner. Destination X is set for the Edmonton Expo Centre in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada on November 15. TNA World Champion Leon Slater will also defend his title there, in his case against Trey Miguel.

title: MLW Fusion Recap: Riddle Advances in Opera Cup
raw_title: Fusion Recap: Riddle Drops the Hammer, Kross Risks It All, and SuperFight Explodes
summary_src: Philadelphia hosted a powder keg of a Fusion as Opera Cup dreams collided, a bear trap entered the equation, and the road to Saturday Night SuperFight took a dangerous turn.
body: Philadelphia hosted a powder keg of a Fusion as Opera Cup dreams collided, a bear trap entered the equation, and the road to Saturday Night SuperFight took a dangerous turn. With the November 7 pay-per-view looming, “The Rude Dude” Matt Riddle punched his ticket to the semifinals, Killer Kross agreed to a potentially catastrophic championship gamble, and ZAMAYA delivered a chilling reality check to Shotzi. Two Carolina standouts. One semifinal spot. Absolutely everything left in the ring. Diego Hill and LaBron Kozone opened Fusion with a blistering Opera Cup quarterfinal that pitted Divebomb’s spectacular aerial arsenal against the Ring Warrior’s frightening strength. Their history made every exchange mean more: Kozone had helped Hill early in his journey, and now his former student stood between him and the next round. Hill attacked the opportunity at full throttle, unleashing a twisting DDT and soaring to the floor. Kozone answered with the kind of power that makes opponents reconsider their career choices, catching Hill out of the air and delivering a devastating burning hammer. Drawing on the destructive lessons passed down from Stan Hansen to Satoshi Kojima to Kozone himself, the Ring Warrior flattened Hill and secured the victory. Hill’s tournament ended in Philadelphia, while Kozone advanced toward a semifinal collision with Austin Aries. Yota Tsuji wanted a fight. Trevor Lee volunteered to give him one. Following a challenge from the New Japan Pro-Wrestling standout, Lee stepped forward to welcome the IWGP Heavyweight Champion to MLW at Saturday Night SuperFight. The Southern Crown Champion made it clear he sees November 7 as an opportunity to test himself against one of the most formidable competitors on the planet. Chicago now has another first-time collision with international implications—and Trevor Lee intends to make his introduction unforgettable. Shotzi thought she had found an ally. ZAMAYA had a very different interpretation. As Rich Bocchini interviewed the undefeated powerhouse, the MLW Women’s World Champion arrived to acknowledge their shared enemies. Shotzi praised ZAMAYA’s dominance and thanked her for the help. Then came the response that sucked the warmth out of the entire conversation. With two sentences, ZAMAYA turned a potential alliance into a warning. Shotzi may have enemies coming from every direction, but the undefeated predator standing beside her made it painfully clear that gratitude buys no protection. Baszler told Hartwell that her feel-good story and dream would become a nightmare with Baszler haunting it from then on. The segment followed last week's tease where Daria Rae appeared unimpressed on the entrance ramp after Hartwell's title defense against Xia Brookside.

title: Amazing Red Retains TNA X-Division Championship Against Cedric Alexander
raw_title: Amazing Red Retains TNA X-Division Championship Against Cedric Alexander
body: 0 Amazing Red is still the TNA X-Division Champion after defeating Cedric Alexander on the October 29 episode of TNA iMPACT . The two high-flyers put on a competitive match, with Alexander coming close to winning the championship. Red entered the match after a memorable night at Slammiversary. He won the X-Division Championship on the same night he was inducted into the TNA Hall of Fame. The veteran defeated Cedric Alexander, BDE, Rich Swann, Fabian Aichner, KC Navarro, and Ryan Nemeth in a seven-way scramble to win the title. However, Alexander earned his title opportunity last week by defeating Aichner, Swann, and Navarro in a four-way match. Alexander took control early by throwing Red to the mat. However, the champion escaped a wristlock and hit a strike off the ropes. Alexander moved to the outside, but Red followed him with a Swanton from the ring post. Red kept the pressure on by chopping Alexander against the barricades before rolling him back into the ring. The challenger finally found an opening when he caught Red with an X-Plex on the apron. Alexander sent Red back into the ring and locked in a facelock. Red managed to escape, but Alexander hit a German suplex for a near fall. The challenger continued his attack in the corner with chops and a choke against the ropes. He then followed up with a splash and a dropkick for another two-count. Red tried to fight back, but Alexander caught him and hit a DVD for yet another near fall. Alexander then locked in a waistlock, looking to wear down the champion. The veteran eventually escaped with a series of elbows. Red got the upper hand with a headscissor takedown and followed it up with a tornado DDT. Red then hit a superkick and tried to finish Alexander with the Code Red. However, the challenger saw it coming and countered the move into a Michinoku Driver. He nearly got the three-count but Red managed to stay in the match. Both men then traded chops, with Red catching Alexander off guard with a roll-up. The challenger kicked out at two, keeping his hopes of winning the championship alive. Alexander followed up with a big right hand, but Red answered with a spinning kick. The champion then hit a DDT from the second rope. Red didn’t give his opponent any time to recover. He quickly connected with the Code Red and finally secured the victory. title: AEW Blood & Guts and Full Gear Feud Tracker
raw_title: AEW FEUD TRACKER: Barber’s look at the eventful last two weeks with The Cut being formed and changing their name, an unexpected TBS Title change, MCMG vs. FTR, Nick Wayne, more
body: •Megan Bayne made it the final two in the CMLL International Grand Prix before falling to Skadi. She had a great showing throughout the match. Bayne doesn’t miss in Mexico. AEW started the build to both Blood & Guts and Full Gear all at the same time last week. I wish AEW would stop setting themselves up to have to build two shows simultaneously. Neither one can get the full focus it deserves. That said, at least one of the Blood & Guts matches makes sense and the Full Gear cars is already shaping up nicely. Let’s see where things stand. Recent and long-time enemies banded together against the Don Callis Family in the set up for the Blood & Guts match. Last week’s show opened with Davis & Doyle absolutely squashing The Young Bucks. The Jackson brothers didn’t get a single bit of offense in. Nick was powerbombed through a table while Matt ate three piledrivers from Davis. This was glorious. AEW does these things so rarely that this was a welcome surprise and put Davis and Doyle over strong. In the next segment Will Ospreay and Adam Copeland teamed up to fight Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight. When this match was announced I assumed it was to be a vehicle to set up Copeland challenging Ospreay. For the second segment in a row we got swerved. After a good back and forth match, Kazuchika Okada snuck down to ringside. He got into Copeland’s face only to get knocked off the apron. As Copeland went for a spear to Fletcher, Fletcher leapfrogged him. At that moment, Okada laid the International Title belt across the middle turnbuckle in time for Copeland’s head to slam into it, busting him open hard-way. Fletcher hit a brainbuster for the win. After the match, the entire DCF hit the ring and overwhelmed Ospreay and Copeland with Fletcher ultimately standing over Ospreay with the world title belt in hand. Eventually, Darby Allin’s music hit and he and the returning Steven Borden made their way to the ring armed with Sting’s baseball bat while Nick Jackson ran out with some kind of paddle. The DCF scurried and Steven Borden laid down the challenge for Blood & Guts. Was this a rushed set up for Blood & Guts? No question. That said the DCF has been the central heel faction in the company for years at this point. Ospreay has been feuding with them for years. The Bucks have been feuding with them for over a year. Darby and Steven Borden have been feuding with them for about five months now. The only new rival here is Copeland. I think the composition of the face team balances out the speed with which the match came together. I’m not opposed to a moratorium on Blood & Guts matches, but as a WCW fan I’ve seen worse builds with less logical teams so this one doesn’t bother me. Beyond next week’s caged warfare, this also seemed to set up some Full Gear title matches. In addition to the Bucks defending against Davis & Doyle, it would appear that Adam Copeland will be challenging Okada for the International Title. Ospreay and Fletcher are reigniting their rivalry, this

title: M By Elegance Survives Jada Stone After Member Quits Elegance Brand on TNA iMPACT
raw_title: M By Elegance Survives Jada Stone After Member Quits Elegance Brand on TNA iMPACT
body: 0 M By Elegance successfully defended her TNA Knockouts Television Championship against Jada Stone on the October 29 episode of iMPACT , but the victory came with an unexpected twist. The title contest not only tested the champion inside the ring but also exposed a growing problem within her own faction. Stone, who previously lost to M in the tournament final for the championship, received another opportunity to capture the gold. However, the match quickly became complicated when Mr. Elegance found himself caught in the crossfire. The trouble started when M accidentally kicked Mr. Elegance off the apron during an early exchange. Stone capitalized with a dropkick and a dive to the outside, putting the ringside member of the Elegance brand in harm’s way. Stone continued attacking the champion and eventually connected with a 619. She also attempted a split-legged moonsault, but M countered with a superkick. The challenger later sent M crashing outside with the Spark Stunner before following up with a Spanish Fly from the steel steps. As the match approached its conclusion, Heather By Elegance distracted the referee while M called for her championship belt. However, Mr. Elegance refused to hand it over and announced that he was quitting the Elegance brand before walking away. Despite losing an ally at a crucial moment, M kept her title hopes alive. She countered Stone’s offence and finished the challenger with a piledriver to secure the victory. Following the match, M addressed Mr. Elegance’s decision on X , writing, “quits?!!!! @AJZiggy1818 well you can’t quit!! cause i deem you UNelegant!!!” Heather also reacted to the departure, posting, “Guys it’s getting lonely over here.” Mr. Elegance joined the faction in January 2026, making his sudden exit a notable change for the group. Meanwhile, M continues her reign after previously defeating Kiera Hogan and Elayna Black in title defences. The champion retained her gold, but the Elegance brand may have lost one of its key members in the process. summary_src: Against game four of the World Series that was a potential series clincher for the Milwaukee Brewers, this past Tuesday’s WWE NXT took a big hit. The show on The CW averaged 520,000 viewers, down 20.6% from the previous week and their lowest audience since since May 19.
body: Against game four of the World Series that was a potential series clincher for the Milwaukee Brewers, this past Tuesday’s WWE NXT took a big hit. The show on The CW averaged 520,000 viewers, down 20.6% from the previous week and their lowest audience since since May 19. It averaged a 0.09 rating in the 18-49 demo, down 10% from last week and tying its lowest rating since August 4. Shown on Fox, the Tampa Bay Rays won in the 12th inning of game four to keep the series alive. The Brewers won on Wednesday in game five, up against AEW Dynamite. As compared to the same week in 2025 when it also went head-to-head with the World Series, overall NXT viewership was down 1.3% while the 18-49 rating was up 28.6%. It’s the third straight week, and fourth of the last five, where NXT has experienced a year-over-year increase in 18-49 rating. Listed below are the last 11 weeks of overall viewership and 18-49 demo ratings for WWE NXT The CW as well as the 10-week average in both categories. This week’s show was down 22.4% in overall viewers and 25% in 18-49 as compared to recent averages. title: Chris Jericho TV Series Nears Pilot Filming
raw_title: Chris Jericho Says TV Series About Early Portion Of His Career Is Close To Filming Pilot Episode
body: There’s an interview with Chris Jericho that was conducted by Skratch N’ Sniff . He revealed that a TV series based on the early portion of his career is close to filming a pilot. “I don’t know,” Jericho responded when asked who would play him in a film. “It’s one of those things where whoever would play me, we probably don’t even know. You can’t say Brad Pitt because Brad Pitt’s older than me but we are actually working on something based on my first book, A Lion’s Tale, that we’ve been working on for a while — of doing a TV series based on that, and so, we’ve kind of moved it up the food chain and it’s getting pretty close to filming a pilot and we do have an actor that is very similar to me when he was first starting out that was from the Letterkenny series if you ever watched that show. So yeah, I mean there might be something very, very soon of not just an autobiography because that’s not enough because I’m, you know, Chris Jericho, right?” He smiled. “I always have to push the envelope that we might have a whole actual TV series about kind of the early years of my career which would be a lot of fun. So, that’s something we’re working on… We’re moving to the pilot stage fairly, fairly soon so…” He continued, “I won’t say who it is in Letterkenny but, there is a real facial similarity.” Jericho has been with All Elite Wrestling since 2019. He is the first-ever AEW World Champion.

title: TNA’s Elayna Black Recalls Feeling ‘Very Insecure’ About Her Body During WWE Run
raw_title: TNA’s Elayna Black Recalls Feeling ‘Very Insecure’ About Her Body During WWE Run
body: 0 TNA star Elayna Black has opened up about the personal struggles she experienced during her time in WWE, revealing how constant public scrutiny affected her confidence. The former NXT wrestler also recalled receiving a particularly hurtful comment about her appearance that left a lasting impression. Speaking in a documentary shared on TNA Wrestling’s YouTube channel , Black explained that she joined WWE at 19 and initially struggled with the pressure of fans and people within the industry constantly judging her. Elayna Black said her first public relationship brought a different level of attention, making her realise that almost everything she did could become a subject of discussion. “I never thought anything was wrong with my body, and then I get put into this position, and all these eyes in this different spotlight,” she explained. “Very quickly, I started to become very, very insecure about my body.” The criticism also affected her confidence as a performer. Black recalled following advice from coaches and working to improve, only to feel that other wrestlers received opportunities she wasn’t getting. She also revealed that someone told her she would never become a champion in WWE because she looked like she “couldn’t even crack an egg.” Black didn’t identify the person responsible for the remark. The documentary also featured Mustafa Ali, who highlighted the additional scrutiny female wrestlers can face regarding their appearance. “I think it’s exponentially harder for the girls in the industry,” Ali said, adding that he had heard difficult accounts from female performers about the criticism they experienced. Black also discussed how her outlook has changed since leaving WWE and joining TNA. She said she now feels more comfortable with her identity, both as a person and as a character. “For the first time in a very long time, I feel confident in who I am as a person and as a character,” she said. Her comments offer a personal look at the challenges she says affected her early wrestling career. Having spent years navigating outside expectations, Black now appears more comfortable finding her own identity in TNA. body: Former WWE star and current TNA wrestler Cedric Alexander believes the existing partnership between the two promotions still has room for improvement. In a recent interview with Medd in the Morning , Alexander discussed the partnership between TNA and WWE . “ I think it’s been working very well. I think there’s still room to improve that relationship, but also, you know, it’s one of those things where it’s just good for the business. I feel like the business itself progresses faster when everyone works together. There’s no need for tribalism. We all find a place to work. “ I remember I was in NXT when the partnership was announced. And I remember being excited because I remember thinking, ‘Ooh, I could probably go to TNA and do some things in TNA.’ That was my exact thought ,” Alexander noted. He claimed that it was one of his bucket list things. While he was not sure about his tenure with WWE, he was still excited to be a part of TNA if an opportunity came . “ And then when the opportunity came up, man, it was even better that it was with Ali and debuting there ,” he said. “ I feel like the last year and a half, two years has been a journey of ups and downs, but it’s been a journey that helps me appreciate wrestling more and gives me better insight into what I need as a professional wrestler. And I think TNA has given me exactly what I need as a professional wrestler ,” he further said. Alexander finished off by stating that the more companies like WWE and TNA come to work together, the better it would be for the pro-wrestling industry. title: Comeback Watch: Jim Cornette Is Returning to Television With New Vice TV Series
raw_title: Jim Cornette Is Returning to Television With New Vice TV Series
body: 0 Jim Cornette is returning to TV, but this time, he will have a show focused entirely on his views about pro wrestling history. Vice TV has officially announced a new series that will serve as a companion to its popular wrestling docuseries, Dark Side of the Ring. Cornette’s work with Vice TV is nothing new. He has been one of the show’s most frequent interview subjects since Dark Side of the Ring premiered in 2019. His knowledge of wrestling history has made him an important voice throughout the series. He also appeared in the seventh season and contributed to the three-part documentary about Jeff Jarrett and TNA. However, the new spinoff will allow Cornette to take the lead instead of appearing as one of several interview subjects. As per PW Insider , Vice TV revealed that Cornette Side of the Ring will premiere on November 10, 2026. The show will see Cornette discuss some of the most shocking, controversial, and memorable moments in wrestling history. Fans can expect the same unfiltered opinions that have made him one of the most recognizable voices in the business. The official synopsis states, “Legendary wrestling manager and historian Jim Cornette pulls back the curtain on outrageous, infamous, and unforgettable moments in pro wrestling, offering his unfiltered perspective and opinions in a companion series to Dark Side of the Ring.” Although the TV premiere is still a few weeks away, Cornette Side of the Ring has already attracted plenty of attention online. Vice Sports and Dark Side of the Ring have been sharing clips from the series on YouTube . One of the most popular episodes, titled “When WWE Tried Necr*philia,” revisited WWE’s infamous Katie Vick storyline from 2002, which involved Triple H and Kane. Another episode focused on Cornette’s longtime rival Vince Russo and his controversial handling of the WCW Championship. The series also revisited Hulk Hogan’s infamous confrontation with TV host Richard Belzer. The incident ended with Hogan choking Belzer during a live TV appearance. Another episode covered former WCW executive Jim Herd’s time running the promotion. A fifth episode has also been released, focusing on WWE’s decision to turn Stone Cold Steve Austin heel. The post Jim Cornette Is Returning to Television With New Vice TV Series appeared first on Wrestlezone .

body: TNA Wrestling TNA continues to barrel ahead towards Destination X, with the first participants in the World X-Cup being announced tonight. As usual, the show brought us some in-ring action mixed with storyline advancement, but how did it hold up in terms of quality? About as well as usual, according to our crew. Below you'll find our opinions on moments ranging from the latest Elegance Brand drama to the Slaughterhouse Syx main event. In between that, we've got thoughts on the video package hyping Shotzi Blackheart's arrival, the aforementioned World X-Cup announcement, and more. If you're in need of a more detailed breakdown of tonight's show, feel free to take a look at our "TNA Impact" 10/29/2026 results live blog. Otherwise, read on to learn our thoughts on the latest installment. TNA Wrestling TNA Destination X is just around the corner on November 15, and beyond Leon Slater defending the TNA World Championship against Trey Miguel, the card is looking a little light. With the pay-per-view only being just a little over two weeks away, I can't help but feel like it's about time for TNA to start announcing some more concrete things for the pay-per-view event. TNA has announced the World X-Cup Tournament and Ultimate X Number One Contenders matches for the Knockouts Word and X-Division Championships. However, outside of Ricky Sosa and Fabian Aichner in the World X-Cup Tournament, the company has yet to officially announce any competitors taking part in any of these matches, which makes it harder for fans to get invested in the show without knowing who will be competing on it. To TNA's credit, they did announce a Knockouts World Championship match between Indi Hartwell and Shayna Baszler tonight, but all of it still didn't feel like it was quite enough of a fix. Considering that this episode of "Impact" really just was a whole bunch of nothing, there is no reason that TNA couldn't use this television time to at least announce some competitors for the pre-existing Destination X matches and use this television time to build some excitement for November 15. It feels like they're in the beginning stages of putting together a card when they really should be more in the middle of doing so instead of leaving it as a mystery. body: 0 AEW President Tony Khan is promising fans an affordable night of wrestling ahead of the November 4 edition of Dynamite: Blood & Guts in Jacksonville, Florida. During a recent interview, Khan discussed what viewers can expect from the special show and made a pointed remark about how much they will need to pay to attend. Speaking with First Coast News , Khan promoted the event at VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena, describing it as an important night for AEW. Interestingly, he also highlighted the company’s approach to ticket pricing. Khan claimed that AEW offers the most affordable tickets among televised wrestling promotions and assured fans that attending Blood & Guts wouldn’t cost them a fortune. “AEW also has the most affordable tickets in TV wrestling. I guarantee you we’re not going to take an arm and a leg for this,” Khan said. “This is going to be a good night at the wrestling matches.” The AEW President also encouraged fans to purchase tickets through AEWTix.com, promising that the experience would deliver value for their money. With Blood & Guts known for its hard-hitting action, Khan looks to ensure the price of admission doesn’t become another battle for supporters. Tony Khan outlined the match’s format during the interview, explaining that the contest will take place across two rings enclosed by a double steel cage. Competitors can win only by forcing their opponents to submit or surrender, making endurance and survival key parts of the contest. “Blood and Guts is a two-ring, double steel cage match with some of the greatest wrestlers in the world fighting it out,” Khan said. He added that fans should expect blood, exciting wrestling, and a hard-hitting contest. The November 4 show also carries significance for AEW as it heads to Jacksonville, a city closely tied to the promotion’s origins. Khan recalled that AEW announced its launch in the city in January 2019, adding to the importance of bringing the special Dynamite episode to VyStar Veterans Memorial Arena. For Khan, the pitch is straightforward: fans can expect intense action without paying an arm and a leg to get through the doors. body: While Rob Van Dam believes Ric Flair’s lifestyle is bad for him, the WWE veteran has still come to his defense just days after his fall. Speaking on the latest edition of RVDTV , Rob Van Dam shared that Flair currently lives the way he wants to live. “ Isn’t there something to be respected about the guy just living the way he wants to live? I mean, he knows he’s killing himself and he’s saying, ‘Look, you know, I’d rather [expletive] live the way I want to live and die when it’s my time than possibly get another couple of years, but not enjoying life, not doing what I want to do ,'” he said. RVD proceeded to compare Ric Flair’s life with the movie, The Wrestler starring Mickey Rourke. “ The guy going out or staying in and going out by his own terms, knowing family and everybody is experiencing pain seeing him do it. But yet it’s his life. And doesn’t he, if anybody, deserve that? ” RVD added. “ I feel like if right now I was to start doing heroin or doing [expletive] coke with all the fentanyl on the street or something and taking a chance that I might not be around for my babies, I think that would be extremely selfish of me at this age ,” he shared. However, RVD added that if he was in his late-70s and had lived the life expectancy of a human, all he would want to do is smoke and drink. “ I learned, you know, when it comes to addicts, through Sabu mostly. And it was like I could be a pain in his ass every time he wanted to, you know, kill his pain. I could be an [expletive] every single time to where it would separate us, or he would hate me ,” RVD shared. “ Or after a while, I could just be a friend and just do my best to watch over him as much as he would let me, but also enjoy my time with him.” Shounak Chakrabarti Shounak Chakrabarti is an experienced sports journalist with a lifelong passion for athletics and storytelling. title: TNA Impact Preview for October 29

body: Impact Zone! It’s Thursday Night, which means that we are in for a brand-new edition of the delight known as Impact! Coming to us from the taping sessions in Dothan, Alabama, tonight’s edition of Impact features not one but two titles being defended as well as a rematch with a new set of rules in place. The X-Division Title will be on the line when Amazing Red makes his first defense of the title since winning it at Bound for Glory against former Champion Cedric Alexander, while M by Elegance will defend her Knockouts Television Title against Jada Stone. After losing to syX at Bound for Glory in a Falls-Count-Anywhere match, the Hardys will face syX once more, this time in a Slaughterhouse syX match. Elsewhere on the card, John Skyler will defend the honor of his woman when he faces off with AJ Francis, Elijah will face the uber-annoying LITTLE BROTHER, and we will hear from our TNA World Heavyweight Champion Leon Slater! All of this and, of course, so much more in store for us tonight! So, how is everyone doing on this Thursday Night? For no reason at all except for the fact that I can, I am doing a marathon (with interruptions) run of the Batman animated films, starting with the Mask of Phantasm in 1993 up to Knight Fall Part 1, which came out this August. Currently, I am eight films in and watching Batman: Year One. That was definitely one of my favorite Batman storylines, and it translated well to film! But enough about me and enough about you, let’s get ready to brace for Impact! Tonight, we are LIVE (to TAPE!) from the Dothan Civic Center, as Tom Hannifan and Matt Rehwoldt are on the call! Highlights from last week, including the Hotch-Ali match and the post-match promo between Hotch and Slater that closed out the show. Maggie tries to choke out Stone as the fans are behind Jada. Stone to her feet and she hits a jawbreaker. Strikes from downtown by Stone, but Maggie shuts that down with a big boot. Maggie shows off (giggity) but she misses the moonsault. Corner bumps from Stone, Jada off the second rope with an arm drag! Area Code Jones from Jada and she is fired up! Stone to the top, but she is caught by Maggie. Roll through counter by Jada for a two, but Maggie hits the SUPERKICK! Both women follow the other into the ropes and counter one another. Stone hits the Spark Stunner, but Maggie rolls out of bounds. Stone heads to the top rope and hits a moonsault, but Mr. Elegance ends up taking the brunt of it. Jada attacks Heather from behind and Stone hits Maggie with a Spanish Fly from the steps! Heather in the ring and she argues with Paige the Ref. Maggie asks Mr. Elegance for her title belt, but he says I QUIT and leaves. Okay then? Counter sequence ensues and Maggie plants Stone with her Tombstone for the win. WINNER: M by Elegance (And still!) TIME: 6:40 THOUGHTS: The match itself was fine, but the ending and the drama of Mr. Elegance allegedly quitting the Brand didn’t need to happen here. It took away from the match in and of itself.

body: Austin Creed and Kofi Kingston, the former WWE stars now performing together as The New Level, have reportedly signed five-year contracts with All Elite Wrestling (AEW). The reported agreements signal a long-term commitment between the two veteran performers and the promotion following their high-profile arrival at AEW All In: London 2026. Both wrestlers have agreed to five-year deals. The news offers a clearer picture of AEW’s plans for the duo, who left WWE earlier this year after spending years establishing themselves as members of The New Day. Although the pair’s AEW arrival was widely anticipated, the reported contract length suggests their new chapter is intended to extend well beyond their initial appearance. The reported five-year agreements are a significant development for The New Level. Under their former WWE identities, Xavier Woods and Kofi Kingston built a reputation as one of the company’s most successful and recognizable tag teams. Their move to AEW gives them an opportunity to continue competing together while introducing themselves to a different audience under a new team name. The reported contract length also provides a clearer indication of how long the promotion could have the pair available for its future programming. However, the full financial terms and other contractual details have not been publicly disclosed in the available report. The five-year duration is the central detail confirmed by recent reports, and further specifics should not be assumed without additional information. Before joining AEW, Creed and Kingston were two-thirds of The New Day alongside Big E . The group became one of WWE’s defining factions of the modern era, combining comedy, audience connection and championship success. Kingston also enjoyed a major singles achievement when he won the WWE Championship in 2019. Woods, meanwhile, captured the King of the Ring tournament in 2021, adding an individual accolade to his accomplishments as a tag-team wrestler. Their WWE chapter ended in 2026 following reported discussions about restructuring their contracts. Rather than continue under revised terms, the pair ultimately departed the company and explored a new opportunity. Their decision attracted considerable attention because of their long association with WWE and the popularity they had built as The New Day. Their AEW signing now gives them a fresh platform to pursue further success as a team. The duo made their AEW debut at All In: London on August 30, 2026, appearing as The New Level alongside Swerve Strickland. Their first outing produced an immediate championship moment. The trio won the Trios Championship Roulette Royale to capture the AEW World Trios Championship on their debut night. The victory gave Creed and Kingston an emphatic introduction to AEW and established their alliance with Strickland as an important part of their initial presentation. The result also demonstrated that AEW was prepared to place the newcomers in a prominent position

body: Cena is expected to provide more details about the competition when he appears on WWE Raw in Brooklyn, including its planned date and location. WWE reportedly wants to ensure the tournament “looks and feels fresh”, with Michaels and Styles brought in as consultants to help shape the project. llm_long: This past Tuesday's WWE NXT on The CW averaged 520,000 viewers while facing game four of the World Series, a potential series clincher for the Milwaukee Brewers that aired on Fox. The figure marked a 20.6 percent decline from the previous week and represented the show's lowest audience since May 19.

NXT drew a 0.09 rating in the 18-49 demographic, which was down 10 percent from last week and tied its lowest mark since August 4. In that World Series game, the Tampa Bay Rays won in the 12th inning to keep the series alive before the Brewers closed it out in game five on Wednesday against AEW Dynamite.

Compared to the same week last year when NXT also went head-to-head with the World Series, this week's overall viewership fell 1.3 percent. The 18-49 rating, however, rose 28.6 percent year-over-year. This marked the third consecutive week and fourth of the last five where NXT posted a year-over-year gain in the 18-49 demographic. The show has now declined versus its 10-week averages, dropping 22.4 percent in total viewers and 25 percent in the 18-49 rating.

title: How WWE Can Revive SmackDown's Creative Slump

body: The Oct. 16 episode of SmackDown was largely blasted as "one of the worst SmackDowns all year." The following week, WWE's fed-up fan base responded by tuning out from the blue brand as the Oct. 23 edition of SmackDown saw a massive 17 percent drop in viewership from that harshly received episode the previous week. Despite a plethora of top talent, including CM Punk, Cody Rhodes, Gunther and Kevin Owens, WWE SmackDown has largely felt lifeless and soul-less in recent weeks. Overall, the show has lacked genuinely entertaining storylines, with mundane women's division rivalries, a boring feud between Cody Rhodes and Randy Orton as well as a lack of appearances from top stars, among other issues. There is no easy solution to all of SmackDown's creative woes, but there is far too much talent on the show for it feel as skippable as it does each week. With Survivor Series and Royal Rumble rapidly approaching, here are some potential ways that WWE can right the SmackDown ship. John Cena Returning To WWE Raw Next Week—What Will He Announce? One of the clearest booking issues on WWE SmackDown is the sheer lack of appearances from many of its top stars. That Oct. 23 episode, for example, did not feature in-person appearances from Finn Balor, Gunther, Owens or Punk, despite their ongoing feuds. While Punk and Owens did appear in a pre-taped segment, that was also true the previous week. In some cases, these types of segments work, but when SmackDown is not featuring its biggest names live and in person, the show's quality tends to take a massive hit. What's more, SmackDown will soon be moving back to three hours temporarily beginning in January 2027. It is difficult to imagine what type of show this will be with an additional hour of TV time tween it often does not feature the show's biggest names. The SmackDown roster is top heavy and lacks depth beyond the main event scene. If WWE's creative team can't find a way to feature its top stars week in and week out, the show is going to struggle to improve when it adds a third hour Penta, the current Mr. Money in the Bank, is arguably WWE's hottest star, with red hot crowd reactions and impressive merchandise sales that have positioned him as a main eventer. The way WWE fans are reacting to him prove that they want to see him as a world champion. The problem is, Penta has virtually no chance of successfully cashing in on Roman Reigns on Raw, as Reigns is expected to face Oba Femi for the World Heavyweight Championship at WrestleMania 43 next April. In that scenario, it's also likely that Femi would beat Reigns, which, in turn, makes it unlikely that Penta would successfully cash in on Femi, either. So, that leaves another option: Penta must move to SmackDown. As one of the most beloved stars in WWE, Penta successfully cashing in on Sami Zayn and winning the WWE Championship could be just what the blue brand needs to reinvigorate it, as long as the timing is right. title: Lil Yachty considers quitting music for WWE, says he wants to wrestle full-time
raw_title: Lil Yachty considers quitting music for WWE, says he wants to wrestle full-time
body: Copied Rapper Lil Yachty has revealed that he is considering making professional wrestling his full-time career, even if it means stepping away from music. In a recent interview with Complex , the Grammy-nominated artist discussed balancing his music commitments with his growing involvement in WWE and said he would be willing to stop releasing albums if his wrestling career progresses as planned. Speaking about his future in wrestling, Yachty said he was actively trying to secure a full-time position with WWE. He explained that if he managed to climb the ranks and earn the money he wanted through the company, he would be prepared to leave music behind. “I won't ever put an album out ever again,” he said, discussing the possibility of transitioning to wrestling full-time. He added, “If I climb the ranks in WWE and get the checks that I want, this music sh*t can kiss me goodbye.” Yachty also spoke about the differences between performing as a musician and working in professional wrestling. He described WWE as a more structured environment, where performers have limited time to communicate with audiences and are expected to follow specific schedules and production requirements. Yachty explained that WWE requires a different level of discipline compared with his music career. He said performers have a limited amount of time during television segments to communicate their storylines and make an impression on viewers. Unlike music performances, where he has greater creative control, wrestling involves working with cameras, producers and strict time limits. Lil Yachty began appearing on WWE programming in April 2026, aligning himself with wrestler Trick Williams. He initially joined the company as Williams' manager and ally before making his in-ring debut against Baron Corbin at WWE Sunday Night's Main Event in September. Yachty has also spoken about receiving a WWE contract before WrestleMania 42. In an earlier interview with Chris Van Vliet, he recalled being offered the opportunity by WWE executive Bruce Prichard. He initially wanted to establish himself as a manager rather than enter the ring as a wrestler.

title: Predicting What WWE Gains and Loses as Shawn Michaels Reportedly Replaces Bruce Prichard

body: Earlier this week, the news broke that Prichard requires neck surgery linked to an injury he sustained in 1991. According to Mike Johnson of PWInsider , he is expected to retire from his full-time role as Executive Director - Creative Writing & Talent after WrestleMania 43. Most notably, he acted as a writer, producer, and Vince McMahon's right-hand man before his release in 2008. The 63-year-old rejoined the creative team as an executive in 2019. Sean Ross Sapp of Fightful Select reported that he would remain with the company as a consultant, but he would work from home when the time comes. WWE is reportedly grooming Shawn Michaels to take on his role. Given his connection to Triple H, this makes perfect sense. More to the point, HBK has been a writer and producer for NXT and a driving force behind the latest crop of young wrestlers. This would be a major change, but it could be the move WWE needs to reshape the company in 2027. Obviously, this is interesting because Prichard is one of the last links to the McMahon regime. The former chairman and CEO still has a lasting imprint on WWE, but we're getting closer to a creative team built entirely by Triple H. That's uncharted territory for the globally recognized purveyor of sports entertainment. However, the company desperately needs some new voices and fresh ideas. Promoting Michaels may not be the most drastic internal shift, but it's a step in the right direction. Similarly, NXT could use a new approach, and AJ Styles has already surfaced as a potential replacement. The developmental brand has undeniably produced a wave of budding stars, but the weekly product has been lackluster. Nevertheless, HBK excels as a coach, and his evident relationships with the wrestlers would make him an exciting addition to the current creative team. He may not have Prichard's years of experience, but he's the right man to usher in the next generation of Superstars. WWE has already improved the pipeline from NXT, but this also ensures this era's call-ups will be handled with even more care. While Triple H is the public face, Michaels is more accessible and hands-on with the talent. The possibility of the two working closely together on the main roster is an intriguing move for the company's future. Conversely, there are certainly some concerns about promoting someone so closely linked to Triple H and the McMahon family. It would be ideal to introduce someone entirely new, with an untainted vision for the product. With all things considered, that was a highly unlikely outcome. WWE will promote someone trusted to steer the ship without changing too much of its time-tested formula. title: Ranking Halloween Havoc's 10 Greatest (and Weirdest) Moments in WWE NXT and WCW History
raw_title: Ranking Halloween Havoc's 10 Greatest (and Weirdest) Moments in WWE NXT and WCW History
body: The concept was revived by the black-and-gold brand as an annual staple starting in 2020 and has been one of their most entertaining shows of the year since then. Prior to that point, Halloween Havoc served as a tentpole pay-per-view for WCW between 1989 and 2000. NXT has kept the core spirit of the event alive by incorporating as many stipulations, spooky elements and colorful characters as possible. It's traditionally the one night of the year where the wrestlers are allowed to let loose and embrace the sheer madness of the haunted holiday. There's been some standout matches and memorable moments at the October classic under the NXT umbrella, but very little has been able to come close to the craziness that ensued at the event during its days as an WCW exclusive. From notable debuts and returns to career-altering performances and wacky gimmicks, these are the 10 greatest—as well as the weirdest—moments in Halloween Havoc history. NXT 2.0 was still in its infancy at the time of Halloween Havoc 2021, which was largely built around the newer names that just debuted on the brand. The night saw Bron Breakker narrowly fall short of dethroning Tommaso Ciampa for the NXT Championship and Toxic Attraction assume total control of the women's division by taking all the titles. Breakker wouldn't win the NXT Championship until a few months later and Toxic Attraction's success was eventually overshadowed by the dominance of Fatal Influence, but one moment from the event that did stand the test of time was Solo Sikoa's debut. LA Knight and Grayson Waller were too busy beefing over who the rightful host of Halloween Havoc was when Sikoa, whose arrival had been hyped up in vignettes in the weeks leading up to it, emerged to make an immediate impact. He proceeded to take out both men in impressive fashion, establishing himself as a one-man wrecking crew in the process. Sikoa has undergone quite the transformation as a character over the last five years, but everything he's accomplished can be traced back to that destructive debut. The New World Order was mere months into their hostile takeover of WCW when Halloween Havoc 1996 rolled around, an event headlined by "Hollywood" Hulk Hogan successfully defending his WCW World Heavyweight Championship against Randy Savage in a heavily-touted WrestleMania rematch. With Savage being the one Hogan betrayed when he turned heel at Bash at the Beach, all signs pointed to him being Hogan's ultimate opponent at Starrcade at the end of the year. WCW going with that match at Halloween Havoc instead left Hogan without an obvious adversary for the their biggest show on the calendar. Hot Rod was fresh off a run as an on-screen authority figure in WWE, so it was certainly shocking to see him jump ship to WCW at a time when they were picking up steam. He walked out in the closing moments of Halloween Havoc to send the message to Hogan that he had another ghost from his past that he had yet to conquer. Piper was treated like a massiv

title: AEW Star Steven Borden Explains When He Decided To Pursue Pro Wrestling
raw_title: AEW Star Steven Borden Explains When He Decided To Pursue Pro Wrestling
body: Borden chose to become a wrestler later than most wrestlers, having his first match just last year in his early 30s. The new AEW star got the wrestling bug when he appeared alongside his father at the 2024 Revolution pay-per-view, which marked Sting's final match in pro wrestling. Speaking on the " Good Karma Wrestling " podcast, he said he didn't want to regret not trying his hand at becoming a wrestler. "Pretty much during Revolution at my dad's retirement match [is when I realized I want to be a wrestler]. Watching him kind of ride off into the sunset and realizing that, you know, my life is going to pass quickly, too, and I'm going to be his age one day, and I could either look back and say, you know, I took the step that I wanted to take, or I could look back and say, 'What if?'" said Borden. "I just didn't want to live with that 'what if' question. So, it was right after Revolution, pretty much." Borden appeared at the Revolution pay-per-view alongside his brother Garrett, with Steven dressed as nWo Wolfpac Sting while his brother was dressed as Surfer Sting. The duo even played a role in the tag team match involving their father, landing splashes on The Young Bucks. Borden made his pay-per-view debut at All Out , when he teamed with Darby Allin, and the Borden brothers are also set to team up at an independent show in November , with Garrett following in their father's footsteps and beginning his own wrestling career.

title: Miz Ends 32-Match Losing Streak

body: Seriously though, is this a step in the right direction for the comedy double act, or will anyone even really notice because their victory happened on a peripheral show? It was actually Wilson who snagged the deciding fall in the match by pinning Axiom, but Miz still celebrated like he'd just won out in the main event of WrestleMania . Why not, eh? This was The Miz's first win in WWE since teaming with Carmelo Hayes to vanquish The Motor City Machine Guns on the 22 August 2025 episode of SmackDown . The wait for singles success rolls on then. For his part, Wilson hasn't won a match since beating Apollo Crews way back on the 29 January edition of Main Event. His last SmackDown triumph? Wins have been hard to come by.

title: WWE NXT Rating And Viewership Drop From Last Week

body: This week’s episode of WWE NXT saw its ratings go down a little bit from the week before. Tuesday night’s show scored a 0.09 rating in the 18 – 49 demographic and 520,000 viewers per Wrestlenomics . These numbers, as always, do not include ESPN Unlimited viewers. Those rating and audience numbers are down 10.0% and 20.6% respectively from last week’s 0.10 demo rating and audience of 655,000. The rating was the lowest since the September 22nd episode also had a 0.09, while the total audience was the lowets since the May 19th episode had 517,000. As a reminder, Nielsen made an adjustment to its Big Data + Panel numbers in late January, and even the original Big Data + Panel ratings makes ratings difficult to compare to pre-change weeks. That said, WWE NXT is averaging a 0.093 demo rating and 617,000 viewers in 2026 compared to a 0.151 and 691,000 for the same time period in 2025.

title: Grayson Waller Shares AJ Styles' Social Media Advice
raw_title: Grayson Waller Recalls AJ Styles Giving The Advice To Not Worry About Social Media Feedback
summary_src: Grayson Waller weighs in on social media. Wrestlers are more prevalent than ever on social media, whether they are just checking what is being said or replying to anyone and everyone.
body: Wrestlers are more prevalent than ever on social media, whether they are just checking what is being said or replying to anyone and everyone. Speaking to Stephanie McMahon on What’s Your Story , Grayson Waller recalled the advice AJ Styles gave regarding social media feedback. “I’ll give you the worst one. The match finishes; they go on social media. ‘This guy is the best. He’s the man.’ AJ Styles gave the best advice ever. He came down to NXT years ago and said, ‘If there is a mean comment about you online, it doesn’t matter. If there is a good comment about you online, it doesn’t matter. Any opinion that matters at any point: Hunter, Shawn, Bloom. Their opinion matters because they are the ones who have done this, and they are the ones who put you in places.’ It’s so hard now not to check because when someone puts you over, it’s the best feeling. ‘Yes, I’m the man,’ but you have to realize, ‘Who is this? They don’t really understand.’ These kids are going through something that no one has before, so it’s hard to understand from their perspective how they feel,” he said. Waller is no stranger to being online, usually throwing shots at his peers. While making the media rounds, Waller gave more praise to AJ Styles for how hands on he is at NXT. You can find his full comments here . If you use any of the quotes above, please credit and link to the original source with a h/t and link back to Fightful for the transcription.

Waller noted it remains difficult for current talent to avoid checking feedback despite the advice.

title: Shiloh Hill predicted to become ‘the guy’ in NXT
raw_title: Shiloh Hill predicted to become ‘the guy’ in NXT
summary_src: Tony D’Angelo addressed the changing landscape of the roster and who he believes will be the next big star on NXT. On the Battleground Podcast, D’Angelo named Shiloh Hill as the next big star on NXT. He praised his work ethic, athleticism and character work.
body: Tony D’Angelo addressed the changing landscape of the roster and who he believes will be the next big star on NXT. On the Battleground Podcast , D’Angelo named Shiloh Hill as the next big star on NXT. He praised his work ethic, athleticism and character work. “I think one person, he’s already starting to turn heads for sure, and he’s actually on Halloween Havoc with me. That’s Shiloh Hill. I think he has a lot of potential and I think he has the character stuff down almost. I’m not going to say he’s got a similar career as I do, but with the Don stuff, that was character-driven work,” said D’Angelo. “And I think right now he’s very character driven, but the side that you haven’t seen, he’s extremely athletic for how big he is. I think he’s a very talented individual who will be the guy at some point. He’s still young. He still has the stuff that he’s got to learn, but I think he’s somebody that will turn some heads in the future.” D’Angelo admitted he had grown comfortable at the top, believing there were barely a handful of competitors who were a threat . He admitted that the roster now has experienced names added with special mentions like Cruz Montana, Grayson Waller, Zilla Fatu and Mason Rook. The NXT star stated that with new challengers emerging, he needs to stay ahead with awareness and preparation. “I think I got a little comfortable on my mountain that I was on because I didn’t really feel threatened, if I’m being honest, by anyone on the roster. There was a lot of people with not a lot of experience. So, I knew that I was going to go in there and whip some a** every time. But now the stakes have changed. The roster has changed. There’s a lot of moving parts. You got Cruz Montana, you got Grayson Waller, you got Zilla Fatu. Whenever Mason Rook comes back, you got him. There’s a lot of people nipping at your heels. So I’ll be more aware and ready for that for sure.” At Halloween Havoc on October 31 , D’Angelo will face Waller for the NXT Championship. Meanwhile, Hill and Naraku collide in a singles match. title: Tony D'Angelo Used Speech Therapy For New Character

body: After he split from the D’Angelo Family, Tony D’Angelo became a new man, standing on his own and showing off a more rugged side. He also sounded a bit different. Speaking to Battle on Battleground , Tony D was asked how he was able to switch up his character from The Don to what fans see now. “I had to go to speech therapy because I had a little bit of an accent. The new evolution of Tony, I had to keep reminding myself and holding my tongue. That was the biggest thing, for sure. I stopped wearing suits. I wanted to just separate myself from that other guy. I was just telling Mark Henry that I also want to show versatility. I can do the character stuff and go that route, but I can also be a badass and fit into that role. It’s just showing everybody what I’m capable of and the powers at be, whatever they want to do with me, they know what I’m capable of,” he said. title: Nikki Bella Goes Off on Men Over Lack of Chivalry After Nasty Airport Encounter
raw_title: Nikki Bella Goes Off on Men Over Lack of Chivalry After Nasty Airport Encounter
summary_src: Nikki Bella is pretty fed up with guys forgetting basic manners, and one nasty airport encounter apparently pushed her over the edge. After getting her ankles repeatedly rammed with a luggage cart, the WWE Hall of Famer had a few things to say about how men should treat women.
body: Speaking on The Nikki & Brie Show , Nikki recalled trying to get through customs in Mexico City when passengers were basically being herded into one line. According to Nikki, one man apparently thought she had cut in front of him and decided to take his frustration out on her ankles. “I told you about Mexico City. I’m literally trying to go through customs. You guys, we were like a herd of cattle that they were trying to put into one line. So people were going in front, whatever. “This guy thought I cut him when I’m just being herded in. He starts to slam his cart into the back of my ankles. “And I look, I’m like, ‘Are you serious?’ And he’s just giving me this look and hitting me. “So one of the officers grabbed me and then let me go right through, which I look back and I’m like, whatever. But I’m like, ew. How gross are you?” That whole mess eventually turned into a bigger conversation about chivalry and basic courtesy. Bella then made it clear that women wanting equal pay and opportunities doesn’t mean men suddenly need to throw old-school manners out the window. “This is chivalry? Like, come on. Even though women are asking to have equal pay and to get the same opportunities, doesn’t mean all of a sudden treat us like a man. You still want to treat a woman as a woman.” And Nikki wasn’t exactly interested in sugarcoating her point. Whether it’s getting off a plane, reaching a stop sign or simply holding a door, she thinks some people need to relearn how to wait their turn and show a little respect. “No, but if you’re going to do that stuff, you’re just a piece of s***. You’re a piece of s*** . Wait your turn to get off the plane. Wait your turn at a stop sign. You know what? Open up a door for someone.” Then Nikki delivered probably the least subtle lesson in chivalry imaginable. As far as she’s concerned, guys really shouldn’t need this one explained to them. “Yeah. If you’ve got nuts and a d***, open the f***** door for a woman. Come on, bro.” Nikki certainly isn’t asking anyone to roll out a red carpet for her. But judging by how fired up she got during the conversation, holding a door open once in a while might be a pretty good place to start. Do you agree with Nikki Bella’s take on chivalry, or do you think those old-school expectations are outdated? Let us know what you think in the comments. body: Tony D’Angelo revealed having to go for speech therapy after ditching his Don gimmick on NXT. The NXT star discussed the evolution of his character from the don persona to a serious, hard-hitting competitor on the Battleground Podcast . D’Angelo explained that the transition involved making several changes to his presentation, including working on his accent and ditching his signature suits to distance himself from his previous character. “I had to go to speech therapy because I had a little bit of an accent. When I started the new evolution of Tony I had to keep reminding myself and hold my tongue and that was the biggest thing for sure. But I stopped wearing suits, I wanted to just separate myself from that other guy. And I was just telling Mark Henry that I also wanted to show versatility. I can do the character stuff. I can go that route if you need me to, but I can also be a bada** and fit into that role. It’s just showing everybody what I’m capable of and then the powers that be, whatever they want to do with me, they know what I’m capable of.” D’Angelo first introduced the gimmick in 2022 with Channing “Stacks” Lorenzo and Troy “Two Dimes” Donovan, and called themselves The Don Family. D’Angelo also discussed the evolution of the NXT roster, noting the influx of experienced talent and how it has raised the level of competition. title: WWE Crown Jewel 2026 Venue Updated to ANB Arena
raw_title: New venue listed for WWE Crown Jewel 2026
summary_src: WWE Crown Jewel 2026’s new venue looks to have been confirmed. Earlier this week, it was announced that Crown Jewel was moving to a new venue but staying in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The ticketing page for the show has since been updated to list “The Venue” (ANB Arena) as hosting the PLE.
body: WWE Crown Jewel 2026’s new venue looks to have been confirmed. Earlier this week, it was announced that Crown Jewel was moving to a new venue but staying in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The ticketing page for the show has since been updated to list “The Venue” (ANB Arena) as hosting the PLE. That’s the same arena where this Saturday’s Canelo Alvarez vs. Christian Mbilli boxing match is being held Tickets for Crown Jewel have yet to be put back on sale. When it was announced that the November 7 PLE was moving away from Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD (King Abdullah Financial District), all tickets were refunded and the announcement stated that tickets would be re-released within 48 hours. If that timeline holds, ticket sales would restart at some point today. Amid a period of turmoil and violence in the Middle East, fans have been questioning whether Crown Jewel would still be able to take place in Saudi Arabia. Airports and other infrastructure targets in Saudi Arabia have faced strikes from the Iran-backed Houthi rebels, including deadly strikes on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh the weekend of October 10-11. WWE/TKO has been monitoring the situation and put plans in place for a backup location in the United States if needed, but TKO boss Ari Emanuel confirmed on October 22 that everything was still set for Saudi Arabia to host the show. TKO held a town hall for employees this week and stressed that safety was paramount to them. “The Venue” (ANB Arena) is smaller than the originally planned location for Crown Jewel. It’s also an indoor arena rather than an outdoor stadium, with that security benefit believed to be a reason for the change. Crown Jewel is set to stream live on the ESPN Unlimited app in the United States and on Netflix internationally at 12 p.m. Eastern time on Saturday, November 7. Here’s what’s been announced for the show so far: Joseph Currier Joseph Currier is a graduate of the University of Massachusetts, obtaining a journalism degree in 2016. Joseph joined F4W during his time at UMass and has now been writing about the industry for nearly a decade. In addition to his work with F4W, Joseph has previously contributed to Sports Illustrated's wrestling coverage. He lives in Massachusetts and is a diehard fan of the Boston sports teams and Liverpool Football Club.
summary: WWE has updated the ticketing page for its November 7, 2026 Crown Jewel premium live event to list The Venue (ANB Arena) in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia as the new host site. The change follows an earlier announcement that the show was moving away from Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD, after which all tickets were refunded with plans to re-release them within 48 hours. The same arena is scheduled to host a boxing match this Saturday between Canelo Alvarez and Christian Mbilli, amid ongoing regional security concerns from Houthi rebel strikes on Saudi infrastructure.

title: Lil Yachty Eyes Full-Time WWE Career
raw_title: Rapper reveals full-time WWE aspirations
body: Earlier this year, rapper Lil Yachty aligned himself with Trick Williams ahead of his championship pursuit. Tagging along Williams' side for the last few months , Lil Yachty is now interested in pursuing his own pro-wrestling dreams. Recently, at WWE Saturday Night's Main Event, Lil Yachty made his WWE in-ring debut against Baron Corbin and lasted five minutes. The two-time Grammy-nominated music artist and producer recently sat down with Complex for an interview. As the conversation continued, Yachty opened up about entering WWE and becoming Trick Williams' manager. When asked about the lessons he could take from WWE into his live music concerts, Yachty claimed that both industries are different before sharing his love for the company. Lil Yachty noted that he's now trying to become full-time with the promotion. "Nah, no correlation. It's so much different; it's so much more militant you gotta be in WWE. This is my show. I call the shots, I make the rules, I do what I want. WWE, it's time, it's cameras… producers. It's so different. It's like militant, and you gotta be on your sh*t… I always talk to wrestlers about this: You just don't have the leeway you have. I can go up there, talk sh*t, f**k up. You got X amount of time and you gotta make everything count, and you gotta captivate that audience. "You don't see them again till next Friday, and you got a real small time in your segment to get your point across, your message across, and be remembered for six more days until next Friday, and hope that you captivated so good that Friday, that, in them six days, you back on TV again. "If you f**k up or you do some bullsh*t, you might not be on TV that next week. It's a lot more militant and disciplined, and I love it, man. I'd like to go full-time; I'm trying to go full-time. I won't ever put an album out ever again," he added. He concluded by claiming that he is able to climb the ranks in WWE and earn enough money, he can kiss his music goodbye. "I swear to God. I will be back flipping, getting thrown through tables and whatever else until my body give out on me," he finished. The rapper has been off television since getting attacked by Baron Corbin during the Sept. 11, 2026 episode of WWE SmackDown.

summary_src: Christian Watson is a legend. This week's Thursday Night Football matchup saw the Green Bay Packers take down the Carolina Panthers with a score of 27-19. During the second quarter, Packers WR Christian Watson went to the hospital after suffering a chest injury.
body: This week’s Thursday Night Football matchup saw the Green Bay Packers take down the Carolina Panthers with a score of 27-19. During the second quarter, Packers WR Christian Watson went to the hospital after suffering a chest injury. Cameras even caught Watson getting into an ambulance. Then, during the third quarter, Watson made his surprising return to the game. Again, cameras caught him getting out of the ambulance. Speaking with reporters after the game , Christian noted that he felt like he was watching WWE during this moment. “I used to watch WWE as a kid, I felt like I was watching WWE SmackDown vs. Raw or something out there. Seeing the cameras on me coming out the ambulance, that was a little crazy. It was a surreal experience, no doubt. Just to go through that and have the fans cheering for me being back out there was definitely exciting.” After returning to the game, Watson recorded 2 additional catches for 13 yards. His total statline for the night was 8 receptions for 113 yards. Christian Watson said he was coughing up blood and broke a rib, but everything else checked out fine at the hospital so he got the OK to play. pic.twitter.com/kHt3QHYE7D If you use any of the quotes above, please credit and link to the original source with a h/t and link back to Fightful for the transcription.
summary: Green Bay Packers wide receiver Christian Watson left Thursday Night Football in an ambulance during the second quarter after suffering a chest injury against the Carolina Panthers. He made a surprising return in the third quarter, with cameras capturing him exiting the ambulance. Watson told reporters afterward that the moment felt like watching WWE SmackDown vs. Raw as a kid and called the fan reaction surreal, before adding two more catches for 13 yards to finish with 8 receptions for 113 yards in the 27-19 win.

title: TNA Instantly Fires Former AEW Star For Disrespecting WWE Partner
raw_title: TNA Instantly Fires Former AEW Star For Disrespecting WWE Partner
body: However, Caster referencing Saudi Arabia in a freestyle rap promo led to TNA cutting all ties instantly and sending the following press release : “During Sunday’s Bound For Glory pay-per-view, insensitive comments were made by Max Caster referencing attacks in Riyadh that killed and injured many people. Making light of violent attacks is wrong. This should never have made it into the show, and that responsibility is ours. Our thoughts are with the victims, their families, and everyone affected. We sincerely apologize. We have removed the segment from replays and our social channels and are taking steps to ensure something like this never happens again. Max Caster will no longer be wrestling for TNA.” TNA cited that the reference to Saudi Arabia attacks was not approved nor is it something they want an association with. Wrestling Observer questioned whether the WWE partnerships with Saudi Arabia and TNA influenced this decision. Caster is known for controversial rap promos, and TNA decided to cut bait after his first one. WWE likely had nothing to do with this directly since they only have a distant partnership with TNA. All that WWE really cares about is having an ally and sometimes using TNA to counter program AEW to hurt their efforts as competition. However, the partnership is more important to TNA as a smaller promotion who gets talent and sometimes financial help from WWE . TNA President Carlos Silva likely did factor in WWE’s relationship with Saudi Arabia when growing upset about Caster’s line. Silva and TNA do not want to alienate WWE or criticize their business relationship with Saudi Arabia. Caster’s promo and all mentions of him were removed from TNA’s social media page earlier today. TNA later made the public statement and confirmed Caster would not return again. Caster and his former AEW tag team partner Anthony Bowens have been rumored to have WWE interest once it became apparent that they were hitting free agency. The Acclaimed team could have been an easy act to bring to WWE. Bowens has been the name more linked to WWE , and it makes more sense now with Caster’s controversial persona. Any chances of WWE signing Caster are likely done since they make so much money from Saudi Arabia and try to refrain from answering the safety concerns. Caster will now have to move around the independent circuit and hope that AEW eventually wants him back. Bowens getting signed by WWE would create even worse news for him since the potential of a tag reunion is his biggest bargaining chip for AEW . Caster tried to rock the boat with a controversial promo and instead just hurt his own career. Joey Haverford Joey Haverford is a seasoned sports content writer with over 12 years of experience.
