title: Maria Kanellis Finds New Path After AEW Exit
raw_title: Former WWE/AEW Star Maria Kanellis Ruminates On Future
summary_src: Former WWE and AEW star Maria Kanellis ruminated on her future and a possible return to the wrestling industry.
body: WWE Former WWE and AEW star Maria Kanellis accomplished much throughout her time in the professional wrestling industry, from winning titles, to being dubbed "The First Lady of ROH." She's taken a step back from the business, however, following her AEW departure in January last year . Since then, she's taken care of her health , and she's happily working as an event planner and florist in Nashville, in addition to being a mother. During an interview on " Insight with Chris Van Vliet ," Kanellis revealed that after her rather unceremonious exit from Tony Khan's company, she spent a few years wondering just what was next. "Because I was in AEW and I was in ROH and I had a tumor and I had skin cancer and I had this and I had that," Kanellis said. "So, it was a lot of self-reflection. Luckily, I have a husband that's just allowed me to take my time to figure out, 'What do I want to do next?' I finally have found something, So, now I'm all in, but before that, it was very much like, 'Eh. I don't know. I don't know. I miss performing and I miss this.' It was really hard." As for her future, Kanellis was once again adamant she hasn't closed the door on returning to wrestling , something she's been open about before. She mentioned a common troupe when it comes to retirement, that in wrestling, you just never know. "I haven't closed the door, but it's not always up to the person," she said. "Wrestling, probably not, unless it's like the Royal Rumble or another Evolution pay-per-view or something like that. But, consistently wrestling? Probably not."
summary: Former WWE, AEW and ROH performer Maria Kanellis has stepped away from wrestling since leaving AEW in January 2023. She now works as an event planner and florist in Nashville while raising her children and focusing on her health after battles with a tumor and skin cancer. In a recent interview, Kanellis discussed the period of self-reflection that followed her departure and how her husband supported her while she decided on her next steps.

title: Tammy Sytch Risks Longer Prison Sentence After Attempt to Overturn DUI Manslaughter Conviction
raw_title: Tammy Sytch Risks Longer Prison Sentence After Attempt to Overturn DUI Manslaughter Conviction
summary_src: Tammy “Sunny” Sytch is trying to blow up the conviction that put her behind bars, but that move could seriously backfire. The WWE Hall of Famer has now been warned that challenging her case could leave her facing even more prison time.
body: According to PWInsider , Sytch filed a motion earlier this month seeking to have her conviction thrown out over what she claims was ineffective assistance from her defense attorney. She wants the court to take another look at the circumstances surrounding the March 2022 crash that killed 75-year-old Julian Lasseter . One of Sytch’s biggest arguments is that her defense didn’t properly investigate whether the crash itself legally caused Lasseter’s death. She pointed to medical information obtained through civil discovery and argued that his pre-existing health problems and other factors should have been investigated before she entered her plea. Sytch claims those records showed Lasseter had a history that included coronary artery disease and other serious medical conditions. She also pointed to toxicology findings and injuries she says were consistent with CPR being performed at the scene. She also raised another pretty major issue involving the prosecution. Sytch claims her defense failed to discover that lead Assistant State Attorney Ashley Terwilliger was married to physician Zachary Terwilliger, who declared Lasseter’s death, and argued that her attorney should have investigated whether that relationship created a potential conflict. Sytch ultimately asked the court for an evidentiary hearing, new counsel if necessary and additional discovery. More importantly, she wants her current judgment and sentence vacated, with the possibility of getting a new trial or some other form of post-conviction relief. There’s just one problem: her first attempt already got shot down. On October 21, Volusia County Circuit Court Judge Christian Miller dismissed Sytch’s motion as “facially insufficient.” The problem wasn’t necessarily the substance of all her claims — the filing failed to satisfy Florida’s procedural requirements, including having the necessary sworn statements concerning the truth of the motion and her ability to understand English. And that came with one hell of a warning. Miller told Sytch that if she eventually succeeds in getting her negotiated plea tossed out, prosecutors would no longer be bound by that deal. That means charges that were previously dropped could potentially come back into play. If Sytch went to trial again and was convicted on all of the original charges, the court noted she could face as much as 26 years behind bars — longer than the 17 years and six months she originally received . So Sytch now has a pretty serious decision to make. She can continue fighting the dismissal and potentially reopen the case, or she can abandon the claims and avoid putting her existing sentence at risk. That’s a pretty wild gamble considering Sytch is already years into her sentence. Getting the conviction overturned would obviously be a massive win for her, but reopening the door also means prosecutors could potentially come back looking for the punishment they originally wanted. title: WWE Reportedly Interested In Signing AEW Star
raw_title: WWE Reportedly Interested In Signing AEW Star
body: WWE could be preparing to pursue another AEW talent, with a new report suggesting that the company is interested in signing Dralistico once his current contract expires. According to WrestleVotes Radio on Fightful Select, WWE is expected to express interest in the Mexican star if he becomes available later this year. Dralistico’s existing AEW contract is reportedly set to expire in December 2026, potentially opening the door for discussions about his future. The report indicates that WWE officials believe Dralistico could be a valuable addition to both the company’s main roster and its AAA operation. His experience in lucha libre and established reputation within the Mexican wrestling scene are reportedly viewed as significant advantages. Dralistico is also said to have support from individuals currently working within WWE. That backing is reportedly unsurprising given his existing relationships with several members of the roster, particularly his brother, Dragon Lee. The potential interest comes as WWE continues to explore opportunities involving established international talent, with Dralistico’s background making him a possible fit for multiple parts of the company’s wrestling operations. Dralistico has been associated with AEW and the La Facción Ingobernable group alongside RUSH, although questions have recently emerged regarding their respective futures with the promotion. Despite the reported interest, there is currently no indication that WWE has reached an agreement with Dralistico or that negotiations are underway. His contractual status remains an important factor, with WWE reportedly expected to monitor developments as December approaches. It also remains unclear whether Dralistico intends to explore free agency or pursue a new agreement with AEW when his current deal comes to an end. For now, Dralistico remains under contract with AEW, but his reported availability at the end of 2026 could make him a name to watch as WWE evaluates potential additions to its roster.
summary: WWE could be preparing to pursue another AEW talent, with a new report suggesting that the company is interested in signing Dralistico once his current contract expires. Per WrestleVotes Radio on Fightful Select, WWE is likely to express interest in the Mexican star if he becomes available later this year.

title: WWE To Air Taped SmackDown Against AEW Dynamite On New Year's Day
raw_title: Update On AEW Dynamite Going Head-To-Head With WWE Smackdown On New Year’s Day
body: AEW Dynamite will air on New Year’s Day against WWE Smackdown, and a new report has an update on WWE’s plans for the matter. As announced late last week, AEW is presenting its New Year’s Smash episodes of Dynamite and Collision on Friday, January 1st and Saturday, January 2nd instead of the usual Wednesday and Saturday. That of course will pit Dynamite against WWE Smackdown. WrestleVotes Radio on Fightful Select reports that a source in WWE has indicated that the company is not changing its taping schedule, which called for the New Year’s Day episode of WWE Smackdown to be taped on December 28th alongside a live episode of Raw. The source noted that WWE intends to stick to that plan regardless of AEW’s plans, which means that the AEW Dynamite episode will be up againsta taped Smackdown. It was added that there is an internal speculation that the holiday episode of Smackdown would likely draw a lower number than the usual live broadcast could be, whether it was going up against a live episode of AEW Dynamite or not. The New Year’s Smash episode of AEW Dynamite is taking place at the Gateway Arena in Atlanta, Georgia. Meanwhile, the Raw & Smackdown taping on December 28th is at the Benchmark International Arena in Tampa, Florida.
summary: AEW will air a live New Year's Smash episode of Dynamite on Friday, January 1 against WWE SmackDown. Per Fightful Select, WWE is keeping its current taping schedule and will air the SmackDown episode taped on December 28 alongside a live Raw. The company expects the pre-taped holiday SmackDown to draw lower numbers regardless of the head-to-head matchup.

The Venue is set to host the boxing fight between Canelo Alvarez and Christian Mbilli on Saturday, October 31. Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport has been closed or running limited flights for much of October after attacks by the Houthis in Yemen on October 10.

title: Blake Monroe Questions Herself During Five-Month SmackDown Wait
raw_title: Blake Monroe admits five-month wait for WWE SmackDown debut made her question herself
summary_src: Blake Monroe opened up about the five month wait in her WWE SmackDown debut. On Busted Open Radio, Monroe cited the delay as frustrating, as she was eager to perform in front of the WWE audience and showcase her abilities.
body: Blake Monroe opened up about the five month wait in her WWE SmackDown debut. On Busted Open Radio, Monroe cited the delay as frustrating, as she was eager to perform in front of the WWE audience and showcase her abilities. Monroe also reflected on moments of self-doubt during the wait but explained how she continued to pitch ideas, work hard, and remain ready until she finally got her opportunity. “I love to work. I love to be out in front of the crowd. I love to win people over, and I can’t do that if I’m not out there. So I was chomping at the bit for five months dying to get out there, and I know better than anyone else that timing is everything. I’ve achieved things in my career that would not have happened if I didn’t fail 10 times before and that’s so many different things, big and small.” “So I knew in my heart, timing is everything, but it does get to a point months in where you’re thinking, ‘Alright, I train, I go to the gym every day, I dress like a million bucks, I have my character, I have ideas. I want to be out there. I see other girls I think I could be better than them. I think if I had the shots they had and the opportunities they had, I would have done more with it.’” “There is that natural hunger and desire, and it can get to a point where you question yourself and think, ‘Why is this not happening for me?’ But ultimately, it’s such a huge machine, there’s so many moving parts. There’s unpredictable factors like injuries and other things that shift around. For me, it was just every single week turning up and saying, ‘I’m ready for this. Here’s 20 different things I want to do on the show until one of them sticks,’ and it did. Now I feel like I’m on the show and you can’t ignore me. You cannot keep me in the back for another week. You cannot look at me and my peers and not use me now.” “I did have moments where I questioned myself, so let that be a lesson to everyone out there. Even The Glamour questions herself, but I remembered who I am, what I did to get here, and I just kept working harder.” Monroe debuted on NXT in June 2025 after a two-year stint with AEW. A teaser vignette aired in April to build anticipation for her main roster debut. Monroe eventually made her in-ring debut on the October 2 episode of SmackDown, facing Giulia. She followed that up with a Street Fight last week, picking up the victory. title: Paul Heyman Eyed For More WWE TV Time
raw_title: Backstage News On Paul Heyman's Potential Return To WWE TV
summary_src: Paul Heyman, who has made sporadic appearances on WWE television in recent months, could soon return with a reportedly new storyline.
body: WWE Paul Heyman could soon be appearing on WWE television more frequently, according to reports. Heyman has made sporadic appearances on WWE television over the last few months, mostly in segments involving The Vision, and before that Oba Femi. " Fightful Select " has now reported that the WWE Hall of Famer is on WWE's creative team's radar and is expected to return to television soon. According to the outlet, Heyman may not be entirely focused on The Vision's storylines upon his return, with reports suggesting he could take on something fresh, but he would still be intertwined with the group featuring Bron Breakker and co. The report added that Heyman would remain associated with The Vision, particularly Breakker. On the October 12 edition of "WWE Raw," Heyman seemed to offer his services to King of the Ring winner Oba Femi after praising him effusively . Femi rejected the offer and is still awaiting his world title opportunity, which he earned by winning the 2026 men's King of the Ring tournament. That could set up a match against current WWE World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns, whose history with Paul Heyman could once again come into focus if Heyman gets involved, especially with The Bloodline also reforming.
summary: Per Fightful Select, WWE Hall of Famer Paul Heyman is on the creative team's radar and expected to appear on television more regularly in the near future. While he will remain connected to The Vision and specifically Bron Breakker, he could also be given fresh storylines upon his return. Heyman recently offered his services to Oba Femi on the October 12 episode of Raw after praising the King of the Ring winner, who turned him down.

title: It's Over for Joe Hendry in WWE
raw_title: It's Over for Joe Hendry in WWE
body: By Shawn Van Horn Published Oct 30, 2026, 8:53 AM EDT Shawn Van Horn is a Features Writer & Editor for The Sportster. He is also a Senior Author for Collider. Shawn has followed pro wrestling for most of his life is well-versed in current events of WWE and AEW. He lives in small town Ohio, where he likes to watch rasslin' and movies. Sign in to your TheSportster account When Joe Hendry signed with WWE last year, it was seen as a huge get for the company. After all, Hendry's character is perfect for sports entertainment. He became a viral sensation in TNA and was one of the most over stars in their crossover with NXT. WWE seemed to see big things for Hendry , even making him the NXT Champion. But after a hot start on the main roster, it has all fallen apart. First came the awkward segments, and now, after a humiliating 32-second loss to Bronson Reed on Main Event, there could be no coming back. Joe Hendry is done in WWE. Joe Hendry offers something unique that other superstars don't do. Sure, he's not the first guy to ever bring a guitar to the ring to sing songs, but unlike Elias, who was a heel ripping on the crowd , Henry uses his talent to tear down his bad guy opponents. And he's good at it. Without WWE interference, there's nothing corny about his songs. They're actually really catchy and have lost nothing from what made Hendry a star on the indie scene. Hendry is a rare comedy gimmick who can be taken seriously to actually win matches. The guy was not only an NXT Champion but a TNA Champion as well. Perhaps he wasn't on the level of a Roman Reigns or Cody Rhodes in WWE, yet there was a realistic hope that he'd be a top midcard star for years to come. Instead of going in that direction, WWE put Hendry with Danhausen (because, like, they're both funny, you know) for a Raw in-ring segment which was among the worst in recent memory. There's also been a never-ending feud with the Judgment Day, with the joke run into the ground that JD McDonagh has a big head. It's more proof that when WWE finds something that works, they'll run it into the ground until fans no longer care. It's getting bad for Joe Hendry on Raw. On October 19, he lost a stupid, overbooked "comedy" match against McDonagh on Raw . Things only got worse this week when he was fed to Bronson Reed. Now, losing to Reed isn't a bad thing. The man's a beast, and only a select few wrestlers should be booked to be on his level. It's how Hendry lost, however, that's so concerning. Their match happened on Main Event, a show no one watches, and Hendry was destroyed in just 32 seconds. That's a former TNA and NXT Champion unable to rise to the occasion whatsoever. Recently, Hendry sat down with TV Insider , where he spoke about the potential he knows he has. "I’m just always looking to get better at what I do. I know in my heart that I can be a top draw for WWE. I know people have things to say about that, but the truth is I know that I can be a top guy, I know that I can be an asset to the pr

With his deal reportedly running through December 2026, the Mexican star’s future has become an interesting talking point as the year approaches its conclusion. According to a report by WrestleVotes Radio on Fightful Select that emerged on October 29, WWE is expected to show interest in Dralístico once his contractual availability becomes clearer. However, there has been no official announcement confirming that WWE has approached him, made an offer, or reached an agreement. The possibility of a move would give Dralístico an opportunity to enter a new chapter of his career, potentially reuniting him with his brother, Dragon Lee, who is already part of WWE. His AEW agreement is believed to extend into December, meaning that the coming weeks could provide a clearer picture of whether he remains with the promotion or explores opportunities elsewhere. WWE’s reported interest does not necessarily mean that a deal is imminent. The promotion would first need to establish his availability and determine whether bringing him into its roster fits its plans. Dralístico has experience competing in several major wrestling promotions and brings a recognizable lucha libre style. His combination of aerial offense, agility, and experience in tag team and faction competition could make him an interesting addition to WWE’s international talent pool. The possibility of WWE pursuing him also raises questions about where he would fit into the company’s structure. He could potentially compete in NXT, work with WWE’s AAA partnership, or eventually become part of the main roster. For now, those possibilities remain speculative rather than confirmed creative plans. Dralístico added to the discussion surrounding his future on October 19 when he shared on his X account , an AI-generated image showing himself sitting in a jail cell. The luchador accompanied the image with the caption, “Maybe not for long?” The post quickly attracted attention from wrestling fans, many of whom interpreted it as a possible hint that he could be preparing to leave AEW when his contract expires. However, Dralístico did not explicitly announce his departure or confirm that he was seeking a move to WWE. The image and caption should therefore be treated as a tease rather than an official statement about his contractual intentions. title: WWE Crown Jewel Moves to New Riyadh Venue
raw_title: WWE Crown Jewel lists new venue, Saudi Arabia claims it intercepted a drone
summary_src: WWE Crown Jewel has a listed venue after a change earlier this week.
body: WWE Crown Jewel has a listed venue after a change earlier this week. The November 7 event in Riyadh, originally scheduled for Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD, is now listed for The Venue . The new location is the same arena where Saul ‘Canelo’ Alvarez and Christian Mbilli are having their fight this Saturday and the location of the postponed Six Kings Slam tennis event. Riyadh Season announced a venue change earlier this week, although specifics of why Crown Jewel was moved were not disclosed. On Friday, Saudi Arabia stated it intercepted a drone that was launched by the Iran-backed Houthis toward Mecca, which the Houthis have denied. Yahya Saree, speaking on behalf of the Houthis, denied Mecca as a target and stated that its military operations are “aimed at Saudi oil facilities and military bases.”
summary: WWE Crown Jewel on November 7 in Riyadh has been relocated from Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD to The Venue. The new arena previously hosted a boxing match this weekend and was slated for the postponed Six Kings Slam tennis event. Riyadh Season announced the venue switch earlier in the week without providing a reason, the same day Saudi Arabia reported intercepting a Houthi drone aimed at Mecca.

title: Blake Monroe Says Injuries Delayed Her SmackDown Start
raw_title: Blake Monroe On Lack Of WWE Main Roster Matches: 'Injuries Changed A Lot Of Things'
summary_src: Blake Monroe has discussed her lengthy wait to make her in-ring debut on the main roster, with the WWE star admitting that it was a frustrating period.
body: WWE/YouTube Blake Monroe has spoken about her frustration over injuries preventing her from getting off to a strong start on "WWE SmackDown." Monroe's vignettes began airing for her "SmackDown" debut as early as April , but her in-ring debut came only in October, as injuries paused her in-ring action. Speaking to " Busted Open ," she explained that she found it difficult to adjust to the lack of in-ring action on the main roster. "NXT brings in big names and also has a lot of homegrown talent. So in that capacity, every week I was used, every week there was something for me and, you know, I contributed a lot, but they also had so much for me," she began. "SmackDown wanted me and they made a play for me, and I do think injuries changed a lot of things. And it's just finding the right moment to debut someone like Blake Monroe. I'm not somebody that you just throw out there. I'm not somebody that will ever get lost in the shuffle. I'm not just the next girl. I'm 'the girl,' and I think it was all about waiting for the right time, the right story, the right opponent to show that I'm not just a pretty face and a big character, I can actually go in the ring." Monroe believes Giulia was the right opponent for her , as it allowed her to showcase her in-ring ability and prove she's more than just a pretty face. She is confident that the future is bright for her on the main roster and believes she's destined to become a world champion soon. "And I think to me the only way is up, and in those five months, although I wasn't on TV a lot, I learned a lot, and I'm very smart, and now I know what to do next, and now I know how I'm going to be World Champion very soon," added the former AEW star. She also acknowledged that timing plays an important role in pro wrestling but admitted she grew frustrated during her time away from the ring, as she was eager to showcase what she was capable of.

Her promotional vignettes started airing in April but her in-ring debut was delayed until October due to injuries. In an interview with Busted Open, she contrasted the regular weekly usage she had in NXT with the slower pace on the main roster and noted that SmackDown had pursued her specifically.

title: AJ Styles Could Take Different Approach to WWE NXT Recruitment Than Shawn Michaels
raw_title: AJ Styles Could Take Different Approach to WWE NXT Recruitment Than Shawn Michaels
summary_src: Matt Hardy thinks AJ Styles getting more involved with NXT could bring a noticeable change to the type of wrestlers getting opportunities there. And one group in particular could benefit if Styles really does end up putting his fingerprints on the brand.
body: Speaking on The Extreme Life of Matt Hardy podcast , Hardy and Jon Alba discussed reports that Shawn Michaels could move into Bruce Prichard’s role after WrestleMania 43, with Styles expected to become more hands-on with NXT as a result. Alba wondered whether Styles’ background could affect how he evaluates developmental talent. Unlike wrestlers who came through WWE’s system from the beginning, Styles spent years grinding through smaller promotions before eventually reaching TNA, NJPW and WWE. Hardy believes that history matters. Since Styles came directly from that world himself, he thinks AJ would pay much more attention to independent wrestlers when looking for talent who deserve an opportunity. “I mean, I do think AJ would be a lot more focused on indies than a lot of other guys would be just because he was such a child of the independent scene, you know, when it was all said and done. I mean, that’s everything he was doing. I remember when he was working those small shows back at, God, what was it initially? MCW.” Hardy then pointed to the path Styles took throughout his own career. AJ worked smaller shows before getting an opportunity in WCW, followed by the run in TNA that turned him into a major name and eventually led him to WWE. Because of that background, Hardy believes Styles still has a much better feel for what’s happening on the independent scene. He even thinks AJ would be more willing than Michaels to take a chance on someone coming from that world. “He was so familiar and just so entrenched in all that, you know. Then he got an opportunity to do some stuff at WCW. Then obviously it was out of business, and then there was TNA, and then obviously WWE when it was all said and done. I think he’s definitely much more on the pulse of indie workers, and he would be much more willing to give someone a chance than someone like Shawn Michaels would be because I don’t think Shawn is quite on that same pulse.” Hardy does see another big advantage to having Styles around developmental talent, though. AJ has spent his career adapting to different opponents, companies and wrestling styles, and Hardy thinks that versatility could make him especially useful when it comes to helping wrestlers improve inside the ring. “I think being cool and calm is very important. I also think he was very good at working so many different styles, you know. He can do a little bit of everything, and I think that will be very beneficial. I think he’ll be able to look at people and help them, especially from an in-ring work standpoint more than anything else.” For now, Styles hasn’t been announced as Michaels’ replacement, so there’s still a lot to figure out before WrestleMania 43. But if his influence within NXT really does grow, Hardy clearly sees his years outside the WWE system as an advantage rather than something he’ll leave behind. title: Three Teams Tied Atop NJPW Super Junior Tag League B Block
raw_title: YOH & Hyo, The Swirl, Kosei Fujita & Robbie Eagles tied on top of B Block
summary_src: New Japan’s Super Junior Tag League has a three-way tie in the B Block heading into the tournament’s final weekend.
body: New Japan’s Super Junior Tag League has a three-way tie in the B Block heading into the tournament’s final weekend. Friday’s show in Gifu in front of 921 was the penultimate set of round-robin matches in the block and produced a three-way tie involving YOH & Hyo, Lee Johnson & Blake Christian, and Kosei Fujita & Robbie Eagles with six points each. The three teams won their matches on Friday, including a main event of Fujita & Eagles defeating Francesco Akira & Jakob Austin Young of the United Empire. The story was Akira and Young being on different pages to emphasize the leadership divides in the group. Fujita hit the Thrill Ride on Young and led to the United Empire’s elimination from the tag league. YOH & Hyo defeated Titán & Daiki Nagai after the 3K was hit on Nagai. The loss sent Titán & Daiki to a record of 0-4. The Swirl of Blake Christian & Lee Johnson remained alive with a win against SHO & Dick Togo, with the House of Torture members trying to play spoiler. Christian hit Brainrot on Togo to get the pin and two points. The final A Block matches go down on Saturday with three teams alive in the block. KUSHIDA & Nick Wayne vs. Robbie X & Taiji Ishimori is the top match, with the Unbound Company guaranteed a spot in the final if they win. If Wayne & KUSHIDA win, they will only win the block if DOUKI & Yoshinobu Kanemaru lose their match to Master Wato & KUUKAI. If House of Torture wins and Unbound Company loses, HOT would advance to Tuesday’s final. The winning teams from each block will meet in the final next Tuesday at Power Struggle in Hiroshima.
summary: YOH & Hyo, The Swirl (Lee Johnson & Blake Christian), and Kosei Fujita & Robbie Eagles each sit at six points in B Block after winning their matches on Friday in Gifu. Fujita & Eagles defeated Francesco Akira & Jakob Austin Young in the main event, eliminating the United Empire from contention while highlighting internal group tensions. YOH & Hyo beat Titán & Daiki Nagai, and The Swirl topped SHO & Dick Togo.

title: Paul Heyman Compares Watson's NFL Return to 1991 Sting Angle
raw_title: Paul Heyman reacts to Christian Watson’s WWE-esque NFL moment
summary_src: During Thursday night’s Green Bay Packers vs. Carolina Panthers NFL game, a scene played out that looked almost identical to a pro wrestling angle. Packers wide receiver Christian Watson injured his ribs while landing after a catch and had to be taken to the hospital by ambulance.
body: During Thursday night’s Green Bay Packers vs. Carolina Panthers NFL game, a scene played out that looked almost identical to a pro wrestling angle. Packers wide receiver Christian Watson injured his ribs while landing after a catch and had to be taken to the hospital by ambulance. He was coughing up some blood, but a CT scan showed no internal bleeding. Despite having a broken rib, Watson was cleared to return with some extra padding on the area. He returned by ambulance, exiting through the side door as he came back to the stadium and eventually got back into the game. The moment immediately drew pro wrestling comparisons from fans and analysts, and Paul Heyman likened it to an angle between Sting and The Dangerous Alliance from WCW in 1991. Sting, who would have to forfeit the United States title if he couldn’t compete, appeared in an ambulance at Clash of Champions 17 and still faced Heyman’s client Rick Rude. Sting went through with the match but, with the story being that he was far less than 100 percent, dropped the title to Rude. Heyman tweeted (while promoting his son Jacob’s recently released roundtable with Cody Rhodes, Charlotte Flair, and O’Shea Jackson Jr.): The Packers defeated the Panthers 27-19, and Watson had eight catches for 113 yards. Speaking in a post-game interview, Watson himself compared the way he returned to something he would have seen watching WWE when he was younger. “I used to watch WWE as a kid, I felt like I was watching WWE SmackDown vs. Raw or something out there,” he said. “Seeing the cameras on me when I was coming out the ambulance, that was a little crazy. But I mean, it was a surreal experience, no doubt. Just to go through that and have the fans cheering for me being back out there was definitely exciting.” Joseph Currier Joseph Currier is a graduate of the University of Massachusetts, obtaining a journalism degree in 2016. Joseph joined F4W during his time at UMass and has now been writing about the industry for nearly a decade. In addition to his work with F4W, Joseph has previously contributed to Sports Illustrated's wrestling coverage. He lives in Massachusetts and is a diehard fan of the Boston sports teams and Liverpool Football Club.
summary: During the Packers-Panthers NFL game, Christian Watson suffered a broken rib, coughed up blood and was taken to the hospital by ambulance, only to return later in the game wearing extra padding. Paul Heyman compared the sequence to a 1991 WCW Clash of Champions angle in which Sting arrived by ambulance to defend the United States title against Rick Rude despite being far from 100 percent and ultimately lost the championship. Heyman made the comparison while promoting his son Jacob.

llm_long: During Thursday night's NFL matchup between the Green Bay Packers and the Carolina Panthers, wide receiver Christian Watson suffered a rib injury after landing from a catch and required ambulance transport to a hospital. Watson was observed coughing up blood yet a CT scan revealed no internal bleeding, and despite a confirmed broken rib he received clearance to return after extra padding was applied to the injured area.

He made his reentry to the stadium via ambulance through a side door before rejoining the game, prompting immediate comparisons to pro wrestling angles from observers. Paul Heyman drew a parallel to a 1991 WCW angle at Clash of the Champions 17 involving Sting and The Dangerous Alliance, where Sting arrived by ambulance to avoid forfeiting the United States title and faced Rick Rude.

In that bout Sting competed while portrayed as far from 100 percent and ultimately lost the championship to Rude. Heyman shared the comparison on Twitter while promoting a roundtable discussion featuring his son Jacob alongside Cody Rhodes, Charlotte Flair and O'Shea Jackson Jr.

The Packers went on to defeat the Panthers 27-19, with Watson recording eight receptions for 113 yards in the contest. He added that seeing cameras focused on him emerging from the ambulance felt surreal yet exciting, especially with the crowd cheering his return.

Despite large concerns from fans, WWE doesn’t seem to want to cancel its trip to the Middle East. Crown Jewel will air on ESPN Unlimited at 12 PM ET on November 7, and on Netflix for international fans.

title: TNA Eyes OVW Deal, Considers Xplosion Taping Change
raw_title: Backstage News On TNA Relationship With OVW, Change To Upcoming Taping Format
summary_src: TNA Wrestling and OVW could be moving closer to a developmental partnership, reportedly due to their shared financial investors.
body: TNA Wrestling/X TNA Wrestling is reportedly keen to sign a deal with OVW, while a report has also delved into the promotion's taping plans. Reports from a few months ago stated that TNA and OVW were interested in signing a deal that would see the latter become a developmental promotion for TNA. " PWInsider Elite " is now reporting that the potential deal is likely due to both companies having the same financial investors. The report added that TNA President Carlos Silva has been at OVW events in the past, but not recently. The report also provided some information about TNA's upcoming tapings, with the promotion reportedly considering filming its "Xplosion" shows at The Davis Arena in Louisville, Kentucky. According to "PWInsider Elite," the decision would be purely financially motivated, as it would be cheaper for TNA to tape the shows. At present, "Xplosion" shows are taped at the same venue as "TNA Impact" shows. TNA has a couple more tapings scheduled for the year, with two venues set to host them: El Paso County Coliseum in El Paso, Texas, and the WinSport Event Centre in Calgary, Canada. The Canadian tapings will take place on November 18 and 19, while the Texas tapings are scheduled for December 18 and 19. title: Bruce Prichard Retirement Report Draws Pushback

body: DMFirst Veer Game odds uden om ROFUS Jalwa Game Goa Game Raja Game MaanWin BRUCE PRICHARD, SHAWN MICHAELS, AJ STYLES, WWE EVOLVE AND MORE By Mike Johnson on 2026-10-30 10:00:00 A few weeks ago, there were reporters and people online bemoaning the end of WWE EVOLVE because WWE Main Event was moved to the same timeslot, yet nothing has happened. Thoughts? Nothing was ever happening to WWE EVOLVE. I had some propose to me that EVOLVE was doomed because of the Main Event deal, but when I asked those in WWE, they pretty much dismissed it and said that Tubi is considered a VOD platform, so it didn't really matter. I think a lot of times, there are fans and even those claiming to be reporters who fill up what they believe to be gaps with their own opinions and decide those opinions must be fact, and then claim them as such - and then it gets recited and repeated when there's nothing to the actual original claim. If two people both think the same thing, that doesn't make their assumptions factual. I've seen some push back on your report Bruce Prichard is going to retire after Wrestlemania by claiming he would be working from home, but doesn't that ignore that you literally wrote that in your report? I don't know what the push back is, but not one person in WWE has come to me to say my report was incorrect. Prichard is planning to retire from his current duties and will work from his home as a consultant. That's what I broke, what I reported and I am standing by that report. If Shawn Michaels will take over for Bruce Prichard, what happens to WWE NXT? Obviously, they will prep someone to take over Michaels' role. They have lots of time to prepare and have a deep pool of producers and others who they can consider. I haven't heard that. There's been a general assumption that Styles will get more involved in scouting talents and the WWE ID program, but no one has told me that's officially happening, either. title: Aries Accepts Riddle Challenge for MLW National Openweight Title
raw_title: Matt Riddle challenges Austin Aries for National Openweight Championship at Saturday Night SuperFight
summary_src: 💥 Big Mouths. Bigger Stakes. Aries vs.
body: 💥 Big Mouths. Bigger Stakes. Aries vs. Riddle—Pre-Order on VEEPS! Aries finally accepts as weeks of insults ignite a championship showdown November 7 on VEEPS Major League Wrestling today announced Austin Aries will defend the MLW National Openweight Championship against “Rude Dude” Matt Riddle at Saturday Night SuperFight, Saturday, November 7 at 8 PM ET , live exclusively on VEEPS from Chicago’s sold-out Cicero Stadium. For weeks on Fusion, Riddle has been pressing Aries for a fight. The champion’s response? Insults, excuses, and an emphatic declaration that absolutely nothing Riddle could do would convince him to put the championship on the line. Now, Aries will have to eat those words—or make Riddle regret every one of his. Their increasingly combustible encounters began with Riddle telling Aries that everyone knew he would “smoke” the champion. Aries fired back with a threat to knock Riddle out “any time, any day,” before adding one convenient qualification: “Just not today.” Aries doubled down when questioned by MLW Insider Rich Bocchini, insisting that he dictated the terms of his title defenses and that Riddle hadn’t earned an opportunity. The champion even claimed he couldn’t be pressured into changing his mind, confidently declaring there was nothing Riddle could do to secure a title shot. That confidence cracked during their latest confrontation on Fusion. After the self-proclaimed “Phantom of the Opera Cup” dismissed the remaining tournament field as competitors fighting to finish second, Riddle stepped into the interview and reminded Aries that their paths could still cross. Aries responded by mocking Riddle’s MMA background, boasting about training in MMA, and invoking his purported friendship with certain fight promoters. Riddle had heard enough. He challenged Aries to put the National Openweight Championship on the line before the Opera Cup could settle their differences. When Aries attempted to walk away, Riddle’s parting insult brought the champion right back. Suddenly, the man who refused to be pressured was agreeing to the very fight he had insisted would never happen. “You and me, SuperFight. It’s on,” Aries declared, promising to embarrass his challenger. Riddle’s response was considerably shorter: “Thanks, bro.” Now the verbal sparring gives way to a championship fight with consequences far beyond bruised egos. Riddle brings punishing strikes, submission expertise, and the confidence of a fighter who has been demanding this opportunity. Aries brings a ruthless technical arsenal, a dangerous brainbuster, and a willingness to exploit any opening to keep his gold. Has Riddle baited the champion into the biggest mistake of his reign? Or has Aries finally found the perfect stage to humiliate the challenger who wouldn’t leave him alone? SUPER GRUDGES. SUPER RIVALS. SUPER DEBUTS. SUPER TITLE FIGHTS. Watch Saturday Night SuperFight live Saturday, November 7 at 8 PM ET, exclusively on VEEPS . Cicero Stadium is sold out—pre-order now

title: Rohan Raja Praises Bret Hart's Kindness
raw_title: Rohan Raja: Bret Hart Is Such A Sweetheart, I Don't Think Many People See That Side Of Him
summary_src: Rohan Raja details his relationship with Bret Hart. As it turns out, Hart has a solid foundation with a number of independent wrestlers in Canada. One of those performers is Rohan Raja, an emerging talent that is currently making waves in Maple Leaf Pro.
body: As it turns out, Hart has a solid foundation with a number of independent wrestlers in Canada. One of those performers is Rohan Raja, an emerging talent that is currently making waves in Maple Leaf Pro. Speaking with Fightful Overbooked’s In The Weeds podcast, Raja talked about his connection with Hart. “I first met Bret when I worked a dungeon show, Dungeon Wrestling. His son runs it in Calgary. That was around 2023, I wrestled Chris Masters at the time. That was the first kind of proper time I met him. Every time I’ve been back there, we’ve developed a nice connection. One of my best friends in the business, his name is Mo Jabari. He’s kind of like Bret’s protege, Bret kind of helps him with a lot of things and stuff. We have that kind of mutual connection too. But yeah, every time I see Bret, he takes so much out of his day just to kind of chill and talk to me and ask me questions. When they say the stuff like don’t meet your heroes, Bret, I have nothing but good things to say about Bret. He doesn’t get enough credit with how much he [cares] — even with fans.” Raja also shared a story about a fan encounter with Bret Hart at his bar, describing him as an absolute sweetheart. “We went to this, he had this Hitman’s Bar of course. It’s a Bret Hart themed bar in Calgary. After the shows, we would go to this section, it’s kind of closed off. As soon as we leave, the fans are in the bigger area. When we start walking through there, everyone’s trying to grab Bret and talk to him. His wife has to come and grab him because she’s like, ‘Bret, we have to go home.’ He stops and talks to everyone. He’s such a sweetheart and I just don’t think many people see that side of him. How he’s asked me even about my family and stuff and how he remembers things, he’s just such a sweetheart.” Also, check out more of our interviews by visiting our main YouTube channel.

title: WWE brings Smackdown to Charleston for the first time ever
raw_title: WWE brings Smackdown to Charleston for the first time ever
body: CHARLESTON, W.Va – The Superstars of World Wrestling Entertainment meet inside the Vandalia Health Coliseum tonight as WWE Smackdown arrives in the Capital City. The show marks the first time Smackdown has ever emanated from Charleston and WWE’s first event in the city since 2023. WWE is hosting a highlight-packed show for Smackdown’s Charleston debut, headlined by three championship matches. In the main event, Undisputed WWE Champion Sami Zayn puts his title on the line against WWE United States Champion Trick Williams. The card also features Nikki Bella challenging Chelsea Green for the WWE Women’s Championship and Rey Fenix defending the AAA World Cruiserweight Championship against Ricky Saints. Ahead of his title match, Saints joined fellow WWE Superstar Blake Monroe at Vandalia Health CAMC Women and Children’s Hospital on Thursday to visit children receiving care. CAMC Women and Children’s staff received a custom WWE championship belt as part of the company’s Season of Giving holiday campaign. Doors open at the Vandalia Health Coliseum at 6 pm, with the show beginning at 7:30 and the national television broadcast starting at 8.

Recent reports indicated that several will expire in the coming months, with TNA expected to begin contract discussions with the affected talents very soon. It is unclear if Lee's deal personally falls under that category. Following her departure from WWE, TNA announced its signing of Lee in November 2024 . The following year, she claimed her first of two reigns as Knockouts World Champion.

title: Saudi Arabia Changes Crown Jewel Venue
raw_title: Saudis say they stopped a drone attack, announce new WWE Crown Jewel venue
summary_src: Earlier this week, Saudi Arabian officials announced that next Saturday’s WWE Crown Jewel premium live event was changing venues within the city of Riyadh. That was apparently news to WWE officials, who’ve made the decision to go ahead with Nov.
body: That was apparently news to WWE officials, who’ve made the decision to go ahead with Nov. 7’s PLE despite attacks on the Riyadh airport by hostile forces in neighboring Yemen, an escalation of an existing conflict stemming from the Israel and U.S.‘s war on Iran. That and similar attacks throughout the Persian Gulf region have led to security warnings from the United States about traveling to Saudi Arabia and other countries in the Middle East. A report yesterday claimed the Saudis made the change to move Crown Jewel from an outdoor to stadium to a “safer” indoor venue. And that does appear to be what they’ve done, as the show is now being listed for an indoor arena in Riyadh called The Venue. Crown Jewel is now planned for the same building that will hold big Riyadh Season events like tomorrow night’s Canelo Alvarez fight, and the rescheduled Six Kings Slam tennis tournament. Without being a military tactician or security expert, I can’t tell you if moving from the larger Riyadh Season Stadium at KAFD (King Abdullah Financial District) to The Venue will increase security, or if this could be related to other issues . I can tell you that the latest reporting from Reuters and Al Jazeera says that Saudi forces in Yemen claim they intercepted a drone attack headed for the holy city of Mecca, which is roughly 500 miles away from Riyadh but is evidence supporting the report’s claim that fighting between Houthi rebels in Yemen and Saudi forces shows “no sign of slowing, and humanitarian agencies warn of worsening conditions for civilians.” WWE’s parent company TKO has reportedly assured talent and staff headed to Saudi Arabia next week that their safety is “paramount”, and we’d heard a security firm would help make the final call on whether the event happens in Riyadh as planned. It would seem that firm has some new information to factor in, but we’ve seen no indication the show won’t go in the KSA next Saturday. We’ll keep you posted. title: Ilja Dragunov Reveals Quick AEW Signing After WWE Exit
raw_title: Ilja Dragunov Says AEW Deal Came Together 'Quite Quickly' After WWE Contract Expiration
summary_src: AEW's Ilja Dragunov has explained how keen he was to join the promotion and how quickly the deal came together.
body: AEW Ilja Dragunov has opened up about his decision to leave WWE for AEW and revealed how swiftly everything fell into place. Dragunov's move to AEW came after a few hiccups with his visa process , and he has revealed to " TMZ's Inside The Ring " that he and AEW quickly agreed on a deal, as the two parties were on the same page about many things. "I don't think that you can find, like, necessarily a point in time where you can say which side, how, and how it came together. I can say it came together quite quickly after my contract expired. That's something that happened in very much of a fragment of a time," he said. Dragunov stated that he felt respected by AEW from quite early on and that he had questioned whether WWE was the right place for him even before his departure. He added that while he enjoyed his time in WWE, his gut instinct told him that his future lay elsewhere. "I felt the respect from the other side [AEW] pretty quickly. I was asking myself if I am at the right place [in WWE] for quite a while already, which doesn't say necessarily anything bad about the years that I spent, the seven years that I spent with the company. But I just was — I mean, I'm so emotionally driven in what I'm doing. I'm always listening to my gut feeling. And what I always try to be is not a hypocrite. So, when I feel like something is not going in the direction that I wanted anymore, it doesn't feel like a place where I want to stick anymore," he added. He decided that there were more opportunities outside of WWE, like AEW, that he wanted to pursue, and he took the chance to leave, ultimately debuting at WrestleDream .

title: In Memoriam: WWE Talent Discouraged From Refusing Saudi Arabia Trip for Crown Jewel
raw_title: WWE Talent Discouraged From Refusing Saudi Arabia Trip for Crown Jewel
summary_src: WWE talent apparently isn’t exactly being encouraged to skip Crown Jewel, despite all the recent talk about people backstage being unhappy with the upcoming trip to Saudi Arabia. In fact, a new report suggests saying no may not feel like much of an option at all.
body: That becomes more interesting because Meltzer spoke with one of WWE’s top stars about the situation. While keeping the wrestler anonymous, he reported that turning down the Saudi Arabia trip is “very much not being encouraged.” So while nobody has been reported as officially refusing to work Crown Jewel, that doesn’t necessarily mean everyone is thrilled about going. Based on what Meltzer was told, there appears to be some pressure within WWE for talent to make the trip rather than sit this one out. That adds some important context to recent claims surrounding Kevin Owens. Jonathan Coachman previously said Owens was one of the names he had been given when discussing wrestlers who were allegedly “furious” backstage over the situation . “Correct. Kevin Owens was one of the names that was told to me yesterday. So I respect that he’s saying something backstage.” Owens is currently set to face CM Punk in a taped match at the Barclays Center rather than at Crown Jewel. However, there has been no confirmation that Owens actually refused to travel to Saudi Arabia or that the Punk match was moved because of any such refusal. WrestleVotes had also previously addressed what could happen if somebody did decide to stay home. Their report claimed talent technically could refuse the trip and give up their payday , but doing so could potentially carry a stigma once they returned to work. “They could say they’re not going, and they won’t get paid, and the rest of their career will be reflective of that. Not the pay, but the stigma — the position that they might find themselves no longer in. They can say, ‘I’m staying home. I’m watching it on my couch. You can figure it out,’ but things may be different when they go back to work.” For all the noise surrounding Crown Jewel, nobody has actually been reported as pulling themselves from the show yet. The bigger question now is how much freedom WWE talent really feel they have to make that decision when one of the company’s own top stars is apparently saying that declining the trip is strongly discouraged. title: Comeback Watch: Christian Watson’s WWE-style ambulance return made for the best internet edits
raw_title: Christian Watson’s WWE-style ambulance return made for the best internet edits
body: Say what you want about the WWE, the AEW, and pro wrestling at any level, but you can draw comparisons between what happens in the squared circle and almost every aspect of public life. I mean, the current President of the United States is a member of the WWE Hall of Fame, but that is a discussion best left to another time. But Thursday night’s game between the Green Bay Packers and the Carolina Panthers gave us perhaps the best WWE-NFL comparison yet. Packers wide receiver Christian Watson left the game — and the stadium — following a catch on a deep ball in the first half. Watson was described as having a chest injury, and not only was he checked out in the blue medical tent, but he departed Lambeau Field via an ambulance for further evaluation. Shortly after halftime, however, Watson was back at Lambeau Field, having been cleared by the medical staff at a nearby hospital. He returned in the same ambulance, this time riding up front, and jogged back onto the field to a loud “pop” from the Packers faithful: That prompted some to overlay the video with audio from WWE matches, like this video here: It is worth mentioning that Watson was diagnosed with a broken rib and was coughing up blood, but he indeed returned to the game and caught two more passes as the Packers defeated the Panthers. The wide receiver finished the game with a career-high eight catches for 113 yards, the highest receiving yardage total from a Packers player this year. But just how close of a comparison was this, really, to the WWE? “It was super dramatic,” said Watson after the game as quoted by the Packers website . “I used to watch WWE as a kid. I felt like I was watching WWE Smackdown vs. Raw or something, seeing the cameras on me when I was coming out of the ambulance. That was a little crazy.” And so close that another member of the WWE Hall of Fame made the comparison himself: Download the new SB Nation app All of your communities in one place. ESPN's Rob Demovsky noted Watson was in the ambulance around 8:30 p.m. local time, then back on the sideline by 9:19 p.m. Even with the injury scare, Watson finished the game with 113 yards on a season-high eight receptions. title: Joe Hendry Blames Logan Paul Injury For Current WWE Slump
raw_title: Joe Hendry Says Injury To WWE Rival Has Put Him In A 'Tough Spot'
summary_src: Joe Hendry is disappointed his rivalry with a WWE star was cut short by his opponent's injury but is motivated to achieve his goal of becoming a world champion.
body: WWE Joe Hendry, after a strong start to his WWE career, is going through a bit of a slump, which he attributes to Logan Paul's injury . Before Paul's injury, Hendry was feuding with The Vision star and notably released a parody song calling on WWE to fire the YouTuber. The former TNA World Champion has admitted that Paul's absence has made it tough for him, but he is still focused on his primary goal of becoming world champion in WWE, which he is confident of achieving. "Well, I mean, you know, I'm in a tough spot right now. So, I was in a feud with Logan Paul. He got injured, so I couldn't take that where it needed to go, maybe do some more songs about Logan. Who knows? Then I had problems with The Vision and The Judgment Day. I got problems with everybody. So, I'm in a tough spot here. I got problems with everyone," he said on the " Michael Fairman Channel ." "But, I mean, for me, my goal is to be a champion in WWE. You know, when I got to NXT and I became NXT Champion, I knew I could do it. I know that I can be a top star in WWE. I have the tools to do it. So, that's what I'm trying to do. I'm trying to become one of the top guys over a long period of time. That's my long-term goal." The Scottish star said that he intends to win a title on the main roster and even has his eyes on the Intercontinental Championship, which is currently held by Chad Gable. Hendry, who is currently feuding with The Judgment Day, particularly JD McDonagh, recently lost to the Irish star on " WWE Raw ," dealing another blow to his goal of climbing the ladder and winning a title. However, these appear to be mere setbacks for the highly motivated star, who acknowledged that he still has work to do before becoming a world champion but is willing to put in the effort .

body: The show kicked off this week with Kit Wil-son making his entrance, followed immediately thereafter by The Miz, who continues to celebrate his 20-year WWE anniversary. Their opponents were former NXT Tag Team Champions Fraxiom, who were coming off a loss to the MFTs on last week’s episode. After some brief tomfoolery from Kit right after the bell, Fraxiom took charge, flying around the ring until The Miz pulled on the middle rope as Axiom went for a springboard. Kit and Miz then worked Axiom over, isolating the masked Spaniard in their half of the ring. Axiom finally got some separation and made the hot tag to Nathan Frazer, who had been doing his best Ultimate Warrior, running back and forth on the ring apron. The pace picked back up, and Frazer went to the top rope for a frog splash, but Kit broke up the follow-up pinfall. A few nearfalls later, Axiom went up top looking for a dropkick on Kit, who was now the legal man. The Miz shoved his partner out of the way and took the dropkick, letting Wilson regroup and eventually roll Axiom up for the win! Reaction: Both teams have been hurting for wins in recent months, so I was curious to see who would get the nod. Fraxiom keeps appearing on multiple brands under the WWE umbrella, so it seems like they’re seen as valuable commodities, but they keep losing. As for Miz and Kit, I’m a little surprised Miz’s 20-year anniversary hasn’t been more storyline-focused. It’s really a testament to Mike Mizanin’s versatility. His days of main-eventing WrestleMania are probably behind him, but he still gives other guys the rub. Kit picking up the pinfall here and having his music play after the match is a small thing, but it probably signals that the purpose of this partnership is to elevate him. In this week’s second match, recently turned bad guy Damian Priest locked up with Ivar. Main Event continued its recent pattern of tag team wrestlers wrestling singles matches without their partners present. Last week it was Lainey Reid, and this week, Ivar flew solo. Since turning on R-Truth recently, Priest has seemed to have his sights set on the United States Championship. As for Ivar, he was wrestling his first televised singles match since defeating Psycho Clown on AAA back in April. The match was hard-hitting and physical from the jump, with the audience providing plenty of oohs and ahhs for some of the collisions. Ivar, perhaps somewhat surprisingly, controlled the match for much of the early going. Momentum shifted when the War Raider came up empty on a big moonsault. Priest, unused to being smaller than his opponents, set up his finishing sequence with a top-rope hurricanrana. Damian followed up shortly after with a South of Heaven chokeslam and rolled tovictory. Reaction: Kind of a weird choice to have Priest fight from underneath after recently turning heel. I get wanting to get him some singles wins to build him up so he can challenge Trick Williams for the US Title, but I think this match would’ve been better

title: Grayson Waller Details NXT Backstage Influence
raw_title: Grayson Waller opens up about backstage role and influence in NXT
summary_src: Grayson Waller’s move to NXT was more than just about him. He detailed his backstage influence and impact on the current and upcoming stars on the brand. On What’s Your Story?
body: Grayson Waller’s move to NXT was more than just about him. He detailed his backstage influence and impact on the current and upcoming stars on the brand. On What’s Your Story? With Steph McMahon, Waller reflected on his initial NXT run where established names such as Tommaso Ciampa and Johnny Gargano played an important role in mentoring younger talent and setting the standard in the locker room. He added that the brand lacks that kind of veteran presence today, with many members of the roster still relatively inexperienced. Waller feels he has stepped into that role , using his own experiences to guide younger talent while also pushing them to raise their standards “We had these veteran guys who took care of us, and now the veterans are kids who’ve been there two years, just because of how the system works. So I’m glad that I can go there and try and help out some of these kids, because it’s at 23 and you’re in WWE, that’s crazy, mentally,” stated Waller. “What a crazy situation to be found in. It’s good that I can go down there and help them out because I’ve been in the same position that they’ve been in.” “At the end of the day, realistically, they’re coming for my spot…That’s what they’re training for. I’m helping them to come and take my spot, but they can’t outwork me. There’s a reason I have this….I tell them to their face, you want what I have take it from me. I go down to training there with Fit Finley, and we do, I run laps around those kids to let them know you can come take it, but you have to take it. I’m not handing you anything, and I think that vibe works well. We’re all pushing for the same goal, but we’re not pushing each other down. We’re working, trying to outwork each other.” In the same interaction, Waller stated igniting healthy competition among the NXT locker room was the reason Shawn Michaels requested him to return to the brand . He reflected on an incident with Carmelo Hayes during their NXT run which hyped him to strive to be better in the ring. (It’s competitive) And it should be. And the ones who don’t. That’s part of the reason Shawn (Michaels) asked me to come back because they didn’t have that fight in them. They’d lost the passion and the energy of knowing. Because when I started, I think Carmelo Hayes is my best example of we were good mates, but I remember a match he had, and he came backstage, and I was next, and he went, ‘Follow that’. But he didn’t do it disrespectfully. He challenged me, and then I went out and I crushed two, and then we were like, ‘Hey, we both raise each other.’ And I don’t think they have that down there at the moment. Right now, it’s not their fault. It’s just there’s so many new guys there at once that they just don’t know what this needs to be for us all to succeed.” Rosanne Raphael Rosanne Raphael is a wrestling writer with over three and a half years of experience covering all things related to the industry. llm_long: Grayson Waller switched from boxing shorts to traditional wrestling tights upon his return to NXT earlier this year. The wardrobe change aligned with Waller adopting a more serious character approach. The adjustment contributed to his first NXT Title victory. Waller told Chris Van Vliet on Insight that he now understands why some viewed him as a joke while wearing the shorts.

He noted that the boxing shorts reflected his fandom for the sport and were intended to create a unique appearance rather than basketball shorts as some assumed. Waller realized the look prevented him from being seen as a serious championship contender.

He decided he needed to alter his presentation instead of repeating the same approach. Waller first wore the tights during the Royal Rumble match. Roman Reigns approached him afterward and told him "Hey, that’s the look. You look like a champion now."

Waller committed to keeping the tights based on that feedback. Upon returning to NXT he determined that elements like leopard shirts no longer fit his evolved persona. Waller stated that the previous vibe represented an old version of himself and that he now feels comfortable being more serious.

title: WWE Crown Jewel Moves To New Riyadh Venue
raw_title: New Venue For WWE Crown Jewel In Saudi Arabia Officially Revealed
summary_src: Just days before WWE Crown Jewel is set to take place in Saudi Arabia, a venue change was made. New details about the venue have been revealed.
body: WWE In just eight days, WWE Crown Jewel is scheduled to be live from Riyadh, Saudi Arabia on November 7. For weeks, there have been questions about the safety of WWE's employees traveling to Riyadh and their safety once they arrived. Earlier this week, an intelligence memo warned of attacks against Americans in "the Middle East and other regions". This comes after the U.S. pulled diplomats and their families from Saudi Arabia . On Wednesday, The Riyadh Season social media account announced that Crown Jewel would be held at a new venue . On Friday, it was revealed that Crown Jewel will now emanate from The Venue , a "modern, multi-purpose indoor venue for world-class entertainment, sports, and corporate events." The website says that it holds over 8,000 spectators and is in the heart of Riyadh, "just minutes from the city's key landmarks." It is 35 minutes from the King Khalid International Airport, which suffered a missile attack that killed 12 people and injured more than 300 . According to Dave Meltzer, Crown Jewel was moved from the previous venue due to safety. The original temporary venue is an outdoor arena and The Venue is indoors. It is also the site of Saturday's boxing match featuring Canelo Álvarez. Earlier this week, Meltzer noted that boxers flew into Bahrain and traveled five hours to Riyadh. People he had heard from relayed that safety has been great. He said unless something major happens between now and next Tuesday , Crown Jewel will still happen in Saudi Arabia. He previously explained the incentives for both WWE and TKO to hold the show there.
summary: WWE Crown Jewel is set for November 7 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The event has been relocated to The Venue, a modern multi-purpose indoor arena in central Riyadh that holds over 8,000 fans and is located 35 minutes from King Khalid International Airport. The change was made for safety reasons according to Dave Meltzer, amid recent security warnings and the U.S. pulling diplomats from the country.

Sytch is currently serving a prison stint in Florida after being convicted in 2023 on a series of charges in relation to the March 2022 death of 75-year-old Julian Lasseter during a traffic incident in Ormond Beach, Florida, including DUI causing death, causing death while operating a vehicle with a suspended or revoked driver’s license, four counts of DUI causing injury to a person, and three counts of DUI causing damage to property. Defendant had slowed her speed and was moving toward a turnaround lane at the time of the collision. While the death of the decedent is tragic, the available criminal case materials indicated that the decedent had no significant physical injuries that clearly explained death from the impact itself. Trial counsel did not conduct an adequate investigation into whether the state could prove that the collision legally caused the decedent’s death.” Sytch’s motion stated that through civil discovery, it was learned that Lasseter had a “substantial and long-standing medical history” including coronary artery disease, stenosis and other serious cardiovascular and internal medical conditions. Civil discovery revealed Lasseter had a substantial and long-standing medical history that included coronary artery disease, stenosis, and other serious cardiovascular and internal medical conditions. Toxicology records showed Adderall and Cialis in his system, and he suffered fractured ribs consistent with CPR administered at the scene.

The motion argues these records raise questions about whether emergency life-saving measures, pre-existing vascular disease, toxicology findings, a spontaneous medical event, or another medical circumstance contributed to or caused the aortic injury, hemorrhage, and death.

title: On the Record: Rusev Responds to Rumors He’ll Join New WWE Faction With Ethan Page and Big Cass
raw_title: Rusev Responds to Rumors He’ll Join New WWE Faction With Ethan Page and Big Cass
summary_src: Rusev is finally ready to get back on WWE television, but one rumored comeback plan definitely hasn’t won him over. In fact, he says he hasn’t even heard about it from WWE — and he’s not sure he wants anything to do with it anyway. Speaking on TMZ’s Inside the Ring, Rusev gave a pretty ...
body: Speaking on TMZ’s Inside the Ring , Rusev gave a pretty encouraging update on his health after spending the last few months away. He confirmed that he suffered numbness in his hands after getting kicked in the head, but said he has actually been good to go for around two months now. “Good. I’ve been out for what, two or three months? I did get kicked in the head, my hands went numb, felt bad, and finished the match. Then I became sick after that. I don’t believe it was related. But I’ve been ready, I’ve been good for two months. I’m just training to go back to TV. I went to NXT and Catch Academy. They called me out of nowhere to go to Hawaii for a live event — of course I will.” That Hawaii appearance saw Rusev wrestle Joe Hendry on October 16 , marking his first match in nearly three months. But despite being healthy and actively preparing for his television comeback, there still doesn’t appear to be a firm date for when WWE will actually put him back on RAW. Then there’s the recent report claiming Rusev will join Ethan Page and Big Cass as a new three-man stable . Rusev was asked directly about that story, and he made it clear nobody in WWE has told him anything about those plans. He also had some fun with the idea itself. Rusev called it “internet booking” based around throwing three heels together, before joking that Page replacing him with another big guy while he was gone doesn’t exactly make him eager to become his teammate now. “It’s very internet booking. We have one, two, three bad guys, let’s put them together. I have not heard anything about this, but also, I don’t know if I’m okay with that either. Like, that guy, I left for a couple of months. I got hurt, sickness, and all that. So Page just went out there and found another tall guy to back him up. Like, ‘F you, bro. You never called me, checked on me. You’re just gonna go and find yourself a big guy? Good for you. I don’t wanna be associated with that.’” Rusev didn’t completely rule out the possibility that the report had been accurate at some point, though. Instead, he pointed out just how quickly WWE’s creative plans can apparently change, suggesting something could be approved one day and disappear the next. “Also, because someone said that they could have been greenlit on Tuesday, but by the time Wednesday night comes, everything could be scrapped. Everything is changing by the hour and day. It all depends on whose mood. Maybe someone got the right report, but then someone said, ‘Oh no, let’s move away from it,’ then they move away from it.” So whatever WWE ultimately has waiting for Rusev, he’s healthy and waiting for the call. After months of dealing with an injury and illness, getting him back on television is no longer about whether his body is ready — it’s about what WWE actually decides to do with him. title: Dave Meltzer Updates On Stephanie Vaquer Illness
raw_title: Dave Meltzer Provides Update On Stephanie Vaquer Illness That Kept Her Off WWE Raw
summary_src: Journalist Dave Meltzer shares more details on the current situation surrounding former WWE Women's World Champion Stephanie Vaquer.
body: Stephanie Vaquer's absence from "WWE Raw" this week is reportedly related to an illness , rather than injury. Still, the timeline for her return remains unclear. On " Wrestling Observer Radio," journalist Dave Meltzer shared more details on the current situation surrounding the former WWE Women's World Champion. "She's ill. I was told it's nothing terribly serious or anything, but she's ill and she's out [indefinitely]," Meltzer said. "Indefinitely in the sense that it's not like it's a week; it's something more serious. I shouldn't even say that, it's something that's indeterminate yet as far as when she'll be back. But that's why they didn't do that match. It wasn't about an injury and it wasn't a worked storyline. They were going to do the match on Monday night, she got sick, and could not come. That's why they did the Becky Lynch-Liv Morgan and that's why they did the DQ [finish] because they didn't want to beat Becky Lynch." Originally, plans called for Vaquer to face Becky Lynch in a match to determine the new number one contender to the Women's World Championship, a title presently held by Liv Morgan. After "Raw" General Manager Adam Pearce revealed that Vaquer had not been medically cleared to compete , they then shifted to a direct title match between Lynch and Morgan in the show's main event. Morgan went on to retain her title due to her Judgment Day stablemates Roxanne Perez and Raquel Rodriguez interfering, and in turn, causing a disqualification. Had Vaquer not suffered an illness, it is unclear if she would have been the one to challenge Morgan instead.
summary: Stephanie Vaquer missed WWE Raw this week due to an illness rather than an injury. Dave Meltzer reported on Wrestling Observer Radio that the situation is not considered terribly serious but her return timeline remains indeterminate. Plans for Vaquer to face Becky Lynch in a number one contender's match were scrapped as a result, leading to the Becky Lynch versus Liv Morgan bout that ended in disqualification.

title: WWE Plans John Cena Classic Details For Raw
raw_title: Backstage Details On WWE's John Cena Classic Ahead Of Presumed Official Announcement
summary_src: More details have emerged about the John Cena Classic ahead of Cena's appearance on WWE Raw, where he could reveal further information about the competition.
body: WWE The John Cena Classic appears to be coming to WWE television soon, with new details emerging about the competition. John Cena announced the introduction of the John Cena Classic at Backlash earlier this year, but details about the competition have been scarce. With Cena set to return to WWE on next week's "WWE Raw" at the Barclays Center in New York , it appears he will use the appearance to provide more information about the event, including where and when it will happen, as per " Fightful Select ." The outlet claimed that WWE's creative team has held several meetings about the John Cena Classic since its announcement at Backlash, as the company reportedly wants to make the competition feel different. Many assumed that the John Cena Classic would be part of the Club WWE membership program, but "Fightful" is reporting that the competition will also be shown elsewhere. A number of people are believed to have been consulted about the John Cena Classic, with the likes of AJ Styles and Shawn Michaels being two names mentioned. Cena offered some insight into his vision for the competition a few weeks ago , explaining that he intends it to serve as a platform for those who deserve an opportunity and that it would move away from WWE's weekly storylines. The 17-time world champion revealed a few months ago that the idea had been fully formulated and kept under wraps until the big reveal . Cena is set to appear not only on "Raw" next week but also on "WWE NXT," where he could handpick a few stars to compete in the John Cena Classic. title: Injury Update: Rusev Says Injury Didn’t Kill His Momentum in WWE
raw_title: Rusev Says Injury Didn’t Kill His Momentum in WWE
summary_src: Rusev doesn’t believe his recent injury killed any of the momentum he had before disappearing from WWE television. As far as he’s concerned, he can come right back, pick up where he left off and continue chasing the championship he’s had his eyes on for more than a year.
body: Speaking on TMZ’s Inside the Ring , Rusev was asked whether he felt the injury came at a particularly bad time considering he had been actively pursuing the Intercontinental Championship before being taken off television. Rusev isn’t looking at it that way. He pointed out that injuries are simply part of professional wrestling, especially with the physical style he works, and his current setback is hardly the first major one he’s dealt with during his career. “I don’t think I can get upset by that. Life is life. It’s a high-impact sport, especially if you do it the right way — things happen. I’ve broken my neck before, tore my knee, shoulder surgery. I don’t think it slowed down my momentum at all.” More importantly, Rusev doesn’t believe spending months away means he has to rebuild everything from scratch. He’s confident enough in what he can do that he expects to simply slot himself back into the mix once WWE puts him on television again. “When you’re good, you’re good. You come back and plug yourself right back in and kick ass and take names. It didn’t slow my momentum at all.” And apparently his Intercontinental Championship pursuit isn’t finished either. Rusev revealed that he’s actually been chasing the title for more than a year and still expects to eventually bring it home. He even joked that the only question is whether he manages to win it before or after welcoming his son, Bear. “I’ve been following the Intercontinental Title for over a year now, and I believe when the time is right, I will bring it back home — whether it’s before my son Bear or after Bear.” That gives Rusev a pretty obvious target whenever WWE finally brings him back to RAW. He may not know exactly what creative has waiting for him yet, but he certainly knows what championship he wants when he gets there. Would you like to see Rusev immediately resume his pursuit of the Intercontinental Championship when he returns to RAW? Let us know what you think in the comments.
